meanings.explanation: To [abolish] a system, practice, or institution means to end it officially.

examples.english: The school decided to [abolish] the old rule about wearing uniforms.
examples.chinese: 学校决定[废除]关于穿校服的旧规定。

examples.english: Many years ago, this country [abolished] slavery.
examples.chinese: 很多年前，这个国家[废除了]奴隶制。

examples.english: They want to [abolish] the homework policy because it gives kids too much pressure.
examples.chinese: 他们想[废除]家庭作业制度，因为它给孩子们的压力太大了。

meanings.explanation: Someone or something that is [abnormal] is different from what is usual or expected in a way that is strange or worrying.

examples.english: The doctor said my test results were [abnormal].
examples.chinese: 医生说我的检查结果[不正常]。

examples.english: It is [abnormal] for a cat to eat vegetables.
examples.chinese: 猫吃蔬菜是[不正常的]。

examples.english: His [abnormal] behavior made his parents worry.
examples.chinese: 他[反常的]行为让他的父母很担心。

meanings.explanation: If something is [absurd], it is so ridiculous or unreasonable that it is amusing or shocking.

examples.english: It is [absurd] that we have to wait so long for a simple answer.
examples.chinese: [荒谬]的是，我们居然要等这么久才得到一个简单的答案。

examples.english: Wearing a heavy coat on such a hot day is totally [absurd].
examples.chinese: 这么热的天穿厚外套真[荒唐]。

examples.english: The movie had an [absurd] plot that made no sense at all.
examples.chinese: 那部电影的情节[荒诞不经]，完全讲不通。

meanings.explanation: The [absurd] refers to something that is absurd or a situation involving absurdity.

examples.english: He loves the theater of the [absurd].
examples.chinese: 他喜欢[荒诞]戏剧。

examples.english: The [absurd] of her complaints made everyone laugh.
examples.chinese: 她那些[可笑]的抱怨让大家都笑了。

examples.english: Life can feel like the [absurd] sometimes.
examples.chinese: 有时候生活会让人觉得很[荒诞]。

meanings.explanation: [Atlantic] refers to the large ocean between Europe/Africa and the Americas, or to the regions bordering this ocean.

examples.english: We flew [Atlantic] waters on our way to New York.
examples.chinese: 我们去纽约的路上飞越了[大西洋]海域。

examples.english: My family drove to the [Atlantic] coast for summer vacation.
examples.chinese: 我们一家开车去[大西洋]海岸过暑假。

examples.english: The [Atlantic] wind made the beach a bit cool today.
examples.chinese: 今天[大西洋]吹来的风让海滩有点凉。

meanings.explanation: The [Atlantic] is the ocean between Europe and Africa on the east and North America and South America on the west.

examples.english: The [Atlantic] is the second largest ocean in the world.
examples.chinese: [大西洋]是世界上第二大洋。

examples.english: A big ship sailed across the [Atlantic] in five days.
examples.chinese: 一艘大船用了五天横渡[大西洋]。

examples.english: Many whales live in the cold waters of the [Atlantic].
examples.chinese: 很多鲸鱼生活在[大西洋]的冷水域。

meanings.explanation: If something [absorbs] a liquid, it soaks it up and holds it.

examples.english: The sponge can [absorb] a lot of water.
examples.chinese: 海绵能[吸收]很多水。

examples.english: This towel helps [absorb] the spilled juice.
examples.chinese: 这条毛巾能帮助[吸]洒出来的果汁。

examples.english: Cotton clothes [absorb] sweat in hot weather.
examples.chinese: 棉质衣服在热天能[吸收]汗水。

meanings.explanation: If something [absorbs] you, it holds all your attention and interest.

examples.english: The exciting story completely [absorbed] me.
examples.chinese: 这个精彩的故事完全[吸引]了我。

examples.english: He was so [absorbed] in his game that he forgot dinner.
examples.chinese: 他[沉浸]在游戏中，连晚饭都忘了。

examples.english: The beautiful music [absorbed] the whole family.
examples.chinese: 优美的音乐[吸引]了全家人。

meanings.explanation: Something that is [abundant] exists or is available in large quantities so that there is more than enough.

examples.english: The apple tree has [abundant] fruit this year.
examples.chinese: 今年这棵苹果树结了[丰硕的]果实。

examples.english: We have [abundant] time to finish our homework.
examples.chinese: 我们有[充足的]时间来完成作业。

examples.english: The forest is full of [abundant] wildlife.
examples.chinese: 这片森林里生活着[大量的]野生动物。

meanings.explanation: [Academic] means relating to education, schools, or the work done at a college or university.

examples.english: She has a very good [academic] record at school.
examples.chinese: 她在学校的[学业]成绩非常好。

examples.english: The new library helps students with their [academic] work.
examples.chinese: 新图书馆帮助学生们完成[学业]。

examples.english: His [academic] performance improved a lot this term.
examples.chinese: 这学期他的[学业]表现进步了很多。

meanings.explanation: An [academic] is a teacher or scholar who works at a college or university.

examples.english: My mom is an [academic] at a big university.
examples.chinese: 我妈妈是一所大学的[学者]。

examples.english: The [academic] gave a very interesting talk at school.
examples.chinese: 那位[学者]在学校做了一场非常有趣的演讲。

examples.english: Many [academics] from around the world came to the meeting.
examples.chinese: 来自世界各地的许多[学者]参加了这次会议。

meanings.explanation: If you have [access] to a building or place, you are able or allowed to go into it.

examples.english: Only teachers have [access] to the staff room.
examples.chinese: 只有老师们有[权限]进入教师休息室。

examples.english: Students can get [access] to the library every day.
examples.chinese: 学生们每天都能[进入]图书馆。

examples.english: We need a key card to gain [access] to the building.
examples.chinese: 我们需要门卡才能[进入]大楼。

meanings.explanation: If you [access] something, you find or get something, especially from a computer or the internet.

examples.english: You can [access] the website from your phone.
examples.chinese: 你可以用手机[访问]这个网站。

examples.english: Please [access] your email to check the message.
examples.chinese: 请[登录]你的邮箱查看消息。

examples.english: I need to [access] my files on the computer.
examples.chinese: 我需要[打开]电脑上的文件。

meanings.explanation: If something is [abnormally] a particular quality, it has that quality in a way that is not normal or usual.

examples.english: This winter is [abnormally] warm.
examples.chinese: 今年冬天[异常]暖和。

examples.english: My puppy is [abnormally] quiet today.
examples.chinese: 我的小狗今天[异常]安静。

examples.english: The river is [abnormally] low this summer.
examples.chinese: 今年夏天河水[异常]低。

meanings.explanation: If a building or space can [accommodate] a certain number of people, it has enough room for them.

examples.english: Our new classroom can [accommodate] forty students.
examples.chinese: 我们的新教室能[容纳]四十名学生。

examples.english: This hotel can [accommodate] up to two hundred guests.
examples.chinese: 这家酒店最多能[容纳]两百位客人。

examples.english: The small tent cannot [accommodate] four people.
examples.chinese: 这顶小帐篷[容纳]不了四个人。

meanings.explanation: To [accommodate] someone means to provide them with a place to stay or live.

examples.english: My aunt was kind enough to [accommodate] us for the weekend.
examples.chinese: 我阿姨很好心，[收留]我们过了个周末。

examples.english: The university will [accommodate] all new students in the dorms.
examples.chinese: 学校会把所有新生都[安排]在宿舍里住。

examples.english: Can you [accommodate] my friend for one night?
examples.chinese: 你能[收留]我朋友住一晚吗？

meanings.explanation: [Antarctic] means relating to the region around the South Pole at the southern end of the Earth.

examples.english: Many cute penguins live in the [Antarctic] region.
examples.chinese: 许多可爱的企鹅生活在[南极的]地区。

examples.english: Scientists study the [Antarctic] ice to learn about climate change.
examples.chinese: 科学家研究[南极的]冰层来了解气候变化。

examples.english: My dad watched a documentary about [Antarctic] wildlife last weekend.
examples.chinese: 我爸爸上周末看了一部关于[南极的]野生动物的纪录片。

meanings.explanation: The [Antarctic] is the cold region surrounding the South Pole at the southern end of the Earth.

examples.english: Many cute penguins live in the [Antarctic].
examples.chinese: 许多可爱的企鹅生活在[南极地区]。

examples.english: Scientists travel to the [Antarctic] to study its cold weather.
examples.chinese: 科学家们前往[南极]研究那里的寒冷气候。

examples.english: The [Antarctic] is covered with thick ice all year.
examples.chinese: [南极地区]一年四季都覆盖着厚厚的冰。

meanings.explanation: An [abundance] of something means there is a very large amount of it, much more than enough.

examples.english: The garden has an [abundance] of colorful flowers in spring.
examples.chinese: 春天花园里[有大量]五颜六色的花。

examples.english: There is an [abundance] of fresh fruit at the market.
examples.chinese: 市场上[有大量]新鲜水果。

examples.english: The forest has an [abundance] of wildlife for people to enjoy.
examples.chinese: 森林里[有丰富]的野生动植物供人们欣赏。

meanings.explanation: If you [accumulate] things, you collect or gather them over a period of time, so that the amount or number increases gradually.

examples.english: I have [accumulated] many books since I was a child.
examples.chinese: 我从小时候起就[攒]了很多书。

examples.english: Dust can [accumulate] quickly if you don't clean your room.
examples.chinese: 如果你不打扫房间，灰尘很快就会[积攒]起来。

examples.english: She [accumulated] enough money to buy a new bicycle.
examples.chinese: 她[攒]够了买一辆新自行车的钱。

meanings.explanation: If you [accompany] someone, you go somewhere with them.

examples.english: My mom [accompany] me to school every morning.
examples.chinese: 我妈妈每天早上[陪]我去学校。

examples.english: Can you [accompany] your friend to the doctor?
examples.chinese: 你能[陪]你的朋友去看医生吗？

examples.english: The teacher [accompany] the kids on the field trip.
examples.chinese: 老师[带领]孩子们去郊游。

meanings.explanation: If something [accompany] something else, it happens or exists at the same time.

examples.english: The music [accompany] the dance perfectly.
examples.chinese: 音乐[伴奏]着舞蹈。

examples.english: Heavy rain [accompany] the storm last night.
examples.chinese: 昨晚的暴风雨[伴随着]大雨。

examples.english: Please [accompany] your answer with a smile.
examples.chinese: 回答时请[配上]一个微笑。

meanings.explanation: An [account] is an arrangement with a bank where you can keep your money and take it out when you need it.

examples.english: My mom opened a [account] for me at the bank.
examples.chinese: 我妈妈帮我在银行开了一个[账户]。

examples.english: I put my birthday money into my savings [account].
examples.chinese: 我把生日收到的钱存进了我的储蓄[账户]。

examples.english: You need a password to check your online [account].
examples.chinese: 你需要密码才能查看你的网上[账户]。

meanings.explanation: An [account] is a written or spoken description of something that has happened.

examples.english: The boy gave a short [account] of what he saw at the park.
examples.chinese: 男孩简短地[描述]了他在公园看到的事情。

examples.english: Please write an [account] of your summer vacation.
examples.chinese: 请写一篇关于你暑假的[记叙文]。

examples.english: Her [account] of the story made everyone laugh.
examples.chinese: 她对这个故事的[讲述]让大家都笑了。

meanings.explanation: The [absorption] of a liquid, gas, or other substance is the process of it being soaked up or taken in by something.

examples.english: The [absorption] of water by this sponge is really fast.
examples.chinese: 这块海绵对水的[吸收]速度非常快。

examples.english: Sunlight helps with the [absorption] of nutrients by plants.
examples.chinese: 阳光有助于植物对养分的[吸收]。

examples.english: The [absorption] of sound by the carpet makes the room quieter.
examples.chinese: 地毯对声音的[吸收]让房间更安静。

meanings.explanation: The [absorption] of information, knowledge, or ideas is the process of learning it and understanding it fully.

examples.english: Slow reading helps better [absorption] of new knowledge.
examples.chinese: 慢速阅读有助于新知识的更好[吸收]。

examples.english: Taking notes can improve your [absorption] of what you read.
examples.chinese: 记笔记可以提升你对阅读内容的[吸收]。

examples.english: The video helped the [absorption] of the new science concept.
examples.chinese: 这个视频帮助了对新科学概念的[吸收]。

meanings.explanation: If you [accomplish] something, you succeed in doing it or finishing it, especially after effort and hard work.

examples.english: She worked hard to [accomplish] her homework before dinner.
examples.chinese: 她努力在晚饭前[完成]了作业。

examples.english: We need to [accomplish] this project by Friday.
examples.chinese: 我们得在周五之前[完成]这个项目。

examples.english: He felt proud after he [accomplished] all his chores.
examples.chinese: [做完]所有家务后，他感到很自豪。

meanings.explanation: If you [accomplish] a goal or dream, you successfully achieve what you planned or hoped for.

examples.english: She [accomplished] her dream of becoming a teacher.
examples.chinese: 她[实现了]当老师的梦想。

examples.english: With practice, you can [accomplish] anything you set your mind to.
examples.chinese: 通过练习，你可以[实现]任何你下定决心要做的事。

examples.english: Our team [accomplished] our goal of raising money for the library.
examples.chinese: 我们小队[达成了]为图书馆募捐的目标。

meanings.explanation: An [invasive] medical procedure involves making a cut or inserting instruments into the body.

examples.english: The doctor said her condition requires [invasive] surgery.
examples.chinese: 医生说她的病情需要[有创]手术。

examples.english: This hospital uses the latest [invasive] techniques to help patients recover faster.
examples.chinese: 这家医院使用最新的[有创]技术来帮助病人更快恢复。

examples.english: Some health problems can be treated without [invasive] procedures.
examples.chinese: 有些健康问题可以通过非[有创]手术来治疗。

meanings.explanation: An [invasive] plant or animal spreads quickly and causes damage to the local environment.

examples.english: The city is working hard to remove [invasive] plants from the park.
examples.chinese: 这座城市正在努力清除公园里的[入侵]植物。

examples.english: Kudzu is an [invasive] vine that covers everything in its path.
examples.chinese: 葛藤是一种[入侵]藤本植物，会覆盖沿途的一切。

examples.english: People should not release pet fish into local rivers because they may become [invasive].
examples.chinese: 人们不应该把宠物鱼放生到当地河流里，因为它们可能会变成[入侵]物种。

meanings.explanation: If you [abandon] a person, animal, or place, you leave them permanently or for a long time, especially when they need you to stay.

examples.english: No one should [abandon] their friends when they need help.
examples.chinese: 朋友需要帮助时，谁都不该[抛弃]他们。

examples.english: Someone [abandoned] a box of kittens by the road.
examples.chinese: 有人把一箱小猫[遗弃]在路边。

examples.english: We will never [abandon] our old dog.
examples.chinese: 我们绝不会[抛弃]我们的老狗。

meanings.explanation: If you [abandon] a plan, activity, or idea, you stop doing it before it is finished.

examples.english: She [abandoned] her idea of becoming a singer.
examples.chinese: 她[放弃]了当歌手的想法。

examples.english: We had to [abandon] our trip because of the heavy snow.
examples.chinese: 因为大雪，我们不得不[取消]行程。

examples.english: Don't [abandon] your homework halfway through.
examples.chinese: 做作业别做到一半就[放弃]。

meanings.explanation: [Academia] is the world of universities, colleges, and academic research, including all the people who work and study in these places.

examples.english: My older sister works in [academia] and teaches at a local university.
examples.chinese: 我姐姐在[学术界]工作，在本地一所大学教书。

examples.english: Many people in [academia] spend lots of time doing scientific research.
examples.chinese: 许多[学术界]人士花很多时间做科学研究。

examples.english: Some top students dream of working in [academia] after they graduate.
examples.chinese: 一些优秀学生毕业后梦想进入[学术界]工作。

meanings.explanation: If something is done [accurately], it is done in a way that is correct, exact, and without any mistakes.

examples.english: Please read the thermometer [accurately] to check my temperature.
examples.chinese: 请[准确地]读取体温计来量我的体温。

examples.english: She can [accurately] count all the stars in the picture.
examples.chinese: 她能[准确地]数出图画里所有的星星。

examples.english: The boy drew the map [accurately] without any errors.
examples.chinese: 那个男孩[准确地]画出了地图，没有任何错误。

meanings.explanation: If you describe or represent something [accurately], you describe or show it in a way that is true to the real facts.

examples.english: The movie [accurately] shows what life was like in the old days.
examples.chinese: 这部电影[真实地]展现了过去生活的样子。

examples.english: Can you [accurately] tell me what happened at school today?
examples.chinese: 你能[如实地]告诉我今天在学校发生了什么事吗？

examples.english: The picture [accurately] describes the beautiful sunset we saw.
examples.chinese: 这幅画[真实地]描绘了我们看到的那场美丽的日落。

meanings.explanation: If you [achieve] something, you successfully get it or reach it, especially after working hard.

examples.english: She studied hard every day and finally [achieved] her dream of going to a good college.
examples.chinese: 她每天都努力学习，终于[实现]了考上好大学的梦想。

examples.english: Our team worked together for months and [achieved] great results in the competition.
examples.chinese: 我们团队合作了好几个月，在比赛中[取得了]很棒的成绩。

examples.english: He practiced running every morning and [achieved] his goal of finishing the race.
examples.chinese: 他每天早上练习跑步，[实现]了跑完比赛的目标。

meanings.explanation: An [absence] is a situation when someone is not present where they are expected to be.

examples.english: Tom's [absence] from school made his teacher worried.
examples.chinese: 汤姆[缺课]让老师很担心。

examples.english: I felt sad during my father's long [absence] from home.
examples.chinese: 爸爸长期[不在家]让我很难过。

examples.english: Please tell the teacher the reason for your [absence].
examples.chinese: 请告诉老师你[缺席]的原因。

meanings.explanation: An [absence] of something is a situation when that thing does not exist or is not available.

examples.english: There was an [absence] of food in the fridge.
examples.chinese: 冰箱里[缺少]食物。

examples.english: The [absence] of sunlight made the room dark.
examples.chinese: 房间里[缺少]阳光，很暗。

examples.english: She showed an [absence] of care when she broke the toy.
examples.chinese: 她弄坏玩具时显得[缺少]细心。

meanings.explanation: If a place or building is [accessible], it is easy to reach or enter.

examples.english: This [accessible] beach is just five minutes' walk from here.
examples.chinese: 这片[容易到达的]海滩离这里走路只要五分钟。

examples.english: This museum is fully [accessible] to wheelchair users.
examples.chinese: 这家博物馆对轮椅使用者是完全[无障碍的]。

examples.english: The only [accessible] path to the lake is this one.
examples.chinese: 通往湖边唯一[可通行的]小路就是这条。

meanings.explanation: If something such as information or service is [accessible], it is easy to obtain, use, or understand.

examples.english: This [accessible] app helps kids learn English easily.
examples.chinese: 这款[易用的]应用帮助孩子们轻松学英语。

examples.english: The book uses [accessible] language for young readers.
examples.chinese: 这本书为年轻读者使用了[易懂的]语言。

examples.english: All the information on the website is [accessible] to everyone.
examples.chinese: 网站上所有信息对每个人都是[可获取的]。

meanings.explanation: [Accuracy] is the quality of being correct or exact, or the degree to which something is true, precise, or error-free.

examples.english: The scientist checked her work for [accuracy].
examples.chinese: 那位科学家检查了她工作的[准确性]。

examples.english: We need more data to improve the [accuracy] of our results.
examples.chinese: 我们需要更多数据来提高结果的[准确度]。

examples.english: The GPS showed our location with surprising [accuracy].
examples.chinese: GPS以惊人的[精确度]显示了我们的位置。

meanings.explanation: If you [acquire] something, you get it or obtain it, especially by buying it or through effort.

examples.english: My family will [acquire] a new puppy next week.
examples.chinese: 我们家下周会[得到]一只新小狗。

examples.english: The museum [acquired] a very old painting.
examples.chinese: 博物馆[购得]了一幅非常古老的画。

examples.english: She wants to [acquire] more books for her library.
examples.chinese: 她想为自己的图书馆[添置]更多书。

meanings.explanation: If you [acquire] a skill or habit, you learn it or develop it over time.

examples.english: You need to practice to [acquire] good reading skills.
examples.chinese: 你需要练习才能[培养]良好的阅读能力。

examples.english: He [acquired] a love of music from his father.
examples.chinese: 他从父亲那里[养成]了对音乐的热爱。

examples.english: Children [acquire] language naturally.
examples.chinese: 孩子们自然而然地[学会]语言。

meanings.explanation: If you [acknowledge] something, you admit that it is true or that it exists.

examples.english: She [acknowledged] that she made a mistake.
examples.chinese: 她[承认]自己犯了错。

examples.english: We must [acknowledge] the truth and move on.
examples.chinese: 我们必须[承认]事实，然后继续前进。

examples.english: He [acknowledged] having done something wrong.
examples.chinese: 他[承认]自己做错了事。

meanings.explanation: If you [acknowledge] someone or something, you show that you recognize or notice them, often in a formal way.

examples.english: The teacher [acknowledged] all the students' efforts.
examples.chinese: 老师[肯定]了所有学生的努力。

examples.english: Please [acknowledge] receipt of this letter.
examples.chinese: 请[确认]收到这封信。

examples.english: She waved to [acknowledge] her friend's greeting.
examples.chinese: 她挥手[回应]朋友的问候。

meanings.explanation: An [actress] is a woman who performs in plays, movies, or television shows, pretending to be a character for an audience.

examples.english: My favorite [actress] is in that new movie.
examples.chinese: 我最喜欢的[女演员]出演了那部新电影。

examples.english: She wants to be an [actress] when she grows up.
examples.chinese: 她长大后想当一名[女演员]。

examples.english: The [actress] played a kind queen in the school play.
examples.chinese: 那位[女演员]在学校的话剧里扮演了一位善良的皇后。

meanings.explanation: If you are [accountable] for something, you are responsible for it and must be ready to explain your actions to others.

examples.english: Our teacher says everyone must be [accountable] for their own homework.
examples.chinese: 老师说每个人都必须对自己的作业[负责]。

examples.english: The coach is [accountable] for the team's bad performance in the match.
examples.chinese: 教练要对球队在比赛中的糟糕表现[负责]。

examples.english: The principal is [accountable] to all the students' parents.
examples.chinese: 校长要对所有学生家长[负责]。

meanings.explanation: A book, play, or film that has been [adapted] has been changed from its original form to make it suitable for a new purpose or audience.

examples.english: This movie is [adapted] from a famous fairy tale.
examples.chinese: 这部电影[改编自]一个著名的童话故事。

examples.english: The book was [adapted] for young readers.
examples.chinese: 这本书[改成了]儿童[版本]。

examples.english: This game is [adapted] to help kids learn math.
examples.chinese: 这个游戏[改编成]帮助孩子们学数学的形式。

meanings.explanation: If you have [adapted] to a new situation, you have changed your behavior or ideas to fit in better.

examples.english: The cat [adapted] to its new home very quickly.
examples.chinese: 这只猫很快就[适应]了新家。

examples.english: She has [adapted] to life in a big city.
examples.chinese: 她已经[适应]了大城市的生活。

examples.english: After a week, I [adapted] to my new school.
examples.chinese: 一周后，我就[适应]了新学校。

meanings.explanation: If you [adjusted] something, you changed or moved it slightly so that it works better, fits better, or looks better.

examples.english: She [adjusted] the mirror so she could see clearly behind the car.
examples.chinese: 她[调整]了后视镜，这样就能清楚地看到车后面了。

examples.english: He [adjusted] his chair to a comfortable height.
examples.chinese: 他把椅子[调整]到了一个舒服的高度。

examples.english: Mom [adjusted] the temperature in the room because it was too cold.
examples.chinese: 妈妈[调了调]房间的温度，因为太冷了。

meanings.explanation: Something that is [adjusted] has been changed or altered slightly to be more suitable, accurate, or effective.

examples.english: The [adjusted] price is five dollars cheaper than before.
examples.chinese: [调整后的]价格比之前便宜了五块钱。

examples.english: The [adjusted] schedule gives us more time to play.
examples.chinese: [调整后的]时间表给了我们更多玩耍的时间。

examples.english: After the teacher gave her advice, my [adjusted] homework got a full score.
examples.chinese: 听了老师的建议之后，我[修改后的]作业拿了满分。

meanings.explanation: If you [accept] something that is offered to you, you agree to take it or say yes to it.

examples.english: She smiled and [accepted] the birthday gift.
examples.chinese: 她笑着[收下]了生日礼物。

examples.english: He decided to [accept] the job offer.
examples.chinese: 他决定[接受]这份工作。

examples.english: Please [accept] this small present from us.
examples.chinese: 请[收下]我们这份小礼物。

meanings.explanation: If you [accept] that something is true, you come to believe that it is true or real.

examples.english: You must [accept] that you cannot always be first.
examples.chinese: 你必须[接受]你不可能总是第一名。

examples.english: He found it hard to [accept] the truth.
examples.chinese: 他很难[接受]事实。

examples.english: Can you [accept] that you made a mistake?
examples.chinese: 你能[承认]自己犯了个错吗？

meanings.explanation: If you [admire] someone, you respect and like them because of their good qualities, skills, or achievements.

examples.english: I really [admire] my teacher because she is so kind.
examples.chinese: 我真的很[钦佩]我的老师，因为她很善良。

examples.english: We all [admire] how hard you study every day.
examples.chinese: 我们都很[佩服]你每天学习那么努力。

examples.english: My brother [admires] the famous basketball player very much.
examples.chinese: 我哥哥非常[崇拜]那位著名的篮球运动员。

meanings.explanation: If you [admire] something, you look at it with pleasure because it is beautiful or impressive.

examples.english: We stopped to [admire] the beautiful sunset at the beach.
examples.chinese: 我们停下来[欣赏]海滩上美丽的日落。

examples.english: She stood by the window to [admire] the flowers in the garden.
examples.chinese: 她站在窗边[欣赏]花园里的花。

examples.english: The children [admire] the colorful paintings at the museum.
examples.chinese: 孩子们在博物馆[欣赏]色彩缤纷的画作。

meanings.explanation: [Actually] means in reality; really. It is used to emphasize that something is true, especially when it is surprising or different from what people think.

examples.english: I thought the game was tomorrow, but it is [actually] today.
examples.chinese: 我以为比赛是明天，但[实际上]是今天。

examples.english: She looks young, but she is [actually] forty years old.
examples.chinese: 她看起来很年轻，但[实际上]已经四十岁了。

examples.english: We [actually] have two dogs at home.
examples.chinese: 我们家[实际上]养了两只狗。

meanings.explanation: [Actually] is also used to add new or surprising information to what you are saying, or to correct someone in a polite way.

examples.english: Dad, I need to tell you something. [Actually], I broke your cup.
examples.chinese: 爸爸，我有件事要告诉你。[其实]，我把你的杯子打碎了。

examples.english: Can you come to my party? [Actually], I am busy that day.
examples.chinese: 你能来我的派对吗？[实际上]我那天没空。

examples.english: Is this your book? [Actually], this is my sister's.
examples.chinese: 这是你的书吗？[其实]这是我姐姐的。

meanings.explanation: An [advantage] is something that puts you in a better position than other people.

examples.english: Being tall is an [advantage] when you play basketball.
examples.chinese: 打篮球时，长得高是个[优势]。

examples.english: My sister has an [advantage] because she studied hard.
examples.chinese: 我姐姐有个[优势]，因为她学习很努力。

examples.english: Knowing two languages is a big [advantage] at work.
examples.chinese: 在工作中，懂两种语言是个很大的[优势]。

meanings.explanation: If you take [advantage] of something, you make good use of it to help you achieve something.

examples.english: We should take [advantage] of the sunny day to go outside.
examples.chinese: 我们应该[利用]这个晴天出去玩。

examples.english: She took [advantage] of the sale to buy new shoes.
examples.chinese: 她[利用]打折的机会买了新鞋。

examples.english: He took [advantage] of his free time to read books.
examples.chinese: 他[利用]空闲时间读书。

meanings.explanation: [Admiration] is a feeling of great respect and approval that you have for someone or something you think is very good or special.

examples.english: I have great [admiration] for my teacher because she always helps us learn.
examples.chinese: 我非常[钦佩]我的老师，因为她总是帮助我们学习。

examples.english: Everyone watched the beautiful fireworks in [admiration].
examples.chinese: 每个人都带着[欣赏]的目光看着美丽的烟花。

examples.english: The team's hard work won the [admiration] of the whole school.
examples.chinese: 这支队伍的努力赢得了全校的[敬佩]。

meanings.explanation: If you [acquaint] someone with something, you make them familiar with it or tell them about it so that they know it.

examples.english: The teacher [acquainted] the new student with the classroom rules.
examples.chinese: 老师让新同学[了解]了班规。

examples.english: Before we play the game, let me [acquaint] you with the rules.
examples.chinese: 玩游戏之前，我先让你[熟悉]一下规则。

examples.english: This book [acquaints] children with the wonderful world of space.
examples.chinese: 这本书让孩子[认识]了奇妙的太空世界。

meanings.explanation: If you [acquaint] one person with another, you introduce them to each other for the first time.

examples.english: Let me [acquaint] you with my best friend, Tom.
examples.chinese: 我来把你[介绍]给我的好朋友汤姆。

examples.english: I [acquainted] my mom with my teacher at the school fair.
examples.chinese: 我在校园活动上把妈妈[介绍]给了老师。

examples.english: She is happy to [acquaint] the new kids with each other.
examples.chinese: 她很乐意把新来的小伙伴[介绍]给大家认识。

meanings.explanation: An [adjustable] object can be changed in size, position, or angle to fit different people or needs.

examples.english: My backpack has an [adjustable] strap.
examples.chinese: 我的背包有一条[可调节的]肩带。

examples.english: This [adjustable] table can be set higher or lower.
examples.chinese: 这张[可调节的]桌子可以调高或调低。

examples.english: The [adjustable] chair fits both kids and adults.
examples.chinese: 这把[可调节的]椅子适合孩子和大人使用。

meanings.explanation: An [adjustable] plan, rule, or idea can be changed to suit particular situations or needs.

examples.english: Our teacher has [adjustable] rules for class activities.
examples.chinese: 我们老师对班级活动有[可调整的]规则。

examples.english: Mom says our picnic time is [adjustable] if it rains.
examples.chinese: 妈妈说如果下雨，我们的野餐时间是[可调整的]。

examples.english: The game's rules are [adjustable] if all players agree.
examples.chinese: 如果所有玩家都同意，游戏规则就是[可调整的]。

meanings.explanation: An [active] person or animal does a lot of physical things like moving around or playing sports, and is full of energy.

examples.english: My grandpa is still very [active] even though he is 80.
examples.chinese: 尽管已经80岁了，我爷爷仍然很[活跃]。

examples.english: The [active] girl plays basketball every weekend.
examples.chinese: 这个[活泼]的女孩每个周末都打篮球。

examples.english: My dog is very [active]—he loves chasing balls in the park.
examples.chinese: 我的狗非常[好动]，他喜欢在公园里追球。

meanings.explanation: If someone is [active] in an organization or activity, they are often involved in it and contribute a lot of time and effort.

examples.english: My mom is [active] in our school's parent club.
examples.chinese: 我妈妈在我们学校的家长俱乐部里很[积极]。

examples.english: He became an [active] member of the swimming team.
examples.chinese: 他成了游泳队的一名[积极的]成员。

examples.english: We should be [active] in class and answer the teacher's questions.
examples.chinese: 我们在课堂上应该[积极]一点，回答老师的问题。

meanings.explanation: If you [adopt] a child, you legally take another person's child into your family and raise it as your own.

examples.english: My neighbors decided to [adopt] a little girl from the orphanage.
examples.chinese: 我的邻居决定从孤儿院[收养]一个小女孩。

examples.english: The couple [adopted] a boy two years ago.
examples.chinese: 这对夫妻两年前[收养]了一个男孩。

examples.english: They have wanted to [adopt] since they got married.
examples.chinese: 他们结婚后就一直想[收养]孩子。

meanings.explanation: If you [adopt] an idea, suggestion, policy, or method, you choose to accept it and start using it.

examples.english: Our school will [adopt] a new rule next semester.
examples.chinese: 我们学校下学期将[采用]一项新规定。

examples.english: She decided to [adopt] my suggestion for the party.
examples.chinese: 她决定[采纳]我关于派对的建议。

examples.english: Many shops [adopt] this new way of selling things.
examples.chinese: 很多商店都[采用]这种新的售卖方式。

meanings.explanation: If someone or something [advance]s, they move forward, making progress or getting closer to a place.

examples.english: The team [advance]d to the next round of the game.
examples.chinese: 球队成功[晋级]下一轮比赛。

examples.english: Our plans are [advance]ing well.
examples.chinese: 我们的计划正在顺利[推进]。

examples.english: The army [advance]d toward the border.
examples.chinese: 军队向边境[前进]。

meanings.explanation: An [advance] is forward movement or progress, often describing an improvement or new development.

examples.english: The medicine is a great [advance] in science.
examples.chinese: 这种药是科学上的伟大[进步]。

examples.english: She made an [advance] in her studies.
examples.chinese: 她的学习取得了[进步]。

examples.english: The army made an [advance] of ten miles.
examples.chinese: 军队向前[推进]了十英里。

meanings.explanation: To [administrate] means to manage or direct an organization, project, or group of people.

examples.english: She [administrate] the department with great care.
examples.chinese: 她用心[管理]着这个部门。

examples.english: He [administrate] the company's daily operations.
examples.chinese: 他[管理]公司的日常运营。

examples.english: They [administrate] the school together.
examples.chinese: 他们一起[管理]这所学校。

meanings.explanation: An [affirmative] answer or response means that you say yes or agree with something.

examples.english: She gave an [affirmative] answer to my question.
examples.chinese: 她对我的问题给予了[肯定的]回答。

examples.english: Is the answer [affirmative]?
examples.chinese: 答案是[肯定]的吗？

examples.english: He nodded in an [affirmative] way.
examples.chinese: 他[肯定]地点了点头。

meanings.explanation: An [affirmative] is a statement, reply, or gesture that shows agreement or acceptance.

examples.english: He answered with a simple [affirmative].
examples.chinese: 他只回答了一个[肯定]。

examples.english: The teacher asked if we understood, and everyone replied in the [affirmative].
examples.chinese: 老师问我们是否理解了，大家都[肯定地]回答。

examples.english: All we need is an [affirmative] from the manager.
examples.chinese: 我们只需要经理的一个[肯定答复]。

meanings.explanation: If something happens [afterward], it happens at a later time after something else has already happened or been mentioned.

examples.english: We went to the park and had ice cream [afterward].
examples.chinese: 我们去了公园，[之后]吃了冰淇淋。

examples.english: Finish your homework first; you can play video games [afterward].
examples.chinese: 先把作业做完，[之后]你再打游戏。

examples.english: She fell off her bike but felt fine [afterward].
examples.chinese: 她从自行车上摔了下来，但[之后]感觉还好。

meanings.explanation: [Aid] is money, food, or other resources that are given to a country, organization, or person to help them.

examples.english: The school gave financial [aid] to students from poor families.
examples.chinese: 学校给来自贫困家庭的学生提供了经济[资助]。

examples.english: Many countries sent [aid] to the area after the big earthquake.
examples.chinese: 大地震发生后，许多国家向该地区送去了[救援物资]。

examples.english: My mom always keeps a [aid] kit in the car just in case.
examples.chinese: 我妈妈总在车里放一个[急救]箱以防万一。

meanings.explanation: To [aid] someone or something means to help or support them.

examples.english: A good night's sleep can [aid] your learning at school.
examples.chinese: 晚上睡个好觉能[帮助]你在学校更好地学习。

examples.english: The teacher used pictures to [aid] the children's understanding of the story.
examples.chinese: 老师用图片来[帮助]孩子们理解这个故事。

examples.english: My grandpa uses a walking stick to [aid] him when he goes out.
examples.chinese: 我爷爷出门时拄着拐杖来[辅助]走路。

meanings.explanation: If something [affects] a person or thing, it influences them or causes them to change in some way.

examples.english: The heavy rain will [affect] our picnic plan.
examples.chinese: 大雨会[影响]我们的野餐计划。

examples.english: Not getting enough sleep can [affect] how well you do in school.
examples.chinese: 睡眠不足会[影响]你在学校的表现。

examples.english: Does the loud noise [affect] your baby's sleep?
examples.chinese: 噪音会[影响]你宝宝睡觉吗？

meanings.explanation: If something [affects] you, it makes you feel a strong emotion, such as sadness, joy, or sympathy.

examples.english: That movie about the lost dog really [affected] me.
examples.chinese: 那部关于走失小狗的电影让我很[感动]。

examples.english: The old man's story [affected] everyone in the room.
examples.chinese: 老人的故事[打动]了房间里每一个人。

examples.english: I was deeply [affected] by the letter she wrote to me.
examples.chinese: 她写给我的那封信让我深受[触动]。

meanings.explanation: [Allied] countries, armies, or groups are those that have joined together for a common purpose, especially during a war or conflict.

examples.english: The [allied] countries worked together to win the war.
examples.chinese: [同盟]国齐心协力赢得了战争。

examples.english: [Allied] forces entered the city early in the morning.
examples.chinese: [盟]军在清晨进入了城市。

examples.english: Our school team is [allied] with the other school for the big competition.
examples.chinese: 我们校队和另一所学校[结盟]参加大赛。

meanings.explanation: [Allied] things or ideas are connected or related in some way, often because they share a common goal or belong to the same group.

examples.english: Exercise and healthy food are [allied] in keeping you fit.
examples.chinese: 运动和健康饮食在保持身体好方面是[相互配合的]。

examples.english: The two subjects are closely [allied] with each other.
examples.chinese: 这两门学科之间[密切相关]。

examples.english: She works in [allied] health fields like nursing and therapy.
examples.chinese: 她在护理和治疗等[相关]健康领域工作。

meanings.explanation: If you are [allergic] to something, your body reacts badly to it, causing symptoms like sneezing, itching, or swelling.

examples.english: My friend is [allergic] to peanuts and cannot eat them.
examples.chinese: 我朋友对花生[过敏]，不能吃花生。

examples.english: I am [allergic] to cats, so my eyes get itchy near them.
examples.chinese: 我对猫[过敏]，所以一靠近猫眼睛就发痒。

examples.english: She is [allergic] to pollen and sneezes a lot in spring.
examples.chinese: 她对花粉[过敏]，春天经常打喷嚏。

meanings.explanation: If you are [allergic] to something, you have a strong dislike for it.

examples.english: My brother is [allergic] to chores and always tries to avoid them.
examples.chinese: 我弟弟[特别讨厌]做家务，总是想方设法逃避。

examples.english: She is [allergic] to early mornings and never wakes up before nine.
examples.chinese: 她[特别讨厌]早起，从来不在九点前起床。

examples.english: He is [allergic] to homework and always complains about it.
examples.chinese: 他对家庭作业[特别反感]，总是抱怨个不停。

meanings.explanation: To [alienate] someone means to make them feel that they do not belong or are no longer welcome in a group.

examples.english: His mean words [alienated] all his friends at school.
examples.chinese: 他说的刻薄话让他在学校里[疏远了]所有朋友。

examples.english: Don't [alienate] your teammates by refusing to share.
examples.chinese: 不要因为不肯分享而[疏远]你的队友。

examples.english: She felt [alienated] when the other kids left her out.
examples.chinese: 当其他孩子把她排除在外时，她感到被[孤立]了。

meanings.explanation: If a person or animal is [adaptable], they are able to change their ideas or behaviour in order to deal with new situations.

examples.english: My little sister is very [adaptable] and makes new friends quickly.
examples.chinese: 我妹妹很[善于适应新环境]，很快就能交到新朋友。

examples.english: Dogs are [adaptable] animals that can live happily in many different places.
examples.chinese: 狗是[适应能力]很强的动物，在很多不同的地方都能快乐生活。

examples.english: Being [adaptable] helps a lot when you start at a new school.
examples.chinese: [适应力强]对刚开始上新学校的孩子特别有帮助。

meanings.explanation: If an object or piece of equipment is [adaptable], it can be changed or used for different purposes.

examples.english: This sofa bed is [adaptable] — it changes from a sofa into a bed.
examples.chinese: 这款沙发床是[多功能]的——可以从沙发变成床。

examples.english: The building toy is [adaptable] for kids of all ages.
examples.chinese: 这款积木玩具可以[灵活调整]适合所有年龄段的孩子。

examples.english: An [adaptable] raincoat works well in both light rain and heavy storms.
examples.chinese: 一件[多用]的雨衣无论下小雨还是大暴雨都能穿。

meanings.explanation: An [agreeable] person is pleasant and easy to like.

examples.english: My new neighbor is an [agreeable] lady who always smiles.
examples.chinese: 我的新邻居是一位[和蔼可亲的]女士，她总是面带微笑。

examples.english: The [agreeable] boy gets along well with all his classmates.
examples.chinese: 这个[友善的]男孩和所有同学都相处得很好。

examples.english: Grandpa is an [agreeable] man who loves telling us stories.
examples.chinese: 爷爷是个[随和的]人，喜欢给我们讲故事。

meanings.explanation: Something that is [agreeable] is pleasant and enjoyable to experience.

examples.english: We had [agreeable] weather during our picnic last weekend.
examples.chinese: 我们上周野餐时遇到了[宜人的]天气。

examples.english: This room has an [agreeable] smell of flowers.
examples.chinese: 这个房间有一股[怡人的]花香。

examples.english: We spent an [agreeable] afternoon playing games in the park.
examples.chinese: 我们在公园里玩游戏，度过了一个[令人愉快的]下午。

meanings.explanation: To [allocate] means to distribute or assign resources such as money, time, or space to specific purposes.

examples.english: The teacher will [allocate] five minutes for each student to present.
examples.chinese: 老师会[分配]每个学生五分钟时间来做展示。

examples.english: Our company needs to [allocate] more budget for the new project.
examples.chinese: 我们公司需要为新项目[分配]更多预算。

examples.english: Please [allocate] this room for tomorrow's meeting.
examples.chinese: 请把这个房间[预留给]明天的会议。

meanings.explanation: An [adventure] is an exciting, unusual, and often slightly risky experience or journey.

examples.english: Last summer I went on an [adventure] in the mountains with my family.
examples.chinese: 去年夏天我和家人去山里经历了一场[冒险]。

examples.english: Building a tree house with dad became our favorite summer [adventure].
examples.chinese: 和爸爸一起建树屋成了我们最喜欢的夏日[冒险]。

examples.english: The book tells about a child's [adventure] in a magical forest.
examples.chinese: 这本书讲述了一个孩子在魔法森林里的[冒险]。

meanings.explanation: [Adventure] is the quality of being willing to take part in exciting, new, or risky activities.

examples.english: Her love of [adventure] led her to travel all over the world.
examples.chinese: 她对[冒险]的热爱让她走遍了全世界。

examples.english: My dad has always had a spirit of [adventure].
examples.chinese: 我爸爸一直有一种[冒险]精神。

examples.english: Kids need room to explore and embrace [adventure].
examples.chinese: 孩子们需要空间去探索和拥抱[冒险]。

meanings.explanation: Something that is [advanced] is very modern, complex, or highly developed.

examples.english: My family bought an [advanced] washing machine that can dry clothes too.
examples.chinese: 我家买了一台[先进的]洗衣机，还能烘干衣服。

examples.english: The [advanced] computer can solve hard problems very fast.
examples.chinese: 这台[先进的]电脑能很快解决难题。

examples.english: Doctors use [advanced] tools to help sick people get better.
examples.chinese: 医生用[先进的]工具帮助病人好起来。

meanings.explanation: Someone who is [advanced] has reached a high level of skill, knowledge, or progress in a particular subject.

examples.english: Tom is in the [advanced] reading group because he reads so well.
examples.chinese: 汤姆在[高级]阅读小组，因为他读得很好。

examples.english: This piano song is for [advanced] players only.
examples.chinese: 这首钢琴曲只适合[高级]水平的演奏者。

examples.english: She took an [advanced] math class after passing the easy one.
examples.chinese: 她通过了简单的数学课后，上了[高级]数学班。

meanings.explanation: If you [alter] something, you change it, usually slightly, so that it is different from what it was before.

examples.english: This dress is too long, so my mom will [alter] it for me.
examples.chinese: 这条裙子太长了，我妈妈会帮我[改]一下。

examples.english: We had to [alter] our plan because it started to rain.
examples.chinese: 因为开始下雨了，我们只好[改变]计划。

examples.english: He [altered] his hairstyle before the school photo.
examples.chinese: 他在拍学校合影之前[改了]发型。

meanings.explanation: An [ally] is a person, group, or country that helps and supports another person, group, or country in a conflict, competition, or difficult situation.

examples.english: In the story, the small country found a strong [ally] to help them.
examples.chinese: 在故事里，这个小国找到了一个强大的[盟友]来帮助他们。

examples.english: She is my best friend and my greatest [ally] at school.
examples.chinese: 她是我最好的朋友，也是我在学校最可靠的[支持者]。

examples.english: The two families became [allies] during the hard times.
examples.chinese: 那两个家庭在困难时期成为[盟友]。

meanings.explanation: If you [ally] yourself with someone, you join with them to help and support each other, especially in a difficult situation or conflict.

examples.english: The two teams decided to [ally] against their common rival.
examples.chinese: 两支队伍决定[联合]对抗共同的对手。

examples.english: We must [ally] with our neighbors to win the game.
examples.chinese: 我们必须和邻居们[结盟]才能赢得比赛。

examples.english: The countries chose to [ally] for peace in the world.
examples.chinese: 这些国家选择[结盟]以维护世界和平。

meanings.explanation: If you [align] things, you put them in a straight line or in the correct position relative to each other.

examples.english: Please [align] the books on the shelf so they look neat.
examples.chinese: 请把书架上的书[摆整齐]，这样看着利落。

examples.english: The teacher asked us to [align] our desks in a row.
examples.chinese: 老师让我们把课桌[排成]一排。

examples.english: Can you help me [align] the two pictures so they are level?
examples.chinese: 你能帮我把这两幅画[对齐]，让它们一样高吗？

meanings.explanation: If you [align] with someone or something, you support the same opinion or follow the same rules.

examples.english: I [align] with my best friend's opinion about the book.
examples.chinese: 在这本书的看法上，我和我最好的朋友[站在一边]。

examples.english: Our team should [align] with the school's rules.
examples.chinese: 我们小组应该[遵守]学校的规定。

examples.english: She decided to [align] herself with the group's idea.
examples.chinese: 她决定[支持]这个小组的想法。

meanings.explanation: If information, a number, or a statement is [accurate], it is completely correct and true with no mistakes.

examples.english: Please give me an [accurate] count of how many kids are in the room.
examples.chinese: 请给我一个屋里有多少孩子的[准确]数字。

examples.english: Your answer to this math problem is [accurate].
examples.chinese: 你这道数学题的答案是[准确]的。

examples.english: The clock on the wall gives an [accurate] time.
examples.chinese: 墙上的钟报时很[准确]。

meanings.explanation: If a person or a tool is [accurate], they can do something exactly without making mistakes.

examples.english: A good watch needs to be very [accurate].
examples.chinese: 好手表必须非常[精准]。

examples.english: He is an [accurate] shooter in basketball games.
examples.chinese: 他打篮球投篮很[精准]。

examples.english: The cook is [accurate] when she adds salt to the soup.
examples.chinese: 这位厨师往汤里加盐时非常[精准]。

meanings.explanation: If something has been [altered], it has been changed from how it was before.

examples.english: Her [altered] dress looks much prettier now.
examples.chinese: 她[改过]的裙子现在好看多了。

examples.english: The [altered] plan finally worked.
examples.chinese: [修改后的]计划终于行得通了。

examples.english: This is an [altered] version of the original story.
examples.chinese: 这是原文[改动后]的版本。

meanings.explanation: An [allergy] is a medical condition that causes you to react badly when you eat, touch, or breathe in a particular substance.

examples.english: My little sister has a food [allergy] to peanuts.
examples.chinese: 我妹妹对花生有食物[过敏]。

examples.english: He carries emergency medicine because of his [allergy] to bee stings.
examples.chinese: 因为对蜂蛰[过敏]，他随身带着急救药。

examples.english: Pollen gives my mom a seasonal [allergy] every spring.
examples.chinese: 花粉让我妈妈每年春天都得季节性[过敏]。

meanings.explanation: If you have an [allergy] to something, you have a strong, instinctive dislike for it.

examples.english: My dad has an [allergy] to getting up early.
examples.chinese: 我爸爸对早起有[反感]。

examples.english: My friend has an [allergy] to doing homework on weekends.
examples.chinese: 我朋友对周末做作业有[反感]。

examples.english: Many people have an [allergy] to cleaning the bathroom.
examples.chinese: 很多人对打扫浴室有[反感]。

meanings.explanation: An [amateur] is someone who does an activity for pleasure or interest, not as a job.

examples.english: My dad is an [amateur] painter who creates art on weekends.
examples.chinese: 我爸爸是个[业余]画家，周末才画画。

examples.english: She sings in a choir as an [amateur], not for money.
examples.chinese: 她[业余]时间在唱诗班唱歌，不是为了赚钱。

examples.english: The tennis match was for [amateurs], not professional players.
examples.chinese: 这场网球比赛是给[业余爱好者]参加的，不是专业选手。

meanings.explanation: An [amateur] is a person who is not very skilled or experienced at doing something.

examples.english: I am an [amateur] at cooking, so I often burn the food.
examples.chinese: 我做饭还是[新手]，所以经常把菜烧糊。

examples.english: He felt like an [amateur] compared to the experienced dancers.
examples.chinese: 跟那些经验丰富的舞者比起来，他觉得自己像个[外行]。

examples.english: Don't worry if you look like an [amateur] on your first try.
examples.chinese: 第一次尝试就算看起来像个[生手]也别担心。

meanings.explanation: If you are [ambitious], you have a strong desire to be successful, powerful, or rich, and you are willing to work hard to achieve it.

examples.english: My brother is very [ambitious] and wants to start his own company one day.
examples.chinese: 我哥哥很有[抱负]，想有朝一日自己开公司。

examples.english: She is an [ambitious] student who always gets the best grades in class.
examples.chinese: 她是一个[有志气的]学生，每次都拿全班最高分。

examples.english: He is [ambitious] and never gives up on his dreams.
examples.chinese: 他很[上进]，从不放弃自己的梦想。

meanings.explanation: An [ambitious] plan, idea, or project is very big, difficult, and shows that someone wants to achieve a lot.

examples.english: Our school has an [ambitious] plan to build a new library next year.
examples.chinese: 我们学校有一个[宏大的]计划，明年要建一座新图书馆。

examples.english: The teacher gave us an [ambitious] project that took a whole month to finish.
examples.chinese: 老师给我们布置了一个[难度很大的]项目，花了一整月才完成。

examples.english: That is an [ambitious] goal, but I think we can do it together.
examples.chinese: 那个目标挺[宏大]，不过我觉得我们一起努力可以实现。

meanings.explanation: [Analysis] is the careful examination of something in order to understand it better, especially by breaking it down into smaller parts.

examples.english: The teacher asked us to do a careful [analysis] of the story before writing the report.
examples.chinese: 老师让我们在写报告之前，先对这篇故事做一次仔细的[分析]。

examples.english: My dad did an [analysis] of our monthly spending to see where the money went.
examples.chinese: 我爸爸对我们每月的开销做了一次[分析]，看看钱都花在了哪里。

examples.english: The scientist's [analysis] showed that the water was clean and safe to drink.
examples.chinese: 科学家的[分析]表明，这水很干净，可以放心喝。

meanings.explanation: An [analysis] is also a written or spoken report that presents the results of examining something in detail.

examples.english: She wrote a great [analysis] of her favorite book for the school project.
examples.chinese: 她为学校项目写了一篇关于她最喜欢那本书的优秀[分析报告]。

examples.english: Our group presented an [analysis] of the survey in front of the whole class.
examples.chinese: 我们小组在全班面前展示了一份关于调查的[分析报告]。

examples.english: The [analysis] at the end of the article helped me understand the topic much better.
examples.chinese: 文章末尾的[分析]帮我更好地理解了这个话题。

meanings.explanation: If you [allow] someone to do something, you let them do it or you do not try to stop them.

examples.english: My mom [allows] me to play outside after I finish my homework.
examples.chinese: 我妈妈[允许]我做完作业后出去玩。

examples.english: The teacher [allows] us to talk during the break.
examples.chinese: 老师[允许]我们在休息时说话。

examples.english: My parents don't [allow] me to eat too much candy.
examples.chinese: 我爸妈不[允许]我吃太多糖果。

meanings.explanation: If something [allows] something to happen, it makes it possible for it to happen.

examples.english: The new park [allows] children to play safely.
examples.chinese: 这个新公园[让]孩子们可以安全地玩耍。

examples.english: This money [allows] us to buy food and clothes.
examples.chinese: 这笔钱[让]我们能买食物和衣服。

examples.english: The window [allows] sunlight to come into the room.
examples.chinese: 窗户[让]阳光照进房间。

meanings.explanation: If you [accuse] someone of doing something wrong or illegal, you say that they have done it.

examples.english: The neighbor [accused] the boy of breaking the window.
examples.chinese: 邻居[指责]男孩打碎了窗户。

examples.english: The police [accused] the man of stealing a car.
examples.chinese: 警方[指控]这名男子偷了一辆车。

examples.english: She [accused] me of eating her chocolate cake.
examples.chinese: 她[指责]我吃了她的巧克力蛋糕。

meanings.explanation: An [ancestor] is a person from whom you are descended, especially someone more remote than a grandparent.

examples.english: My [ancestor] came from China many years ago.
examples.chinese: 我的[祖先]很多年前从中国来到这里。

examples.english: She learned about her [ancestor] who was a famous scientist.
examples.chinese: 她了解了她的[祖先]——一位著名科学家。

examples.english: Every family has interesting [ancestor] stories.
examples.chinese: 每个家庭都有有趣的[祖先]故事。

meanings.explanation: If you are [amused], you think that something is funny or entertaining, and it makes you smile or laugh.

examples.english: The children were [amused] by the clown's funny tricks.
examples.chinese: 孩子们被小丑滑稽的表演[逗乐]了。

examples.english: She had an [amused] smile on her face.
examples.chinese: 她脸上带着[愉悦的]微笑。

examples.english: My dad was [amused] when the puppy chased its tail.
examples.chinese: 当小狗追着自己的尾巴转时，爸爸被[逗乐]了。

meanings.explanation: If something or someone [amused] you, they made you laugh or smile by being funny or entertaining.

examples.english: The funny movie [amused] everyone in the theater.
examples.chinese: 这部有趣的电影[逗乐]了影院里的所有人。

examples.english: The teacher [amused] the class with a joke.
examples.chinese: 老师用一个笑话把全班[逗笑]了。

examples.english: His silly dance [amused] his little sister.
examples.chinese: 他滑稽的舞蹈把妹妹[逗乐]了。

meanings.explanation: Someone who is [amiable] is friendly, good-natured, and pleasant to be with.

examples.english: My teacher is a very [amiable] person who always smiles at us.
examples.chinese: 我的老师是个非常[和蔼]的人，总是微笑着对我们。

examples.english: We had an [amiable] conversation about our favorite books.
examples.chinese: 我们聊起喜欢的书，气氛非常[友好]。

examples.english: She was in an [amiable] mood after hearing the good news.
examples.chinese: 听到好消息后，她心情变得[愉悦]起来。

meanings.explanation: You use [almost] to say that something is not completely true or does not happen completely, but it is very nearly true or very nearly happens.

examples.english: It's [almost] time for school.
examples.chinese: [差不多]到上学的时间了。

examples.english: I [almost] fell off my bike.
examples.chinese: 我[差点]从自行车上摔下来。

examples.english: The cake is [almost] done.
examples.chinese: 蛋糕[快]做好了。

meanings.explanation: Your [ankle] is the joint between your foot and your leg where they connect.

examples.english: I fell off my bike and hurt my [ankle].
examples.chinese: 我从自行车上摔下来，[脚踝]受了伤。

examples.english: She rolled her [ankle] while playing basketball.
examples.chinese: 她打篮球时[崴了脚踝]。

examples.english: Put some ice on your [ankle] to make it feel better.
examples.chinese: 在[脚踝]上敷点冰，会舒服一些。

meanings.explanation: Something or someone that is [amusing] is funny and entertaining, making you smile or laugh.

examples.english: The [amusing] clown made all the children laugh loudly.
examples.chinese: 这个[有趣的]小丑把所有孩子都逗得大笑起来。

examples.english: My grandpa shared an [amusing] story about his childhood dog.
examples.chinese: 爷爷给我讲了一个关于他童年时狗狗的[好笑的]故事。

examples.english: We watched an [amusing] cartoon together last night.
examples.chinese: 昨晚我们一起看了一部[有趣的]动画片。

meanings.explanation: If something is [ancient], it is very old and belongs to a time in the distant past.

examples.english: We visited an [ancient] castle during our school trip.
examples.chinese: 我们在学校旅行期间参观了一座[古老的]城堡。

examples.english: The museum has many [ancient] treasures from Egypt.
examples.chinese: 这座博物馆收藏了许多来自埃及的[古代]珍宝。

examples.english: My grandmother told us stories about [ancient] times.
examples.chinese: 我奶奶给我们讲了[古时候]的故事。

meanings.explanation: If something is [appealing], it is pleasant or attractive and makes you want to have it, do it, or be near it.

examples.english: The colorful cupcakes look very [appealing] to the children.
examples.chinese: 这些色彩缤纷的纸杯蛋糕看起来很[诱人]，孩子们都很喜欢。

examples.english: This toy has an [appealing] design with bright lights and soft music.
examples.chinese: 这个玩具的[设计很吸引人]，有明亮的灯光和轻柔的音乐。

examples.english: Swimming in a cool pool sounds [appealing] on a hot summer day.
examples.chinese: 在炎热的夏天，到凉爽的泳池里游泳听起来很[诱人]。

meanings.explanation: If a person is [appealing], they have qualities that make other people like them or feel sympathy for them.

examples.english: The little girl gave an [appealing] smile that melted everyone's heart.
examples.chinese: 那个小女孩露出了[惹人喜爱的]笑容，融化了所有人的心。

examples.english: He has an [appealing] personality and makes friends easily.
examples.chinese: 他个性[讨人喜欢]，很容易交到朋友。

examples.english: The puppy made [appealing] noises when asking for food.
examples.chinese: 那只小狗要食物时发出了[惹人怜爱的]声音。

meanings.explanation: Your [appetite] is the physical desire that you have to eat food.

examples.english: After running in the park, I have a really big [appetite].
examples.chinese: 在公园里跑步之后，我的[胃口]特别大。

examples.english: She is sick today, so she has no [appetite] at all.
examples.chinese: 她今天生病了，所以一点[胃口]都没有。

examples.english: The smell of mom's cooking gives me a good [appetite].
examples.chinese: 妈妈做饭的香味让我[胃口大开]。

meanings.explanation: If you have an [appetite] for something, you have a strong desire or eagerness to do or have it.

examples.english: He has a big [appetite] for reading books.
examples.chinese: 他很[爱]看书。

examples.english: My sister has a strong [appetite] for learning new things.
examples.chinese: 我妹妹对学习新东西有很强烈的[渴望]。

examples.english: The little boy has a great [appetite] for adventure.
examples.chinese: 这个小男孩对冒险有很大的[热情]。

meanings.explanation: If there is an [ample] amount of something, there is enough of it and usually some extra.

examples.english: We have [ample] time to finish our homework before dinner.
examples.chinese: 晚饭前我们有[充足的]时间写完作业。

examples.english: There is [ample] food in the fridge for all of us.
examples.chinese: 冰箱里有[足够的]食物给我们大家吃。

examples.english: The park has [ample] space for children to play games.
examples.chinese: 公园里有[足够的]空间供孩子们做游戏。

meanings.explanation: If a room or space is [ample], it is large and has plenty of room.

examples.english: The house has an [ample] living room where we can all play together.
examples.chinese: 这栋房子的客厅很[宽敞]，我们可以在里面一起玩。

examples.english: Her closet is [ample] enough to hold all her clothes.
examples.chinese: 她的衣柜很[宽敞]，足够放下她所有的衣服。

examples.english: The garden is [ample] for a small vegetable patch.
examples.chinese: 这个花园很[大]，可以弄一小块菜地。

meanings.explanation: An [antique] is an old object, such as furniture or jewelry, that is valuable because of its age and rarity.

examples.english: My grandmother has an [antique] clock from the 1800s.
examples.chinese: 我奶奶有一个19世纪的[古董]钟。

examples.english: We found this old vase at an [antique] shop.
examples.chinese: 我们在一家[古董]店找到了这个旧花瓶。

examples.english: The museum displays many [antique] toys from the past.
examples.chinese: 博物馆展出许多过去的[古董]玩具。

meanings.explanation: Something that is [antique] is very old, usually at least 100 years old, and is often valuable or collectible.

examples.english: They live in a house full of [antique] furniture.
examples.chinese: 他们住在一个满是[古董]家具的房子里。

examples.english: My dad drives an [antique] car to car shows.
examples.chinese: 我爸爸开着[老式]汽车去参加车展。

examples.english: She loves wearing [antique] dresses from the 1920s.
examples.chinese: 她喜欢穿20世纪20年代的[复古]裙子。

meanings.explanation: An [angle] is the shape or space formed when two straight lines or surfaces meet at a point, measured in degrees.

examples.english: A right [angle] measures exactly 90 degrees.
examples.chinese: 直[角]正好是90度。

examples.english: The two walls meet at a sharp [angle].
examples.chinese: 这两面墙成锐[角]相交。

examples.english: A triangle has three [angles].
examples.chinese: 三角形有三个[角]。

meanings.explanation: An [angle] is a particular position from which you look at something, or a particular way of thinking about a problem or situation.

examples.english: We looked at the castle from a different [angle].
examples.chinese: 我们从不同的[角度]看了城堡。

examples.english: The photographer changed his [angle] to take a better photo.
examples.chinese: 摄影师改变[角度]拍了一张更好的照片。

examples.english: Let's try to solve this problem from a new [angle].
examples.chinese: 我们试试从新[角度]解决这个问题。

meanings.explanation: [Appreciation] is the feeling of being grateful and recognizing the good qualities of someone or something.

examples.english: She gave her teacher a card to show her [appreciation].
examples.chinese: 她给了老师一张卡片，来表达她的[感谢]。

examples.english: My mom always cooks dinner for us, and I have great [appreciation] for her.
examples.chinese: 我妈妈总是为我们做晚饭，我对她充满[感激]之情。

examples.english: He received a small gift as a [appreciation] for his help.
examples.chinese: 他收到一份小礼物，作为对他帮忙的[感谢]。

meanings.explanation: [Appreciation] is the understanding and enjoyment of something good, such as art, music, or good food.

examples.english: Listening to classical music helps kids develop an [appreciation] for beautiful sounds.
examples.chinese: 听古典音乐能帮助孩子们培养对优美声音的[欣赏]能力。

examples.english: Our art teacher taught us an [appreciation] of paintings.
examples.chinese: 我们的美术老师教了我们如何[欣赏]绘画。

examples.english: Traveling to different countries gave her a deeper [appreciation] of other cultures.
examples.chinese: 去不同的国家旅行让她对其他文化有了更深的[欣赏]和理解。

meanings.explanation: If something such as a statement or answer is expressed [ambiguously], it is done in a way that can be understood in two or more different ways.

examples.english: My brother answered my question about his new toy [ambiguously].
examples.chinese: 我哥哥[模棱两可地]回答了我关于他新玩具的问题。

examples.english: The school notice stated the picnic time [ambiguously].
examples.chinese: 学校通知[含糊不清地]标明了野餐时间。

examples.english: The little girl pointed [ambiguously] to where she hid the candy.
examples.chinese: 小女孩[含含糊糊地]指着她藏糖果的地方。

meanings.explanation: If something's nature or appearance is [ambiguously] characterized, it is unclear what it really is or which category it belongs to.

examples.english: The dark shape in the fog moved [ambiguously], so we couldn't tell what it was.
examples.chinese: 雾里的黑影[模糊不定地]移动着，所以我们说不出那是什么东西。

examples.english: The little girl painted the sky [ambiguously], so it looked either blue or purple.
examples.chinese: 小女孩[模糊不清地]画了天空，所以它看起来既像蓝色又像紫色。

examples.english: Her expression was [ambiguously] happy and sad after hearing the news.
examples.chinese: 听到消息后，她的表情[难以捉摸地]既开心又难过。

meanings.explanation: If you [appoint] someone to a job or position, you formally choose them for it.

examples.english: The school will [appoint] a new teacher next month.
examples.chinese: 学校下个月将[任命]一位新老师。

examples.english: My dad was [appointed] as the team leader.
examples.chinese: 我爸爸被[任命]为团队负责人。

examples.english: They decided to [appoint] her to the job.
examples.chinese: 他们决定[任命]她担任这份工作。

meanings.explanation: If you [appoint] a time or place for something, you decide on it in advance.

examples.english: Let's [appoint] a time to meet at the park.
examples.chinese: 我们来[约定]一个时间在公园见面吧。

examples.english: We [appointed] Friday as the day for our party.
examples.chinese: 我们[约定]星期五举办派对。

examples.english: They [appointed] the school hall for the meeting.
examples.chinese: 他们[选定]学校礼堂作为会议地点。

meanings.explanation: When something [appears], it becomes visible or comes into sight, often after being hidden or unseen.

examples.english: A beautiful rainbow [appeared] in the sky after the rain.
examples.chinese: 雨后天空中[出现]了一道美丽的彩虹。

examples.english: The sun [appeared] from behind the thick clouds.
examples.chinese: 太阳从厚厚的云层后[出现]了。

examples.english: My missing cat [appeared] on our doorstep this morning.
examples.chinese: 我走失的猫今天早上[出现在]了我们家门口。

meanings.explanation: If something [appears] to be a particular way, it seems to be that way based on what you can see or know.

examples.english: She [appears] to be very happy with her new toy.
examples.chinese: 她[看起来]对她的新玩具很满意。

examples.english: It [appears] that we will have to walk home today.
examples.chinese: [看来]我们今天得走路回家了。

examples.english: This question [appears] easier than it actually is.
examples.chinese: 这道题[看起来]比实际要简单。

meanings.explanation: If you are [anxious], you feel worried or nervous about something that might happen.

examples.english: I feel [anxious] about the big test tomorrow.
examples.chinese: 我对明天的大考感到[焦虑]。

examples.english: She looks [anxious] before her first day of school.
examples.chinese: 她在开学第一天前看起来很[紧张]。

examples.english: He was [anxious] waiting for his mom to pick him up.
examples.chinese: 他等妈妈来接的时候很[不安]。

meanings.explanation: If you are [anxious] to do something, you want to do it very much.

examples.english: The children are [anxious] to open their Christmas presents.
examples.chinese: 孩子们[急切]地想打开圣诞礼物。

examples.english: She is [anxious] to meet her new baby brother.
examples.chinese: 她[急切]地想见到她的新弟弟。

examples.english: He is [anxious] to learn how to ride a bike.
examples.chinese: 他[迫切]地想学骑自行车。

meanings.explanation: [Arctic] means relating to the most northern part of the world, near the North Pole, or describes weather that is extremely cold.

examples.english: It was so cold that our fingers felt [arctic].
examples.chinese: 天太冷了，我们的手指感觉像[冰冻]了一样。

examples.english: Polar bears live in [arctic] areas.
examples.chinese: 北极熊生活在[北极]地区。

examples.english: We wore thick coats because of the [arctic] wind.
examples.chinese: 因为[极寒]的冷风，我们穿上了厚外套。

meanings.explanation: The [Arctic] is the region of the world around the North Pole, which is covered in ice and snow for most of the year.

examples.english: Many scientists go to the [Arctic] to study the ice.
examples.chinese: 很多科学家去[北极]研究冰川。

examples.english: The [Arctic] is very cold, even in summer.
examples.chinese: [北极]非常冷，即使在夏天也一样。

examples.english: My dream is to travel to the [Arctic] one day.
examples.chinese: 我的梦想是有朝一日去[北极]旅行。

meanings.explanation: If you [approach] someone or something, you come near to them in distance or time.

examples.english: A friendly dog [approached] me when I was walking in the park.
examples.chinese: 我在公园散步时，一只友好的狗[走近]了我。

examples.english: Winter is [approaching] and it will get much colder soon.
examples.chinese: 冬天[即将来临]，很快就会变得更冷。

examples.english: The plane slowly [approached] the runway for landing.
examples.chinese: 飞机慢慢[靠近]跑道准备降落。

meanings.explanation: An [approach] is a way of doing something or dealing with a situation.

examples.english: We need a better [approach] to solve this math problem.
examples.chinese: 我们需要一种更好的[方法]来解决这道数学题。

examples.english: Her [approach] to learning English is to watch movies every day.
examples.chinese: 她学习英语的[方法]是每天看电影。

examples.english: A different [approach] might help us finish the project faster.
examples.chinese: 不同的[思路]可能帮助我们更快完成这个项目。

meanings.explanation: An [arch] is a curved structure that goes over an open space, like a bridge or a doorway.

examples.english: We walked under the stone [arch] into the garden.
examples.chinese: 我们穿过石头[拱道]走进了花园。

examples.english: The rainbow made a beautiful [arch] in the sky.
examples.chinese: 彩虹在天空中形成了一道美丽的[拱形]。

examples.english: The old bridge has a tall [arch] over the river.
examples.chinese: 那座老桥在河面上有一个高高的[拱形]。

meanings.explanation: If something [arches], it curves or bends into the shape of an arch.

examples.english: The cat likes to [arch] its back when it wakes up.
examples.chinese: 那只猫醒来时喜欢把背[弓起]。

examples.english: She [arched] her eyebrows when she heard the news.
examples.chinese: 听到这个消息时，她把眉毛[扬了起来]。

examples.english: The tree branches [arch] over the path.
examples.chinese: 树枝在小路上空[形成了拱形]。

meanings.explanation: If you [appreciate] something that someone has done for you, you feel grateful for it.

examples.english: I really [appreciate] your help with my math homework.
examples.chinese: 我非常[感激]你帮我做数学作业。

examples.english: My grandma [appreciates] everything the neighbors do for her.
examples.chinese: 我奶奶很[感激]邻居们为她做的每件事。

examples.english: We all [appreciate] the kindness you showed us.
examples.chinese: 我们都很[感激]你对我们的好意。

meanings.explanation: If you [appreciate] something, you recognize and enjoy its good qualities or value.

examples.english: I really [appreciate] the soft wind on a hot summer day.
examples.chinese: 我很[欣赏]炎热夏日里柔和的微风。

examples.english: My dad [appreciates] quiet mornings with a cup of tea.
examples.chinese: 我爸爸很[欣赏]伴着一杯茶的安静清晨。

examples.english: You need to slow down to [appreciate] the beauty around you.
examples.chinese: 你需要放慢脚步才能[欣赏]身边的美景。

meanings.explanation: An [anchor] is a heavy metal object that is dropped from a boat or ship into the water to stop it from moving.

examples.english: The sailor dropped the [anchor] into the sea.
examples.chinese: 水手把[锚]抛进了海里。

examples.english: Our boat did not move because the [anchor] held it in place.
examples.chinese: 我们的船没有移动，因为[锚]把它固定住了。

examples.english: They pulled up the [anchor] and sailed away.
examples.chinese: 他们收起[锚]，出海航行去了。

meanings.explanation: An [anchor] is a person who presents news on television or radio.

examples.english: The news [anchor] reads the news on TV every evening.
examples.chinese: 新闻[主播]每晚在电视上播报新闻。

examples.english: She dreams of becoming a news [anchor] one day.
examples.chinese: 她梦想有一天能成为新闻[主播]。

examples.english: The [anchor] asked the mayor some important questions.
examples.chinese: [主播]向市长问了一些重要的问题。

meanings.explanation: If the police [arrest] someone, they take them away to ask them about a crime which they might have committed.

examples.english: The police [arrested] the thief on the street.
examples.chinese: 警察在街上[逮捕]了那个小偷。

examples.english: He was [arrested] for speeding last night.
examples.chinese: 他昨晚因为超速被[拘留]了。

examples.english: Don't run away, or the guards will [arrest] you!
examples.chinese: 别跑，不然保安会[抓住]你的！

meanings.explanation: An [arrest] is the act of taking someone away by the police because they are believed to have done something wrong.

examples.english: The man was put under [arrest] for stealing a bike.
examples.chinese: 那个男人因为偷自行车而被[逮捕]了。

examples.english: After the [arrest], the police took him to the station.
examples.chinese: [逮捕]之后，警察把他带到了派出所。

examples.english: The news about her [arrest] spread quickly in the school.
examples.chinese: 关于她被[逮捕]的消息很快在学校里传开了。

meanings.explanation: When you [arrive] at a place, you reach it at the end of a journey.

examples.english: Our train will [arrive] at the station in ten minutes.
examples.chinese: 我们的火车还有十分钟就[到]站了。

examples.english: I usually [arrive] home around six o'clock.
examples.chinese: 我一般六点左右[到]家。

examples.english: The guests started to [arrive] at the party.
examples.chinese: 客人们开始陆续[到达]聚会现场。

meanings.explanation: If something [arrives], it happens or appears, especially in a gradual or expected way.

examples.english: Spring finally [arrived] after a long winter.
examples.chinese: 漫长的冬天过去后，春天终于[来临]了。

examples.english: The news [arrived] that she won the competition.
examples.chinese: [传来]消息说她赢得了比赛。

examples.english: All the gifts [arrived] safely on Christmas morning.
examples.chinese: 所有的礼物在圣诞节的早晨都[送到]了。

meanings.explanation: An [architect] is a person who designs buildings and plans how they are built.

examples.english: My neighbor is an [architect] who designs beautiful houses.
examples.chinese: 我的邻居是一位[建筑师]，专门设计漂亮的房子。

examples.english: The [architect] drew careful plans for our new school.
examples.chinese: 这位[建筑师]为我们的新学校绘制了详细的设计图。

examples.english: She wants to be an [architect] when she grows up.
examples.chinese: 她长大后想当一名[建筑师]。

meanings.explanation: An [architect] is the person who creates and plans something such as a new system, idea, or project.

examples.english: He was the main [architect] of our class's spring trip plan.
examples.chinese: 他是我们班级春游计划的主要[策划者]。

examples.english: She is the [architect] of this new after-school reading club.
examples.chinese: 她是这个新课外读书俱乐部的[创始人]。

examples.english: He was the [architect] of the town's big park project.
examples.chinese: 他是这个城镇大型公园项目的[总设计师]。

meanings.explanation: An [assault] is a physical attack on another person.

examples.english: The boy on the playground threw a rock during the [assault].
examples.chinese: 操场上，那个男孩在[攻击]中扔了一块石头。

examples.english: She was scared after the [assault] near her home.
examples.chinese: 在家附近遭遇[袭击]后，她很害怕。

examples.english: The police caught the man who made the [assault].
examples.chinese: 警察抓住了那个实施[攻击]的男子。

meanings.explanation: If someone [assaults] you, they physically attack you.

examples.english: The mean boy [assaulted] his classmate after school.
examples.chinese: 那个刻薄的男孩放学后[殴打]了他的同学。

examples.english: A stranger tried to [assault] the girl in the park.
examples.chinese: 一个陌生人试图在公园里[袭击]那个女孩。

examples.english: No one should [assault] another person.
examples.chinese: 任何人都不能[攻击]他人。

meanings.explanation: An [aggressive] person or animal behaves in an angry or threatening way, as if they want to fight or attack.

examples.english: The big dog becomes [aggressive] when strangers come near the house.
examples.chinese: 那只大狗见到陌生人靠近房子时变得很[凶]。

examples.english: He spoke in an [aggressive] voice that frightened the little girl.
examples.chinese: 他说话的声音很[凶狠]，吓到了那个小女孩。

examples.english: The player was punished for [aggressive] behavior during the game.
examples.chinese: 那名球员因为在比赛中的[粗暴]行为受到了处罚。

meanings.explanation: If someone is [aggressive], they are determined to win or succeed by using forceful and energetic methods.

examples.english: Our team played an [aggressive] game and scored many goals.
examples.chinese: 我们队打得很[积极主动]，进了很多球。

examples.english: She has an [aggressive] style when playing chess.
examples.chinese: 她下棋的风格很[激进]。

examples.english: You need to be [aggressive] if you want to succeed in business.
examples.chinese: 要想在生意上成功，你得[大胆进取]。

meanings.explanation: You use [approximately] to show that an amount or number is not exact, but is close to a particular figure.

examples.english: It takes [approximately] ten minutes to walk to school.
examples.chinese: 走路去学校[大约]需要十分钟。

examples.english: There are [approximately] thirty students in our class.
examples.chinese: 我们班[大约]有三十个学生。

examples.english: The tree in our yard is [approximately] five meters tall.
examples.chinese: 我们院子里的树[大约]有五米高。

meanings.explanation: If you [ascertain] something, you find out or make sure that it is true. It means you want to be certain about a fact or a situation.

examples.english: The teacher wanted to [ascertain] how many students would come to the picnic.
examples.chinese: 老师想[弄清楚]有多少学生会来野餐。

examples.english: Please [ascertain] if the library is open today before we go.
examples.chinese: 我们出发前，请先[确认]一下图书馆今天是否开放。

examples.english: Mom tried to [ascertain] the exact time of my game.
examples.chinese: 妈妈想[确认]我比赛的确切时间。

meanings.explanation: When you [ascertain] something, you discover it through careful checking or investigation, especially in a more formal situation.

examples.english: The police tried to [ascertain] what happened last night.
examples.chinese: 警察试图[查明]昨晚发生了什么。

examples.english: We need to [ascertain] the cause of the fire.
examples.chinese: 我们需要[查明]起火的原因。

examples.english: The doctor wanted to [ascertain] the cause of her illness.
examples.chinese: 医生想要[查明]她生病的原因。

meanings.explanation: An [altitude] is the height of something above the level of the sea or above the ground.

examples.english: The plane is flying at an [altitude] of 10,000 meters.
examples.chinese: 飞机在[海拔]一万米的高空飞行。

examples.english: This mountain has an [altitude] of 4,500 meters.
examples.chinese: 这座山的[海拔]是四千五百米。

examples.english: The pilot checked the plane's [altitude] on the screen.
examples.chinese: 飞行员检查了飞机的[高度]。

meanings.explanation: In geometry, an [altitude] is the height of a triangle or other shape, measured straight down from the top point to the bottom side.

examples.english: We measured the [altitude] of the triangle in math class.
examples.chinese: 我们在数学课上测量了三角形的[高]。

examples.english: The [altitude] of this triangle is 5 centimeters.
examples.chinese: 这个三角形的[高]是五厘米。

examples.english: Draw an [altitude] from the top point to the bottom line.
examples.chinese: 从顶点到底边画一条[高]。

meanings.explanation: An [artifact] is an object that is made by a person, especially something of historical or cultural interest, such as a tool, piece of art, or ancient item.

examples.english: The museum displayed a beautiful clay pot that was an [artifact] from ancient China.
examples.chinese: 博物馆展出了一只漂亮的陶罐，那是来自中国古代的[文物]。

examples.english: Archaeologists found an [artifact] while digging in the old village.
examples.chinese: 考古学家在那个古老的村庄挖掘时发现了一件[人工制品]。

examples.english: This stone arrowhead is an [artifact] made by people long ago.
examples.chinese: 这个石箭头是很久以前人们制作的[手工艺品]。

meanings.explanation: When people [assemble], they gather together in one place, or you bring them together.

examples.english: The students [assemble] in the schoolyard every morning.
examples.chinese: 学生们每天早上在操场上[集合]。

examples.english: The manager asked all workers to [assemble] in the meeting room.
examples.chinese: 经理让所有员工在会议室[集合]。

examples.english: Everyone will [assemble] at the park gate at 9 o'clock.
examples.chinese: 大家将在九点在公园门口[集合]。

meanings.explanation: If you [assemble] something, you fit its different parts together to make it.

examples.english: Dad needs to [assemble] the new bookshelf this weekend.
examples.chinese: 爸爸这周末需要[组装]新书柜。

examples.english: It took me two hours to [assemble] the toy car.
examples.chinese: 我花了两个小时[组装]那辆玩具车。

examples.english: Please follow the instructions to [assemble] the parts.
examples.chinese: 请按照说明书把这些零件[组装]起来。

meanings.explanation: If you [apply] for a job, a place at a school, or permission to do something, you formally ask to be given it or allowed to do it.

examples.english: My sister wants to [apply] for a part-time job at the bookstore.
examples.chinese: 我姐姐想[申请]书店的兼职工作。

examples.english: Tom [applied] for a library card yesterday.
examples.chinese: 汤姆昨天[申请]了借书卡。

examples.english: She is going to [apply] to the art school next year.
examples.chinese: 她打算明年[申请]那所艺术学校。

meanings.explanation: If you [apply] something to a surface, you put it on that surface. If you [apply] a rule or skill, you use it in a particular situation.

examples.english: Remember to [apply] sunscreen before you go outside to play.
examples.chinese: 出去玩之前记得[涂]防晒霜。

examples.english: We learned how to [apply] this math rule in class today.
examples.chinese: 今天课上我们学了怎么[运用]这个数学规则。

examples.english: He [applied] the glue carefully to the paper.
examples.chinese: 他小心地把胶水[涂]在纸上。

meanings.explanation: An [assignment] is a piece of work or a task that a teacher gives you to do, usually as part of your schoolwork or homework.

examples.english: I have a math [assignment] due tomorrow.
examples.chinese: 我明天有一份数学[作业]要交。

examples.english: The teacher gave us a fun [assignment] about animals.
examples.chinese: 老师给我们布置了一份关于动物的有趣[作业]。

examples.english: She finished her English [assignment] quickly.
examples.chinese: 她很快就完成了英语[作业]。

meanings.explanation: An [assignment] can also mean a job or duty that you are given to do, especially at work or during a trip.

examples.english: The reporter went abroad for a special [assignment].
examples.chinese: 记者出国执行一项特别[任务]。

examples.english: His first [assignment] at the new company was to design a logo.
examples.chinese: 他在新公司的第一个[任务]是设计一个标志。

examples.english: The police officer completed her [assignment] successfully.
examples.chinese: 那位女警成功完成了她的[任务]。

meanings.explanation: If you [arrange] a number of things, you put them in a particular order or position.

examples.english: I always [arrange] my toys in my toy box after playing.
examples.chinese: 我玩完玩具后总会把它们[整理]好放进玩具箱。

examples.english: My mom [arranged] the plates and bowls on the dining table.
examples.chinese: 我妈妈把餐盘和碗[摆放]在餐桌上。

examples.english: Can you help me [arrange] these pencils by color?
examples.chinese: 你能帮我按颜色[整理]这些铅笔吗？

meanings.explanation: If you [arrange] an event, meeting, or activity, you plan and organize it so that it can take place.

examples.english: Dad will [arrange] a family trip to the beach this summer.
examples.chinese: 爸爸今年夏天会[安排]一次家庭沙滩旅行。

examples.english: We need to [arrange] a birthday party for my little sister.
examples.chinese: 我们要给小妹妹[安排]一场生日派对。

examples.english: The teacher [arranged] a meeting with my parents yesterday.
examples.chinese: 老师昨天[安排]了和我父母的见面。

meanings.explanation: If someone is [arrogant], they behave in a proud, unpleasant way toward other people because they believe that they are more important or better than others.

examples.english: The [arrogant] boy said he was smarter than everyone else.
examples.chinese: 那个[傲慢的]男孩说自己比所有人都聪明。

examples.english: Nobody wants to be friends with her because she is so [arrogant].
examples.chinese: 没人想跟她交朋友，因为她太[傲慢]了。

examples.english: His [arrogant] tone made everyone in the room feel upset.
examples.chinese: 他[傲慢]的语气让房间里每个人都觉得不舒服。

meanings.explanation: If you [assume] that something is true, you think that it is true although you have no definite proof.

examples.english: I [assume] you like ice cream, so I bought two scoops.
examples.chinese: 我[以为]你喜欢吃冰淇淋，所以买了两球。
