examples.chinese: 她因为胃部[不适]去看医生了。

meanings.explanation: If you [come across] someone or something, you meet or find them by chance.

examples.english: I [came across] an old photo while cleaning my room.
examples.chinese: 我打扫房间的时候[偶然发现]了一张老照片。

examples.english: Yesterday I [came across] my primary school teacher on the street.
examples.chinese: 昨天我在街上[偶遇]了我的小学老师。

examples.english: She [came across] a nice little shop when walking home.
examples.chinese: 她走路回家的时候[偶然发现]了一家漂亮的小店。

meanings.explanation: If you [come across] in a particular way, you seem to have a particular quality when you speak or behave.

examples.english: He [comes across] as a very honest kid.
examples.chinese: 他[给人感觉]是一个很诚实的孩子。

examples.english: When she speaks, she [comes across] as very confident.
examples.chinese: 她说话的时候[显得]很自信。

examples.english: That teacher [comes across] as very strict at first.
examples.chinese: 那位老师一开始[给人的感觉]很严厉。

meanings.explanation: To [clarify] something means to make it easier to understand, often by giving more details or explaining it more clearly.

examples.english: Can you [clarify] what you mean by that?
examples.chinese: 你能[说清楚]你那么说是什么意思吗？

examples.english: The teacher stopped to [clarify] the rules of the game.
examples.chinese: 老师停下来[讲清楚]游戏规则。

examples.english: Please [clarify] your answer so everyone can follow.
examples.chinese: 请[解释清楚]你的回答，让大家都能听懂。

meanings.explanation: If you [clarify] a liquid such as butter or soup, you remove unwanted substances so that it becomes clear and pure.

examples.english: Mom knows how to [clarify] butter for baking cookies.
examples.chinese: 妈妈知道怎么[澄清]黄油来烤饼干。

examples.english: The chef showed us how to [clarify] chicken broth.
examples.chinese: 厨师给我们示范了如何[澄清]鸡汤。

examples.english: You can [clarify] the soup by straining it through a cloth.
examples.chinese: 你可以用布过滤来[澄清]汤。

meanings.explanation: If you [combine] two or more things, you join them together or mix them into one.

examples.english: Let's [combine] the flour and eggs to make pancakes.
examples.chinese: 我们把面粉和鸡蛋[混合]在一起做煎饼吧。

examples.english: We can [combine] our money to buy a birthday present.
examples.chinese: 我们可以把钱[凑]在一起买生日礼物。

examples.english: The two classes [combine] for the art lesson every Friday.
examples.chinese: 两个班每周五[合]在一起上美术课。

meanings.explanation: A [combine] is a large farm machine that cuts crops and separates the grain from them.

examples.english: My uncle drives a [combine] to harvest wheat in autumn.
examples.chinese: 我叔叔秋天开[联合收割机]收割小麦。

examples.english: The farmer uses a [combine] to collect the corn.
examples.chinese: 农民用[联合收割机]来收玉米。

examples.english: We watched the big red [combine] working in the field.
examples.chinese: 我们看着那台红色的大[联合收割机]在田里作业。

meanings.explanation: If a situation, rule, or person [compels] you to do something, they force you to do it.

examples.english: The bad weather [compelled] us to stop our picnic.
examples.chinese: 坏天气[迫使]我们停止了野餐。

examples.english: My dad [compels] me to finish homework before playing.
examples.chinese: 我爸爸[强迫]我做完作业再玩。

examples.english: Traffic rules [compel] drivers to stop at red lights.
examples.chinese: 交通规则[迫使]司机红灯时停车。

meanings.explanation: If something [compels] a particular reaction or feeling, it causes it strongly.

examples.english: Her brave act [compels] everyone's admiration.
examples.chinese: 她勇敢的行为[博得]所有人的赞赏。

examples.english: This moving story [compels] our full attention.
examples.chinese: 这个感人的故事[吸引]我们全部的注意力。

examples.english: His honest words [compelled] our trust.
examples.chinese: 他诚实的话语[赢得]了我们的信任。

meanings.explanation: The [complexity] of something is how complicated or difficult to understand it is.

examples.english: The [complexity] of this puzzle makes it hard to finish.
examples.chinese: 这道拼图游戏的[复杂性]让它很难完成。

examples.english: I don't understand the [complexity] of this math problem.
examples.chinese: 我不懂这道数学题的[复杂之处]。

examples.english: The game has different levels of [complexity].
examples.chinese: 这款游戏有不同的[复杂]程度。

meanings.explanation: A [complexity] is a part of something that makes it difficult to understand or deal with.

examples.english: There are many [complexities] in planning a birthday party.
examples.chinese: 策划生日派对有很多[复杂环节]。

examples.english: The teacher explained the [complexity] of the grammar rule.
examples.chinese: 老师解释了这条语法规则的[复杂之处]。

examples.english: We need to understand all the [complexities] before we start.
examples.chinese: 开始前我们需要了解所有的[复杂情况]。

meanings.explanation: A [complication] is a problem or difficulty that makes a situation harder to deal with than it already is.

examples.english: The heavy rain added a [complication] to our school trip.
examples.chinese: 大雨给我们的学校出游添了[麻烦]。

examples.english: We finished the project on time without any [complications].
examples.chinese: 我们按时完成了项目，没有出现任何[波折]。

examples.english: Money problems are a common [complication] for many families.
examples.chinese: 经济问题是许多家庭常见的[困扰]。

meanings.explanation: A [complication] is an additional medical problem that makes an existing illness or condition worse or harder to treat.

examples.english: She developed a [complication] after the surgery.
examples.chinese: 她手术后出现了[并发症]。

examples.english: The doctor said there were no [complications] during the treatment.
examples.chinese: 医生说治疗过程中没有出现[并发症]。

examples.english: A common [complication] of a cold is an ear infection.
examples.chinese: 感冒常见的[并发症]是耳部感染。

meanings.explanation: A [commentator] is a person who gives spoken description and analysis of an event on television, radio, or the internet, especially during a sports game.

examples.english: The [commentator] talked excitedly about the soccer game on TV.
examples.chinese: 这位[解说员]在电视上兴奋地解说这场足球比赛。

examples.english: My dad always listens to the [commentator] when he watches basketball games.
examples.chinese: 我爸爸看篮球比赛的时候总会听这位[解说员]的解说。

examples.english: The [commentator] explained the new game rules to us clearly.
examples.chinese: 这位[解说员]清楚地给我们讲解了新的比赛规则。

meanings.explanation: A [commentator] is a person who gives opinions and analysis on public issues or interesting topics in newspapers, on TV, or online.

examples.english: The news [commentator] talked about the new city park rule on TV.
examples.chinese: 这位新闻[评论员]在电视上谈论了新的城市公园规则。

examples.english: This [commentator] often shares his ideas about school life online.
examples.chinese: 这位[评论员]经常在网上分享他对校园生活的看法。

examples.english: Many kids like to watch what this cartoon [commentator] says online.
examples.chinese: 很多小朋友喜欢看这位动漫[评论员]在网上的发言。

meanings.explanation: If you [compose] a piece of music, a poem, or a letter, you create it by writing or putting words, music, or ideas together.

examples.english: My older brother can [compose] beautiful songs on his guitar.
examples.chinese: 我哥哥能用吉他[作曲]，曲调很优美。

examples.english: She sat at her desk to [compose] a thank-you letter.
examples.chinese: 她坐在桌前[写]一封感谢信。

examples.english: The famous musician has [compose]d many symphonies.
examples.chinese: 这位著名音乐家已经[创作]了许多交响曲。

meanings.explanation: If you [compose] yourself, you make an effort to become calm and control your emotions, especially after being angry or upset.

examples.english: He took a deep breath to [compose] himself before the interview.
examples.chinese: 面试前他深吸一口气，让自己[冷静]下来。

examples.english: Try to [compose] yourself and tell me what happened.
examples.chinese: 试着[平复]一下情绪，告诉我发生了什么。

examples.english: She needed a moment to [compose] herself after hearing the news.
examples.chinese: 听到这个消息后，她需要一点时间[镇定]自己。

meanings.explanation: When you [complain], you express that you are unhappy, annoyed, or not satisfied with something.

examples.english: My sister always [complains] that her bedroom is too small.
examples.chinese: 我妹妹总是[抱怨]她的卧室太小了。

examples.english: Dad [complained] about the bad weather this morning.
examples.chinese: 爸爸今天早上[抱怨]天气太差了。

examples.english: Don't [complain] when you have to do a little work.
examples.chinese: 需要做一点工作的时候，别老是[抱怨]。

meanings.explanation: If you [complain] to someone in authority, you formally tell them about a problem or something bad that has affected you.

examples.english: We need to [complain] to the manager about the cold food.
examples.chinese: 我们需要向经理[投诉]这份凉掉的食物。

examples.english: My mom [complained] to the school about the broken playground.
examples.chinese: 我妈妈向学校[投诉]了破损的操场。

examples.english: If the product is broken, you can [complain] to the shop.
examples.chinese: 如果商品坏了，你可以向商店[投诉]。

meanings.explanation: Something that is [comprehensive] includes all or nearly all the elements or aspects of something, so that nothing important is left out.

examples.english: The teacher gave us a [comprehensive] list of books to read this summer.
examples.chinese: 老师给了我们一份[详尽的]暑假书单。

examples.english: We need a [comprehensive] plan before we start the project.
examples.chinese: 在开始项目之前，我们需要一个[全面的]计划。

examples.english: The doctor gave him a [comprehensive] health check.
examples.chinese: 医生给他做了一次[全面的]健康检查。

meanings.explanation: (British English) A [comprehensive] school is a state secondary school that provides education for children of all abilities in a particular area.

examples.english: She goes to the local [comprehensive] school near our house.
examples.chinese: 她在我们家附近的[公立综合]中学上学。

examples.english: My brother studied at a [comprehensive] for five years.
examples.chinese: 我哥哥在一所[公立综合]中学念了五年书。

examples.english: Most children in this town attend a [comprehensive].
examples.chinese: 这个镇上大多数孩子都上[公立综合]中学。

meanings.explanation: A [complicated] situation, problem, or question has many different parts and is difficult to understand or deal with.

examples.english: This math problem is too [complicated] for me.
examples.chinese: 这道数学题对我来说太[复杂]了。

examples.english: I don't understand this [complicated] game rule.
examples.chinese: 我看不懂这个[复杂]的游戏规则。

examples.english: Making a cake from scratch seems [complicated], but it's actually easy.
examples.chinese: 从头做蛋糕看起来很[复杂]，其实很简单。

meanings.explanation: A [complicated] machine, object, or system has many different connected parts, making it hard to understand how it works.

examples.english: The inside of a watch is very [complicated].
examples.chinese: 手表的内部非常[复杂]。

examples.english: This toy robot has a [complicated] design.
examples.chinese: 这个玩具机器人的设计很[复杂]。

examples.english: A car engine is a [complicated] piece of machinery.
examples.chinese: 汽车引擎是一个[复杂]的机械部件。

meanings.explanation: If something is [complete], it has all the parts it should have and is finished; nothing is missing.

examples.english: I have a [complete] collection of stamps from my grandpa.
examples.chinese: 我有一套[完整的]爷爷邮票收藏。

examples.english: She gave me a [complete] list of all the things to buy.
examples.chinese: 她给了我一张[完整的]购物清单。

examples.english: This puzzle is not [complete]; there are pieces missing.
examples.chinese: 这个拼图[不完整]，还缺几块。

meanings.explanation: To [complete] something means to finish it or to make it whole by adding whatever was missing.

examples.english: I will [complete] my homework before dinner.
examples.chinese: 我会在晚饭前[完成]作业。

examples.english: Can you help me [complete] this form?
examples.chinese: 你能帮我[填完]这个表格吗？

examples.english: She [complete]d the race in first place.
examples.chinese: 她[跑完]了比赛，获得了第一名。

meanings.explanation: Something that is [compositive] is made by putting different parts, elements, or ideas together to form a single thing.

examples.english: The artist used a [compositive] style, mixing paint and paper in one picture.
examples.chinese: 这位艺术家采用了[复合的]风格，把颜料和纸张混合在一幅画里。

examples.english: This toy has a [compositive] design with building blocks of many colors.
examples.chinese: 这个玩具采用了[组合的]设计，包含许多颜色的积木。

examples.english: A [compositive] meal includes food from different groups like vegetables and meat.
examples.chinese: 一顿[搭配均衡的]餐食包含来自不同种类的食物，比如蔬菜和肉类。

meanings.explanation: If you [concentrate] on something, you give all your attention to it and think hard about it.

examples.english: Please turn off the music. I need to [concentrate] on my homework.
examples.chinese: 请把音乐关了吧，我得[集中注意力]写作业。

examples.english: It's hard to [concentrate] when your little brother keeps shouting.
examples.chinese: 弟弟一直在叫喊的时候，很难[集中注意力]。

examples.english: She closed her eyes and [concentrated] on the question.
examples.chinese: 她闭上眼睛，[集中精力]思考那道题。

meanings.explanation: If you [concentrate] something, or if something [concentrates], it is brought together in one place, or its strength increases.

examples.english: The orange juice is too sour. You need to add water to the [concentrated] juice.
examples.chinese: 这橙汁太酸了，你得往[浓缩]果汁里加点水。

examples.english: The factory [concentrates] all its workers on making toys.
examples.chinese: 这家工厂把所有工人都[集中]起来做玩具。

examples.english: Most of the population is [concentrated] in the city center.
examples.chinese: 大部分人口都[集中在]市中心。

meanings.explanation: The [conclusion] is the final part of something, such as a story, speech, or meeting.

examples.english: At the [conclusion] of the movie, everyone clapped.
examples.chinese: 电影[结束]时，大家都鼓掌了。

examples.english: Please wait until the [conclusion] of the ceremony.
examples.chinese: 请等到仪式[结束]。

examples.english: The [conclusion] of the book was very exciting.
examples.chinese: 这本书的[结尾]非常精彩。

meanings.explanation: A [conclusion] is an opinion or decision that you reach after thinking about something carefully.

examples.english: After studying the facts, I came to a [conclusion].
examples.chinese: 研究了事实之后，我得出了一个[结论]。

examples.english: What is your [conclusion] about this problem?
examples.chinese: 关于这个问题，你的[结论]是什么？

examples.english: The scientist reached a surprising [conclusion].
examples.chinese: 这位科学家得出了一个令人惊讶的[结论]。

meanings.explanation: If someone is [composed], they are calm and in control of their feelings, even when something difficult or upsetting happens.

examples.english: The little girl stayed [composed] when she lost her toy.
examples.chinese: 那个小女孩丢了玩具时依然保持[镇定]。

examples.english: Even before a big test, my brother always looks [composed].
examples.chinese: 即使在大考之前，我哥哥也总是看起来很[镇定]。

examples.english: Take a deep breath and try to stay [composed].
examples.chinese: 深呼吸，尽量保持[镇定]。

meanings.explanation: If something is [composed] of particular parts or things, it is made from those parts or consists of them.

examples.english: Water is [composed] of hydrogen and oxygen.
examples.chinese: 水由氢和氧[组成]。

examples.english: Our class is [composed] of twenty boys and fifteen girls.
examples.chinese: 我们班由二十个男生和十五个女生[组成]。

examples.english: This salad is [composed] of fresh vegetables.
examples.chinese: 这份沙拉由新鲜蔬菜[组成]。

meanings.explanation: When you [compute] something, you calculate it or work it out by using numbers, especially with the help of a computer.

examples.english: We need to [compute] the total price of these apples.
examples.chinese: 我们需要[计算]这些苹果的总价。

examples.english: I will use a calculator to [compute] my math homework.
examples.chinese: 我要用计算器来[计算]我的数学作业。

examples.english: My dad uses his laptop to [compute] our monthly expenses.
examples.chinese: 我爸爸用他的笔记本电脑来[计算]我们家每月的开销。

meanings.explanation: If you [comprehend] something, you understand it fully and clearly.

examples.english: I can't [comprehend] why he didn't come to my birthday party.
examples.chinese: 我无法[理解]他为什么没来我的生日派对。

examples.english: It is hard to [comprehend] how big the world is.
examples.chinese: 很难[理解]这个世界有多大。

examples.english: This story is too difficult for me to [comprehend].
examples.chinese: 这个故事太难了，我[理解]不了。

meanings.explanation: If you [conduct] an activity or task, you organize it and carry it out.

examples.english: Our teacher will [conduct] a science experiment in class today.
examples.chinese: 我们老师今天会在课上[做]一个科学实验。

examples.english: The school will [conduct] a survey about what students like to eat.
examples.chinese: 学校将[进行]一项关于学生喜欢吃什么的调查。

examples.english: My dad [conducts] meetings at his office every Monday morning.
examples.chinese: 我爸爸每个星期一早上在办公室[主持]会议。

meanings.explanation: Someone's [conduct] is the way they behave in particular situations.

examples.english: Tom won an award for good [conduct] at school.
examples.chinese: 汤姆因为在学校的[良好表现]而获得了奖项。

examples.english: The teacher was unhappy with his bad [conduct] in class.
examples.chinese: 老师对他在课堂上的[不良行为]很不满意。

examples.english: We should show good [conduct] when we visit the museum.
examples.chinese: 我们去参观博物馆时应该表现出[良好的举止]。

meanings.explanation: A [confederation] is a group of states, organizations, or people that have joined together for a shared goal or purpose, while each member keeps some of its own power or independence.

examples.english: Canada became a [confederation] in 1867.
examples.chinese: 加拿大在1867年成为一个[联邦]。

examples.english: The twelve countries formed a [confederation] to help each other trade.
examples.chinese: 这十二个国家组成一个[联盟]来互相帮助贸易。

examples.english: Our club is part of a larger [confederation] of youth groups.
examples.chinese: 我们俱乐部是一个更大的青年团体[联合会]的一部分。

meanings.explanation: A [confederation] is also the act of joining together into a group, or the state of being joined in this way.

examples.english: The [confederation] of the northern colonies took many years.
examples.chinese: 北方殖民地的[联合]花了很多年才实现。

examples.english: After the [confederation], the new country had one flag.
examples.chinese: [联合]之后，这个新国家有了一面旗帜。

examples.english: The tribes lived in peace after their [confederation].
examples.chinese: 各部落[联合]后和平地生活在一起。

meanings.explanation: [Conclusive] evidence, proof, or results prove that something is definitely true and leave no room for doubt.

examples.english: The detective found [conclusive] evidence that proved who did it.
examples.chinese: 侦探找到了[确凿的]证据，证明了是谁干的。

examples.english: We got a [conclusive] result after many tests.
examples.chinese: 经过多次测试，我们得到了[确定的]结果。

examples.english: The teacher hasn't made a [conclusive] decision about our school trip yet.
examples.chinese: 老师还没有对我们的学校旅行做出[最终的]决定。

meanings.explanation: When you make a [comparison], you look at two or more people or things to see how they are alike or different.

examples.english: Let's make a [comparison] between a bicycle and a car.
examples.chinese: 我们把自行车和汽车做一个[比较]吧。

examples.english: In [comparison] to yesterday, today is much warmer.
examples.chinese: 跟昨天一[比]，今天暖和多了。

examples.english: A quick [comparison] of the prices shows this store is cheaper.
examples.chinese: 快速[比较]一下价格就能看出这家店更便宜。

meanings.explanation: A [comparison] is a statement that one thing is similar to another thing.

examples.english: The teacher made a [comparison] between our class and a big family.
examples.chinese: 老师打了一个[比方]，说我们班就像一个大家庭。

examples.english: She made a funny [comparison] between her dad and a teddy bear.
examples.chinese: 她开了一个有趣的[比喻]，说她爸爸像一只泰迪熊。

examples.english: His [comparison] of the clouds to cotton candy made everyone smile.
examples.chinese: 他把云朵比作棉花糖的[比喻]让大家都笑了。

meanings.explanation: If you [confirm] something, you say or show that it is definitely true or correct.

examples.english: Can you [confirm] if the party is at six o'clock?
examples.chinese: 你能[确认]一下派对是不是六点吗？

examples.english: The teacher [confirmed] that we will have a test tomorrow.
examples.chinese: 老师[确认]了明天要考试。

examples.english: Mom [confirmed] the bad weather on TV.
examples.chinese: 妈妈在电视上[确认]了恶劣天气的消息。

meanings.explanation: When you [confirm] a plan, booking, or arrangement, you say that you will definitely do it or keep it.

examples.english: Please [confirm] your seat on the plane before Friday.
examples.chinese: 请在周五之前[确认]你的飞机座位。

examples.english: I called the restaurant to [confirm] our table for tonight.
examples.chinese: 我给餐厅打了电话，[确认]了今晚的位子。

examples.english: She sent a message to [confirm] she could come to the party.
examples.chinese: 她发了一条消息[确认]她能来参加派对。

meanings.explanation: If you [confine] someone or something, you keep them within a particular place or area, or you keep them within certain limits.

examples.english: Please [confine] your dog to the backyard.
examples.chinese: 请把你的狗[关在]后院。

examples.english: The sick boy was [confined] to his room for a week.
examples.chinese: 那个生病的男孩在房间里[待了]一个星期。

examples.english: Let's [confine] our drawing to this piece of paper.
examples.chinese: 我们把画画[限定在]这张纸上吧。

meanings.explanation: If something is [complex], it has many different parts and is often difficult to understand or deal with.

examples.english: This math problem is too [complex] for me.
examples.chinese: 这道数学题对我来说太[复杂]了。

examples.english: The rules of this board game are very [complex].
examples.chinese: 这个桌游的规则非常[复杂]。

examples.english: My grandpa explained the [complex] rules of chess to me.
examples.chinese: 爷爷给我讲了[复杂]的国际象棋规则。

meanings.explanation: A [complex] is a group of buildings that are built together for a particular purpose.

examples.english: There is a new shopping [complex] near my school.
examples.chinese: 我们学校附近新开了一家购物[中心]。

examples.english: Our family lives in a large apartment [complex].
examples.chinese: 我们家住在一个大型公寓[小区]里。

examples.english: The sports [complex] has a swimming pool and a basketball court.
examples.chinese: 这个体育[中心]有游泳池和篮球场。

meanings.explanation: A [conflict] is a situation where two or more people or groups disagree strongly and often argue or fight.

examples.english: The two boys had a [conflict] over who gets to play the video game first.
examples.chinese: 这两个男孩因为谁先玩电子游戏而起[争执]。

examples.english: There is a [conflict] between the two teams in the soccer game.
examples.chinese: 这两支足球队在比赛中有[冲突]。

examples.english: My mom and I sometimes have a [conflict] about my bedtime.
examples.chinese: 我和妈妈有时会因睡觉时间而有[分歧]。

meanings.explanation: If two things [conflict], they are different or opposite and cannot both be true or happen at the same time.

examples.english: What he said [conflicts] with what she told me.
examples.chinese: 他说的和她告诉我的互相[矛盾]。

examples.english: The new school rules [conflict] with our family rules.
examples.chinese: 新的学校规定和我们的家规[相冲突]。

examples.english: Her study plan [conflicts] with her dance class schedule.
examples.chinese: 她的学习计划和她的舞蹈课时间[冲突]。

meanings.explanation: If you [confuse] two things, you get them mixed up so that you think one of them is the other one.

examples.english: I often [confuse] my twin brothers because they look exactly the same.
examples.chinese: 我经常[搞混]我的双胞胎兄弟，因为他们长得一模一样。

examples.english: Don't [confuse] the red cup with the blue one.
examples.chinese: 别把红色杯子和蓝色的[弄混]了。

examples.english: It's easy to [confuse] these two words.
examples.chinese: 这两个词很容易[混淆]。

meanings.explanation: To [confuse] someone means to make them unable to think clearly or to understand something.

examples.english: This math problem really [confuses] me.
examples.chinese: 这道数学题把我[搞糊涂]了。

examples.english: Too many rules will [confuse] the children.
examples.chinese: 太多规则会把孩子们[弄糊涂]的。

examples.english: The teacher's explanation [confused] everyone.
examples.chinese: 老师的解释让大家都很[困惑]。

meanings.explanation: If you [conclude] something, you end it or bring it to a finish.

examples.english: Our teacher [concluded] the lesson with a funny song.
examples.chinese: 我们老师用一首有趣的歌[结束]了这节课。

examples.english: The party [concluded] with everyone dancing together.
examples.chinese: 派对以大家一起跳舞[结束]。

examples.english: Let's [conclude] our game and go to bed.
examples.chinese: 我们[结束]游戏去睡觉吧。

meanings.explanation: If you [conclude] that something is true, you decide it is true after thinking carefully.

examples.english: From the footprints, I [concluded] that a cat had been here.
examples.chinese: 从脚印来看，我[断定]有只猫来过这里。

examples.english: After trying all the keys, she [concluded] that the small one worked.
examples.chinese: 试了所有钥匙后，她[得出结论]小的那把能用。

examples.english: What do you [conclude] from this story?
examples.chinese: 你从这个故事[得出什么结论]？

meanings.explanation: If you [conceal] something, you hide it carefully so that no one can see it or find it.

examples.english: The cat [concealed] itself under the bed.
examples.chinese: 那只猫把自己[藏]在了床底下。

examples.english: He [concealed] the birthday gift in the closet.
examples.chinese: 他把生日礼物[藏]在了衣柜里。

examples.english: She [concealed] the candy wrapper behind her back.
examples.chinese: 她把糖纸[藏]在了背后。

meanings.explanation: If you [conceal] something such as information or your feelings, you do not let anyone know about it.

examples.english: He [concealed] the bad news from his mom.
examples.chinese: 他向妈妈[隐瞒]了这个坏消息。

examples.english: She tried to [conceal] her nervousness before the test.
examples.chinese: 考试前她试图[掩饰]自己的紧张。

examples.english: He didn't [conceal] his love for ice cream.
examples.chinese: 他没有[隐瞒]自己对冰淇淋的喜爱。

meanings.explanation: If something [comprises] a number of things or people, it has them as its parts or members; to include or contain.

examples.english: A dozen [comprises] twelve items.
examples.chinese: 一打[包含]十二件物品。

examples.english: Our class [comprises] twenty students.
examples.chinese: 我们班[由]二十名学生[组成]。

examples.english: This fruit basket [comprises] apples, bananas, and oranges.
examples.chinese: 这个水果篮[装有]苹果、香蕉和橙子。

meanings.explanation: If something [comprises] a group of people or things, those people or things form or make up that thing.

examples.english: Three players [comprise] a basketball team on the court.
examples.chinese: 三名球员[组成]场上一支篮球队。

examples.english: Ten teams [comprise] the league this season.
examples.chinese: 十支队伍[构成了]本赛季的联盟。

examples.english: Six lessons [comprise] the first unit of our textbook.
examples.chinese: 六节课[构成了]我们教科书的第一单元。

meanings.explanation: If you are [conscious] of something, you notice it or recognize that it exists or is happening.

examples.english: I was very [conscious] of his eyes watching me.
examples.chinese: 我[意识到]他在看着我。

examples.english: She is very [conscious] of the dangers of the road.
examples.chinese: 她很[清楚]路上的危险。

examples.english: We need to be [conscious] of how much water we use.
examples.chinese: 我们需要[注意]自己用了多少水。

meanings.explanation: Someone who is [conscious] is awake rather than asleep or unconscious.

examples.english: The man was still [conscious] after the accident.
examples.chinese: 事故发生后，那个男人仍然[清醒]。

examples.english: She became [conscious] again after a short sleep.
examples.chinese: 小睡了一会儿后，她又[清醒]过来了。

examples.english: Is the patient [conscious] yet?
examples.chinese: 病人现在[清醒]了吗？

meanings.explanation: Something that is [confusing] makes it difficult for you to understand or know what to do.

examples.english: The game rules are so [confusing] that I don't know how to play.
examples.chinese: 游戏规则太[令人困惑]了，我都不会玩。

examples.english: This math problem is really [confusing].
examples.chinese: 这道数学题真的[让人搞不懂]。

examples.english: The road signs here are very [confusing].
examples.chinese: 这里的路牌非常[容易让人混淆]。

meanings.explanation: If a situation or thing is [confusing], it contains many different parts or pieces that are not easy to tell apart.

examples.english: The two cats look so [confusing] that I can't tell which is which.
examples.chinese: 两只猫看起来太[容易搞混]了，我分不清哪只是哪只。

examples.english: The map is so [confusing] that we keep walking in the wrong direction.
examples.chinese: 这地图太[让人迷惑]了，我们一直走错方向。

examples.english: The teacher's handwriting is a bit [confusing].
examples.chinese: 老师的字迹有点[难以辨认]。

meanings.explanation: A [compromise] is an agreement between two people or groups in which each side gives up something that they want, so that both sides can be satisfied.

examples.english: My friends and I reached a [compromise] and decided to go to the park first.
examples.chinese: 我和朋友们达成了[妥协]，决定先去公园。

examples.english: A good [compromise] means everyone gives a little.
examples.chinese: 好的[折中方案]意味着每个人都让一小步。

examples.english: The [compromise] worked well and both teams were happy.
examples.chinese: 这个[折中办法]很管用，两支队伍都很开心。

meanings.explanation: If you [compromise] with someone, you reach an agreement by both accepting less than you originally wanted, so that neither person feels completely unhappy.

examples.english: You need to [compromise] when playing with others.
examples.chinese: 和别人一起玩的时候，你需要[让步]。

examples.english: Can we [compromise] on where to eat dinner?
examples.chinese: 我们能在去哪儿吃晚饭上[折中一下]吗？

examples.english: She learned to [compromise] with her little brother.
examples.chinese: 她学会了和弟弟[妥协]。

meanings.explanation: If you [consider] something, you think about it carefully before making a decision or forming an opinion about it.

examples.english: Please [consider] what you want to eat for dinner tonight.
examples.chinese: 请好好[考虑]今晚想吃什么。

examples.english: I need to [consider] if I should join the art club.
examples.chinese: 我需要[考虑]一下要不要加入美术社团。

examples.english: She will [consider] your idea before she decides.
examples.chinese: 她在做决定之前会认真[考虑]你的想法。

meanings.explanation: If you [consider] someone or something in a particular way, you believe or regard them as having that quality.

examples.english: I [consider] him my best friend.
examples.chinese: 我[把]他[当作]我最好的朋友。

examples.english: We all [consider] this a great success.
examples.chinese: 我们都[认为]这是一次巨大的成功。

examples.english: They [consider] their dog part of the family.
examples.chinese: 他们[把]自家的狗[看作]家庭的一员。

meanings.explanation: If you have [competence], you have the ability to do something well or effectively.

examples.english: Mom's cooking shows her [competence] in the kitchen.
examples.chinese: 妈妈的厨艺说明她在厨房里很有[本事]。

examples.english: The teacher praised his [competence] in reading.
examples.chinese: 老师表扬了他的阅读[能力]。

examples.english: She showed great [competence] when she fixed her bike all by herself.
examples.chinese: 她自己修好了自行车，展现了很强的[能力]。

meanings.explanation: A [competence] is a particular skill or type of knowledge that someone has.

examples.english: Learning a new language is a useful [competence].
examples.chinese: 学一门新语言是一项有用的[技能]。

examples.english: Good communication is an important [competence] for teamwork.
examples.chinese: 良好的沟通是团队合作中一项重要的[能力]。

examples.english: Cooking is a [competence] everyone should learn.
examples.chinese: 烹饪是每个人都该学的[本领]。

meanings.explanation: To [connect] means to join two or more things together, or to link them in some way.

examples.english: Please [connect] the two pipes together.
examples.chinese: 请把这两根管子[连接]在一起。

examples.english: The bridge [connect]s the two islands.
examples.chinese: 这座桥[连接]着两个岛屿。

examples.english: We need to [connect] these pieces of the puzzle.
examples.chinese: 我们需要把这些拼图碎片[连接]起来。

meanings.explanation: If you [connect] with someone, you feel a close bond or understanding with them.

examples.english: She [connect]s well with her new classmates.
examples.chinese: 她和新同学相处得很[合得来]。

examples.english: This story [connect]s with readers of all ages.
examples.chinese: 这个故事能和所有年龄的读者产生[共鸣]。

examples.english: I always [connect] with my best friend after school.
examples.chinese: 放学后我总是和最好的朋友[聊天]。

meanings.explanation: If someone or something is [consistent], they always behave or perform in the same way and do not change.

examples.english: My teacher is always [consistent]—she gives us the same rules every day.
examples.chinese: 我的老师总是很[一贯的]——她每天都给我们定同样的规矩。

examples.english: He gets good grades because his work is [consistent].
examples.chinese: 他成绩很好，因为他的表现很[稳定]。

examples.english: The sun rises every morning in a [consistent] way.
examples.chinese: 太阳每天早上[如期]升起。

meanings.explanation: Two things that are [consistent] match or agree with each other and do not contradict each other.

examples.english: Her story is [consistent] with what her brother said.
examples.chinese: 她的说法和她哥哥说的[一致]。

examples.english: The test results are [consistent] with the doctor's猜测.
examples.chinese: 检查结果和医生的猜测[相符]。

examples.english: Your actions should be [consistent] with your words.
examples.chinese: 你的行动应该和你说的话[一致]。

meanings.explanation: A [confined] space or area is small and does not give much room for moving around freely.

examples.english: It's crowded in this [confined] kitchen.
examples.chinese: 这个[狭小的]厨房挤得慌。

examples.english: The rabbit can't run fast in the [confined] cage.
examples.chinese: 兔子在[狭窄的]笼子里跑不快。

examples.english: We had to stay in the [confined] car during the rainstorm.
examples.chinese: 暴风雨期间我们只能待在[狭小的]车厢里。

meanings.explanation: If someone or an animal is [confined] to a particular place, they are kept there and cannot leave freely.

examples.english: The sick dog was [confined] to the backyard.
examples.chinese: 生病的狗被[关]在后院里。

examples.english: During the storm, we were [confined] in the mountain hut.
examples.chinese: 暴风雨期间，我们被[困]在山间小屋里。

examples.english: The naughty cat was [confined] to the balcony after breaking the vase.
examples.chinese: 这只淘气的猫打碎花瓶后被[关]在阳台上。

meanings.explanation: A [constituent] is one of the parts that something is made of. If you say that something is a [constituent] of a whole thing, you mean it is one of the pieces or elements that form it.

examples.english: Flour and eggs are the main [constituents] of a cake.
examples.chinese: 面粉和鸡蛋是蛋糕的主要[成分]。

examples.english: Water is an important [constituent] of our body.
examples.chinese: 水是我们身体的重要[组成部分]。

examples.english: Each [constituent] of this machine must work well.
examples.chinese: 这台机器的每一个[零部件]都必须运转良好。

meanings.explanation: A [constituent] is a person who lives in a certain area and is represented by an elected official, such as a mayor or a member of parliament.

examples.english: The mayor listened carefully to every [constituent] who came to the meeting.
examples.chinese: 市长认真听取了每一位来参加会议的[选民]的意见。

examples.english: Our school invited a local leader to talk with the [constituents].
examples.chinese: 我们学校邀请了一位当地领导来和[选民们]交流。

examples.english: She sent a letter to her [constituents] to tell them the good news.
examples.chinese: 她给[选民们]写了一封信，告诉他们这个好消息。

meanings.explanation: [Confidence] is the belief that you are able to do things well or succeed.

examples.english: She stood on the stage and sang with lots of [confidence].
examples.chinese: 她站在台上唱歌，充满了[自信]。

examples.english: Practice more and you will build [confidence] in speaking English.
examples.chinese: 多练习，你就能建立说英语的[信心]。

examples.english: He answered the question with great [confidence].
examples.chinese: 他回答问题时显得特别有[自信]。

meanings.explanation: If you have [confidence] in someone or something, you feel sure that they are good, reliable, or able to do what you want.

examples.english: I have full [confidence] in my best friend.
examples.chinese: 我对我最好的朋友完全[信任]。

examples.english: The students have great [confidence] in their teacher.
examples.chinese: 学生们对老师非常[信任]。

examples.english: The players have [confidence] that their hard work will pay off.
examples.chinese: 队员们[相信]他们的努力会有回报。

meanings.explanation: When someone does something [constrainedly], they do it in a way that seems forced or restricted, not natural or relaxed, often because they are trying to control themselves.

examples.english: She smiled [constrainedly] at the strange visitor.
examples.chinese: 她对那个奇怪的访客[勉强地]笑了笑。

examples.english: He answered [constrainedly] because his father was listening.
examples.chinese: 因为父亲在听着，他[约束地]作了回答。

examples.english: The girl spoke [constrainedly] in front of the whole class.
examples.chinese: 女孩在全班面前[拘谨地]发了言。

meanings.explanation: When you [consume] something, you eat or drink it.

examples.english: We [consume] three meals every day.
examples.chinese: 我们每天都要[吃]三顿饭。

examples.english: The puppy [consumes] a lot of milk.
examples.chinese: 这只小狗要[喝]很多牛奶。

examples.english: Please don't [consume] food in the library.
examples.chinese: 请不要在图书馆里[吃]东西。

meanings.explanation: If something [consumes] time, energy, or resources, it uses them up.

examples.english: This game [consumes] too much of my free time.
examples.chinese: 这个游戏[占用]了我太多空闲时间。

examples.english: Old fridges [consume] a lot of electricity.
examples.chinese: 旧冰箱很[耗电]。

examples.english: The fire [consumed] the whole building.
examples.chinese: 大火[吞噬]了整栋大楼。

meanings.explanation: A [consequence] is something that happens or exists because of something else that has happened.

examples.english: Eating too much candy has a bad [consequence] for your teeth.
examples.chinese: 吃太多糖果对牙齿会产生不好的[后果]。

examples.english: One [consequence] of the rain is that the ground gets wet.
examples.chinese: 下雨的一个[结果]就是地面变湿了。

examples.english: You need to think about the [consequence] before you do something dangerous.
examples.chinese: 在做危险的事情之前，你得想想[后果]。

meanings.explanation: A [consequence] is the importance or significance that something is considered to have.

examples.english: This small mistake is of little [consequence].
examples.chinese: 这个小错误没什么[重要性]。

examples.english: Only things that help others are of real [consequence].
examples.chinese: 只有帮助别人的事情才具有真正的[重要性]。

examples.english: What he said is of no [consequence] to our trip.
examples.chinese: 他说的话对我们的出行来说毫无[重要性]。

meanings.explanation: If you are in [contact] with someone, you communicate with them regularly by phone, email, or other means. A [contact] is also a person you know who can help you in some way.

examples.english: I have lost [contact] with my old friend since she moved away.
examples.chinese: 自从老朋友搬走后，我和她就[断了联系]。

examples.english: You should keep in [contact] with your teacher after school.
examples.chinese: 放学后你应该和老师保持[联系]。

examples.english: She is a useful [contact] at the company.
examples.chinese: 她是公司里一位很管用的[人脉]。

meanings.explanation: If you [contact] someone, you telephone, write to, or email them, usually in order to give them information or ask them something.

examples.english: You can [contact] me by email if you have any questions.
examples.chinese: 如果你有任何问题，可以发邮件[联系]我。

examples.english: I will [contact] the school to ask about the class.
examples.chinese: 我会[联系]学校去问一下那门课的情况。

examples.english: Please [contact] your parents and tell them you are safe.
examples.chinese: 请[联系]你的父母，告诉他们你很安全。

meanings.explanation: If you are [confused], you are unable to think clearly or understand something correctly.

examples.english: I am [confused] about today's homework.
examples.chinese: 我对今天的作业感到很[困惑]。

examples.english: My little sister gets [confused] when she counts above 100.
examples.chinese: 我妹妹数到100以上就会[糊涂]。

examples.english: He looked [confused] when I asked him the question.
examples.chinese: 我问他这个问题时，他看起来很[困惑]。

meanings.explanation: If you [confused] one person or thing with another, you wrongly thought that they were the same person or thing.

examples.english: I [confused] the twins with each other yesterday.
examples.chinese: 我昨天把这对双胞胎[认错]了。

examples.english: She [confused] my bag with hers and took it home.
examples.chinese: 她把我的包[错认]成她的拿走了。

examples.english: I think I [confused] the dates of our meeting.
examples.chinese: 我想我[弄混]了我们开会的日期。

meanings.explanation: If something is [constant], it does not change its amount, nature, or state over a period of time.

examples.english: The car kept a [constant] speed on the highway.
examples.chinese: 汽车在高速公路上保持[恒定的]速度。

examples.english: We need [constant] room temperature to store this medicine.
examples.chinese: 我们需要[恒定的]室温来储存这种药。

examples.english: She has been my [constant] friend since we were little.
examples.chinese: 从小时候起，她就是我[不变的]朋友。

meanings.explanation: [Constant] things happen very often or all the time without stopping.

examples.english: The [constant] noise from next door makes it hard to focus.
examples.chinese: 隔壁[持续不断的]噪音让人很难集中注意力。

examples.english: [Constant] practice will help you learn to ride a bike fast.
examples.chinese: [持续的]练习会帮你很快学会骑自行车。

examples.english: My little cousin needs [constant] attention when he's awake.
examples.chinese: 我的小表弟醒着的时候需要[时刻不停的]照顾。

meanings.explanation: If something [contain]s something else, it has that thing inside it or within it.

examples.english: This bottle [contain]s fresh orange juice.
examples.chinese: 这个瓶子[装]着鲜橙汁。

examples.english: The letter [contain]s some important documents.
examples.chinese: 这封信[里]有一些重要文件。

examples.english: This small town [contain]s a famous old church.
examples.chinese: 这个小镇[有]一座著名的老教堂。

meanings.explanation: If you [contain] an emotion or feeling, you hold it back and stop yourself from showing it.

examples.english: She could hardly [contain] her excitement.
examples.chinese: 她几乎[忍不住]自己的兴奋。

examples.english: He tried to [contain] his anger.
examples.chinese: 他努力[压住]自己的怒火。

examples.english: I couldn't [contain] my laughter.
examples.chinese: 我[忍不住]大笑起来。

meanings.explanation: A [contract] is a legal agreement between two or more people or groups that says what each person must do.

examples.english: My dad signed a [contract] with the phone company for two years.
examples.chinese: 我爸爸和手机公司签了一份两年的[合同]。

examples.english: Please read the [contract] carefully before you sign it.
examples.chinese: 签字之前请仔细阅读这份[合同]。

examples.english: The teacher and the school made a [contract] about the new rules.
examples.chinese: 老师就新规定和学校签订了一份[合同]。

meanings.explanation: If you [contract] with someone, you make a legal agreement with them to do something.

examples.english: Our school [contracted] with a bus company to take students on a trip.
examples.chinese: 我们学校和一家公交公司[签约]，安排学生出行。

examples.english: She [contracted] to teach art classes every Saturday.
examples.chinese: 她[签约]每周六教美术课。

examples.english: The city [contracted] a builder to fix the old bridge.
examples.chinese: 市政府[签约]一位建筑商来修理旧桥。

meanings.explanation: If you [contradict] someone, you say that what they have said is wrong or not true. If one thing contradicts another, they cannot both be true.

examples.english: The witness [contradicted] the defendant's story in court.
examples.chinese: 证人在法庭上[反驳]了被告的说法。

examples.english: Scientists found evidence that [contradicts] earlier findings.
examples.chinese: 科学家们发现了与早期研究结果[相矛盾]的证据。

examples.english: She tried to [contradict] me, but I knew I was right.
examples.chinese: 她想[反驳]我，但我知道我是对的。

meanings.explanation: If two statements or facts [contradict] each other, they cannot both be true or correct.

examples.english: The two reports [contradict] each other completely.
examples.chinese: 这两份报告[互相矛盾]，完全不一致。

examples.english: His actions [contradict] his words all the time.
examples.chinese: 他的行为总是[与]他的言语[相矛盾]。

examples.english: The evidence [contradicts] what the suspect told police.
examples.chinese: 证据与嫌疑人告诉警察的内容[相悖]。

meanings.explanation: The [consumption] of something such as food, energy, or resources is the act of using it or the amount of it that is used.

examples.english: The [consumption] of too much sugar is bad for your teeth.
examples.chinese: 糖分的过量[摄入]对你的牙齿有害。

examples.english: Our family's [consumption] of electricity rises in summer.
examples.chinese: 我家夏天的电力[消耗量]有所增加。

examples.english: We need to reduce the [consumption] of plastic bags.
examples.chinese: 我们需要减少塑料袋的[消耗]。

meanings.explanation: [Consumption] refers to the act of people buying and using goods and services.

examples.english: During holidays, the [consumption] of gifts goes up a lot.
examples.chinese: 节日期间，礼品的[消费量]会大幅上升。

examples.english: Advertisements often encourage people's [consumption].
examples.chinese: 广告常常会刺激人们的[消费]。

examples.english: Online [consumption] becomes more and more popular now.
examples.chinese: 现在网上[消费]变得越来越流行。

meanings.explanation: If two or more people [connive], they secretly work together to do something dishonest or illegal.

examples.english: The two students [connived] to cheat on the test.
examples.chinese: 那两个学生[串通]好在考试中作弊。

examples.english: He [connived] with his friend to hide the broken vase from his mom.
examples.chinese: 他和朋友[串通]好了，把打碎的花瓶藏起来不让他妈妈发现。

examples.english: The shop owner [connived] with the supplier to sell fake goods.
examples.chinese: 店主和供应商[暗中勾结]，一起卖假货。

meanings.explanation: If someone [connives] at something, they secretly allow it to happen even though they know it is wrong.

examples.english: The teacher [connived] at the students' plan to skip class.
examples.chinese: 老师对学生逃课的计划[睁一只眼闭一只眼]。

examples.english: His parents [connived] at his habit of playing video games late at night.
examples.chinese: 他父母对他深夜打游戏的习惯[默许]了。

examples.english: The manager [connived] at the workers' long breaks.
examples.chinese: 经理对工人们长时间休息的事[装作没看见]。

meanings.explanation: Something [controversial] is one that causes strong disagreement or debate among people because different individuals have different opinions about it.

examples.english: The new [controversial] law made many people angry.
examples.chinese: 这项[有争议的]新法律让很多人感到愤怒。

examples.english: He is a [controversial] writer who always shares bold ideas.
examples.chinese: 他是一位[争议不断的]作家，总是发表大胆的观点。

examples.english: The [controversial] plan to cut down the old tree upset the neighborhood.
examples.chinese: 这个[有争议的]砍树计划让邻居们很不满。

meanings.explanation: If you [control] something, you make it do what you want or make it stay the way you want it to be.

examples.english: My mom knows how to [control] the TV with this remote.
examples.chinese: 我妈妈知道怎么用遥控器[操控]电视。

examples.english: The teacher tries to [control] the noisy class.
examples.chinese: 老师努力[管好]吵闹的班级。

examples.english: Please [control] your dog so it doesn't run away.
examples.chinese: 请[看住]你的狗，别让它跑了。

meanings.explanation: [Control] is the power or ability to make someone or something do what you want.

examples.english: The pilot has [control] of the airplane.
examples.chinese: 飞行员[掌控着]飞机。

examples.english: Please keep your voice under [control] in the library.
examples.chinese: 在图书馆里请[控制]好你的音量。

examples.english: The driver lost [control] of his bike on the hill.
examples.chinese: 骑车人在下坡时失去了[控制]。

meanings.explanation: To [convey] information, thoughts, or feelings means to make them known or understood by other people, often through words, gestures, or expressions.

examples.english: A warm smile can [convey] happiness without any words.
examples.chinese: 一个温暖的微笑不用任何话就能[传达]快乐。

examples.english: Please use simple words to [convey] your ideas to the class.
examples.chinese: 请用简单的词语向全班[表达]你的想法。

examples.english: This painting [conveys] a strong feeling of peace and love.
examples.chinese: 这幅画[传达]出一种强烈的平和与爱的感觉。

meanings.explanation: To [convey] something means to transport or carry it from one place to another.

examples.english: The truck is used to [convey] fresh fruit to the market.
examples.chinese: 这辆卡车用来把新鲜水果[运送]到市场。

examples.english: Buses [convey] many passengers to work every day.
examples.chinese: 公共汽车每天把很多乘客[运送]去上班。

examples.english: The river [conveys] water from the mountains to the sea.
examples.chinese: 这条河把水从山上[输送]到大海。

meanings.explanation: If you [continue] an action or activity, you keep doing it without stopping.

examples.english: I will [continue] to read my storybook after dinner.
examples.chinese: 晚饭后我会[继续]读我的故事书。

examples.english: Please [continue] drawing your picture, don't stop.
examples.chinese: 请[继续]画你的画，不要停下。

examples.english: The rain [continued] all day yesterday.
examples.chinese: 昨天雨[持续]了一整天。

meanings.explanation: If you [continue] after a pause or stop, you start doing the same thing again.

examples.english: We stopped for lunch and [continued] our walk after.
examples.chinese: 我们停下来吃午饭，之后[继续]散步。

examples.english: After the break, the teacher asked us to [continue] our lesson.
examples.chinese: 休息过后，老师让我们[继续]上课。

examples.english: The game [continued] ten minutes later after the rain stopped.
examples.chinese: 雨停后，比赛在十分钟后[继续]进行。

meanings.explanation: A [confocal] microscope is a special type of microscope that uses a laser beam and a tiny hole to block out blurry light, so it can take very clear, sharp pictures of extremely small things like cells and bacteria.

examples.english: Our science teacher showed us a [confocal] microscope that can take 3D pictures of cells.
examples.chinese: 我们的科学老师给我们看了一台[共聚焦]显微镜，它能拍出细胞的三维图像。

examples.english: Scientists use [confocal] microscopes to watch how living cells move and grow.
examples.chinese: 科学家用[共聚焦]显微镜观察活细胞如何移动和生长。

examples.english: With a [confocal] microscope, doctors can see tiny details inside the human eye.
examples.chinese: 用[共聚焦]显微镜，医生能看到人眼内部微小的细节。

meanings.explanation: If you say something is [countless], you mean there are so many of them that they cannot be counted.

examples.english: There are [countless] stars in the sky on a clear night.
examples.chinese: 晴朗的夜晚，天空中有[数不清的]星星。

examples.english: She has visited the park [countless] times with her family.
examples.chinese: 她和家人来这个公园[无数次]了。

examples.english: He has read [countless] books about dinosaurs.
examples.chinese: 他读了[数不清的]关于恐龙的书。

meanings.explanation: [Construction] is the process of making buildings, roads, bridges, or other large structures.

examples.english: The [construction] of the new library will begin next spring.
examples.chinese: 新图书馆的[建设]将于明年春天开始。

examples.english: My father works in [construction] and helps build tall buildings.
examples.chinese: 我爸爸从事[建筑]工作，帮忙盖高楼大厦。

examples.english: There is a loud [construction] site near my home.
examples.chinese: 我家附近有个很吵的[建筑]工地。

meanings.explanation: The [construction] of something is the way its parts are put together or arranged.

examples.english: This wooden bridge has a simple but strong [construction].
examples.chinese: 这座木桥的[构造]简单但很牢固。

examples.english: The [construction] of this sentence makes it easy to read.
examples.chinese: 这个句子的[结构]读起来很容易懂。

examples.english: The toy car has a clever [construction] with only four parts.
examples.chinese: 这辆玩具车的[结构]很巧妙，只有四个零件。

meanings.explanation: [Considerable] means great in amount or degree; fairly large.

examples.english: We spent a [considerable] amount of time on this project.
examples.chinese: 我们在这个项目上花了[大量的]时间。

examples.english: She has made [considerable] progress in math this semester.
examples.chinese: 她这学期在数学方面取得了[相当大的]进步。

examples.english: There was a [considerable] number of people at the birthday party.
examples.chinese: 生日派对上有[相当多的]人。

meanings.explanation: If you [coordinate] an activity or event, you organize all the different parts of it so that they work together well.

examples.english: We need to [coordinate] the class party so everything goes smoothly.
examples.chinese: 我们需要[协调]好班级派对，让一切顺利进行。

examples.english: Can you [coordinate] with your teammates on the group project?
examples.chinese: 你能和队友在小组作业上[协调配合]吗？

examples.english: My mom will [coordinate] the family trip next month.
examples.chinese: 我妈妈会[统筹安排]下个月的家庭旅行。

meanings.explanation: A [coordinate] is a number or letter that tells you the exact position of a point on a map, a graph, or a screen.

examples.english: Can you find the [coordinate] of the red dot on the map?
examples.chinese: 你能找到地图上红点的[坐标]吗？

examples.english: The math teacher taught us how to write the [coordinate] of each point.
examples.chinese: 数学老师教我们怎么写出每个点的[坐标]。

examples.english: Use the GPS to get the [coordinate] of the park.
examples.chinese: 用GPS来获取公园的[坐标]。

meanings.explanation: Something that is [coordinated] is arranged in a harmonious, orderly, or matching way, so that different parts work well together.

examples.english: She wore a [coordinated] outfit with a blue shirt and matching blue pants.
examples.chinese: 她穿了一套[配套的]衣服，蓝色衬衫和同色系的裤子很搭。

examples.english: The dancers did a [coordinated] dance moves together.
examples.chinese: 舞者们一起跳了一支[配合默契的]舞蹈。

examples.english: All the furniture in the room is [coordinated] in the same style.
examples.chinese: 房间里所有的家具都是[配套的]，风格统一。

meanings.explanation: To [coordinate] means to arrange different things so they work together harmoniously, or to organize elements to achieve a common goal.

examples.english: She [coordinated] all the games at the birthday party.
examples.chinese: 她[组织协调]了生日聚会上所有的游戏。

examples.english: The teacher [coordinated] the students' group projects.
examples.chinese: 老师[协调]了学生的分组项目。

examples.english: We need to [coordinate] our schedules to meet this weekend.
examples.chinese: 我们需要[协调]一下时间表，这周末见个面。

meanings.explanation: If someone or something [convince]s you that something is true, they make you believe it is true.

examples.english: My dad [convinced] me that dinosaurs are not scary anymore.
examples.chinese: 爸爸[让我相信]恐龙其实并不吓人。

examples.english: She [convinced] me that her answer to the math problem is correct.
examples.chinese: 她[让我相信]她这道数学题的答案是对的。

examples.english: The video [convinced] us that polar bears need our help.
examples.chinese: 这段视频[让我们相信]北极熊需要我们的帮助。

meanings.explanation: If you [convince] someone to do something, you persuade them to do it.

examples.english: Can you [convince] your dad to take us to the zoo?
examples.chinese: 你能[说服]你爸爸带我们去动物园吗？

examples.english: I [convinced] my friend to try the new ice cream flavor.
examples.chinese: 我[说服]我的朋友尝了这个新冰淇淋口味。

examples.english: She [convinced] her teacher to give us five more minutes of break.
examples.chinese: 她[说服]老师多给我们五分钟休息时间。

meanings.explanation: A [couple] is two people who are together in a romantic relationship, or two people or things that are together.

examples.english: They are a happy [couple] who love hiking together.
examples.chinese: 他们是一对喜欢一起徒步的快乐[情侣]。

examples.english: I need a [couple] of eggs to make this cake.
examples.chinese: 我需要[两]个鸡蛋来做这个蛋糕。

examples.english: A young [couple] moved in next door to us.
examples.chinese: 一对年轻[情侣]搬到了我们家隔壁。

meanings.explanation: To [couple] things means to join them together or connect them.

examples.english: The train engines are [coupled] together at the station.
examples.chinese: 火车的车头在车站被[连接]在一起。

examples.english: Please [couple] the wires carefully before turning on the machine.
examples.chinese: 请在开机之前小心地[连接]电线。

examples.english: The car seats can be [coupled] to form a bed.
examples.chinese: 车座可以[拼]起来变成一张床。

meanings.explanation: The [content] of a book, website, TV show, or speech is the information, ideas, or material that it contains or presents.

examples.english: The [content] of this website is very helpful for kids.
examples.chinese: 这个网站的[内容]对孩子们非常有帮助。

examples.english: Our teacher asked us to write about the [content] of the story.
examples.chinese: 老师让我们写一写这个故事的[内容]。

examples.english: There is a lot of interesting [content] in that magazine.
examples.chinese: 那本杂志里有很多有趣的[内容]。

meanings.explanation: If you are [content], you are happy and satisfied with what you have and do not wish for anything more or different.

examples.english: She is [content] with her small but cozy bedroom.
examples.chinese: 她对自己那间虽小但温馨的卧室很[满足]。

examples.english: The old cat looked [content] lying in the warm sun.
examples.chinese: 那只老猫躺在暖洋洋的太阳底下，看起来很[满足]。

examples.english: He is [content] to play with his toy cars all afternoon.
examples.chinese: 他整个下午都在玩自己的玩具车，觉得很[知足]。

meanings.explanation: If you [cover] something, you put something over or around it in order to protect or hide it.

examples.english: Please [cover] your mouth when you cough.
examples.chinese: 咳嗽时请[捂住]嘴巴。

examples.english: She [covers] the baby with a soft blanket at night.
examples.chinese: 晚上她用柔软的毯子把宝宝[盖]住。

examples.english: The snow [covered] the ground like a white carpet.
examples.chinese: 大雪像白色地毯一样[覆盖]了地面。

meanings.explanation: The [cover] of a book or magazine is the stiff, outside part that protects the pages inside.

examples.english: The [cover] of my storybook has a picture of a dragon.
examples.chinese: 我的故事书[封面上]有一条龙的图画。

examples.english: Please don't judge a book by its [cover].
examples.chinese: 请不要以[封面]来判断一本书的好坏。

examples.english: He drew a beautiful [cover] for his school notebook.
examples.chinese: 他为他的学校笔记本画了一个漂亮的[封面]。

meanings.explanation: If something [consists] of particular things or people, it is formed or made up from them.

examples.english: My breakfast [consists] of bread and milk.
examples.chinese: 我的早餐[包括]面包和牛奶。

examples.english: The team [consists] of five students.
examples.chinese: 这个小组[包括]五名学生。

examples.english: This salad [consists] of fresh vegetables.
examples.chinese: 这份沙拉[包括]新鲜蔬菜。

meanings.explanation: If something [consists] in a particular quality or action, that quality or action is its main or essential part.

examples.english: Happiness [consists] in being thankful for what you have.
examples.chinese: 快乐[在于]感恩自己所拥有的一切。

examples.english: The job [consists] in helping people in need.
examples.chinese: 这份工作[在于]帮助有需要的人。

examples.english: True beauty [consists] in kindness and honesty.
examples.chinese: 真正的美[在于]善良和诚实。

meanings.explanation: A [counter] is a long flat surface in a shop, restaurant, kitchen, or bank where goods are served or business is done.

examples.english: I put my shopping bag on the [counter] while I paid.
examples.chinese: 我付钱的时候把购物袋放在[柜台]上。

examples.english: Mom keeps a bowl of apples on the kitchen [counter].
examples.chinese: 妈妈在厨房[台面]上放了一碗苹果。

examples.english: Please line up at the checkout [counter].
examples.chinese: 请在收银[柜台]排队。

meanings.explanation: If you [counter] an attack, argument, or problem, you do something to oppose it or reduce its harmful effect.

examples.english: The boxer quickly moved to [counter] his opponent's punch.
examples.chinese: 拳击手迅速移动[反击]对手的出拳。

examples.english: She tried to [counter] his bad argument with facts.
examples.chinese: 她试图用事实[反驳]他的错误言论。

examples.english: We can use this medicine to [counter] the fever.
examples.chinese: 我们可以用这种药[缓解]发烧。

meanings.explanation: A [crew] is a group of people who work together as a team, especially on a ship or airplane.

examples.english: The [crew] welcomed all passengers on the plane.
examples.chinese: [机组人员]热情欢迎飞机上的所有乘客。

examples.english: The ship [crew] worked together to survive the storm.
examples.chinese: [船员们]齐心协力在暴风雨中求生。

examples.english: They filmed the show with a small video [crew].
examples.chinese: 他们用一小支[摄制组]来拍摄这个节目。

meanings.explanation: A [crew] is a group of friends who often do things together.

examples.english: I went to the beach with my soccer [crew].
examples.chinese: 我和足球队的那帮[伙伴们]一起去海滩。

examples.english: My dance [crew] meets every Saturday morning.
examples.chinese: 我的舞蹈[小分队]每个周六上午碰面。

examples.english: The whole [crew] is coming to my birthday party.
examples.chinese: 全班[死党]都会来我的生日派对。

meanings.explanation: If you [create] something, you make or produce it for the first time.

examples.english: My teacher helps us [create] fun stories in class.
examples.chinese: 老师帮我们在课堂上[创作]有趣的故事。

examples.english: I want to [create] a cool robot with my building blocks.
examples.chinese: 我想用积木[制作]一个很酷的机器人。

examples.english: The sun [creates] light and warmth for us every day.
examples.chinese: 太阳每天为我们[创造]光和温暖。

meanings.explanation: [Convenience] is the quality of being easy, useful, or suitable for your needs.

examples.english: I like the [convenience] of paying with my phone.
examples.chinese: 我喜欢用手机付款的[方便]。

examples.english: For [convenience], we live close to the school.
examples.chinese: 为了[方便]，我们住在学校附近。

examples.english: The [convenience] of online shopping saves me a lot of time.
examples.chinese: 网购的[方便]给我省了很多时间。

meanings.explanation: A [convenience] is something that makes your life easier or more comfortable.

examples.english: The park has many [conveniences] like benches and drinking fountains.
examples.chinese: 公园里有很多[便利设施]，比如长椅和饮水器。

examples.english: A microwave is a useful [convenience] in the kitchen.
examples.chinese: 微波炉在厨房里是一种有用的[便利设施]。

examples.english: Modern [conveniences] like elevators make our lives easier.
examples.chinese: 像电梯这样的现代[便利设施]让我们的生活更轻松。

meanings.explanation: A [crop] is a plant that is grown in large quantities for food or other use.

examples.english: The farmers are planting wheat [crop] this spring.
examples.chinese: 农民们今年春天正在种[小麦]。

examples.english: We eat many different [crops] like rice, corn, and vegetables.
examples.chinese: 我们吃很多不同的[农作物]，比如大米、玉米和蔬菜。

examples.english: This year's tomato [crop] is very good.
examples.chinese: 今年的西红柿[收成]很好。

meanings.explanation: If you [crop] something, you cut part of it off to make it shorter or neater.

examples.english: My mom asked me to [crop] the grass in the garden.
examples.chinese: 妈妈让我把花园里的草[修剪]一下。

examples.english: I use scissors to [crop] my hair.
examples.chinese: 我用剪刀[剪]头发。

examples.english: Please [crop] the picture to remove the ugly part.
examples.chinese: 请把照片[裁剪]一下，把难看的部分去掉。

meanings.explanation: [Craftsmanship] is the skill and expertise that a person uses when making things by hand or working in a skilled trade.

examples.english: The old carpenter showed great [craftsmanship] when making our wooden table.
examples.chinese: 这位老木匠给我们做木桌子的时候，展现了出色的[手艺]。

examples.english: My grandpa learned his [craftsmanship] from his dad when he was a kid.
examples.chinese: 我爷爷还是小孩的时候，就从他爸爸那里学到了这门[手艺]。

examples.english: Lots of practice helped the potter get great [craftsmanship].
examples.chinese: 大量练习让这位陶艺师傅练就了出色的[手艺]。

meanings.explanation: The [craftsmanship] of a handmade object refers to the quality of how it was made, especially when it is very well made.

examples.english: This handmade chair has really nice [craftsmanship].
examples.chinese: 这把手工椅子的[做工]真的很棒。

examples.english: We all like the fine [craftsmanship] of this wooden box.
examples.chinese: 我们都很喜欢这个木箱的精良[工艺]。

examples.english: You can see good [craftsmanship] in how smoothly this door opens.
examples.chinese: 从这扇门开得这么顺滑就能看出它[做工]很好。

meanings.explanation: A [crisis] is a difficult, dangerous, or stressful situation that requires urgent action or attention.

examples.english: The hospital is in [crisis] because there aren't enough doctors.
examples.chinese: 医院因为医生不够而陷入了[危机]。

examples.english: When the big storm came, our town faced a serious [crisis].
examples.chinese: 暴风雨来临时，我们小镇面临严重的[危机]。

examples.english: Don't panic — we can solve this [crisis] together.
examples.chinese: 别慌——我们可以一起解决这个[危机]。

meanings.explanation: A [crisis] is also a critical moment or turning point when a situation changes dramatically, often reaching its most difficult stage before improving or getting worse.

examples.english: The company reached a [crisis] and had to make big changes.
examples.chinese: 公司到了一个[关键转折点]，不得不做出重大改变。

examples.english: The patient's illness got much worse during the health [crisis].
examples.chinese: 在健康[危险期]，病人的病情急剧恶化了。

examples.english: Many teenagers go through an identity [crisis] as they grow up.
examples.chinese: 很多青少年在成长过程中会经历自我认同[危机]。

meanings.explanation: [Coral] is a hard substance that is formed from the skeletons of tiny sea animals. It is often found in warm oceans and is used to make jewelry or to form reefs.

examples.english: We saw lots of colorful fish swimming around the [coral].
examples.chinese: 我们看到很多五颜六色的鱼在[珊瑚]周围游来游去。

examples.english: My grandmother gave me a pretty [coral] necklace for my birthday.
examples.chinese: 我奶奶送我一条漂亮的[珊瑚]项链作为生日礼物。

examples.english: The diver took a photo of the bright orange [coral].
examples.chinese: 潜水员给那株亮橙色的[珊瑚]拍了张照片。

meanings.explanation: Something that is [coral] is a pinkish-orange color, like the color of the sea substance called coral.

examples.english: She wore a beautiful [coral] dress to the party.
examples.chinese: 她穿了一条漂亮的[珊瑚色]裙子去参加聚会。

examples.english: I painted my bedroom walls a soft [coral] color.
examples.chinese: 我把卧室的墙刷成了柔和的[珊瑚色]。

examples.english: This [coral] lipstick looks really nice on you.
examples.chinese: 这支[珊瑚色]口红涂在你嘴上真好看。

meanings.explanation: If something is [crucial], it is extremely important because it has a big effect on how things turn out.

examples.english: Getting enough sleep is [crucial] for your health.
examples.chinese: 充足的睡眠对你的健康[至关重要]。

examples.english: Reading every day is [crucial] if you want to improve your English.
examples.chinese: 如果你想提高英语，每天阅读是[至关重要的]。

examples.english: Good friends are [crucial] for a happy life.
examples.chinese: 好朋友对幸福生活来说[至关重要]。

meanings.explanation: A [crucial] time, moment, or decision is one that is so important it decides whether something will succeed or fail.

examples.english: The last five minutes of the game were [crucial].
examples.chinese: 比赛最后五分钟是[关键的]。

examples.english: Tomorrow is a [crucial] day for her because she has a big test.
examples.chinese: 明天对她来说是[关键的]一天，因为她有一场大考。

examples.english: His goal in the last minute was a [crucial] moment for the team.
examples.chinese: 他在最后一分钟的进球对球队来说是一个[关键的]时刻。

meanings.explanation: A [contribution] is something that you give, such as money, help, or ideas, to help a group of people or to achieve a shared goal.

examples.english: Each student made a small [contribution] to the class project.
examples.chinese: 每个学生都为班级项目做出了一小份[贡献]。

examples.english: Your [contribution] of food and clothes helped many families in need.
examples.chinese: 你[捐赠]的食物和衣服帮助了许多困难家庭。

examples.english: Small [contributions] from everyone can make a big difference.
examples.chinese: 每个人的小小[贡献]都能带来很大的改变。

meanings.explanation: A [contribution] is a story, article, or piece of writing that you write for a magazine, newspaper, book, or website.

examples.english: She wrote a [contribution] for the school newspaper.
examples.chinese: 她为校报写了一篇[稿件]。

examples.english: His [contribution] to the magazine was about protecting wild animals.
examples.chinese: 他为杂志写的[文章]是关于保护野生动物的。

examples.english: The teacher asked everyone to write a short [contribution] for the class blog.
examples.chinese: 老师请大家为班级博客写一篇短文[投稿]。

meanings.explanation: A [criminal] is a person who has committed a crime.

examples.english: The police caught the [criminal] last night.
examples.chinese: 警察昨晚抓住了那个[罪犯]。

examples.english: That [criminal] stole a lot of money from the shop.
examples.chinese: 那个[罪犯]从商店偷了很多钱。

examples.english: Everyone thinks he is a dangerous [criminal].
examples.chinese: 大家都认为他是一个危险的[罪犯]。

meanings.explanation: [Criminal] acts or activities are illegal and related to crime.

examples.english: Stealing things is a [criminal] act.
examples.chinese: 偷东西是一种[犯罪的]行为。

examples.english: The police stopped his [criminal] plan.
examples.chinese: 警察阻止了他[犯罪的]计划。

examples.english: The man was involved in [criminal] behavior.
examples.chinese: 那个男人参与了[犯罪的]行为。

meanings.explanation: If you are [critical] of someone or something, you express disapproval of them or point out their faults.

examples.english: My mom is always [critical] of how I dress.
examples.chinese: 我妈妈总是[批评]我的穿着方式。

examples.english: The teacher was [critical] of his messy homework.
examples.chinese: 老师[批评]了他凌乱的作业。

examples.english: Don't be so [critical] of others; everyone makes mistakes.
examples.chinese: 不要这么[批评]别人；每个人都会犯错。

meanings.explanation: Something that is [critical] is extremely important or serious, and may determine the success or failure of something.

examples.english: This test is [critical] for my final grade.
examples.chinese: 这次考试对我的最终成绩[至关重要]。

examples.english: We are at a [critical] moment in the project's development.
examples.chinese: 我们正处于项目发展的[关键]时刻。

examples.english: The doctor said my injury is not [critical] - I'll recover soon.
examples.chinese: 医生说我的伤势不[严重]——我会很快康复。

meanings.explanation: [Cruelty] is the quality of being cruel; cruel behavior or actions that cause pain or suffering to others.

examples.english: The [cruelty] of the king made everyone fear him.
examples.chinese: 那位国王的[残暴]让所有人都害怕他。

examples.english: We must stop [cruelty] to animals and protect them.
examples.chinese: 我们必须停止对动物的[残忍行为]，保护它们。

examples.english: Her [cruelty] to her younger sister was not acceptable.
examples.chinese: 她对妹妹的[刻薄]是不可接受的。

meanings.explanation: A [cube] is a solid object with six square sides of equal size.

examples.english: The toy comes in a [cube] box with pictures on it.
examples.chinese: 这个玩具装在一个带图案的[正方体]盒子里。

examples.english: We built a tower using small wooden [cube] blocks.
examples.chinese: 我们用木制的小[方块]搭了一座塔。

examples.english: A dice is a [cube] with dots on each side.
examples.chinese: 骰子是一个每面都有点数的[立方体]。

meanings.explanation: If you [cube] something, you cut it into small square-shaped pieces.

examples.english: Mom will [cube] the cheese for our lunch.
examples.chinese: 妈妈会把奶酪[切成小块]给我们当午餐。

examples.english: Please [cube] the apples before putting them in the bowl.
examples.chinese: 请把苹果[切成方块]再放进碗里。

examples.english: The chef likes to [cube] the potatoes for the soup.
examples.chinese: 厨师喜欢把土豆[切丁]做汤。

meanings.explanation: [Culture] is the beliefs, customs, arts, and way of life of a particular group of people or society.

examples.english: China has a long history and rich [culture].
examples.chinese: 中国有着悠久的历史和丰厚的[文化]。

examples.english: People from different [cultures] celebrate holidays in their own ways.
examples.chinese: 来自不同[文化]背景的人用各自的方式庆祝节日。

examples.english: I love learning about the food and [culture] of other countries.
examples.chinese: 我喜欢了解其他国家的美食和[文化]。

meanings.explanation: [Culture] also refers to the arts, music, literature, and other creative activities that people value in a society.

examples.english: The museum is a great place to enjoy art and [culture].
examples.chinese: 博物馆是欣赏艺术和[文化]的好地方。

examples.english: Our school encourages students to take part in music and [culture] activities.
examples.chinese: 我们学校鼓励学生参加音乐和[文化]活动。

examples.english: Reading books can help you understand human [culture] better.
examples.chinese: 读书能帮助你更好地了解人类[文化]。

meanings.explanation: A [cycle] is a series of events or processes that are regularly repeated in the same order.

examples.english: The four seasons make up a yearly [cycle].
examples.chinese: 四季构成一年的[循环]。

examples.english: We learned about the water [cycle] in science class.
examples.chinese: 我们在科学课上学习了水[循环]。

examples.english: The washing machine has a short wash [cycle].
examples.chinese: 这台洗衣机有一个短洗涤[周期]。

meanings.explanation: To [cycle] means to ride a bicycle, or to move in or go through a cycle.

examples.english: I [cycle] to school every morning.
examples.chinese: 我每天早上[骑自行车]去学校。

examples.english: She likes to [cycle] in the park on weekends.
examples.chinese: 她喜欢周末在公园里[骑车]。

examples.english: We [cycle] together as a family every Sunday.
examples.chinese: 我们全家每个星期天一起[骑自行车]。

meanings.explanation: [Damage] is physical harm that is caused to something, making it broken, less valuable, or unable to work properly.

examples.english: The heavy rain caused a lot of [damage] to our roof.
examples.chinese: 大雨对我们的屋顶造成了很大[损坏]。

examples.english: My bike has some [damage] on the left wheel.
examples.chinese: 我的自行车左轮上有点[损坏]。

examples.english: The storm did serious [damage] to the old tree in our yard.
examples.chinese: 暴风雨对我们院子里那棵老树造成了严重[破坏]。

meanings.explanation: To [damage] something means to cause physical harm to it, so that it is broken or does not work properly.

examples.english: Please don't [damage] the flowers when you play in the garden.
examples.chinese: 在花园里玩的时候，请不要[损坏]花朵。

examples.english: The hot water can [damage] your favorite cup.
examples.chinese: 热水会[损坏]你最喜欢的杯子。

examples.english: He dropped his phone and [damaged] the screen.
examples.chinese: 他把手机掉在地上，[摔坏了]屏幕。

meanings.explanation: [Curiosity] is a strong desire to know or learn about something.

examples.english: Children have natural [curiosity] about the world.
examples.chinese: 孩子们对世界有着天然的[好奇心]。

examples.english: Out of [curiosity], I opened the strange box.
examples.chinese: 出于[好奇心]，我打开了那个奇怪的盒子。

examples.english: Her [curiosity] led her to discover many new things.
examples.chinese: 她的[好奇心]让她发现了许多新事物。

meanings.explanation: A [curiosity] is also something that is strange or unusual and attracts interest.

examples.english: The old clock is a [curiosity] in our museum.
examples.chinese: 这座老钟是我们博物馆里的一个[稀罕物件]。

examples.english: That custom guitar is quite a [curiosity].
examples.chinese: 那把定制吉他真是个[稀奇玩意儿]。

examples.english: The villagers saw the flying machine as a [curiosity].
examples.chinese: 村民们把飞行器看作是个[新鲜玩意儿]。

meanings.explanation: A [court] is a flat area where people play sports games like tennis, basketball, or volleyball.

examples.english: We play basketball on the school [court] every afternoon.
examples.chinese: 我们每天下午在学校[球场]打篮球。

examples.english: Let's meet at the tennis [court] after class.
examples.chinese: 我们下课后在网球[场]碰面吧。

examples.english: There is a new volleyball [court] in the park near my house.
examples.chinese: 我家附近的公园里新修了一个排球[场]。

meanings.explanation: A [court] is a place where judges and lawyers work and where legal problems are solved.

examples.english: The judge walked into the [court] and everyone stood up.
examples.chinese: 法官走进[法庭]，所有人都站了起来。

examples.english: My aunt works at the [court] and helps people every day.
examples.chinese: 我姑姑在[法院]工作，每天都帮助别人。

examples.english: The [court] said the boy did the right thing.
examples.chinese: [法庭]说那个男孩做的是对的。

meanings.explanation: A [cultivated] area of land or plant is grown or cared for by people, rather than growing wild in nature.

examples.english: Farmers water the [cultivated] fields every sunny morning.
examples.chinese: 农民们每个晴朗的早晨都给[耕种过的]田地浇水。

examples.english: These [cultivated] tomatoes are much bigger than wild ones.
examples.chinese: 这些[人工栽培的]西红柿比野生的大很多。

examples.english: My grandpa grows vegetables in his small [cultivated] yard.
examples.chinese: 爷爷在他那片小小的[开垦过的]院子里种蔬菜。

meanings.explanation: A [cultivated] person is well-educated, has polite manners, and knows a lot about culture and art.

examples.english: Our head teacher is a [cultivated] person who can recite many ancient poems.
examples.chinese: 我们班主任是个[有修养的]人，会背诵很多古诗。

examples.english: She greeted everyone with a warm and [cultivated] smile.
examples.chinese: 她用温暖[有教养的]微笑问候每一个人。

examples.english: My [cultivated] uncle takes me to see art shows every month.
examples.chinese: 我那位[有文化修养的]叔叔每个月带我去看艺术展。

meanings.explanation: If you express [criticism] of someone or something, you say what you think is wrong or bad about them.

examples.english: My mom's [criticism] was that my room was too messy.
examples.chinese: 妈妈的[批评]是我的房间太乱了。

examples.english: Her friend's [criticism] made her feel very sad.
examples.chinese: 朋友的[批评]让她非常难过。

examples.english: The coach's [criticism] helped the team play much better.
examples.chinese: 教练的[批评]让队伍表现好了很多。

meanings.explanation: [Criticism] is the activity of making careful judgments about the good and bad qualities of books, movies, music, or art.

examples.english: We learned about film [criticism] in class today.
examples.chinese: 今天课上我们学了电影[评论]。

examples.english: This book got very good [criticism] from readers.
examples.chinese: 这本书获得了读者很好的[评论]。

examples.english: Art [criticism] helps us understand paintings better.
examples.chinese: 艺术[评论]帮助我们更好地理解画作。

meanings.explanation: If a vehicle [crash]es or someone [crash]es it, it hits something violently, often causing damage.

examples.english: The car [crashed] into a tree on the way to school.
examples.chinese: 上学路上，汽车[撞]到了一棵树上。

examples.english: She [crashed] her bike into the fence.
examples.chinese: 她把自行车[撞]到了栅栏上。

examples.english: Two cars [crashed] on the wet road.
examples.chinese: 两辆车在湿滑的路上[撞]在了一起。

meanings.explanation: If a computer, phone, or program [crash]es, it suddenly stops working.

examples.english: My computer [crashed] while I was doing my homework.
examples.chinese: 我做作业的时候电脑[死机]了。

examples.english: The game [crashed] and I lost all my progress.
examples.chinese: 游戏[崩溃]了，我的进度全没了。

examples.english: The app [crashed] when I tried to open it.
examples.chinese: 我打开应用的时候它就[闪退]了。

meanings.explanation: If you [declare] something, you say it clearly and officially in public so that everyone knows.

examples.english: The teacher will [declare] the winner of the game after lunch.
examples.chinese: 老师会在午饭后[宣布]游戏的获胜者。

examples.english: He stood up and [declared] that he was the team leader.
examples.chinese: 他站起来，[宣称]自己是队长。

examples.english: The country [declared] its independence a long time ago.
examples.chinese: 这个国家很久以前就[宣布]了独立。

meanings.explanation: A [debt] is an amount of money that you owe to someone else, which you must pay back later.

examples.english: My father helped me [pay off] my [debt] for the new bicycle.
examples.chinese: 爸爸帮我还清了买新自行车的[欠款]。

examples.english: She borrowed some money from the bank and now she has a [debt] to repay.
examples.chinese: 她从银行借了些钱，现在有[债务]要还。

examples.english: It took him two months to clear all his [debts].
examples.chinese: 他花了两个月时间才还清所有[债务]。

meanings.explanation: If you say that you owe someone a [debt] of gratitude, you mean you feel very thankful to them for their help or kindness.

examples.english: I owe a [debt] of gratitude to my teacher for helping me learn to read.
examples.chinese: 我很[感激]老师教我认字。

examples.english: We all owe a [debt] of thanks to the firefighters who saved our home.
examples.chinese: 我们都[感谢]消防员救了我们家。

examples.english: She felt she had a [debt] to repay after her friend helped her so much.
examples.chinese: 朋友帮了她那么多，她觉得[欠了人情]。

meanings.explanation: If you [cross] a road, river, bridge, or other area, you go from one side of it to the other.

examples.english: Look left and right before you [cross] the road.
examples.chinese: 你[穿过]马路前要左右看看。

examples.english: Our class needs to [cross] the bridge to get to the park.
examples.chinese: 我们班需要[过]这座桥才能到公园。

examples.english: The little duck can [cross] the river by itself.
examples.chinese: 小鸭子可以自己[过]这条河。

meanings.explanation: A [cross] is a shape made by one line going across another, and it is also the main symbol of Christianity.

examples.english: The church has a wooden [cross] at the front.
examples.chinese: 教堂前方有一个木制[十字架]。

examples.english: Put a [cross] next to the answer you want to choose.
examples.chinese: 在你想选的答案旁边打一个[叉号]。

examples.english: Draw a small [cross] where you should write your name.
examples.chinese: 在你需要写名字的地方画一个小[叉号]。

meanings.explanation: A [cylinder] is a solid or hollow object with a circular top and base, straight parallel sides, and a shape like a tube.

examples.english: I keep my colored pencils in a plastic [cylinder] on my desk.
examples.chinese: 我把彩笔放在书桌上的塑料[圆筒]里。

examples.english: A can of cola is a small metal [cylinder].
examples.chinese: 一罐可乐就是一个小小的金属[圆柱体]。

examples.english: The hospital uses big [cylinder]s to store oxygen.
examples.chinese: 医院用大[钢瓶]来储存氧气。

meanings.explanation: A [cylinder] is one of the tube-shaped chambers in an engine where the piston moves to produce power.

examples.english: This car engine has four [cylinder]s.
examples.chinese: 这个汽车发动机有四个[汽缸]。

examples.english: The mechanic fixed a broken [cylinder] in my dad's truck.
examples.chinese: 机修工修好了我爸爸卡车里一个坏了的[汽缸]。

examples.english: A bigger [cylinder] in the engine can make more power.
examples.chinese: 发动机里更大的[汽缸]可以产生更多动力。

meanings.explanation: A [defence] is something that you do or say in order to protect someone or something from being harmed, attacked, or criticised.

examples.english: He took a karate class to learn [defence].
examples.chinese: 他报了一个空手道班来学习[防身]。

examples.english: The thick walls of the castle were built as a [defence] against enemies.
examples.chinese: 城堡厚厚的城墙是抵御敌人的[防御工事]。

examples.english: She spoke up in [defence] of her best friend.
examples.chinese: 她站出来为最好的朋友[辩护]。

meanings.explanation: In sports, the [defence] is the part of a team whose main job is to stop the other team from scoring.

examples.english: Our team has a really strong [defence] this year.
examples.chinese: 我们队今年的[防守]非常强。

examples.english: He plays on the [defence] in the school football team.
examples.chinese: 他在校足球队打[后卫]。

examples.english: The [defence] stopped the other team from scoring any goals.
examples.chinese: [防守]让对方一个球都没进。

meanings.explanation: If something [decline]s, it becomes smaller or less in amount, number, or quality.

examples.english: The temperature [decline]s at night in the desert.
examples.chinese: 沙漠里晚上的温度[下降]。

examples.english: His health has [decline]d since last year.
examples.chinese: 他的健康自去年以来一直在[衰退]。

examples.english: The number of students in our school has [decline]d.
examples.chinese: 我们学校的学生人数[减少]了。

meanings.explanation: If you [decline] something, you politely say that you do not want to accept it or do it.
