meanings.explanation: If a person, plan, or system is [flexible], they can be changed or adapted easily to suit new conditions.

examples.english: My boss is very [flexible], so I can work from home on Fridays.
examples.chinese: 我的老板很[通融]，所以我可以周五在家办公。

examples.english: We need a [flexible] plan because the weather might change.
examples.chinese: 我们需要一个[灵活的]计划，因为天气可能会变。

examples.english: The school has a [flexible] schedule for students.
examples.chinese: 学校的课程安排很[灵活]，方便学生。

meanings.explanation: A [firm] thing is solid and not soft, and does not shake or move easily.

examples.english: This mattress is very [firm], so I sleep really well on it.
examples.chinese: 这张床垫很[硬]，所以我睡得特别香。

examples.english: Press the [firm] button to start the machine.
examples.chinese: 按一下这个[硬]按钮来启动机器。

examples.english: The ground is [firm] enough to walk on after the rain.
examples.chinese: 雨后地面变[硬]了，可以走了。

meanings.explanation: A [firm] person is strong and determined, and their decisions or actions are unlikely to change.

examples.english: My mom is [firm] about my bedtime at nine o'clock.
examples.chinese: 我妈妈对我的睡觉时间要求很[严格]，必须是九点。

examples.english: The teacher gave a [firm] no to our request for more break time.
examples.chinese: 老师[坚定地]拒绝了我们增加休息时间的请求。

examples.english: He stayed [firm] and did not change his answer.
examples.chinese: 他[毫不动摇]，没有改变自己的答案。

meanings.explanation: A [firm] is a business company, especially one that provides professional services.

examples.english: His dad works at a law [firm] in the city.
examples.chinese: 他爸爸在城里的一家[律师事务所]工作。

examples.english: We started our own [firm] five years ago.
examples.chinese: 我们五年前创办了自己的[公司]。

examples.english: That [firm] makes the best ice cream in town.
examples.chinese: 那家[店]是城里冰淇淋做得最好的。

meanings.explanation: If you [finish] something, you complete it or bring it to an end.

examples.english: I need to [finish] my homework before dinner.
examples.chinese: 我需要在晚饭前[做完]我的作业。

examples.english: She [finished] her breakfast and went out to play.
examples.chinese: 她[吃完]早餐就出去玩了。

examples.english: We will [finish] our art project tomorrow.
examples.chinese: 我们明天会[完成]我们的美术项目。

meanings.explanation: A [finish] is the last part or the end of an activity or event.

examples.english: All the runners were tired near the [finish].
examples.chinese: 所有跑步者在[终点]附近都累了。

examples.english: We watched the cartoon from start to [finish].
examples.chinese: 我们从开头到[结尾]看完了这部卡通片。

examples.english: Lily was the first to reach the [finish] in the race.
examples.chinese: 莉莉是比赛中第一个到达[终点]的人。

meanings.explanation: If you [fill] a container, you put something into it until it is full.

examples.english: Please [fill] the glass with water.
examples.chinese: 请把杯子[装]满水。

examples.english: The boy likes to [fill] the bucket with sand.
examples.chinese: 男孩喜欢把桶[装]满沙子。

examples.english: She helped [fill] the basket with apples.
examples.chinese: 她帮忙把篮子[装]满苹果。

meanings.explanation: If you [fill] a need or requirement, you satisfy it or meet it.

examples.english: This pizza can [fill] your hunger.
examples.chinese: 这块披萨能[填]饱你的肚子。

examples.english: We need to [fill] the position quickly.
examples.chinese: 我们需要尽快[填补]这个职位。

examples.english: The teacher helps [fill] the gap in learning.
examples.chinese: 老师帮助[弥补]学习中的不足。

meanings.explanation: [Fiction] refers to books and stories that describe imaginary events and people, rather than real events.

examples.english: I love reading [fiction] about magical adventures.
examples.chinese: 我喜欢读关于魔法冒险的[小说]。

examples.english: My school library has a whole shelf full of [fiction].
examples.chinese: 我校图书馆有一整架[小说]。

examples.english: This [fiction] has a very brave main character.
examples.chinese: 这本[小说]有一个非常勇敢的主角。

meanings.explanation: A [fiction] is a story or statement that is not true, made up by someone.

examples.english: The boy admitted that his story about finding treasure was just [fiction].
examples.chinese: 这个男孩承认他找到宝藏的故事纯属[虚构]。

examples.english: What the girl told the teacher was total [fiction].
examples.chinese: 这个女孩告诉老师的话全是[编造]。

examples.english: He made up a [fiction] to explain why he was late.
examples.chinese: 他编了一个[谎话]来解释自己为什么迟到。

meanings.explanation: Someone or something that is [female] belongs to the sex that can give birth to babies or produce eggs.

examples.english: My aunt is a [female] doctor at the city hospital.
examples.chinese: 我姑姑是市医院的[女]医生。

examples.english: The [female] cat gently carries her kittens by the neck.
examples.chinese: [母]猫轻轻叼着她的小猫。

examples.english: There are more [female] students than male students in our class.
examples.chinese: 我们班[女]生比男生多。

meanings.explanation: A [female] is a person or an animal that belongs to the sex that can give birth to babies or produce eggs.

examples.english: In my family, the [females] all enjoy gardening on weekends.
examples.chinese: 在我家，[女性]们周末都喜欢种花。

examples.english: Is your pet bird a [female] or a male?
examples.chinese: 你的宠物鸟是[母的]还是公的？

examples.english: The [females] of this species take care of the babies.
examples.chinese: 这个物种的[雌性]负责照顾宝宝。

meanings.explanation: [Flesh] is the soft part of a person's or animal's body between the skin and the bones.

examples.english: The doctor said my cut was only through the [flesh], not the bone.
examples.chinese: 医生说我的伤口只割到了[肉]，没有伤到骨头。

examples.english: The lion ate the [flesh] of the zebra.
examples.chinese: 狮子吃掉了斑马的[肉]。

examples.english: Our bodies are made of skin, [flesh], and bones.
examples.chinese: 我们的身体由皮肤、[肉]和骨头组成。

meanings.explanation: The [flesh] of a fruit or vegetable is the soft part that you eat inside it.

examples.english: The [flesh] of this watermelon is bright red.
examples.chinese: 这个西瓜的[果肉]是鲜红色的。

examples.english: Monkeys like to eat the sweet [flesh] of bananas.
examples.chinese: 猴子喜欢吃香蕉甜甜的[果肉]。

examples.english: Peel the orange to get to the juicy [flesh] inside.
examples.chinese: 剥开橘子皮，就能吃到里面多汁的[果肉]。

meanings.explanation: If you [forbid] someone to do something, or if you [forbid] an activity, you order them not to do it or say that it is not allowed.

examples.english: My mom [forbids] me to play video games on weekdays.
examples.chinese: 妈妈[不许]我在工作日打游戏。

examples.english: Smoking is [forbidden] in this restaurant.
examples.chinese: 这家餐厅[禁止]吸烟。

examples.english: The teacher [forbids] us from running in the hallway.
examples.chinese: 老师[禁止]我们在走廊里跑来跑去。

meanings.explanation: The [flexibility] of something is the ability to bend or be bent easily without breaking.

examples.english: Stretching every day helps improve your body's [flexibility].
examples.chinese: 每天拉伸有助于提高你身体的[柔韧性]。

examples.english: This rubber band has good [flexibility].
examples.chinese: 这个橡皮筋的[柔韧性]很好。

examples.english: Yoga can increase the [flexibility] of your muscles.
examples.chinese: 瑜伽可以增强你肌肉的[柔韧性]。

meanings.explanation: [Flexibility] is the ability to change or adapt easily to suit different situations.

examples.english: Our teacher allows [flexibility] in when we finish our homework.
examples.chinese: 我们老师在完成作业的时间上留出了[灵活性]。

examples.english: This job gives me a lot of [flexibility] to spend time with my family.
examples.chinese: 这份工作给了我很大[灵活性]，让我能多陪家人。

examples.english: We need more [flexibility] to solve this problem.
examples.chinese: 解决这个问题需要我们更多[灵活性]。

meanings.explanation: [Folk] are people in general, especially ordinary people in a particular group or area.

examples.english: The [folk] in this town are very friendly.
examples.chinese: 这个镇上的[乡亲们]非常热情。

examples.english: Country [folk] love to live close to nature.
examples.chinese: 乡下[老百姓]喜欢亲近大自然。

examples.english: Many old [folk] enjoy sitting in the park.
examples.chinese: 许多老年[人]喜欢坐在公园里。

meanings.explanation: Your [folks] are your parents, family members, or relatives.

examples.english: I will visit my [folk] this weekend.
examples.chinese: 这个周末我要去看望[家人]。

examples.english: My [folk] live in a small village.
examples.chinese: 我的[老家]在一个小村庄。

examples.english: She invited her [folk] to the birthday party.
examples.chinese: 她邀请了[亲戚]来参加生日派对。

meanings.explanation: If you [flee] from danger or a threatening person or animal, you run away from it as quickly as you can.

examples.english: The rabbit [fled] when it saw the fox.
examples.chinese: 兔子一看到狐狸就[逃走了]。

examples.english: Everyone [fled] from the burning building.
examples.chinese: 所有人都从着火的大楼里[逃了出来]。

examples.english: The deer [fled] into the forest.
examples.chinese: 鹿[逃进]了森林。

meanings.explanation: If you [flee] a place or unpleasant situation, you leave it quickly to get away from something bad.

examples.english: Many families [fled] the war to find safety.
examples.chinese: 很多家庭[逃离]了战争，去寻找安全的地方。

examples.english: She [fled] the noisy city for a quiet life in the country.
examples.chinese: 她[逃离]了嘈杂的城市，去乡下过平静的生活。

examples.english: The birds [fled] the cold winter.
examples.chinese: 鸟儿[逃离]了寒冷的冬天。

meanings.explanation: If you [found] something, you discovered it after looking for it or by chance. It is the past tense of 'find'.

examples.english: I [found] a cute little cat in the garden this morning.
examples.chinese: 我今天早上在花园里[发现]了一只可爱的小猫。

examples.english: She [found] her lost keys in her school bag.
examples.chinese: 她在书包里[找到了]她丢的钥匙。

examples.english: We [found] a really nice restaurant near our school.
examples.chinese: 我们在学校附近[找到了]一家特别好吃的餐厅。

meanings.explanation: If you [found] an organization, company, or school, you start it and make it exist. It is different from the past tense of 'find'.

examples.english: He [founded] a small bookshop in our town.
examples.chinese: 他在我们镇上[创办]了一家小书店。

examples.english: She wants to [found] a club for kids who love drawing.
examples.chinese: 她想[创立]一个给喜欢画画的孩子参加的社团。

examples.english: The teacher [founded] a reading group to help students.
examples.chinese: 老师[建立]了一个阅读小组来帮助学生们。

meanings.explanation: If you are [focused], you are giving all your attention to what you are doing and not letting anything distract you.

examples.english: I need to stay [focused] during the math test.
examples.chinese: 我需要在数学考试中保持[专注]。

examples.english: She was so [focused] on her homework that she didn't hear the phone ring.
examples.chinese: 她写作业时太[专心]了，连电话响都没听到。

examples.english: To win the game, you must stay [focused] until the very end.
examples.chinese: 要想赢得比赛，你必须从头到尾保持[专注]。

meanings.explanation: If something such as a plan, discussion, or approach is [focused], it is very clear and directed at a particular aim.

examples.english: The school has a [focused] plan to help students read better.
examples.chinese: 学校制定了一个[明确的]计划来帮助学生提高阅读能力。

examples.english: Our discussion was very [focused] and we solved the problem quickly.
examples.chinese: 我们的讨论非常[有针对性]，很快就解决了问题。

examples.english: The book gives a [focused] look at life in the ocean.
examples.chinese: 这本书[集中]介绍了海洋里的生活。

meanings.explanation: [Foreign] describes something that relates to or comes from another country, not your own.

examples.english: I am learning a [foreign] language at school.
examples.chinese: 我正在学校学[外语]。

examples.english: My mom likes cooking [foreign] food.
examples.chinese: 我妈妈喜欢做[外国]菜。

examples.english: She visited a [foreign] country last summer.
examples.chinese: 她去年夏天去[外国]玩了一趟。

meanings.explanation: [Foreign] also means not familiar or known to you; seeming strange.

examples.english: This topic feels [foreign] to me.
examples.chinese: 这个话题让我觉得很陌[生]。

examples.english: His ideas seemed [foreign] at first.
examples.chinese: 他的一些想法起初让我觉得很陌[生]。

examples.english: The doctor removed a [foreign] object from his ear.
examples.chinese: 医生从他耳朵里取出了一个[异物]。

meanings.explanation: A [formal] occasion or piece of clothing is one that follows special rules about how people should behave or dress.

examples.english: I wore a [formal] suit to my sister's wedding.
examples.chinese: 我穿了一套[正式的]西装去参加姐姐的婚礼。

examples.english: The school held a [formal] dinner for the parents.
examples.chinese: 学校为家长们举办了一场[正式的]晚宴。

examples.english: She put on a [formal] dress for the ceremony.
examples.chinese: 她为典礼换上了一条[正式的]裙子。

meanings.explanation: Someone who is [formal] behaves in a serious, polite way and does not act relaxed or friendly.

examples.english: The teacher was very [formal] on the first day of school.
examples.chinese: 开学第一天，老师非常[严肃庄重]。

examples.english: He gave a [formal] greeting to the new principal.
examples.chinese: 他向新校长致意时很[拘谨客套]。

examples.english: Please use [formal] language when writing to the mayor.
examples.chinese: 给市长写信时请使用[正式的]语言。

meanings.explanation: Something that is [frequent] happens often or many times.

examples.english: Rain is very [frequent] here in summer.
examples.chinese: 夏天这里经常[下雨]。

examples.english: She is a [frequent] guest at our house.
examples.chinese: 她是我们家的[常客]。

examples.english: He made [frequent] mistakes in his homework.
examples.chinese: 他在作业中[经常]出错。

meanings.explanation: If you [frequent] a place, you visit it often.

examples.english: We [frequent] that coffee shop after school.
examples.chinese: 放学后我们[常去]那家咖啡店。

examples.english: My grandpa [frequents] the park every morning.
examples.chinese: 我爷爷每天早上都[去]公园。

examples.english: Many students [frequent] the library before exams.
examples.chinese: 很多学生在考试前[经常去]图书馆。

meanings.explanation: If something is [free], you can have it without paying any money for it.

examples.english: The ice cream shop gives [free] water to customers.
examples.chinese: 这家冰淇淋店给顾客提供[免费的]水。

examples.english: I got this toy for [free] at the school fair.
examples.chinese: 我在学校集市上[免费]得到了这个玩具。

examples.english: The museum is [free] on Sundays for children.
examples.chinese: 这家博物馆周日对儿童[免费]开放。

meanings.explanation: If you are [free], you are not busy and you have time to do things.

examples.english: Are you [free] to play games after school?
examples.chinese: 你放学后[有空]一起玩游戏吗？

examples.english: My mom will be [free] to help me with homework tonight.
examples.chinese: 我妈妈今晚[有空]帮我做作业。

examples.english: The teacher is [free] during lunch break.
examples.chinese: 这位老师在午休时间[有空]。

meanings.explanation: If you [free] a person or animal, you let them go or make them no longer trapped.

examples.english: The fireman helped [free] the cat from the tree.
examples.chinese: 消防员帮忙把猫从树上[解救]下来。

examples.english: Please [free] the bird from its cage.
examples.chinese: 请把鸟从笼子里[放]出来。

examples.english: He worked hard to [free] the trapped rabbit.
examples.chinese: 他努力[救出]那只被困的兔子。

meanings.explanation: [Formerly] means something was true or existed in the past, but it is no longer true or does not exist now.

examples.english: [Formerly], I lived with my grandparents in the countryside.
examples.chinese: [以前], 我和爷爷奶奶住在乡下。

examples.english: This building was [formerly] a post office.
examples.chinese: 这栋楼[过去]是邮局。

examples.english: My dad was [formerly] a teacher before he became a writer.
examples.chinese: 我爸爸[早先]是老师，后来才成为作家。

meanings.explanation: A [fund] is an amount of money that is collected or saved for a particular purpose.

examples.english: The school set up a [fund] to help poor students buy books.
examples.chinese: 学校设立了一笔[基金]，用来帮助贫困学生买书。

examples.english: My parents put some money into a [fund] for my college education.
examples.chinese: 我父母往一笔教育[基金]里存了一些钱，供我上大学用。

examples.english: We are raising a [fund] to build a new playground for the kids.
examples.chinese: 我们正在筹集一笔[资金]，给孩子们建一个新的游乐场。

meanings.explanation: To [fund] a project, activity, or organization means to provide money to pay for it.

examples.english: The rich man agreed to [fund] the new library in our town.
examples.chinese: 那位富人同意[资助]我们镇上的新图书馆。

examples.english: The government will [fund] the science project next year.
examples.chinese: 政府明年将[资助]这个科学项目。

examples.english: We need to find someone to [fund] our school trip.
examples.chinese: 我们需要找人来[资助]我们的学校旅行。

meanings.explanation: You use [finally] to say that something happens after a long period of time, especially when there have been problems or delays and you are glad that it has happened.

examples.english: After waiting for an hour, the bus [finally] arrived.
examples.chinese: 等了一个小时后，公交车[终于]来了。

examples.english: She [finally] finished all her homework.
examples.chinese: 她[终于]把所有的作业都做完了。

examples.english: We [finally] found the missing key under the sofa.
examples.chinese: 我们[终于]在沙发下面找到了丢失的钥匙。

meanings.explanation: You use [finally] to introduce the last point or idea in a discussion, list, or series of actions.

examples.english: [Finally], I want to thank my mom and dad for their help.
examples.chinese: [最后]，我想感谢爸爸妈妈的帮助。

examples.english: [Finally], please remember to turn off the lights before you leave.
examples.chinese: [最后]，请记得离开前关灯。

examples.english: First we went to the zoo, then we had lunch, and [finally] we watched a movie.
examples.chinese: 我们先去了动物园，然后吃了午饭，[最后]看了一场电影。

meanings.explanation: If something [frightens] you, it makes you feel afraid or scared.

examples.english: Loud noises [frighten] my little sister.
examples.chinese: 巨大的声响会[吓到]我的小妹妹。

examples.english: The big dog [frightened] the children in the park.
examples.chinese: 那只大狗[吓到了]公园里的孩子们。

examples.english: Please don't make that face — you'll [frighten] the baby.
examples.chinese: 别做那个鬼脸——你会[吓到]宝宝的。

meanings.explanation: Something that is [finite] has a limit or an end; it is not endless or infinite.

examples.english: We only have a [finite] amount of time to finish our homework.
examples.chinese: 我们写作业的时间是[有限的]。

examples.english: My patience is [finite], so please stop making noise.
examples.chinese: 我的耐心是[有限的]，所以请别再吵了。

examples.english: The Earth's resources are [finite], so we should not waste them.
examples.chinese: 地球的资源是[有限的]，所以我们不应该浪费。

meanings.explanation: A [finite] number or quantity is one that has a definite value and can be counted; it is not infinite.

examples.english: There is a [finite] number of seats in the cinema.
examples.chinese: 电影院里的座位数量是[有限的]。

examples.english: The teacher said we can only invite a [finite] number of friends to the party.
examples.chinese: 老师说我们只能邀请[有限个]朋友来参加聚会。

examples.english: In math class, we learned the difference between [finite] and infinite numbers.
examples.chinese: 在数学课上，我们学习了[有限]数和无限数的区别。

meanings.explanation: [Friendly] describes someone who is kind, pleasant, and easy to talk to. It can also describe behavior that shows warmth and openness toward others.

examples.english: My neighbor is very [friendly] and always says hello.
examples.chinese: 我的邻居非常[友好]，总是主动打招呼。

examples.english: The little puppy is [friendly] to everyone it meets.
examples.chinese: 这只小狗对遇到的每个人都很[友好]。

examples.english: She always greets us with a [friendly] smile.
examples.chinese: 她总是带着[友善的]微笑迎接我们。

meanings.explanation: A [garment] is an item of clothing.

examples.english: She packed six [garments] for her summer vacation.
examples.chinese: 她为暑假打包了六件[衣服]。

examples.english: This factory makes [garments] for children.
examples.chinese: 这家工厂生产儿童[服装]。

examples.english: The blue [garment] on the chair is my jacket.
examples.chinese: 椅子上那件蓝色的[衣服]是我的夹克。

meanings.explanation: If someone is [frail], they are weak and not strong, often because they are old or sick.

examples.english: The [frail] old man needed help to walk down the stairs.
examples.chinese: 那位[虚弱的]老人需要帮助才能走下楼梯。

examples.english: After being sick for a week, the kitten looked very [frail].
examples.chinese: 病了一周后，那只小猫看起来非常[虚弱]。

examples.english: My grandmother is getting [frail] and cannot carry heavy bags anymore.
examples.chinese: 我奶奶越来越[虚弱]了，再也提不动重袋子了。

meanings.explanation: If something is [frail], it is easily broken, damaged, or destroyed because it is not strong.

examples.english: Be careful with that [frail] glass vase — it might break.
examples.chinese: 小心那个[易碎的]玻璃花瓶——它可能会碎。

examples.english: The old bridge was [frail] and could not hold heavy trucks.
examples.chinese: 那座旧桥[不结实]，承受不了重型卡车。

examples.english: The bird built its nest with [frail] twigs that could snap in the wind.
examples.chinese: 小鸟用[细脆的]树枝搭窝，那些树枝风一吹就会断。

meanings.explanation: Someone who is [frivolous] does silly or unnecessary things instead of being serious and sensible.

examples.english: My sister buys [frivolous] things like ten different colored hats.
examples.chinese: 我妹妹买一些[不必要的]东西，比如十种不同颜色的帽子。

examples.english: Stop being so [frivolous] and finish your homework first.
examples.chinese: 别这么[不务正业]了，先把作业做完。

examples.english: He spent all his money on [frivolous] games and toys.
examples.chinese: 他把所有钱都花在了[无聊的]游戏和玩具上。

meanings.explanation: A [frivolous] activity or object is silly or not important, rather than useful or serious.

examples.english: The judge dismissed the [frivolous] complaint as a waste of time.
examples.chinese: 法官驳回了这桩[无聊的]投诉，认为那是浪费时间。

examples.english: We should not waste time on such [frivolous] matters.
examples.chinese: 我们不应该在这种[无关紧要的]事情上浪费时间。

examples.english: The meeting discussed serious issues, not [frivolous] topics.
examples.chinese: 会议讨论的是严肃问题，而不是[琐碎的]话题。

meanings.explanation: A [flight] is a journey made by airplane, or the action of flying through the air.

examples.english: We booked a [flight] to Paris for our vacation.
examples.chinese: 我们预订了去巴黎的[航班]去度假。

examples.english: The [flight] was delayed by three hours because of the storm.
examples.chinese: 由于暴风雨，[航班]延误了三个小时。

examples.english: We watched the [flight] of the birds over the lake.
examples.chinese: 我们观看了鸟儿在湖面上空[飞翔]的景象。

meanings.explanation: A [flight] is also a set of stairs that goes from one floor to another in a building.

examples.english: She ran up a [flight] of stairs to her bedroom.
examples.chinese: 她跑上[一段楼梯]到卧室。

examples.english: We climbed a long [flight] of steps to reach the top of the hill.
examples.chinese: 我们爬了很长[一段台阶]才到达山顶。

examples.english: The little boy ran down the [flight] of stairs laughing.
examples.chinese: 小男孩笑着从[楼梯]上跑下来。

meanings.explanation: A [form] of something is a particular type, kind, or variety of it.

examples.english: Swimming is a popular [form] of exercise.
examples.chinese: 游泳是一种很受欢迎的锻炼[方式]。

examples.english: Ice is a solid [form] of water.
examples.chinese: 冰是水的一种固体[形态]。

examples.english: Reading is a great [form] of entertainment.
examples.chinese: 阅读是一种很好的娱乐[形式]。

meanings.explanation: If you [form] something or it [form]s, you make it begin to exist or it begins to exist.

examples.english: Let's [form] a circle and play a game.
examples.chinese: 我们来[围成]一个圈做游戏吧。

examples.english: Clouds began to [form] in the afternoon sky.
examples.chinese: 下午天空中开始[形成]云朵。

examples.english: The kids [form]ed a club to help animals.
examples.chinese: 孩子们[组建]了一个帮助动物的小社团。

meanings.explanation: A [general] idea, rule, or feeling is one that relates to most people or things, rather than being about specific details.

examples.english: The [general] idea of the story is about friendship.
examples.chinese: 这个故事的[大致]内容是关于友情的。

examples.english: We need to make a [general] plan before the school trip.
examples.chinese: 学校春游前，我们需要先做一个[总体]计划。

examples.english: The [general] feeling in the class was excitement.
examples.chinese: 班里的[普遍]情绪是兴奋。

meanings.explanation: A [general] is a high-ranking officer in the army who commands a large group of soldiers.

examples.english: The [general] stood at the front of the army.
examples.chinese: [将军]站在军队的最前面。

examples.english: The [general] gave orders to the soldiers.
examples.chinese: [将军]向士兵们下达了命令。

examples.english: My grandpa told me a story about a brave [general].
examples.chinese: 爷爷给我讲了一个关于一位英勇[将军]的故事。

meanings.explanation: A [gesture] is a movement of your body, especially your hands or arms, that shows what you are thinking or feeling.

examples.english: He made a friendly [gesture] to say hello to me.
examples.chinese: 他做了一个友好的[手势]来跟我打招呼。

examples.english: She opened her arms in a welcoming [gesture].
examples.chinese: 她张开双臂，做出了一个表示欢迎的[姿势]。

examples.english: The teacher used hand [gestures] to help us understand the story.
examples.chinese: 老师用[手势]来帮助我们理解故事。

meanings.explanation: A [gesture] is also an action that you do to show your feelings or intentions, often to be polite or kind to someone.

examples.english: It was a nice [gesture] to give her a birthday card.
examples.chinese: 送她一张生日贺卡是一种贴心的[表示]。

examples.english: He cooked dinner for his mom as a [gesture] of thanks.
examples.chinese: 他给妈妈做了一顿晚饭，以表达[心意]。

examples.english: Thank you for the flowers — that was a very sweet [gesture].
examples.chinese: 谢谢你的花，这个[举动]真让人感动。

meanings.explanation: To [generalize] means to make a general statement or create a broader application based on specific observations or cases.

examples.english: You shouldn't [generalize] from just two examples.
examples.chinese: 你不应该只根据两个例子就[概括]。

examples.english: The teacher asked us to [generalize] the pattern we observed.
examples.chinese: 老师让我们[归纳]观察到的规律。

examples.english: It's easy to [generalize] about people you've never met.
examples.chinese: 对从未见过的人[一概而论]是很容易的。

meanings.explanation: In science and statistics, to [generalize] means to apply conclusions from a sample study to a larger population.

examples.english: Researchers hope to [generalize] their findings to the whole population.
examples.chinese: 研究人员希望将他们的发现[推广]到整个人群。

examples.english: We cannot [generalize] results from such a small sample.
examples.chinese: 我们无法从这么小的样本中[得出普遍结论]。

examples.english: The study's results can be [generalized] to other age groups.
examples.chinese: 这项研究的结果可以[推广]到其他年龄组。

meanings.explanation: If you [get rid of] something, you remove it or dispose of it. If you [get rid of] someone, you make them leave.

examples.english: I need to [get rid of] these old clothes.
examples.chinese: 我得把这些旧衣服[扔掉]。

examples.english: We should [get rid of] this broken chair.
examples.chinese: 我们应该把这把坏椅子[处理掉]。

examples.english: He finally [got rid of] his smoking habit.
examples.chinese: 他终于[戒掉了]吸烟的习惯。

meanings.explanation: When liquids [freeze], they become solid because the temperature is very low.

examples.english: The pond water will [freeze] on very cold winter days.
examples.chinese: 在非常寒冷的冬天，池塘里的水会[结冰]。

examples.english: We can [freeze] leftover bread to keep it fresh.
examples.chinese: 我们可以把吃剩的面包[冷冻]起来保鲜。

examples.english: This river can [freeze] as early as December.
examples.chinese: 这条河最早十二月就会[结冰]。

meanings.explanation: If you [freeze], you suddenly stop moving completely because you are very afraid or surprised.

examples.english: You might [freeze] when you see a big dog running at you.
examples.chinese: 当你看到大狗朝你冲过来时，你可能会[僵住]。

examples.english: Don't [freeze] when the teacher asks you a question.
examples.chinese: 老师问你问题时，别[呆住]不动。

examples.english: I always [freeze] when I hear a loud thunderclap at night.
examples.chinese: 晚上听到打雷我总是[愣住]。

meanings.explanation: If you [gather] people or things, you bring them together into one place or group.

examples.english: We [gather] at my grandma's house every Spring Festival.
examples.chinese: 我们每年春节都会[聚集]在奶奶家。

examples.english: Can you [gather] your crayons on the table?
examples.chinese: 你能把桌上的蜡笔都[收集]起来吗？

examples.english: All the students [gather] on the playground for the morning meeting.
examples.chinese: 所有学生都[聚集]在操场开早会。

meanings.explanation: If you [gather] that something is true, you believe or understand it based on what you see or hear.

examples.english: I [gather] you don't like this cake, because you haven't eaten any.
examples.chinese: 我[猜想]你不喜欢这个蛋糕，因为你一口都没吃。

examples.english: From the smile on her face, I [gather] she got good news.
examples.chinese: 从她脸上的笑容，我[推测]她得到了好消息。

examples.english: I [gather] you've already met my little brother.
examples.chinese: 我[猜想]你已经见过我弟弟了。

meanings.explanation: Something that is [fundamental] is a necessary or essential part of something, forming its base or most important element.

examples.english: Learning to read is [fundamental] for every child.
examples.chinese: 学会阅读对每个孩子来说都是[必备的]。

examples.english: The [fundamental] rule is to always tell the truth.
examples.chinese: [基本的]规则是永远要说真话。

examples.english: Music education is [fundamental] to a child's development.
examples.chinese: 音乐教育对孩子的成长[至关重要]。

meanings.explanation: A [fundamental] is a basic principle or foundation that something is built upon.

examples.english: Respect for others is a [fundamental] of good relationships.
examples.chinese: 尊重他人是好的人际关系的[基本原则]。

examples.english: The [fundamentals] of cooking are easy to learn.
examples.chinese: 烹饪的[基础技能]很容易学。

examples.english: We must understand the [fundamentals] before moving on.
examples.chinese: 我们必须先理解[基本原理]再继续。

meanings.explanation: A [gentle] person or animal is kind, soft, and not rough or violent towards others.

examples.english: My dad is [gentle] when he holds our new baby cat.
examples.chinese: 我爸爸抱我们新来的小猫时很[温柔]。

examples.english: The [gentle] dog never barks at young children.
examples.chinese: 这只[温顺]的狗从不对小孩子叫。

examples.english: You need to be [gentle] when you hold this small bird.
examples.chinese: 你捧这只小鸟的时候要[轻柔]一点。

meanings.explanation: If something such as wind, a voice, or sunlight is [gentle], it is soft and not strong or harsh.

examples.english: A [gentle] wind blew through our open window.
examples.chinese: 一阵[轻柔]的风吹过我们敞开的窗户。

examples.english: Mom used a [gentle] voice to read me a bedtime story.
examples.chinese: 妈妈用[轻柔]的声音给我读睡前故事。

examples.english: We walked in the [gentle] afternoon sun.
examples.chinese: 我们在午后[柔和]的阳光下散步。

meanings.explanation: Someone or something that is [generative] is able to produce, create, or bring new things into existence.

examples.english: The artist has a highly [generative] imagination and creates beautiful paintings every day.
examples.chinese: 这位艺术家有着极富[创造力的]想象力，每天创作出美丽的画作。

examples.english: A healthy garden soil is [generative] and helps plants grow strong.
examples.chinese: 肥沃的菜园土壤很[有生产力]，能帮助植物茁壮成长。

examples.english: Her [generative] ideas helped us make a fun science project.
examples.chinese: 她[富有创造力的]想法帮助我们做出了一个有趣的科学项目。

meanings.explanation: [Generative] technology or AI is designed to create new content such as text, pictures, or music, rather than just analyzing information.

examples.english: [Generative] AI can write poems and draw pictures for children.
examples.chinese: [生成式]AI能帮孩子写诗、画画。

examples.english: My brother uses [generative] tools to help with his art homework.
examples.chinese: 我哥哥用[生成式]工具来帮他做美术作业。

examples.english: This [generative] app creates music based on your favorite colors.
examples.chinese: 这款[生成式]应用会根据你喜欢的颜色创作音乐。

meanings.explanation: Something that is [glowing] gives off a soft, warm light. It can also describe a person's skin or face that looks healthy, warm, and full of color.

examples.english: We sat around the [glowing] campfire and ate marshmallows.
examples.chinese: 我们围坐在[发着光]的篝火旁吃棉花糖。

examples.english: She came back from the beach with a [glowing] face.
examples.chinese: 她从海滩回来，脸上[红润发亮]。

examples.english: The stars in the sky looked [glowing] and beautiful last night.
examples.chinese: 昨晚天上的星星看起来[亮晶晶]的，特别漂亮。

meanings.explanation: A [glowing] description or report is full of praise and shows great admiration or approval of someone or something.

examples.english: The teacher wrote a [glowing] report about how well Tom did in class.
examples.chinese: 老师写了一份[极好的]评语，表扬汤姆在课堂上表现得非常棒。

examples.english: My mom gave a [glowing] review of the new noodle shop.
examples.chinese: 妈妈对那家新开的面馆给了[大加赞赏的]评价。

examples.english: The book got a [glowing] review in the school newspaper.
examples.chinese: 这本书在校报上得到了一篇[高度赞美的]书评。

meanings.explanation: The [following] thing or person is the one that comes next after the thing or person you have just talked about.

examples.english: Please write your answer on the [following] line.
examples.chinese: 请把答案写在[下]一行。

examples.english: We're going to the zoo on the [following] Saturday.
examples.chinese: 我们[下个]周六要去动物园。

examples.english: Please answer the [following] three questions.
examples.chinese: 请回答[下面的]三个问题。

meanings.explanation: A [following] is a group of people who like, support, or follow a particular person, group, or idea.

examples.english: The popular singer has a large [following] online.
examples.chinese: 这位受欢迎的歌手在网上有一大批[追随者]。

examples.english: This food blogger has a big [following] on social media.
examples.chinese: 这位美食博主在社交媒体上有很多[粉丝]。

examples.english: This cute cartoon cat has a big [following] among kids.
examples.chinese: 这只可爱的卡通猫在小朋友中有很多[粉丝]。

meanings.explanation: A [frontline] worker or service works directly with the public or deals directly with a crisis, rather than working in a support role away from the action.

examples.english: Doctors and nurses are [frontline] workers who help sick people every day.
examples.chinese: 医生和护士是每天帮助病人的[一线]工作者。

examples.english: We should thank all [frontline] staff for their hard work.
examples.chinese: 我们应该感谢所有[一线]工作人员的辛勤付出。

examples.english: [Frontline] community workers help our neighbors every day.
examples.chinese: [一线]社区工作者每天都帮助我们的邻居。

meanings.explanation: The [frontline] is the position or area where people are most directly involved in dealing with a problem, crisis, or important activity.

examples.english: Many brave doctors and nurses worked on the [frontline] during the pandemic.
examples.chinese: 许多勇敢的医生和护士在疫情期间奋战在[一线]。

examples.english: Teachers stand on the [frontline] of educating children every day.
examples.chinese: 老师们每天站在教育孩子的[第一线]。

examples.english: Volunteers quickly went to the [frontline] to help after the flood.
examples.chinese: 洪水过后，志愿者们迅速前往[一线]提供帮助。

meanings.explanation: A [gradual] change or process happens slowly over a long period of time, not suddenly.

examples.english: There has been a [gradual] rise in temperature this week.
examples.chinese: 这周气温[逐渐]上升了。

examples.english: Learning a language is a [gradual] process that takes time.
examples.chinese: 学习语言是一个需要时间、[循序渐进]的过程。

examples.english: The hill has a [gradual] slope, so walking up is easy.
examples.chinese: 这座山坡度[平缓]，所以走上去很容易。

meanings.explanation: A [grant] is a sum of money given by a government, school, or organization to help someone pay for education, research, or a project.

examples.english: She got a [grant] from the government to study at a university.
examples.chinese: 她获得了一笔政府[资助]，可以在大学读书。

examples.english: Our school received a [grant] to build a new library.
examples.chinese: 我们学校获得了一笔[拨款]，用来建一座新图书馆。

examples.english: He applied for a [grant] to start his own small business.
examples.chinese: 他申请了一笔[补助金]，想开一家小店。

meanings.explanation: If you [grant] someone something, you agree to give it to them, or you allow them to do what they have asked.

examples.english: The teacher [granted] him a few more minutes to finish the test.
examples.chinese: 老师[给]了他几分钟额外时间来把试卷做完。

examples.english: My mom [granted] me permission to go to the party.
examples.chinese: 妈妈[答应]了我去参加聚会的请求。

examples.english: The fairy [granted] the little girl three wishes.
examples.chinese: 仙女[满足]了小女孩三个愿望。

meanings.explanation: Something that is [glorious] is very beautiful, impressive, and makes people feel happy and full of admiration.

examples.english: We had a [glorious] day at the beach yesterday.
examples.chinese: 我们昨天在海滩度过了[美好的]一天。

examples.english: The [glorious] sunset turned the whole sky bright red.
examples.chinese: [壮丽的]日落把整片天空都染成了鲜红色。

examples.english: The princess wore a [glorious] blue dress to the ball.
examples.chinese: 公主穿着一件[华丽的]蓝色礼服参加舞会。

meanings.explanation: A [glorious] victory, success, or achievement is very great and deserves full praise and honor.

examples.english: Our team won a [glorious] victory in the final game.
examples.chinese: 我们队在决赛中取得了[辉煌的]胜利。

examples.english: The soldiers helped our country win a [glorious] battle.
examples.chinese: 战士们帮助国家赢得了一场[光荣的]战斗。

examples.english: My sister got a [glorious] result in her piano competition.
examples.chinese: 我姐姐在钢琴比赛中取得了[出色的]成绩。

meanings.explanation: If you are [furious], you are extremely angry.

examples.english: My mom was [furious] when I spilled juice on the new carpet.
examples.chinese: 我把果汁洒在新地毯上时，妈妈[非常生气]。

examples.english: The teacher was [furious] because someone drew on the wall.
examples.chinese: 老师因为有人在墙上乱画而[大发雷霆]。

examples.english: Dad was [furious] with the dog for eating his sandwich.
examples.chinese: 爸爸因为狗吃掉了他的三明治而[非常恼火]。

meanings.explanation: A [furious] action or event is done with great energy, speed, or force.

examples.english: There was a [furious] storm with loud thunder last night.
examples.chinese: 昨晚有一场雷声很大的[猛烈]暴风雨。

examples.english: The two teams had a [furious] competition to win the prize.
examples.chinese: 两支队伍为了赢得奖品展开了[激烈的]竞争。

examples.english: The rabbit ran at a [furious] speed to escape the fox.
examples.chinese: 兔子以[飞快的]速度逃跑，躲避狐狸。

meanings.explanation: You use [generally] to say that something is true or happens most of the time, but not always.

examples.english: I [generally] wake up at seven o'clock in the morning.
examples.chinese: 我[通常]早上七点起床。

examples.english: The weather is [generally] warm in spring.
examples.chinese: 春天天气[通常]很暖和。

examples.english: My dad [generally] cooks dinner on weekends.
examples.chinese: 我爸爸[通常]周末做晚饭。

meanings.explanation: You use [generally] to say that something is true for most people or is widely believed or accepted.

examples.english: It is [generally] believed that reading is good for us.
examples.chinese: [普遍]认为读书对我们有好处。

examples.english: This song is [generally] loved by young people.
examples.chinese: 这首歌[普遍]受到年轻人的喜爱。

examples.english: Apples are [generally] known as a healthy fruit.
examples.chinese: 苹果[普遍]被看作一种健康水果。

meanings.explanation: A [gorilla] is a large African ape with dark hair, known for being the largest and most powerful of all primates.

examples.english: The [gorilla] is the largest ape in the world.
examples.chinese: [大猩猩]是世界上最大的类人猿。

examples.english: We saw a family of [gorilla]s at the zoo.
examples.chinese: 我们在动物园看到了一[大猩猩]家族。

examples.english: The baby [gorilla] clung tightly to its mother.
examples.chinese: 这只幼[大猩猩]紧紧抱着它的妈妈。

meanings.explanation: If you [grasp] something, you take hold of it firmly with your hand or fingers.

examples.english: The baby tried to [grasp] the toy.
examples.chinese: 宝宝试图[抓住]那个玩具。

examples.english: He [grasped] my hand and smiled.
examples.chinese: 他[握住]我的手，笑了笑。

examples.english: She [grasped] the rope to climb up.
examples.chinese: 她[抓住]绳子往上爬。

meanings.explanation: If you [grasp] an idea or subject, you understand it completely.

examples.english: It took me a while to [grasp] the math concept.
examples.chinese: 我花了一会儿才[理解]这个数学概念。

examples.english: She quickly [grasped] how the game worked.
examples.chinese: 她很快[领会]了游戏是怎么玩的。

examples.english: I cannot [grasp] what he is trying to say.
examples.chinese: 我[搞不懂]他想说什么。

meanings.explanation: When people, animals, or plants [grow], they become bigger, taller, or more mature as time passes.

examples.english: My puppy will [grow] bigger in a few months.
examples.chinese: 我的小狗几个月后会[长大]。

examples.english: Children [grow] so fast when they sleep well.
examples.chinese: 孩子们睡眠充足时会[长得]很快。

examples.english: The little tree will [grow] tall and strong.
examples.chinese: 这棵小树会[长成]又高又壮的大树。

meanings.explanation: If you [grow] plants, you put seeds in the ground and take care of them until they become fully developed.

examples.english: My mom likes to [grow] tomatoes in our garden.
examples.chinese: 我妈妈喜欢在我们的花园里[种]西红柿。

examples.english: Farmers [grow] rice in the wet fields.
examples.chinese: 农民们在稻田里[种植]水稻。

examples.english: We plan to [grow] sunflowers near the fence.
examples.chinese: 我们计划在栅栏旁边[种]向日葵。

meanings.explanation: A [handle] is the part of an object that you use to hold, open, or carry it, like on a cup, door, or bag.

examples.english: Please turn the door [handle] to open it.
examples.chinese: 请转动门[把手]来开门。

examples.english: The tea cup has a small [handle] on the side.
examples.chinese: 茶杯侧面有一个小[把手]。

examples.english: I held the bike by its [handle] bars.
examples.chinese: 我握着自行车的[把手]。

meanings.explanation: If you [handle] something, you deal with it or take care of it in a particular way.

examples.english: Mom will [handle] this difficult question.
examples.chinese: 妈妈会[处理]这个难题。

examples.english: Please [handle] the glass carefully so it won't break.
examples.chinese: 请小心[拿]这个玻璃杯，别打碎了。

examples.english: Can you [handle] all your homework today?
examples.chinese: 你今天能[应付]完所有作业吗？

meanings.explanation: Something that is [giant] is extremely large, or much larger than other things of its kind.

examples.english: We saw a [giant] elephant at the zoo.
examples.chinese: 我们在动物园看到了一头[巨大的]大象。

examples.english: She ate a [giant] bowl of ice cream.
examples.chinese: 她吃了一[大]碗冰淇淋。

examples.english: The [giant] pumpkin won first prize at the fair.
examples.chinese: 那个[巨大的]南瓜在集市上得了一等奖。

meanings.explanation: A [giant] is a person or thing that is unusually large, powerful, or important.

examples.english: The basketball player was a true [giant] on the court.
examples.chinese: 那个篮球运动员在球场上是个名副其实的[巨人]。

examples.english: Technology [giants] like Apple sell products all over the world.
examples.chinese: 像苹果这样的科技[巨头]把产品卖到了世界各地。

examples.english: He is a [giant] in the world of science.
examples.chinese: 他是科学界的[巨匠]。

meanings.explanation: If something happens [gradually], it happens slowly and steadily over a period of time rather than suddenly.

examples.english: The sun [gradually] rose above the hills.
examples.chinese: 太阳[渐渐]升上了山冈。

examples.english: My little sister [gradually] learned to ride a bike.
examples.chinese: 我妹妹[渐渐]学会了骑自行车。

examples.english: The leaves [gradually] turned yellow in autumn.
examples.chinese: 秋天树叶[渐渐]变黄了。

meanings.explanation: A [guiltless] person is completely innocent and has not done anything wrong or illegal.

examples.english: The judge said the man was [guiltless] and let him go home.
examples.chinese: 法官说这个男人是[无罪的]，让他回家了。

examples.english: She looked at her mom with a [guiltless] smile after eating the cookie.
examples.chinese: 她吃完饼干后，带着[无辜的]微笑看着妈妈。

examples.english: Everyone believed he was [guiltless] because he was at home all evening.
examples.chinese: 大家都相信他是[清白的]，因为他一整晚都在家。

meanings.explanation: If someone is [guiltless] of something, they are not responsible for it and cannot be blamed for it.

examples.english: The boy was [guiltless] of breaking the window; it was the wind.
examples.chinese: 打破窗户这件事，男孩是[没有责任的]，是风弄的。

examples.english: She was [guiltless] of the mistake because she never touched the computer.
examples.chinese: 她对那个错误是[毫无干系的]，因为她根本没有碰过电脑。

examples.english: My dog is [guiltless] of making the mess in the kitchen.
examples.chinese: 把厨房搞得一团糟这件事，我的狗是[没有责任的]。

meanings.explanation: Something that is [hard] is difficult to do, understand, or answer.

examples.english: This math problem is too [hard] for me.
examples.chinese: 这道数学题对我来说太[难]了。

examples.english: She had a [hard] time finding her way home.
examples.chinese: 她[费了好大劲]才找到回家的路。

examples.english: Is it [hard] to learn to ride a bike?
examples.chinese: 学骑自行车[难]吗？

meanings.explanation: If you work or try [hard], you put a lot of effort into what you are doing.

examples.english: He studies [hard] every evening.
examples.chinese: 他每天晚上都[努力]学习。

examples.english: It was raining [hard] when we left school.
examples.chinese: 我们放学时雨下得很[大]。

examples.english: She tried [hard] to win the race.
examples.chinese: 她拼了命地[努力]想赢得比赛。

meanings.explanation: If you [govern] a country, state, or city, you officially make decisions about its laws and manage its affairs.

examples.english: The president helps to [govern] the country.
examples.chinese: 总统帮忙[管理]国家。

examples.english: Our city has a mayor who helps [govern] it.
examples.chinese: 我们城市有位市长帮忙[管理]。

examples.english: It is not easy to [govern] a large nation.
examples.chinese: [管理]一个大国并不容易。

meanings.explanation: If rules, laws, or principles [govern] something, they control or influence how it happens or is done.

examples.english: Rules [govern] how we play the game.
examples.chinese: 规则[决定]我们怎么玩游戏。

examples.english: The laws of nature [govern] everything around us.
examples.chinese: 自然法则[决定]着周围的一切。

examples.english: Good manners [govern] how we talk to others.
examples.chinese: 礼貌[决定]我们怎么跟别人说话。

meanings.explanation: The [harshness] of something is the quality of being cruel, severe, or unkind.

examples.english: The teacher was surprised by the [harshness] of the boy's words.
examples.chinese: 老师对这个男孩话语的[刻薄]感到惊讶。

examples.english: She could not forget the [harshness] of her stepmother.
examples.chinese: 她无法忘记继母的[刻薄]。

examples.english: The [harshness] of his punishment made everyone feel sorry for him.
examples.chinese: 惩罚的[严厉]让所有人都为他感到难过。

meanings.explanation: The [harshness] of a condition or environment is the quality of being very unpleasant, rough, or hard to bear.

examples.english: The [harshness] of the winter wind made us stay indoors.
examples.chinese: 冬风的[刺骨]让我们待在了屋里。

examples.english: We were not ready for the [harshness] of desert life.
examples.chinese: 我们没有准备好面对沙漠生活的[艰苦]。

examples.english: The [harshness] of the sun burned her skin quickly.
examples.chinese: 阳光的[强烈]很快晒伤了她的皮肤。

meanings.explanation: Something or someone that is [harmless] does not cause any harm or damage, and is not dangerous or threatening.

examples.english: Don't be scared of that spider, it is completely [harmless].
examples.chinese: 别害怕那只蜘蛛,它完全[无害]。

examples.english: It was just a [harmless] joke, not meant to upset anyone.
examples.chinese: 那只是个[善意的]玩笑，不是故意要惹人生气的。

examples.english: This toy is [harmless] for small children to play with.
examples.chinese: 这个玩具小孩子玩起来很[安全]。

meanings.explanation: [Harm] refers to physical or mental damage, injury, or hurt caused to a person, animal, or thing.

examples.english: The storm didn't do much [harm] to our house.
examples.chinese: 风暴对我们房子没造成多大[损害]。

examples.english: I mean no [harm] by saying this.
examples.chinese: 我说这话没有[恶意]。

examples.english: Keeping secrets can sometimes cause [harm] to friendships.
examples.chinese: 隐瞒秘密有时会[伤害][友谊]。

meanings.explanation: If you [harm] someone or something, you cause physical or mental damage or injury to them.

examples.english: Please don't [harm] the little birds in the garden.
examples.chinese: 请不要[伤害]花园里的小鸟。

examples.english: Smoking can really [harm] your health.
examples.chinese: 吸烟真的会[损害]你的健康。

examples.english: We must protect children from things that [harm] them.
examples.chinese: 我们必须保护儿童免受[伤害]他们的事物。

meanings.explanation: Something that is [handy] is useful or convenient for daily use or a particular purpose.

examples.english: This small knife is really [handy] when we go camping.
examples.chinese: 这把小刀在我们去露营的时候特别[好用]。

examples.english: This folding shopping bag is very [handy] to carry around.
examples.chinese: 这个可折叠购物袋随身携带很[方便]。

examples.english: Keep a water bottle [handy] when you go hiking.
examples.chinese: 去远足的时候把水瓶放在[顺手]的地方。

meanings.explanation: Someone who is [handy] is good at using their hands to make, fix, or do things well.

examples.english: My dad is really [handy] and can fix almost anything broken.
examples.chinese: 我爸爸手很[巧]，几乎什么坏东西都能修。

examples.english: My grandpa is [handy] at making small wooden toys.
examples.chinese: 我爷爷做小木制玩具手很[灵巧]。

examples.english: Being [handy] saves us a lot of money on home repairs.
examples.chinese: 手[巧]能帮我们省下不少家里维修的钱。

meanings.explanation: If you do something [heartily], you do it in an enthusiastic and energetic way, with all your heart.

examples.english: The children laughed [heartily] at the funny clown.
examples.chinese: 孩子们看着滑稽的小丑，[开心地]大笑起来。

examples.english: He ate [heartily] because he was very hungry.
examples.chinese: 他饿坏了，所以[大口大口地]吃着。

examples.english: She agreed [heartily] with her friend's good idea.
examples.chinese: 她非常[赞同]朋友的好主意。

meanings.explanation: Something that is [harmful] causes damage or injury to someone or something, especially to a person's health or well-being.

examples.english: Eating too much candy is [harmful] to your teeth.
examples.chinese: 吃太多糖果对牙齿[有害]。

examples.english: Smoking is very [harmful] to our health.
examples.chinese: 吸烟对健康非常[有害]。

examples.english: Staying up too late every night is [harmful] for your body.
examples.chinese: 每天熬夜太晚对身体[有害]。

meanings.explanation: If you [grind] something, you crush it into very small pieces or powder by pressing it against a hard surface or using a machine.

examples.english: Dad [grinds] coffee beans every morning before breakfast.
examples.chinese: 爸爸每天早上在早饭前[磨]咖啡豆。

examples.english: Please [grind] some pepper onto your noodles.
examples.chinese: 请[磨]一些胡椒撒在你的面条上。

examples.english: This machine can [grind] wheat into flour.
examples.chinese: 这台机器能把小麦[磨成]面粉。

meanings.explanation: If you [grind] or [grind] away at something, you work very hard at it, often for a long period of time.

examples.english: I [grind] every evening to finish all my homework.
examples.chinese: 我每天晚上[努力]完成所有作业。

examples.english: She [grinds] every day to improve her English.
examples.chinese: 她每天[用功]来提高英语水平。

examples.english: He [grinds] for two hours every day to prepare for the test.
examples.chinese: 他每天[苦读]两个小时来准备考试。

meanings.explanation: A [helicopter] is a type of aircraft that uses spinning blades on top to fly up and down, and can also move sideways and backward.

examples.english: We saw a [helicopter] flying over our school this morning.
examples.chinese: 今天早上我们看见一架[直升机]从我们学校上空飞过。

examples.english: The hospital has a [helicopter] to carry sick people quickly.
examples.chinese: 这家医院有一架[直升机]，可以快速运送病人。

examples.english: My dream is to take a [helicopter] ride and see the city from the sky.
examples.chinese: 我的梦想是坐一次[直升机]，从空中看看这座城市。

meanings.explanation: If you [helicopter] somewhere, you travel there by helicopter.

examples.english: The doctors will [helicopter] the injured man to a big hospital.
examples.chinese: 医生们将[用直升机运送]这名伤员到一家大医院。

examples.english: The president was [helicoptered] to the airport because of the heavy rain.
examples.chinese: 因为雨太大，总统被[用直升机送往]机场。

examples.english: They [helicoptered] food and water to the village cut off by the flood.
examples.chinese: 他们[用直升机空投]食物和水到被洪水隔绝的村庄。

meanings.explanation: A [herd] is a group of animals of one kind that live and feed together.

examples.english: A [herd] of cows is eating grass in the green field.
examples.chinese: 一[群]奶牛正在绿油油的草地上吃草。

examples.english: We saw a large [herd] of elephants during our trip to Africa.
examples.chinese: 我们在非洲旅行时看到了一大[群]大象。

examples.english: The farmer takes good care of his [herd] of sheep.
examples.chinese: 农场主把他那[群]羊照顾得很好。

meanings.explanation: If you [herd] animals, you cause them to move together to a particular place as a group.

examples.english: The dog helps to [herd] the sheep into the pen.
examples.chinese: 这只狗帮忙把羊群[赶]进围栏里。

examples.english: Farmers [herd] their cattle together before a storm comes.
examples.chinese: 暴风雨来临前，农场主会把牛[赶]在一起。

examples.english: The teacher [herded] the children onto the school bus.
examples.chinese: 老师把孩子们[赶]上了校车。

meanings.explanation: A [guarantee] is a formal promise that something will be done or will happen as expected, especially that a product will be repaired or replaced if it breaks within a specific period.

examples.english: My new bike comes with a three-year [guarantee].
examples.chinese: 我的新自行车有三年的[保修]。

examples.english: The shop gives a money-back [guarantee] for this board game.
examples.chinese: 这家店给这款桌游提供退款[保证]。

examples.english: Dad says no one can give a [guarantee] that it won't break.
examples.chinese: 爸爸说没人能给出它不会坏的[保证]。

meanings.explanation: If you [guarantee] something, you make a firm promise that it will definitely happen or be as described.

examples.english: The seller [guarantees] that this toy is safe for children.
examples.chinese: 卖家[保证]这个玩具对孩子是安全的。

examples.english: I can [guarantee] you'll love this strawberry ice cream.
examples.chinese: 我[保证]你会喜欢这个草莓冰淇淋。

examples.english: This store [guarantees] all its products for one year.
examples.chinese: 这家店[保证]所有商品保修一年。

meanings.explanation: If you [hold] something, you have it in your hands or arms.

examples.english: Please [hold] my bag for a minute.
examples.chinese: 请帮我[拿]一下包。

examples.english: She [held] the baby gently in her arms.
examples.chinese: 她轻轻地把宝宝[抱]在怀里。

examples.english: Can you [hold] this cup of water for me?
examples.chinese: 你能帮我[端着]这杯水吗？

meanings.explanation: If you [hold] an event or activity, you organize it and make it happen.

examples.english: Our school will [hold] a sports day next Friday.
examples.chinese: 我们学校下周五将[举办]运动会。

examples.english: They [held] a birthday party for their son.
examples.chinese: 他们为儿子[举办了]一场生日派对。

examples.english: We [hold] a class meeting every Monday morning.
examples.chinese: 我们每周一早上都会[开]班会。

meanings.explanation: A [harmonious] relationship, group, or place is one where people are friendly and peaceful with each other and do not argue.

examples.english: Our [harmonious] family always eats dinner together every day.
examples.chinese: 我们[和睦的]家庭每天都会一起吃晚饭。

examples.english: The neighbors have a [harmonious] relationship with each other.
examples.chinese: 邻居们之间有着[和谐的]关系。

examples.english: A [harmonious] classroom helps us learn more happily.
examples.chinese: 一个[和谐的]教室能帮助我们更快乐地学习。

meanings.explanation: If different things such as colors, sounds, or flavors are [harmonious], they combine together in a pleasant way that looks or tastes good.

examples.english: The [harmonious] colors of this painting make me feel relaxed.
examples.chinese: 这幅画[协调的]色彩让我感觉很放松。

examples.english: The three girls sang a [harmonious] song at the party.
examples.chinese: 三个女孩在聚会上唱了一首[和谐的]歌。

examples.english: The [harmonious] mix of spices makes this dish really delicious.
examples.chinese: 多种香料[协调的]搭配让这道菜非常美味。

meanings.explanation: If you [halt] or if something [halts], you stop moving or stop what you are doing.

examples.english: The bus [halted] at the red light.
examples.chinese: 公交车在红灯前[停下来]了。

examples.english: Please [halt] when you hear the bell.
examples.chinese: 听到铃声请[停下]。

examples.english: He [halted] his bicycle at the gate.
examples.chinese: 他在门口[停下]了自行车。

meanings.explanation: A [halt] is a temporary or permanent stop in movement or activity.

examples.english: The car came to a sudden [halt].
examples.chinese: 汽车突然[停]了下来。

examples.english: The rain brought a [halt] to our picnic.
examples.chinese: 大雨让我们的野餐[中止]了。

examples.english: There was a short [halt] before the parade began.
examples.chinese: 游行开始前有短暂的[停顿]。

meanings.explanation: [Heliacal] describes something relating to the sun or to a star when it rises or sets at the same time as the sun.

examples.english: The [heliacal] rising of Sirius happens every early summer.
examples.chinese: 天狼星的[偕日]升起发生在每年初夏。

examples.english: Ancient people used [heliacal] risings to tell the time of year.
examples.chinese: 古人利用[偕日]升起来判断一年中的时节。

examples.english: We watched a video about the [heliacal] cycle in science class.
examples.chinese: 我们在科学课上看了一段关于[偕日]周期的视频。

meanings.explanation: If you [hate] someone or something, you dislike them very much.

examples.english: I [hate] broccoli because it tastes bad.
examples.chinese: 我[讨厌]西兰花，因为它吃起来不好吃。

examples.english: She [hates] waking up early in winter.
examples.chinese: 她[讨厌]冬天早起。

examples.english: He [hates] doing homework on weekends.
examples.chinese: 他[讨厌]周末做作业。

meanings.explanation: [Hate] is a very strong feeling of dislike for someone or something.

examples.english: There is too much [hate] in the world today.
examples.chinese: 今天世界上有太多的[仇恨]。

examples.english: He couldn't hide his [hate] for the bully.
examples.chinese: 他无法掩饰对那个恶霸的[恨]。

examples.english: Don't let [hate] take over your heart.
examples.chinese: 别让[恨]占据你的心。

meanings.explanation: Things that are [identical] are exactly the same in appearance, character, or amount.

examples.english: The two dolls look [identical] — I can't tell them apart.
examples.chinese: 这两个娃娃看起来完全[一样]——我都分不清。

examples.english: She bought an [identical] dress like her sister's.
examples.chinese: 她买了一件和她姐姐[一模一样]的裙子。

examples.english: These two pictures are almost [identical].
examples.chinese: 这两张图画几乎[完全相同]。

meanings.explanation: If you [ignore] someone or something, you deliberately do not pay attention to them or take notice of them.

examples.english: She tried to talk to him, but he just [ignored] her.
examples.chinese: 她试着和他说话，但他根本不[理]她。

examples.english: Please do not [ignore] your little sister when she asks for help.
examples.chinese: 妹妹请你帮忙的时候，请不要[不理]她。

examples.english: He [ignored] the message and went out to play.
examples.chinese: 他[没理]那条消息，跑出去玩了。

meanings.explanation: If you [ignore] a problem, fact, or situation, you do not deal with it or think about it, even though you should.

examples.english: You cannot [ignore] the mess in your room any longer.
examples.chinese: 你不能继续对房间里的脏乱[视而不见]了。

examples.english: He [ignored] his cough for weeks before seeing a doctor.
examples.chinese: 他好几周都对咳嗽[不管不顾]，才去看医生。

examples.english: We should not [ignore] the rules of the game.
examples.chinese: 我们不应该[无视]游戏规则。

meanings.explanation: [Illegal] is used to describe something that is not allowed by law or is against the law.

examples.english: It is [illegal] to park here without a permit.
examples.chinese: 没有许可证在这里停车是[违法的]。

examples.english: The police caught him for [illegal] gambling.
examples.chinese: 警察发现他参与[非法]赌博。

examples.english: They ran an [illegal] casino in the basement.
examples.chinese: 他们在地下室经营一家[非法]赌场。

meanings.explanation: [Healthcare] is the services provided by doctors, nurses, and hospitals to keep people healthy and treat them when they are ill.

examples.english: My mom works in [healthcare] and helps sick people every day.
examples.chinese: 我妈妈在[医疗保健]行业工作，每天帮助生病的人。

examples.english: Good [healthcare] helps everyone stay healthy and happy.
examples.chinese: 好的[医疗保健]能帮助每个人保持健康快乐。

examples.english: We go to the clinic for regular [healthcare] check-ups.
examples.chinese: 我们去诊所做定期的[医疗保健]检查。

meanings.explanation: [Healthcare] is also the system or industry that organizes and provides medical treatment and disease prevention.

examples.english: The [healthcare] in our city is very good.
examples.chinese: 我们城市的[医疗系统]非常好。

examples.english: My aunt wants to work in [healthcare] when she grows up.
examples.chinese: 我姑姑长大后想在[医疗行业]工作。

examples.english: The [healthcare] industry offers many different kinds of jobs.
examples.chinese: [医疗]行业提供许多不同类型的工作。

meanings.explanation: [Horror] is a strong feeling of fear, shock, or disgust that you experience when you see or hear something frightening or unpleasant.

examples.english: She watched the spider with [horror].
examples.chinese: 她[惊恐地]看着那只蜘蛛。

examples.english: He screamed in [horror] when he saw the ghost.
examples.chinese: 他看到鬼时[吓得]尖叫起来。

examples.english: I felt a sense of [horror] at the loud noise.
examples.chinese: 那巨大的声响让我感到一阵[恐惧]。

meanings.explanation: A [horror] is something that is very shocking, frightening, or unpleasant.

examples.english: The storm was a [horror] for the small town.
examples.chinese: 那场暴风雨对这个小镇来说是一场[灾难]。

examples.english: That old house is a [horror] at night.
examples.chinese: 那座老房子在晚上很[吓人]。

examples.english: The movie shows the [horror] of war.
examples.chinese: 这部电影展现了战争的[恐怖]。

meanings.explanation: If something is [huge], it is extremely large in size, amount, or degree.

examples.english: Look at that [huge] elephant! It's taller than a bus.
examples.chinese: 快看那头[巨大的]大象！它比公交车还高。

examples.english: They bought a [huge] watermelon from the market.
examples.chinese: 他们从市场买了一个[大个儿的]西瓜。

examples.english: The [huge] tree in our schoolyard is over a hundred years old.
examples.chinese: 校园里那棵[粗壮的]大树已经有一百多岁了。

meanings.explanation: If something is [huge], it is very important, serious, or significant, rather than physically large.

examples.english: Getting an A on the math test was a [huge] deal for him.
examples.chinese: 数学考了A对他来说是一件[了不得的]事。

examples.english: Missing the school bus made a [huge] difference — he was late for class.
examples.chinese: 没赶上校车造成了[很大的]影响——他上课迟到了。

examples.english: Moving to a new city is a [huge] change for our family.
examples.chinese: 搬到一座新城市对我们家来说是[巨大的]转变。

meanings.explanation: A [herbivore] is an animal that only eats plants and does not eat meat.

examples.english: A cow is a [herbivore] that eats grass in the field every day.
examples.chinese: 牛是一种[食草动物]，每天在田里吃青草。

examples.english: Rabbits are [herbivores] and love to eat carrots and fresh leaves.
examples.chinese: 兔子是[食草动物]，它们爱吃胡萝卜和新鲜的叶子。

examples.english: The giant panda is a [herbivore] that mainly eats bamboo.
examples.chinese: 大熊猫是一种[食草动物]，主要吃竹子。

meanings.explanation: An [imitation] is a copy of something, especially one that is not genuine or of good quality.

examples.english: Her bag looks nice, but it's just an [imitation].
examples.chinese: 她的包看起来不错，但只是个[仿制品]。

examples.english: This ring is an [imitation] of a real diamond ring.
examples.chinese: 这枚戒指是真正的钻石戒指的[仿制品]。

examples.english: The shop sells [imitation] flowers that look very real.
examples.chinese: 这家店卖的[假花]看起来非常逼真。

meanings.explanation: An [imitation] is the act of copying someone's behavior, speech, or actions.

examples.english: The little boy did a funny [imitation] of his teacher.
examples.chinese: 小男孩[模仿]了一下他的老师，特别搞笑。

examples.english: Babies learn to talk by [imitation].
examples.chinese: 婴儿通过[模仿]来学说话。

examples.english: Her [imitation] of a cat made everyone laugh.
examples.chinese: 她对猫的[模仿]把大家都逗笑了。

meanings.explanation: If you [hide] something or yourself somewhere, you put them or yourself in a place where they cannot be seen or found by other people.

examples.english: My little sister likes to [hide] her toys under the bed.
examples.chinese: 我妹妹喜欢把她的玩具[藏]在床底下。

examples.english: The cat will [hide] in the closet when it rains.
examples.chinese: 下雨时猫咪会[躲]进壁橱里。

examples.english: I can't [hide] my birthday surprise from mom any longer.
examples.chinese: 我再也没法把我的生日惊喜[藏]着不让妈妈知道了。

meanings.explanation: A [hide] is the skin of a large animal, used especially for making leather.

examples.english: This belt is made from cow [hide].
examples.chinese: 这条腰带是用牛[皮]做的。

examples.english: The hunter tanned the deer [hide] to make clothes.
examples.chinese: 猎人把鹿[皮]鞣制后用来做衣服。

examples.english: Early humans used [hide] to keep warm.
examples.chinese: 早期人类用[兽皮]保暖。

meanings.explanation: A [hostile] person or their behaviour is unfriendly and aggressive towards other people.

examples.english: The [hostile] dog barked loudly at the stranger.
examples.chinese: 这只[凶恶的]狗对着陌生人大声吠叫。

examples.english: He gave me a [hostile] look when I asked him to move.
examples.chinese: 当我请他挪一下时，他给了我一个[充满敌意的]眼神。

examples.english: Some children are [hostile] to kids they don't know.
examples.chinese: 有些孩子会对不认识的小孩[不友好]。

meanings.explanation: [hostile] forces, countries, or territory belong to an enemy in a war or conflict.

examples.english: The soldiers crossed into [hostile] territory.
examples.chinese: 士兵们进入了[敌方的]领地。

examples.english: The general sent spies to gather information about [hostile] forces.
examples.chinese: 将军派间谍收集[敌方的]军队情报。

examples.english: During the war, ships were often attacked by [hostile] submarines.
examples.chinese: 战争期间，船只经常遭到[敌方的]潜艇袭击。

meanings.explanation: An [immigrant] is a person who has come to live permanently in a country that is not their own.

examples.english: My friend is an [immigrant] who moved here from Canada five years ago.
examples.chinese: 我的朋友是一位[移民]，五年前从加拿大搬来这里。

examples.english: Many [immigrants] have made our city a very exciting place to live.
examples.chinese: 许多[移民]让我们的城市变成了一个充满生机的居住地。

examples.english: Her grandmother was an [immigrant] who came from Italy to start a new life.
examples.chinese: 她的祖母是一位[移民]，从意大利来到这里开始新生活。

meanings.explanation: If you can [identify] someone or something, you are able to recognize them and distinguish them from other people or things.

examples.english: I can [identify] every flower in my grandma's garden.
examples.chinese: 我能[认出]奶奶花园里的每一朵花。

examples.english: Can you [identify] which toy is yours on the playground?
examples.chinese: 你能在操场上[认出]哪个玩具是你的吗？

examples.english: My dog can [identify] my voice from far away.
examples.chinese: 我的狗能从很远的地方[辨认出]我的声音。

meanings.explanation: If you [identify] a problem, fact, or cause, you discover it and realize that it exists or is important.

examples.english: We need to [identify] the reason why the plant is dying.
examples.chinese: 我们需要[找出]这株植物枯萎的原因。

examples.english: My mom helped me [identify] the mistake in my math homework.
examples.chinese: 妈妈帮我[找出]了数学作业里的错误。

examples.english: The teacher asked us to [identify] three problems in our classroom.
examples.chinese: 老师让我们[找出]教室里的三个问题。

meanings.explanation: A [hominid] is any member of the family Hominidae, a group of primates that includes humans, great apes (orangutans, chimpanzees, gorillas), and their ancestors.

examples.english: Scientists found a skull of an ancient [hominid] in the cave.
examples.chinese: 科学家在洞穴里发现了一个古老[人族]的头骨。

examples.english: This [hominid] lived in Africa about two million years ago.
examples.chinese: 这种[人族]大约两百万年前生活在非洲。

examples.english: The study of [hominid] fossils helps us understand human evolution.
examples.chinese: [人族]化石的研究帮助我们了解人类进化。

meanings.explanation: If you [imagine] something, you form a picture or idea of it in your mind.

examples.english: Close your eyes and [imagine] you are on a sunny beach.
examples.chinese: 闭上眼睛，[想象]你在阳光明媚的沙滩上。

examples.english: I like to [imagine] what my future home will look like.
examples.chinese: 我喜欢[想象]我未来的家会是什么样子。

examples.english: Can you [imagine] a dragon with rainbow colors?
examples.chinese: 你能[想象]一条彩虹色的龙吗？

meanings.explanation: If you [imagine] something is true, you think or believe it is possible, but you are not certain.

examples.english: I [imagine] she will come to my birthday party tomorrow.
examples.chinese: 我[想]她明天会来参加我的生日派对。

examples.english: He is very tired, so I [imagine] he will sleep early tonight.
examples.chinese: 他很累，所以我[想]他今晚会早睡。

examples.english: Do you [imagine] it will rain this afternoon?
examples.chinese: 你[觉得]今天下午会下雨吗？

meanings.explanation: If something happens [immediately], it happens without delay, right away.

examples.english: Please come here [immediately].
examples.chinese: 请[马上]过来。

examples.english: He [immediately] called his mom when he got home.
examples.chinese: 他到家[立刻]给妈妈打了电话。

examples.english: Call me [immediately] if you get lost.
examples.chinese: 如果迷路了[立即]给我打电话。

meanings.explanation: [Immoderation] is the habit of doing things too much or going too far, without stopping at a reasonable limit.

examples.english: His [immoderation] in eating sweets gave him a bad toothache.
examples.chinese: 他[毫无节制]地吃糖，结果牙疼得厉害。

examples.english: The teacher told us that [immoderation] in playing games is bad for our studies.
examples.chinese: 老师告诉我们，[过度]玩游戏对学习不好。

examples.english: Her [immoderation] in shopping made her run out of pocket money very quickly.
examples.chinese: 她[毫无节制]地买东西，很快就把零花钱花光了。

meanings.explanation: If you describe something as [horrible], you mean that it is very bad or unpleasant.

examples.english: The weather is [horrible] today, so we have to stay inside.
examples.chinese: 今天天气[糟透了]，我们只能待在家里。

examples.english: I have a [horrible] cold and cannot go to school.
examples.chinese: 我感冒[很难受]，不能去上学了。

examples.english: This milk tastes [horrible]; I think it is old.
examples.chinese: 这牛奶[太难喝]了，我觉得它坏了。

meanings.explanation: Something that is [horrible] causes you to feel great shock, fear, or disgust.

examples.english: We saw a [horrible] car accident on the way home.
examples.chinese: 回家的路上我们看到了一起[可怕的]车祸。

examples.english: The news about the earthquake was [horrible].
examples.chinese: 地震的消息[太可怕]了。

examples.english: That [horrible] monster in the movie scared my little brother.
examples.chinese: 电影里那只[可怕的]怪物把我弟弟吓坏了。

meanings.explanation: If you [hunt] animals or birds, you chase and try to kill them for food or sport.

examples.english: My grandpa likes to [hunt] rabbits in the forest.
examples.chinese: 我爷爷喜欢在森林里[猎]兔子。

examples.english: Lions [hunt] other animals for food.
examples.chinese: 狮子[捕猎]其他动物作为食物。

examples.english: We should not [hunt] wild animals just for fun.
examples.chinese: 我们不应该只是为了好玩而[猎杀]野生动物。

meanings.explanation: If you [hunt] for something, you search for it until you find it.

examples.english: I [hunt] for my pencil case every morning before school.
examples.chinese: 我每天早上上学前都[找]我的铅笔盒。

examples.english: Mom [hunts] for her glasses all the time.
examples.chinese: 妈妈总是在[找]她的眼镜。

examples.english: We [hunted] for a nice place to have a picnic.
examples.chinese: 我们[找]了一个好地方野餐。

meanings.explanation: An [impression] is an idea, feeling, or opinion that you have about someone or something, especially one that is formed quickly or without much information.

examples.english: My first [impression] of the new school was that it was very big and beautiful.
examples.chinese: 我对新学校的最初[印象]是它又大又漂亮。

examples.english: She made a good [impression] on the teacher by answering all the questions.
examples.chinese: 她回答了所有问题，给老师留下了好[印象]。

examples.english: I was under the [impression] that we had no homework today.
examples.chinese: 我[以为]今天没有作业。

meanings.explanation: An [impression] is a mark left on a surface by pressing something against it.

examples.english: The cat left deep [impressions] in the soft sand.
examples.chinese: 猫在柔软的沙滩上留下了深深的[脚印]。

examples.english: He pressed his finger into the clay to make an [impression].
examples.chinese: 他把手指按进黏土里，压出一个[印记]。

examples.english: The old book had the [impression] of a leaf between its pages.
examples.chinese: 那本旧书的页面之间有一片叶子的[压痕]。

meanings.explanation: Something that is [impossible] cannot be done or cannot happen.

examples.english: It's [impossible] to eat ten hamburgers in one minute.
examples.chinese: 一分钟吃十个汉堡是[不可能的]。

examples.english: Mom says staying up all night is [impossible] on school days.
examples.chinese: 妈妈说上学日熬夜是[不可能的]。

examples.english: The teacher asked a question that was [impossible] to answer.
examples.chinese: 老师问了一个[不可能]回答的问题。

meanings.explanation: If you [improve] something, you make it better or more satisfactory.

examples.english: I want to [improve] my English by reading more books.
examples.chinese: 我想通过多读书来[提高]我的英语。

examples.english: Exercise can [improve] your health.
examples.chinese: 锻炼可以[改善]你的健康。

examples.english: This new bike helped [improve] my speed.
examples.chinese: 这辆新自行车帮我[提高]了速度。

meanings.explanation: If something [improve]s, it becomes better.

examples.english: My grades have [improve]d a lot this semester.
examples.chinese: 我这学期的成绩[提高]了很多。

examples.english: The weather will [improve] tomorrow.
examples.chinese: 明天天气会[好转]。

examples.english: Her English has [improve]d since she moved here.
examples.chinese: 自从她搬到这里后，她的英语[进步]了很多。

meanings.explanation: If you [imply] something, you suggest it indirectly rather than saying it openly.

examples.english: His calm voice [implied] that everything was under control.
examples.chinese: 他平静的声音[暗示]一切都在掌控之中。

examples.english: Are you [implying] that I should apologize first?
examples.chinese: 你是在[暗示]我应该先道歉吗？

examples.english: The dark clouds [imply] that it might rain soon.
examples.chinese: 乌云[预示]可能很快会下雨。

meanings.explanation: If something [includes] a particular thing or person, that thing or person is part of the larger group, list, or amount.

examples.english: The hotel price [includes] breakfast.
examples.chinese: 酒店价格[包含]早餐。

examples.english: Please [include] me in the game!
examples.chinese: 请让我也[参加]到游戏里吧！

examples.english: The bag [includes] three books and a pencil.
examples.chinese: 这个袋子里[装有]三本书和一支铅笔。

meanings.explanation: If you [include] someone in an activity or group, you make them part of it so that they can join in.

examples.english: Don't forget to [include] Lily in the party.
examples.chinese: 别忘了把莉莉也[算上]，让她来参加派对。

examples.english: Mom always [includes] us when she cooks.
examples.chinese: 妈妈做饭时总会让我们也[参与]进来。

examples.english: We should [include] everyone in the class project.
examples.chinese: 全班的项目应该把每个人[都算进去]。

meanings.explanation: If something is [imprecise], it is not exact, accurate, or fully detailed enough for a particular purpose.

examples.english: Dad's [imprecise] map led us to the wrong park.
examples.chinese: 爸爸那张[不精确]的地图把我们带到了错误的公园。

examples.english: This old watch shows [imprecise] time.
examples.chinese: 这块旧手表显示[不准确]的时间。

examples.english: My [imprecise] drawing doesn't look much like the real cat.
examples.chinese: 我[不精准]的画不太像那只真猫。

meanings.explanation: If someone or something is [inactive], they are not doing anything, not moving, or not working.

examples.english: The [inactive] cat slept on the sofa all afternoon.
examples.chinese: 那只[不动的]猫整个下午都在沙发上睡觉。

examples.english: My [inactive] toy needs new batteries to work.
examples.chinese: 我那个[不运转的]玩具需要换电池才能工作。

examples.english: Being [inactive] for too long is not good for your body.
examples.chinese: 长时间[不活动]对你的身体不好。

meanings.explanation: If you are [inactive], you do not take part in physical activities or sports very often.

examples.english: After school, I used to be [inactive] and just watched TV.
examples.chinese: 以前放学后我总是[不爱活动]，就看电视。

examples.english: The doctor said I am too [inactive] and should play outside more.
examples.chinese: 医生说我太[缺乏运动]了，应该多去户外玩。

examples.english: He was an [inactive] child who rarely joined sports games.
examples.chinese: 他是个[不爱运动]的孩子，很少参加体育比赛。

meanings.explanation: [Immobility] is the state of not moving at all or being unable to move.

examples.english: The hunter kept his body in complete [immobility] to avoid scaring the deer.
examples.chinese: 猎人让身体保持完全[静止]，以免吓跑鹿。

examples.english: The [immobility] of the stone statue made it look almost like a real person.
examples.chinese: 这座石雕像的[静止不动]让它看起来几乎像真人一样。

examples.english: After the operation, the doctor required my dad to keep complete [immobility] for two weeks.
examples.chinese: 手术后，医生要求我爸爸保持两周完全[静止]。

meanings.explanation: [Immobility] is the state of a situation or system that does not change or make progress.

examples.english: The [immobility] of the old rules made the game boring for all kids.
examples.chinese: 旧规则的[一成不变]让所有孩子觉得游戏很无聊。

examples.english: People wanted to change the [immobility] of their small town and build a new park.
examples.chinese: 人们想要改变小镇的[停滞不前]，建一座新公园。

examples.english: The [immobility] of the school’s rules stopped them from adding a new playground.
examples.chinese: 学校规则的[停滞不变]阻止了他们修建一个新操场。

meanings.explanation: If something [increases], it becomes larger in amount, number, or degree.

examples.english: The number of students will [increase] next year.
examples.chinese: 明年学生人数将会[增加]。

examples.english: Eating vegetables can help [increase] your energy.
examples.chinese: 多吃蔬菜可以帮助[提升]你的精力。

examples.english: Please [increase] the volume; I can't hear the music.
examples.chinese: 请把音量[调大]，我听不见音乐。

meanings.explanation: An [increase] is a rise in the amount, number, or degree of something.

examples.english: There has been a big [increase] in the price of eggs.
examples.chinese: 鸡蛋的价格出现了大幅[上涨]。

examples.english: The teacher noted an [increase] in homework quality.
examples.chinese: 老师注意到作业质量有所[提高]。

examples.english: We expect a small [increase] in temperature tomorrow.
examples.chinese: 我们预计明天的气温会有小幅[上升]。

meanings.explanation: If you are [independent], you can do things by yourself and do not need to rely on others for help.

examples.english: My little sister is very [independent] — she dresses herself every morning.
examples.chinese: 我妹妹很[独立]，每天早上都是自己穿衣服。

examples.english: She wants to be [independent] when she grows up, so she can live on her own.
examples.chinese: 她长大后想变得[独立]，这样就能自己一个人生活了。

examples.english: An [independent] child can finish homework without asking parents for help.
examples.chinese: 一个[独立]的孩子可以不用找父母帮忙就能自己完成作业。

meanings.explanation: If two things are [independent], they are not connected with each other and do not affect one another.

examples.english: The two science projects are [independent] — they have nothing to do with each other.
examples.chinese: 这两个科学项目是[互不相关的]，彼此之间没有任何联系。

examples.english: My choices are [independent] of what my friends decide to do.
examples.chinese: 我的选择跟朋友们决定做什么完全[没关系]。

examples.english: These two test questions are [independent], so answering one won't help you with the other.
examples.chinese: 这两道考试题目[互不相关]，所以答对一道对做另一道没有帮助。

meanings.explanation: To [indicate] means to show, point to, or make something clear or known.

examples.english: The smile on her face [indicated] that she was happy.
examples.chinese: 她脸上的微笑[表明]她很开心。

examples.english: This arrow [indicates] where to turn left.
examples.chinese: 这个箭头[指示]左转的方向。

examples.english: The teacher used a map to [indicate] where the museum is.
examples.chinese: 老师用地图[指出]博物馆在哪里。

meanings.explanation: To [indicate] means to give information about something or to be a sign of something.

examples.english: The temperature drop may [indicate] that winter is coming.
examples.chinese: 气温下降可能[预示]冬天要来了。

examples.english: The doctor said his cough [indicated] a cold.
examples.chinese: 医生说他的咳嗽[表明]他感冒了。

examples.english: Can you [indicate] your favorite color on this form?
examples.chinese: 你能在表格上[标明]你最喜欢的颜色吗？

meanings.explanation: If a place is [inaccessible], it is very difficult or impossible to reach or enter.

examples.english: The old house on the hill is [inaccessible] by car, so we had to walk.
examples.chinese: 山上那栋老房子开车[到不了]，所以我们只能步行。

examples.english: The mountain path becomes [inaccessible] after heavy rain.
examples.chinese: 大雨过后，山路变得[无法通行]。

examples.english: The cave is [inaccessible] without special climbing tools.
examples.chinese: 没有专门的攀爬工具，这个洞穴是[进不去]的。

meanings.explanation: If something such as a book, idea, or service is [inaccessible], it is difficult or impossible to understand or use.

examples.english: This science book is [inaccessible] to young children because of the hard words.
examples.chinese: 这本科学书因为生词太多，对小孩子来说[太难懂]了。

examples.english: The website is [inaccessible] to people who cannot see well.
examples.chinese: 这个网站对视力不好的人来说是[无法使用]的。

examples.english: The lawyer used so many difficult terms that his speech was [inaccessible] to us.
examples.chinese: 那位律师用了太多难懂的术语，他的讲话我们根本[听不懂]。

meanings.explanation: [Incontinence] is the inability to control the bladder or bowels, resulting in accidental leaking of urine or feces.

examples.english: The old man has [incontinence] and needs to wear special underwear.
examples.chinese: 那位老人有[失禁]问题，需要穿特制的内衣。

examples.english: Some doctors can help patients with [incontinence] problems.
examples.chinese: 有些医生可以帮助有[失禁]问题的病人。

examples.english: She was embarrassed about her [incontinence] issue.
examples.chinese: 她对自己的[尿失禁]问题感到尴尬。

common_collocations: it is important to do something

meanings.explanation: If you say that something is [important], you mean that it has great significance or value and matters a lot.

examples.english: Reading is [important] for learning new things.
examples.chinese: 阅读对学习新知识很[重要]。

examples.english: It is [important] to listen to your teacher.
examples.chinese: 听老师的话很[重要]。

examples.english: Getting enough sleep is [important] for your health.
examples.chinese: 充足的睡眠对你的健康很[重要]。

meanings.explanation: An [important] person has power, influence, or a high status that makes them matter more than others.

examples.english: The principal is a very [important] person at our school.
examples.chinese: 校长是我们学校一位非常[重要]的人物。

examples.english: Some [important] guests will visit our school today.
examples.chinese: 今天有一些[重要]的客人来参观我们学校。

examples.english: He is an [important] leader in our community.
examples.chinese: 他是我们社区的一位[重要]领袖。
