examples.chinese: 她试着[想象]自己未来当上医生的样子。

examples.english: I cannot [picture] my grandma as a young girl.
examples.chinese: 我无法[想象]奶奶年轻时的模样。

meanings.explanation: If two [parallel] lines, roads, or surfaces are [parallel], they stay the same distance apart from each other along their whole length.

examples.english: The two [parallel] lines on my math notebook never meet.
examples.chinese: 我的数学笔记本上这两条[平行的]线永远不会相交。

examples.english: Railway tracks are always [parallel] to each other.
examples.chinese: 铁轨始终是互相[平行的]。

examples.english: Please draw a [parallel] line under the first one.
examples.chinese: 请在第一条线下面画一条[平行的]线。

meanings.explanation: A [parallel] process, event, or situation happens at the same time as another one and is similar to it in many ways.

examples.english: There are [parallel] swimming lessons for kids of different ages.
examples.chinese: 这里为不同年龄的孩子开设了[平行的]游泳课。

examples.english: My mom has a [parallel] work schedule to my dad's.
examples.chinese: 我妈妈和爸爸的工作安排是[平行的]。

examples.english: The park has [parallel] birthday party areas for different groups.
examples.chinese: 公园为不同团体准备了[平行的]生日派对场地。

meanings.explanation: A [physician] is a person who is trained and qualified to treat people who are sick or injured, especially one who is not a surgeon.

examples.english: My mom took me to see a [physician] when I had a fever.
examples.chinese: 我发烧时妈妈带我去看了[医生]。

examples.english: The [physician] checked my heart and said I was healthy.
examples.chinese: [医生]检查了我的心脏，说我很健康。

examples.english: Our family [physician] has helped us stay healthy for many years.
examples.chinese: 我们家的家庭[医生]多年来一直帮助我们保持健康。

meanings.explanation: [Plain] means easy to see or understand; clear and simple. It describes something that is not complicated or decorated.

examples.english: The instructions on the box are written in [plain] English.
examples.chinese: 盒子上的说明是用[简单明白的]英语写的。

examples.english: Just tell me the [plain] truth, I can handle it.
examples.chinese: 就告诉我[直白的]真相吧，我能承受。

examples.english: Her dress was [plain] but very pretty.
examples.chinese: 她的裙子很[朴素]，但是非常漂亮。

meanings.explanation: A [plain] is a large, flat area of land with no hills or mountains.

examples.english: We drove across the big [plain] for hours.
examples.chinese: 我们开车穿越那片大[平原]，开了好几个小时。

examples.english: Horses ran freely across the [plain].
examples.chinese: 马在[平原]上自由奔跑。

examples.english: The village sits on a quiet [plain].
examples.chinese: 村庄坐落在一片宁静的[平原]上。

meanings.explanation: If you [persuade] someone to do something, you get them to do it by talking to them and making them think it is a good idea.

examples.english: I tried to [persuade] my mom to buy me a new toy car.
examples.chinese: 我努力[说服]我妈妈给我买一辆新玩具车。

examples.english: Can you [persuade] your dad to let us play outside?
examples.chinese: 你能[说服]你爸爸让我们出去玩吗？

examples.english: She [persuaded] me to go swimming with her this weekend.
examples.chinese: 她[说服]我这周末和她一起去游泳。

meanings.explanation: If you [persuade] someone that something is true, you make them believe it is true.

examples.english: She [persuaded] me that she was telling the truth.
examples.chinese: 她让我[相信]她说的是真话。

examples.english: He [persuaded] us that his plan would work well.
examples.chinese: 他让我们[相信]他的计划会顺利进行。

examples.english: Can you [persuade] them that we are not lying?
examples.chinese: 你能让他们[相信]我们没有撒谎吗？

meanings.explanation: A [phenomenon] is a fact or event that can be observed and studied, especially something unusual or remarkable.

examples.english: Lightning is a natural [phenomenon].
examples.chinese: 闪电是一种自然[现象]。

examples.english: Scientists are studying the [phenomenon] of global warming.
examples.chinese: 科学家们正在研究全球变暖这一[现象]。

examples.english: This strange [phenomenon] has puzzled experts for years.
examples.chinese: 这种奇怪的[现象]让专家们困惑了多年。

meanings.explanation: A [phenomenon] is an exceptional or extraordinary person, thing, or event.

examples.english: She is a musical [phenomenon] at only ten years old.
examples.chinese: 她年仅十岁就是一位音乐[奇才]。

examples.english: The new phone was a [phenomenon] in the tech world.
examples.chinese: 这款新手机在科技界是个[奇迹]。

examples.english: He is considered a [phenomenon] in the world of chess.
examples.chinese: 他被认为是国际象棋界的[天才]。

meanings.explanation: A [payment] is the act of paying money for something or the amount of money that you pay for goods or services.

examples.english: Mom uses her phone to make a [payment] when we go shopping.
examples.chinese: 我们去购物时，妈妈用手机进行[付款]。

examples.english: You have to finish the [payment] before you can take the book home.
examples.chinese: 你必须先完成[付款]才能把这本书带回家。

examples.english: The monthly [payment] for our car loan is 3000 yuan.
examples.chinese: 我们车贷每个月的[付款]是3000元。

meanings.explanation: A [payment] is an amount of money or something given to someone in return for their work, or as compensation for harm or as a consequence of their actions.

examples.english: The young writer got a large [payment] for his first story.
examples.chinese: 这位年轻作家因为他的第一篇故事得到了一笔丰厚的[报酬]。

examples.english: He got a [payment] from the shop after he was hurt there.
examples.chinese: 他在商店受伤后，得到了商店的一笔[赔偿]。

examples.english: This failing grade is a [payment] for not studying for the test.
examples.chinese: 这个不及格的分数是不复习考试的[报应]。

meanings.explanation: If something is [personal], it belongs or relates to a particular person rather than to other people, and is not meant to be shared or used by everyone.

examples.english: Please keep your [personal] things in your backpack.
examples.chinese: 请把你的[个人]物品放在书包里。

examples.english: This is my [personal] laptop, so I don't let others use it.
examples.chinese: 这是我的[个人]笔记本电脑，所以我不让别人用。

examples.english: Never tell anyone your [personal] password.
examples.chinese: 千万不要告诉任何人你的[个人]密码。

meanings.explanation: [Personal] matters are about your private life, feelings, opinions, or relationships, rather than about work, school, or other public things.

examples.english: I don't want to talk about my [personal] problems at school.
examples.chinese: 我不想在学校谈论我的[私人]问题。

examples.english: She wrote a [personal] letter to her best friend.
examples.chinese: 她给最好的朋友写了一封[私人]信件。

examples.english: It's not polite to ask [personal] questions.
examples.chinese: 问[隐私]问题是不礼貌的。

meanings.explanation: [Pollution] is the presence of harmful substances or waste in the air, water, or land that makes the environment dirty and unsafe.

examples.english: The factory creates [pollution] that makes the river dirty.
examples.chinese: 这家工厂产生的[污染]让河水变脏了。

examples.english: We need to stop [pollution] to protect our planet.
examples.chinese: 我们需要阻止[污染]来保护我们的地球。

examples.english: Cars cause [pollution] in big cities.
examples.chinese: 汽车在大城市造成[污染]。

meanings.explanation: If you are [positive], you are hopeful and confident, and you think about what is good in a situation rather than what is bad.

examples.english: She always has a [positive] attitude towards learning.
examples.chinese: 她对学习总是抱有[积极的]态度。

examples.english: Try to stay [positive] even when things are hard.
examples.chinese: 即使遇到困难，也要尽量保持[积极乐观]。

examples.english: His [positive] spirit cheered everyone up.
examples.chinese: 他那[积极乐观的]精神让大家都高兴了起来。

meanings.explanation: A [positive] thing is good, helpful, or useful.

examples.english: Eating vegetables has a [positive] effect on your body.
examples.chinese: 吃蔬菜对你的身体有[好的]影响。

examples.english: My teacher gave me some [positive] feedback on my essay.
examples.chinese: 老师给我的作文提了一些[正面的]反馈。

examples.english: We should look at the [positive] side of this change.
examples.chinese: 我们应该看看这次变化[积极的]一面。

meanings.explanation: If you [pause] while you are doing something, you stop doing it for a short time before starting again.

examples.english: Please [pause] your game and come eat dinner.
examples.chinese: 请[暂停]一下游戏，过来吃晚饭吧。

examples.english: She [paused] to catch her breath after running.
examples.chinese: 她跑完后[停]下来喘了口气。

examples.english: The teacher told us to [pause] and think before answering.
examples.chinese: 老师让我们先[停]一下，想想再回答。

meanings.explanation: A [pause] is a short period of time when you stop doing something before continuing.

examples.english: There was a long [pause] before he answered the question.
examples.chinese: 他回答问题前[停顿]了很久。

examples.english: After a short [pause], the teacher continued the lesson.
examples.chinese: 短暂[停顿]后，老师继续上课。

examples.english: Let's take a [pause] and have a snack.
examples.chinese: 我们[暂停]一下，吃点零食吧。

meanings.explanation: If you [postpone] something, you decide to do it at a later time or date than you had originally planned.

examples.english: We had to [postpone] the picnic because of rain.
examples.chinese: 因为下雨，我们不得不[推迟]了野餐。

examples.english: The teacher decided to [postpone] the test until Friday.
examples.chinese: 老师决定把考试[推迟]到周五。

examples.english: Let's [postpone] our visit until next month.
examples.chinese: 我们把拜访[推迟]到下个月吧。

meanings.explanation: A [preceding] thing, place, or time is the one that comes immediately before the one you are talking about.

examples.english: Please read the [preceding] page before you start this one.
examples.chinese: 在开始阅读这一页之前，请先读[前面的]那一页。

examples.english: The [preceding] day was rainy, but today it is sunny.
examples.chinese: [前]一天下着雨，但今天阳光灿烂。

examples.english: Look at the [preceding] example to understand this math problem.
examples.chinese: 看看[前面的]例子来理解这道数学题。

meanings.explanation: Something that is [precise] is exact, accurate, and correct in every detail, with no mistakes or guesses.

examples.english: Please tell me the [precise] time of your arrival.
examples.chinese: 请告诉我你到达的[准确]时间。

examples.english: The scientist wrote down the [precise] temperature every hour.
examples.chinese: 科学家每小时都记录下[精确]的温度。

examples.english: We need [precise] measurements to build this bookshelf.
examples.chinese: 我们需要[精确]的尺寸来做这个书架。

meanings.explanation: Someone who is [precise] is very careful about small details and likes everything to be correct and tidy.

examples.english: My math teacher is very [precise] and never makes a mistake.
examples.chinese: 我的数学老师非常[严谨]，从来不犯错。

examples.english: She is [precise] about keeping her room clean every day.
examples.chinese: 她对每天保持房间整洁非常[一丝不苟]。

examples.english: A good cook must be [precise] with the amount of salt.
examples.chinese: 一个好厨师放盐的量必须[非常讲究]。

meanings.explanation: A [powder] is a fine, dry substance made up of many tiny particles, such as talcum powder, flour, or soap powder.

examples.english: She put some face [powder] on before going to the party.
examples.chinese: 她参加派对前在脸上扑了点[粉]。

examples.english: My mom uses washing [powder] to clean our clothes.
examples.chinese: 我妈妈用洗衣[粉]来洗衣服。

examples.english: The snow on the mountain was like soft white [powder].
examples.chinese: 山上的雪像柔软的白色[粉末]。

meanings.explanation: If you [powder] something, you put powder on it, usually your skin or face.

examples.english: She [powdered] her face lightly after washing it.
examples.chinese: 她洗完脸后轻轻地在脸上[扑了粉]。

examples.english: My mom [powdered] the baby after his bath.
examples.chinese: 我妈妈给宝宝洗完澡后给他[扑了爽身粉]。

examples.english: He [powdered] his nose in the bathroom before the meeting.
examples.chinese: 他开会前去洗手间在鼻子上[扑了粉]。

meanings.explanation: If you are [predisposed] to something, you have a natural tendency or an increased likelihood of developing it, often because of your genes, family history, or personal nature.

examples.english: Some people are [predisposed] to getting sick more easily than others.
examples.chinese: 有些人比其他人更容易[天生容易]生病。

examples.english: My mom says I'm [predisposed] to being tall like my dad.
examples.chinese: 我妈妈说我[天生倾向于]像我爸爸一样长得高。

examples.english: Kids who grow up reading a lot may be [predisposed] to loving books.
examples.chinese: 从小大量阅读的孩子可能[天生就]爱书。

meanings.explanation: If someone is [predisposed] to think or act in a certain way, they already have an attitude or habit that makes them lean in that direction before they even think about it.

examples.english: She is [predisposed] to being kind to everyone she meets.
examples.chinese: 她对遇到的每个人都[天生就]很友善。

examples.english: He seems [predisposed] to worry about small things.
examples.chinese: 他好像[天生就爱]为小事操心。

examples.english: My brother is [predisposed] to try new foods without fear.
examples.chinese: 我弟弟[天生就敢]尝试新食物，一点也不怕。

meanings.explanation: A [pilot] is a person who flies an aircraft such as a plane or helicopter.

examples.english: My dream is to become a [pilot] and fly planes around the world.
examples.chinese: 我的梦想是成为一名[飞行员]，开着飞机环游世界。

examples.english: The [pilot] safely landed the plane in the heavy storm.
examples.chinese: [飞行员]在暴风雨中让飞机安全降落了。

examples.english: Uncle John has been an airline [pilot] for twenty years.
examples.chinese: 约翰叔叔做航空公司[飞行员]已经二十年了。

meanings.explanation: To [pilot] a vehicle, aircraft, or new program means to guide it, fly it, or test it before general use.

examples.english: He [pilots] a small plane to visit his parents every month.
examples.chinese: 他每个月[驾驶]一架小飞机去看望父母。

examples.english: The school will [pilot] a new art program next semester.
examples.chinese: 学校下学期会[试点]一门新的艺术课程。

examples.english: The captain [piloted] the ship through the narrow channel.
examples.chinese: 船长[引领]轮船穿过了狭窄的航道。

meanings.explanation: A [position] is the particular place where someone or something is located in relation to other things.

examples.english: Please sit in this [position] so everyone can see you.
examples.chinese: 请坐在这个[位置]上，这样大家都能看到你。

examples.english: The [position] of the clock on the wall is just right.
examples.chinese: 墙上时钟的[位置]刚刚好。

examples.english: She moved her chair to a better [position] to watch TV.
examples.chinese: 她把椅子移到更好的[位置]看电视。

meanings.explanation: A [position] is a job or role that someone has in a company or organization.

examples.english: My dad got a new [position] at his company.
examples.chinese: 我爸爸在公司得到了一个新[职位]。

examples.english: She is leaving her [position] next month.
examples.chinese: 她下个月就要离开她的[职位]了。

examples.english: The school advertised a teaching [position] online.
examples.chinese: 学校在网上发布了一个教学[职位]的招聘信息。

meanings.explanation: [Potential] is the capacity or ability that someone or something has to develop or achieve something in the future.

examples.english: The little boy shows great [potential] in painting.
examples.chinese: 这个小男孩在绘画方面展现出很大的[潜力]。

examples.english: You need to practice more to realize your full [potential].
examples.chinese: 你需要多练习来充分发挥你的[潜力]。

examples.english: This new game has a lot of [potential] to become popular.
examples.chinese: 这款新游戏很有[潜力]成为热门。

meanings.explanation: [Potential] describes something that may happen or become real in the future, but is not yet developed or certain.

examples.english: We should watch out for [potential] safety problems when playing.
examples.chinese: 我们玩耍时要留意[潜在的]安全问题。

examples.english: Reading every day has many [potential] benefits for you.
examples.chinese: 每天阅读对你有很多[潜在的]好处。

examples.english: The teacher is talking to [potential] new members of the art club.
examples.chinese: 老师正在和美术俱乐部的[潜在]新成员交谈。

meanings.explanation: [Precision] is the quality of being very exact and accurate.

examples.english: The scientist measured the liquid with great [precision].
examples.chinese: 科学家非常[精确地]测量了液体。

examples.english: A watchmaker needs [precision] to fix small parts.
examples.chinese: 钟表匠修理小零件需要[精确]。

examples.english: She cut the paper with [precision] to make a perfect square.
examples.chinese: 她[精确地]剪纸，做出了一个完美的正方形。

meanings.explanation: [Precisely] means exactly, in an exact way, or with complete accuracy.

examples.english: The train leaves at 6:00 [precisely].
examples.chinese: 火车[正好]6点发车。

examples.english: She [precisely] cut the paper into equal squares.
examples.chinese: 她[精确地]把纸切成大小相等的方块。

examples.english: That is [precisely] what I was looking for.
examples.chinese: 那[正是]我在找的东西。

meanings.explanation: You use [precisely] to emphasize that something is exactly or only that thing, often for emphasis or to introduce a more exact explanation.

examples.english: I forgot [precisely] where I put my keys.
examples.chinese: 我[正好]忘了把钥匙放哪儿了。

examples.english: [Precisely] because of the rain, we stayed inside.
examples.chinese: [正是]因为下雨，我们待在了室内。

examples.english: More [precisely], I need to finish my homework first.
examples.chinese: [更准确地说]，我需要先完成作业。

meanings.explanation: A [pregnancy] is the condition of a woman or female animal having a baby or babies developing inside her body.

examples.english: My aunt is careful with her diet during [pregnancy].
examples.chinese: 我阿姨在[怀孕期间]对饮食很小心。

examples.english: The cat's [pregnancy] will last about two months.
examples.chinese: 这只猫的[怀孕期]大约会持续两个月。

examples.english: She bought a book about [pregnancy] to learn more.
examples.chinese: 她买了一本关于[怀孕]的书来学习更多知识。

meanings.explanation: If something [predominates] in a situation, it is the most important or largest element, or the strongest influence.

examples.english: In our class, girls [predominate] — we have many more girls than boys.
examples.chinese: 我们班上[女生居多]，女生比男生多很多。

examples.english: Red colors [predominate] in this painting — you can see red everywhere.
examples.chinese: 这幅画以[红色为主]，到处都能看到红色。

examples.english: At the party, pizza and soda [predominate] on the food table.
examples.chinese: 派对上，披萨和可乐[占大多数]，在食物桌上最多。

meanings.explanation: A [precious] object or material is very valuable because it is rare, beautiful, and usually expensive.

examples.english: My mom keeps her [precious] necklace in a safe box.
examples.chinese: 我妈妈把她[珍贵的]项链放在保险箱里。

examples.english: Gold and silver are [precious] metals.
examples.chinese: 黄金和白银都是[珍贵的]金属。

examples.english: This store sells [precious] stones like diamonds.
examples.chinese: 这家店售卖钻石这类[珍贵的]宝石。

meanings.explanation: If something is [precious] to you, it means you love it very much and think it is extremely important.

examples.english: These photos are very [precious] to me because they have my grandma in them.
examples.chinese: 这些照片对我来说非常[珍贵]，因为里面有我奶奶。

examples.english: Time with your family is the most [precious] gift.
examples.chinese: 和家人在一起的时光是最[珍贵]的礼物。

examples.english: My childhood memories are very [precious] to me.
examples.chinese: 我的童年回忆对我来说非常[珍贵]。

meanings.explanation: If you [pretend] that something is the case or that you have a particular feeling, you behave as if it is true or as if you have that feeling, even though it is not true or you do not really have that feeling.

examples.english: The little boy likes to [pretend] he is a superhero.
examples.chinese: 小男孩喜欢[假装]自己是超级英雄。

examples.english: She didn't really like the gift, but she [pretended] to be happy.
examples.chinese: 她其实不太喜欢那个礼物，但她[假装]很开心。

examples.english: Let's [pretend] we are on a beach right now!
examples.chinese: 我们[假装]现在就在沙滩上吧！

meanings.explanation: If children [pretend], they imagine that a situation or game is real, often as part of playing.

examples.english: The kids love to [pretend] they are doctors and nurses.
examples.chinese: 孩子们喜欢[扮演]医生和护士。

examples.english: My sister and I used to [pretend] the sofa was a ship.
examples.chinese: 我和妹妹过去常把沙发[当作]船来玩。

examples.english: Don't be scared—it's just a game, we're only [pretending].
examples.chinese: 别害怕——这只是游戏，我们只是在[角色扮演]。

meanings.explanation: [Pressure] is the force that you produce when you press something.

examples.english: Use both hands to apply [pressure] to the wound.
examples.chinese: 要用双手[压住]伤口。

examples.english: The [pressure] of the water filled the balloon.
examples.chinese: 水的[压力]把气球填满了。

examples.english: Check the tire [pressure] before a long trip.
examples.chinese: 长途旅行前要检查一下轮胎[气压]。

meanings.explanation: If you feel [pressure], you feel worried or stressed because of problems or work.

examples.english: I feel [pressure] when I have too much homework.
examples.chinese: 作业太多的时候我会感到[压力]。

examples.english: My mom is under a lot of [pressure] at work.
examples.chinese: 我妈妈工作[压力很大]。

examples.english: Don't put [pressure] on me to finish quickly!
examples.chinese: 别[催]我快点做完！

meanings.explanation: A [predator] is an animal that kills and eats other animals for food.

examples.english: A lion is a fierce [predator] that hunts zebras on the grassland.
examples.chinese: 狮子是草原上捕猎斑马的凶猛[捕食者]。

examples.english: An owl is a nighttime [predator] that catches small mice for food.
examples.chinese: 猫头鹰是夜间[捕食者]，以捕捉小老鼠为食。

examples.english: Great white sharks are the largest [predator]s in the ocean.
examples.chinese: 大白鲨是海洋中体型最大的[捕食者]。

meanings.explanation: A [predator] is a person who deliberately harms or exploits weaker or more vulnerable people, often for personal gain.

examples.english: Parents warn children to stay away from strange [predator]s online.
examples.chinese: 父母提醒孩子要远离网络上陌生的[掠夺者]。

examples.english: The [predator] tricked an old woman into giving him all her money.
examples.chinese: 那个[掠夺者]骗走了一位老奶奶的所有钱。

examples.english: Police finally caught the [predator] who hurt young kids.
examples.chinese: 警察终于抓住了那个伤害小孩子的[掠夺者]。

meanings.explanation: If something is [possible], it can be done or achieved.

examples.english: Is it [possible] to finish your homework before dinner?
examples.chinese: 晚饭前做完作业[可能]吗？

examples.english: I think it's [possible] for you to learn how to ride a bike.
examples.chinese: 我觉得你学会骑自行车是[可能]的。

examples.english: With hard work, anything is [possible].
examples.chinese: 只要努力，什么都是[可能]的。

meanings.explanation: If you say that a situation or event is [possible], it might happen or be true, although it is not certain.

examples.english: It's [possible] that it will rain this afternoon.
examples.chinese: 今天下午[可能]会下雨。

examples.english: She found a [possible] answer to the riddle.
examples.chinese: 她找到了谜语的一个[可能]的答案。

examples.english: It's [possible] that she is still at school.
examples.chinese: 她[可能]还在学校。

meanings.explanation: If you [prevent] something from happening, you stop it from occurring.

examples.english: The seatbelt helps [prevent] injuries in car accidents.
examples.chinese: 安全带有助于[预防]车祸中的受伤。

examples.english: We need to [prevent] the disease from spreading.
examples.chinese: 我们需要[防止]这种疾病传播。

examples.english: Washing hands can [prevent] germs from spreading.
examples.chinese: 洗手可以[阻止]细菌传播。

meanings.explanation: A [present] is something that you give to someone as a gift, especially on a special occasion like a birthday or holiday.

examples.english: I bought a beautiful [present] for my mom's birthday.
examples.chinese: 我为妈妈的生日买了一精美的[礼物]。

examples.english: The children opened their [presents] under the Christmas tree.
examples.chinese: 孩子们在圣诞树下拆开了他们的[礼物]。

examples.english: Thank you for the lovely [present]!
examples.chinese: 谢谢你这份可爱的[礼物]！

meanings.explanation: If you [present] something to someone, you give it to them or show it to them in a formal way.

examples.english: The teacher [presented] the award to the winner.
examples.chinese: 老师[颁发]奖项给获胜者。

examples.english: He [presented] his ideas at the meeting.
examples.chinese: 他在会议上[展示]了自己的想法。

examples.english: Let me [present] my friend to you.
examples.chinese: 让我[介绍]我的朋友给你。

meanings.explanation: If someone or something is [present], they are in a particular place at a particular time.

examples.english: Everyone was [present] at the party.
examples.chinese: 每个人都[出席]了派对。

examples.english: The food is [present] on the table.
examples.chinese: 食物[在]桌子上[放着]。

examples.english: I live in the [present] moment.
examples.chinese: 我活在[当下]。

meanings.explanation: A [pregnant] woman or female animal has a baby or young animal developing inside its body.

examples.english: My cousin is a [pregnant] young woman.
examples.chinese: 我的表姐是一位[怀孕的]年轻女士。

examples.english: The [pregnant] rabbit eats more vegetables than before.
examples.chinese: 这只[怀孕的]兔子比以前吃更多蔬菜。

examples.english: That [pregnant] lady takes a walk every morning.
examples.chinese: 那位[怀孕的]女士每天早上都会散步。

meanings.explanation: A [pregnant] silence, pause, or expression is full of unexpressed meaning or strong feeling.

examples.english: After she finished speaking, there was a [pregnant] silence.
examples.chinese: 她说完话后，是一阵[意味深长的]沉默。

examples.english: He gave me a [pregnant] smile before leaving.
examples.chinese: 离开前，他给了我一个[意味深长的]微笑。

examples.english: There was a [pregnant] pause in our conversation.
examples.chinese: 我们的对话中出现了一段[意味深长的]停顿。

meanings.explanation: If something is done [primitively], it is done in a simple or basic way, without modern equipment or technology.

examples.english: The early settlers lived [primitively] in small wooden houses.
examples.chinese: 早期移民在简陋的小木屋里[简单地]生活着。

examples.english: They cooked [primitively] over an open fire.
examples.chinese: 他们在篝火上[原始地]做饭。

examples.english: The cabin was furnished [primitively] with just a bed and a table.
examples.chinese: 小木屋里[简陋地]只放了一张床和一张桌子。

meanings.explanation: A [previous] event or thing is one that happened or existed before the one that you are talking about.

examples.english: I met him at the [previous] school I went to.
examples.chinese: 我在[以前]上的那所学校里见过他。

examples.english: Please turn to the [previous] page in your book.
examples.chinese: 请翻到书的[前一]页。

examples.english: She was much happier in her [previous] home.
examples.chinese: 她在[以前的]家里开心多了。

meanings.explanation: Something that is [primary] is the most important or the main one among several things.

examples.english: My [primary] reason for learning English is to make more friends.
examples.chinese: 我学英语的[主要原因]是想交更多朋友。

examples.english: The [primary] goal of this game is to have fun.
examples.chinese: 这个游戏的[主要目的]就是开心。

examples.english: Helping others is my [primary] concern today.
examples.chinese: 帮助别人是我今天[最关心的事]。

meanings.explanation: [Primary] is also used to describe things that are the earliest or first in order, especially relating to the education of young children.

examples.english: My little sister goes to [primary] school every morning.
examples.chinese: 我妹妹每天早上都去[小]学。

examples.english: She started learning the piano in [primary] school.
examples.chinese: 她从[小]学开始学钢琴。

examples.english: The [primary] students were playing happily in the playground.
examples.chinese: [小]学生们在操场上开心地玩耍。

meanings.explanation: A [private] place or thing belongs to or is only for one particular person or group, not for everyone.

examples.english: I have my own [private] bedroom at home.
examples.chinese: 在家里我有自己[私人的]卧室。

examples.english: She goes to a [private] school near our neighborhood.
examples.chinese: 她上的是我们家附近的一所[私立]学校。

examples.english: This is a [private] parking space, so you cannot park here.
examples.chinese: 这是[私人]停车位，你不能停在这里。

meanings.explanation: If something is [private], it is kept secret and not shared with or shown to other people.

examples.english: Can I talk to you in [private] for a minute?
examples.chinese: 我能跟你[私下]说几句话吗？

examples.english: Please don't read my diary — it is [private].
examples.chinese: 请不要看我的日记——那是我的[隐私]。

examples.english: She kept her birthday party [private] and only invited close friends.
examples.chinese: 她的生日派对是[私密]的，只邀请了很熟的朋友。

meanings.explanation: A [primate] is any animal that belongs to the group of mammals that includes apes, monkeys, lemurs, and humans. They have large brains and are usually very clever.

examples.english: The monkey at the zoo is a [primate] that loves to swing from trees.
examples.chinese: 动物园里的猴子是一种喜欢在树上荡来荡去的[灵长类动物]。

examples.english: Humans and apes are both [primate]s because we have similar bodies.
examples.chinese: 人类和类人猿都是[灵长类动物]，因为我们的身体很相似。

examples.english: My favorite [primate] is the little lemur with big eyes.
examples.chinese: 我最喜欢的[灵长类动物]是眼睛大大的小狐猴。

meanings.explanation: If you [praise] someone or something, you express approval, admiration, or respect for them, usually by saying good things about them.

examples.english: We should [praise] others when they do good things.
examples.chinese: 别人做好事时，我们应该[表扬]他们。

examples.english: My dad likes to [praise] me when I finish my homework.
examples.chinese: 我完成作业时，爸爸喜欢[表扬]我。

examples.english: The teacher will [praise] you for sharing with friends.
examples.chinese: 老师会[表扬]你和朋友分享。

meanings.explanation: [Praise] is the expression of approval, admiration, or respect for someone or something, usually through spoken or written words.

examples.english: The singer received lots of [praise] from the audience.
examples.chinese: 这位歌手得到了观众的热烈[赞扬]。

examples.english: Your hard work deserves high [praise].
examples.chinese: 你的辛勤付出值得高度[赞扬]。

examples.english: The brave boy won [praise] from everyone.
examples.chinese: 那个勇敢的男孩赢得了大家的[称赞]。

meanings.explanation: If you [presume] that something is true, you think that it is true even though you do not have definite proof.

examples.english: I [presume] you're coming to our picnic this Saturday.
examples.chinese: 我[料想]你这周六会来我们的野餐。

examples.english: We [presume] that our teacher will give us homework today.
examples.chinese: 我们[推测]老师今天会给我们布置作业。

examples.english: She [presumes] her dog will wait for her at the door.
examples.chinese: 她[认为]她的狗会在门口等她。

meanings.explanation: If you [presume] to do something, you do it even though you do not have the right or permission to do it.

examples.english: The boy [presumed] to enter the teacher's office without knocking.
examples.chinese: 这个男孩[胆敢]不敲门就进老师办公室。

examples.english: I [presume] to give you some advice, even though I'm not an expert.
examples.chinese: 我[胆敢]给你提一些建议，尽管我不是专家。

examples.english: She never [presumes] to ask personal questions to strangers.
examples.chinese: 她从不[胆敢]向陌生人问私人问题。

meanings.explanation: If you [profess] a feeling, belief, or intention, you say that you have it, especially when other people doubt whether you really do.

examples.english: He [professed] his love for her in front of everyone.
examples.chinese: 他在大家面前[表白]了对她的爱。

examples.english: She [professed] to know nothing about the broken window.
examples.chinese: 她[声称]对窗户破了的事一无所知。

examples.english: They [professed] that they would never fight again.
examples.chinese: 他们[信誓旦旦地说]再也不吵架了。

meanings.explanation: If you [profess] a belief, religion, or skill, you openly state that you hold it or have it.

examples.english: My friend [professes] to be good at cooking, but his food tastes terrible.
examples.chinese: 我朋友[自称]很会做饭，但他做的菜太难吃了。

examples.english: He [professed] himself a fan of that singer.
examples.chinese: 他[自称]是那个歌手的粉丝。

examples.english: She [professes] to love reading more than anything else.
examples.chinese: 她[声称]自己最爱做的事就是读书。

meanings.explanation: If you [prefer] someone or something, you like them more than another person or thing, so you would choose them if you had a choice.

examples.english: I [prefer] dogs to cats because dogs are more fun.
examples.chinese: 比起猫，我更[喜欢]狗，因为狗更有趣。

examples.english: She [prefers] to walk to school every day.
examples.chinese: 她更[喜欢]每天走路去上学。

examples.english: We [prefer] this park for our afternoon picnic.
examples.chinese: 我们更[喜欢]在这个公园进行下午的野餐。

meanings.explanation: [Previously] means at a time before the present time or before the particular time that you are talking about.

examples.english: I [previously] lived in a small town with my grandparents.
examples.chinese: 我[之前]和爷爷奶奶一起住在一个小镇上。

examples.english: This book was [previously] kept on the top shelf.
examples.chinese: 这本书[之前]一直放在最上面的架子上。

examples.english: She [previously] danced in a show, but now she sings.
examples.chinese: 她[之前]在演出里跳舞，现在改唱歌了。

meanings.explanation: If something is [probable], it is very likely to happen or be true.

examples.english: It's [probable] that she will come to the party.
examples.chinese: [可能]她会来参加聚会。

examples.english: Rain is [probable] this afternoon.
examples.chinese: 今天下午[可能]会下雨。

examples.english: He is the [probable] winner of the game.
examples.chinese: 他[很可能]是这次比赛的获胜者。

meanings.explanation: If you [proceed], you continue doing something or continue going somewhere.

examples.english: Please [proceed] to the front of the line.
examples.chinese: 请[往前走]到队伍前面。

examples.english: After the break, we will [proceed] with the lesson.
examples.chinese: 休息后，我们将[继续]上课。

examples.english: You may [proceed] when the light turns green.
examples.chinese: 绿灯亮时，你可以[前行]。

meanings.explanation: If you [proceed] to do something, you do it after you have finished doing something else.

examples.english: She finished her homework and then [proceed] to clean her room.
examples.chinese: 她做完作业，然后[接着]打扫房间。

examples.english: He ate breakfast and [proceed] to brush his teeth.
examples.chinese: 他吃完早餐，[接着]去刷牙。

examples.english: First mix the flour, then [proceed] to add the eggs.
examples.chinese: 先把面粉搅匀，然后[接着]加鸡蛋。

meanings.explanation: [Preparation] is the process of getting something ready for a particular event or purpose.

examples.english: Good [preparation] is very important before a test.
examples.chinese: 好的[准备]在考试前非常重要。

examples.english: My mom spent a long time on food [preparation] for the party.
examples.chinese: 我妈妈花了很长时间为派对做食物[准备]。

examples.english: The teacher does careful [preparation] before every class.
examples.chinese: 老师每节课前都会认真做[准备]。

meanings.explanation: [Preparation] can also refer to all the things that are done to get ready for a future event.

examples.english: The [preparation] for the school trip took us three days.
examples.chinese: 学校春游的[准备工作]花了我们三天。

examples.english: All the [preparation] for the show is ready now.
examples.chinese: 演出的所有[准备工作]现在都就绪了。

examples.english: She is in charge of the [preparation] for the sports meet.
examples.chinese: 她负责运动会的[准备工作]。

meanings.explanation: A [professor] is a teacher at a college or university who has a high level of knowledge about a particular subject.

examples.english: My aunt is a [professor] at Beijing University.
examples.chinese: 我姑姑是北京大学的[教授]。

examples.english: The [professor] gave us a very interesting lesson today.
examples.chinese: [教授]今天给我们上了一堂非常有趣的课。

examples.english: She wants to become a [professor] when she grows up.
examples.chinese: 她长大后想当一名[教授]。

meanings.explanation: A [professor] is someone who is a skilled expert in a particular area and often teaches others about it.

examples.english: He is a famous music [professor] who teaches piano.
examples.chinese: 他是一位著名的音乐[教授]，教弹钢琴。

examples.english: The art [professor] showed us how to mix colors.
examples.chinese: 美术[教授]教我们如何调色。

examples.english: Our math [professor] makes learning fun and easy.
examples.chinese: 我们的数学[教授]让学习变得既有趣又简单。

meanings.explanation: [Prominence] is the state of being important, well-known, or noticeable.

examples.english: The actor rose to [prominence] after starring in a popular movie.
examples.chinese: 这位演员在主演了一部热门电影后[崭露头角]。

examples.english: She gained [prominence] as a young singer in her school.
examples.chinese: 她作为学校里一位年轻的歌手而[小有名气]。

examples.english: His [prominence] in the art world grew over many years.
examples.chinese: 他在艺术界的[声望]是多年积累起来的。

examples.english: The scientist's [prominence] brought her many awards.
examples.chinese: 这位科学家的[知名度]为她赢得了许多奖项。

meanings.explanation: [Prominence] is the fact or quality of being easy to see or notice.

examples.english: The red building has a [prominence] on the street corner.
examples.chinese: 那栋红色建筑在街角很[显眼]。

examples.english: She wore a bright hat for [prominence] in the crowd.
examples.chinese: 她戴了一顶亮色的帽子，好在人群中更[醒目]。

examples.english: The [prominence] of the mountain makes it easy to find.
examples.chinese: 这座山的[突出]位置让它很容易被找到。

examples.english: The large sign was given [prominence] at the top of the page.
examples.chinese: 那个大招牌被放在页面顶部，非常[显眼]。

meanings.explanation: A [professional] is a person who has a job that requires special training or skill, especially one that follows a profession like medicine, law, or engineering.

examples.english: My older brother is a [professional] who works at a law firm.
examples.chinese: 我哥哥是一名[职业律师]，在一家律师事务所工作。

examples.english: We need to hire a [professional] to fix the air conditioner.
examples.chinese: 我们得雇一个[专业人士]来修空调。

examples.english: She is a trained [professional] in child education.
examples.chinese: 她是一位经过专业培训的[教育工作者]。

meanings.explanation: If someone is [professional], they have the type of job that needs special training and do it with a high level of skill and care.

examples.english: He is a very [professional] tennis player who plays in international matches.
examples.chinese: 他是一位非常[专业]的网球运动员，参加国际比赛。

examples.english: The doctor gave a very [professional] examination.
examples.chinese: 那位医生做了非常[专业]的检查。

examples.english: Her attitude at work is very [professional].
examples.chinese: 她对工作的态度非常[职业化]。

meanings.explanation: To [protect] someone or something means to keep them safe from harm, damage, or danger.

examples.english: Parents always want to [protect] their children from getting hurt.
examples.chinese: 父母总想[保护]孩子免受伤害。

examples.english: She wears a hat to [protect] herself from the hot sun.
examples.chinese: 她戴了顶帽子，[防止]被烈日晒到。

examples.english: We must [protect] the environment so the earth stays beautiful.
examples.chinese: 我们必须[保护]环境，让地球保持美丽。

meanings.explanation: If you [produce] something such as goods, food, or energy, you make, grow, or create it, often in large quantities.

examples.english: This factory [produces] delicious candies for kids.
examples.chinese: 这家工厂为孩子们[生产]美味的糖果。

examples.english: Our garden [produces] lots of fresh tomatoes every summer.
examples.chinese: 我们菜园每年夏天[产出]很多新鲜西红柿。

examples.english: The sun [produces] the heat and light we need every day.
examples.chinese: 太阳[产生]我们每天需要的光和热。

meanings.explanation: [Produce] refers to fresh food such as fruits and vegetables that are grown on farms for sale.

examples.english: My mom buys fresh [produce] from the market every morning.
examples.chinese: 我妈妈每天早上都去市场买新鲜[果蔬]。

examples.english: The shop sells local [produce] from nearby farms.
examples.chinese: 这家店铺售卖来自附近农场的本地[农产品]。

examples.english: We always wash fresh [produce] carefully before eating it.
examples.chinese: 我们吃新鲜[果蔬]前总会仔细清洗。

meanings.explanation: [Properness] is the quality of being correct, suitable, or appropriate for a particular situation.

examples.english: The teacher praised the [properness] of her answer.
examples.chinese: 老师表扬了她答案的[恰当性]。

examples.english: We should check the [properness] of our clothes before the party.
examples.chinese: 聚会前我们应该检查一下穿着是否[得体]。

examples.english: His [properness] at the dinner table impressed everyone.
examples.chinese: 他在餐桌上的[得体举止]给所有人留下了深刻印象。

meanings.explanation: [Properness] also means behaving in a way that follows social rules and good manners.

examples.english: Grandma taught us the importance of [properness] when meeting guests.
examples.chinese: 奶奶教导我们接待客人时[礼貌得体]的重要性。

examples.english: The [properness] of saying 'please' and 'thank you' is very important.
examples.chinese: 说"请"和"谢谢"这种[礼貌举止]是非常重要的。

examples.english: She always shows great [properness] in the way she speaks to elders.
examples.chinese: 她和长辈说话时总是表现出很高的[礼貌修养]。

meanings.explanation: A [procedure] is a set of actions that you do in a particular order to complete a task or achieve something.

examples.english: Please follow the safety [procedure] when you use the scissors.
examples.chinese: 使用剪刀时请遵守安全[步骤]。

examples.english: Let me show you the [procedure] for washing your hands.
examples.chinese: 我来教你洗手的[步骤]。

examples.english: What is the correct [procedure] for returning a book to the library?
examples.chinese: 把书还给图书馆的正确[流程]是什么？

meanings.explanation: A [procedure] is a medical treatment or operation that is done on a person's body.

examples.english: The dentist said the [procedure] would be quick and painless.
examples.chinese: 牙医说这个[治疗]会很快，一点儿也不疼。

examples.english: My grandpa had a small medical [procedure] at the hospital last week.
examples.chinese: 我爷爷上周在医院做了一个小的医疗[手术]。

examples.english: The doctor explained the [procedure] before the blood test.
examples.chinese: 医生在抽血前解释了[操作步骤]。

meanings.explanation: A [profit] is money that you gain from a business or an activity after you have paid all the costs.

examples.english: The little store made a small [profit] this year.
examples.chinese: 这家小商店今年赚了一点[利润]。

examples.english: She sold lemonade and kept the [profit] to buy a new toy.
examples.chinese: 她卖了柠檬水，把[赚到的钱]存起来买新玩具。

examples.english: His goal is to increase the [profit] of his father's shop.
examples.chinese: 他的目标是增加父亲店铺的[利润]。

meanings.explanation: If you [profit] from something, you get some advantage or benefit from it.

examples.english: You can [profit] from reading books every day.
examples.chinese: 每天读书能让你[受益]。

examples.english: He [profited] greatly from his teacher's advice.
examples.chinese: 他从老师的建议中[获益]良多。

examples.english: The whole team will [profit] from more practice.
examples.chinese: 整个团队会从更多练习中[受益]。

meanings.explanation: A [promise] is a statement that you will do something or that something will happen.

examples.english: I made a [promise] to my mom that I would clean my room.
examples.chinese: 我跟妈妈[承诺]要打扫房间。

examples.english: The [promise] he gave me was to play together tomorrow.
examples.chinese: 他给我的[承诺]是明天一起玩。

examples.english: She always keeps her [promise] and returns things on time.
examples.chinese: 她总是遵守[承诺]，按时归还东西。

meanings.explanation: If you [promise] something, you say that you will definitely do it or provide it.

examples.english: I [promise] to help you with your homework.
examples.chinese: 我[答应]帮你做作业。

examples.english: He [promised] to bring the toy car today.
examples.chinese: 他[答应]今天带玩具车来。

examples.english: She [promised] that she would not be late again.
examples.chinese: 她[保证]不再迟到了。

meanings.explanation: If a law or rule [prohibits] something, it officially says that you must not do it.

examples.english: The school rules [prohibit] running in the hallway.
examples.chinese: 校规[禁止]在走廊奔跑。

examples.english: This sign [prohibits] people from parking here.
examples.chinese: 这个标志[禁止]人们在这里停车。

examples.english: Laws [prohibit] selling cigarettes to kids.
examples.chinese: 法律[禁止]向儿童售卖香烟。

meanings.explanation: If a situation or event [prohibits] an action, it makes it impossible for you to do it.

examples.english: The heavy rain [prohibited] us from going camping.
examples.chinese: 大雨[阻止]了我们去露营。

examples.english: The broken lock [prohibits] me from opening the door.
examples.chinese: 坏掉的锁[阻止]我打开门。

examples.english: The sudden illness [prohibited] him from joining our trip.
examples.chinese: 突如其来的疾病[阻止]他参加我们的旅行。

meanings.explanation: The [provenance] of something is the place that it comes from or that it originally came from.

examples.english: The museum checks the [provenance] of old paintings before buying them.
examples.chinese: 博物馆在购买古画之前会先核查它们的[来源]。

examples.english: This old coin has a [provenance] from ancient Rome.
examples.chinese: 这枚古币的[来源]可以追溯到古罗马。

examples.english: We need to record the [provenance] of this family treasure.
examples.chinese: 我们需要记录下这件传家宝的[来源]。

meanings.explanation: [Prevention] is the act of stopping something bad from happening before it occurs.

examples.english: Washing your hands is a good [prevention] against germs.
examples.chinese: 勤洗手是对病菌的一种很好的[预防]。

examples.english: Our school holds a fire [prevention] drill every year.
examples.chinese: 我们学校每年都进行火灾[预防]演习。

examples.english: A healthy diet helps with the [prevention] of diseases.
examples.chinese: 健康的饮食有助于疾病的[预防]。

meanings.explanation: A [principal] is the person who is in charge of a primary or secondary school.

examples.english: Our [principal] is a kind man who often talks with us.
examples.chinese: 我们的[校长]人很和善，经常和我们聊天。

examples.english: The [principal] announced a one-day holiday after the heavy snow.
examples.chinese: 大雪过后，[校长]宣布放假一天。

examples.english: I have to go to the [principal]'s office after class.
examples.chinese: 下课后我得去[校长]办公室。

meanings.explanation: The [principal] person or thing is the most important one in a group or situation.

examples.english: My [principal] reason for walking to school is to get more exercise.
examples.chinese: 我走路去上学的[主要]原因是多锻炼身体。

examples.english: The [principal] food people eat here is rice.
examples.chinese: 这里人们吃的[主要]食物是大米。

examples.english: Her [principal] hobby after school is drawing.
examples.chinese: 她放学后的[主要]爱好是画画。

meanings.explanation: If something is [public], it is connected with or available to all the people in a particular area or country.

examples.english: This is a [public] library, and anyone can borrow books here.
examples.chinese: 这是一家[公共]图书馆，任何人都可以在这里借书。

examples.english: My mom always takes the [public] bus to work.
examples.chinese: 我妈妈总是坐[公共]汽车去上班。

examples.english: We had a picnic in the [public] park last Sunday.
examples.chinese: 上个星期天我们在[公共]公园里野餐了。

meanings.explanation: The [public] means all the people in general, or a group of people who share a particular interest.

examples.english: The new park is now open to the [public].
examples.chinese: 新公园现在已经对[公众]开放了。

examples.english: This is a private party, not for the [public].
examples.chinese: 这是一场私人聚会，不是给[公众]的。

examples.english: The [public] can visit the museum for free this weekend.
examples.chinese: 这个周末[公众]可以免费参观博物馆。

meanings.explanation: If a company or boss [promote]s you, you are given a more important job or a higher rank in the organization.

examples.english: My dad was [promote]d to manager last week.
examples.chinese: 我爸爸上周被[提拔]当经理了。

examples.english: She worked very hard and got [promote]d.
examples.chinese: 她工作非常努力，[升职]了。

examples.english: The company decided to [promote] him to team leader.
examples.chinese: 公司决定[提拔]他当组长。

meanings.explanation: If you [promote] something, you help it become more popular, successful, or well-known, often by advertising it or encouraging people to try it.

examples.english: The school is having a book fair to [promote] reading.
examples.chinese: 学校正在举办书展来[推广]阅读。

examples.english: The singer went on TV to [promote] her new song.
examples.chinese: 这位歌手上了电视来[宣传]她的新歌。

examples.english: Eating fruits and vegetables can [promote] good health.
examples.chinese: 吃水果和蔬菜可以[促进]健康。

meanings.explanation: When a company or person [publishes] a book, magazine, or newspaper, they print it and sell it to the public.

examples.english: My dad wants to [publish] a book about his travel stories.
examples.chinese: 我爸爸想[出版]一本关于他旅行故事的书。

examples.english: Our school will [publish] a newspaper next month.
examples.chinese: 我们学校下个月将[出版]一份报纸。

examples.english: She wrote many poems and wanted to [publish] them.
examples.chinese: 她写了很多诗，想把它们[发表]。

meanings.explanation: To [publish] something means to make information or material available to the public, especially on the internet.

examples.english: He decided to [publish] his photos online.
examples.chinese: 他决定在网上[发布]他的照片。

examples.english: The blog will [publish] the article tomorrow.
examples.chinese: 这个博客明天将[发布]这篇文章。

examples.english: Anyone can [publish] videos on this website.
examples.chinese: 任何人都可以在这个网站上[发布]视频。

meanings.explanation: [protection] is the act of keeping someone or something safe from harm, damage, or danger.

examples.english: Wearing a seat belt offers good [protection] in a car crash.
examples.chinese: 系安全带在车祸时能提供很好的[保护]。

examples.english: This sunscreen gives [protection] against the sun.
examples.chinese: 这款防晒霜能提供防晒[保护]。

examples.english: The fence provides [protection] for the garden.
examples.chinese: 这个篱笆能[保护]花园。

meanings.explanation: A [qualification] is a skill, ability, or experience that makes someone suitable for a particular job or activity.

examples.english: She has the right [qualifications] for this job.
examples.chinese: 她具备做这份工作的[资格]。

examples.english: Good communication is an important [qualification] for a teacher.
examples.chinese: 善于沟通是当老师的重要[条件]。

examples.english: His years of experience are a great [qualification] for the team.
examples.chinese: 他多年的经验是加入这个团队的一大[优势]。

meanings.explanation: A [qualification] is an official certificate or degree that shows you have passed an exam or completed a course of study.

examples.english: She got a teaching [qualification] after college.
examples.chinese: 她大学毕业后拿到了教师资格[证书]。

examples.english: You need a medical [qualification] to work in this hospital.
examples.chinese: 你需要有医学[资质]才能在这家医院工作。

examples.english: He is studying hard to get his driving [qualification].
examples.chinese: 他正刻苦学习，想取得驾驶[资格证]。

meanings.explanation: If you [propose] a plan, idea, or activity, you suggest it for people to think about and consider.

examples.english: I [propose] we eat ice cream after dinner.
examples.chinese: 我[提议]我们晚饭后吃冰淇淋。

examples.english: My mom [proposed] a walk after dinner.
examples.chinese: 我妈妈[提议]晚饭后去散散步。

examples.english: He [proposed] a new game for our picnic.
examples.chinese: 他[提议]我们野餐时玩一个新游戏。

meanings.explanation: If you [propose] to someone you love, you formally ask that person to marry you.

examples.english: He [proposed] to his girlfriend on a mountain top.
examples.chinese: 他在山顶向女朋友[求婚]。

examples.english: My uncle [proposed] to my aunt five years ago.
examples.chinese: 我叔叔五年前向我阿姨[求婚]。

examples.english: He [proposed] with a pretty diamond ring.
examples.chinese: 他用一枚漂亮的钻戒[求婚]。

meanings.explanation: If you [raise] something, you lift it up or move it to a higher position.

examples.english: Please [raise] your hand if you know the answer.
examples.chinese: 知道答案的话请[举手]。

examples.english: He [raised] the flag in the morning.
examples.chinese: 他早上[升了旗]。

examples.english: She [raised] her head and looked at the sky.
examples.chinese: 她[抬起]头看了看天空。

meanings.explanation: If you [raise] the level, amount, or number of something, you make it higher or greater than before.

examples.english: The store [raised] the price of milk.
examples.chinese: 这家店[提高了]牛奶的价格。

examples.english: My dad got a [raise] at work this year.
examples.chinese: 我爸爸今年工作[加薪]了。

examples.english: We need to [raise] more money for the school trip.
examples.chinese: 我们需要为学校旅行[筹集]更多的钱。

meanings.explanation: If you [preserve] something, you take action to keep it as it is or to protect it from being damaged or changed.

examples.english: We should [preserve] the forest for wild animals.
examples.chinese: 我们应该为野生动物[保护]森林。

examples.english: We should [preserve] this old park for everyone to enjoy.
examples.chinese: 我们应该[保护]这个老公园，让大家都能来玩。

examples.english: The park workers [preserve] the lake by keeping it clean.
examples.chinese: 公园工作人员通过保持清洁来[保护]湖泊。

meanings.explanation: If you [preserve] food, you treat it so that it does not decay and can be kept for a long time.

examples.english: Mom and I [preserve] strawberries by making them into jam.
examples.chinese: 妈妈和我把草莓做成草莓酱来[保存]。

examples.english: Long ago, people used salt to [preserve] meat and fish.
examples.chinese: 很久以前，人们用盐来[保存]肉和鱼。

examples.english: We can [preserve] cucumbers by putting them in vinegar.
examples.chinese: 我们可以用醋来[保存]黄瓜。

meanings.explanation: When you do something [quickly], you do it at a fast speed or without taking much time.

examples.english: The rabbit ran [quickly] across the grass.
examples.chinese: 兔子[飞快地]跑过草地。

examples.english: Please walk [quickly] or we will be late for school.
examples.chinese: 请走[快点]，否则我们上学要迟到了。

examples.english: She finished her homework [quickly] so she could play.
examples.chinese: 她[很快地]做完作业，这样就可以去玩了。

meanings.explanation: The [purpose] of something is the reason for which it is made or done.

examples.english: The [purpose] of a clock is to tell us the time.
examples.chinese: 钟表的[作用]是告诉我们时间。

examples.english: What is the [purpose] of your visit today?
examples.chinese: 你今天来访的[目的]是什么？

examples.english: A knife has the [purpose] of cutting food.
examples.chinese: 刀子的[用途]是切食物。

meanings.explanation: Someone's [purpose] is the aim or intention that they want to achieve.

examples.english: Her main [purpose] in life is to help animals.
examples.chinese: 她人生的主要[目标]是帮助动物。

examples.english: He went to the store with the [purpose] of buying milk.
examples.chinese: 他去商店的[目的]是买牛奶。

examples.english: My [purpose] today is to finish my homework.
examples.chinese: 我今天[打算]完成我的作业。

meanings.explanation: If you [prove] something, you show that it is definitely true or correct by giving facts or evidence.

examples.english: Can you [prove] that you finished your homework?
examples.chinese: 你能[证明]你做完作业了吗？

examples.english: The scientist wanted to [prove] her idea was correct.
examples.chinese: 这位科学家想[证明]她的想法是对的。

examples.english: He showed us the photos to [prove] he was at the party.
examples.chinese: 他给我们看照片来[证明]他参加了派对。

meanings.explanation: If someone or something [proves] to be a particular thing, they are found to be that thing through experience or over time.

examples.english: His idea [proved] to be a great success.
examples.chinese: 他的想法最后[证明]非常成功。

examples.english: The movie [proved] to be more popular than anyone expected.
examples.chinese: 这部电影[证明]比大家预想的更受欢迎。

examples.english: She [proved] to be a wonderful teacher.
examples.chinese: 她[证明]是一位很棒的老师。

meanings.explanation: A [pulley] is a simple machine made of a wheel with a groove around it and a rope that fits in the groove, used to lift heavy things more easily.

examples.english: We used a [pulley] to lift the heavy box up to the tree house.
examples.chinese: 我们用[滑轮]把那个重箱子吊到了树屋上。

examples.english: The flag goes up to the top of the pole by a [pulley].
examples.chinese: 旗子是通过[滑轮]升到杆顶的。

examples.english: A [pulley] makes lifting heavy objects much easier.
examples.chinese: [滑轮]让提起重物变得省力多了。

meanings.explanation: When you [reach] a place, you arrive there after traveling.

examples.english: We will [reach] the beach after ten minutes of walking.
examples.chinese: 再走十分钟，我们就[到达]海边了。

examples.english: The train [reaches] the station at six o'clock.
examples.chinese: 火车六点钟[抵达]车站。

examples.english: They finally [reached] the top of the mountain.
examples.chinese: 他们终于[到达]了山顶。

meanings.explanation: If you [reach] for something, you stretch out your arm or body to touch or get it.

examples.english: The little girl [reaches] for the cookie jar on the table.
examples.chinese: 小女孩[伸手]去拿桌上的饼干罐。

examples.english: Can you [reach] the light switch from your bed?
examples.chinese: 你躺在床上能[够到]电灯开关吗？

examples.english: He stood on his toes to [reach] the apple on the tree.
examples.chinese: 他踮起脚尖去[够]树上的苹果。

meanings.explanation: [Rapidly] means doing something quickly or at a high speed.

examples.english: The train moved [rapidly] through the countryside.
examples.chinese: 火车[快速地]穿过乡村。

examples.english: The baby is growing [rapidly] these days.
examples.chinese: 宝宝最近[迅速地]长大了。

examples.english: News spreads [rapidly] on the internet.
examples.chinese: 新闻在互联网上[快速地]传播。

meanings.explanation: If you [provide] something that someone needs or wants, you give it to them or make it available to them.

examples.english: The library [provides] many interesting storybooks for us.
examples.chinese: 图书馆为我们[提供]了很多有趣的故事书。

examples.english: This website [provides] lots of fun games for kids.
examples.chinese: 这个网站为孩子们[提供]很多好玩的游戏。

examples.english: Can you [provide] your address to the postman?
examples.chinese: 你能给邮递员[提供]你的地址吗？

meanings.explanation: If you [provide] for someone, you earn enough money to buy them the food, clothes, and other basic things they need to live.

examples.english: His father [provides] for the whole family by working in a factory.
examples.chinese: 他爸爸在工厂做工，[供养]全家。

examples.english: He has to [provide] for three children after his wife passed away.
examples.chinese: 妻子去世后，他不得不[供养]三个孩子。

examples.english: My uncle works hard to [provide] for his old parents and young kids.
examples.chinese: 我叔叔努力工作来[供养]他年迈的父母和年幼的孩子。

meanings.explanation: If you [pursue] something such as a goal, dream, or career, you make a lot of effort to achieve it or get it over a period of time.

examples.english: Lily [pursues] her dream of becoming a dancer every day.
examples.chinese: 莉莉每天都在[追求]她成为舞蹈家的梦想。

examples.english: My cousin wants to [pursue] a job as a vet because he loves animals.
examples.chinese: 我表哥想[从事]兽医工作，因为他喜欢动物。

examples.english: We need to work hard to [pursue] our happy life.
examples.chinese: 我们需要努力[追求]我们的幸福生活。

meanings.explanation: If you [pursue] a person or animal that is moving away, you follow them quickly in order to catch them.

examples.english: The police officer [pursued] the thief for two blocks.
examples.chinese: 警察[追捕]小偷追了两个街区。

examples.english: The dog [pursued] the rabbit into the woods.
examples.chinese: 狗[追赶]兔子进了树林。

examples.english: The cat [pursued] the mouse around the house.
examples.chinese: 猫围着房子[追赶]老鼠。

meanings.explanation: When you [receive] something, someone gives it to you and you get it.

examples.english: I [receive]d a beautiful birthday gift from my best friend.
examples.chinese: 我[收到]了最好朋友送的一份漂亮的生日礼物。

examples.english: Did you [receive] my message yesterday?
examples.chinese: 你昨天[收到]我的消息了吗？

examples.english: We will [receive] the new books next Monday.
examples.chinese: 我们下周一会[收到]新书。

meanings.explanation: When you [receive] treatment, help, or an education, you are given it by someone such as a doctor or a teacher.

examples.english: My sister [receive]s piano lessons every Saturday.
examples.chinese: 我妹妹每周六都[接受]钢琴课。

examples.english: He [receive]d good care at the hospital.
examples.chinese: 他在医院[接受]了很好的照顾。

examples.english: Students [receive] a warm welcome on the first day of school.
examples.chinese: 学生们在开学第一天[受到了]热烈的欢迎。

meanings.explanation: If you do something [readily], you do it willingly and without hesitation.

examples.english: She [readily] helped her mom clean the house.
examples.chinese: 她很[乐意]帮妈妈打扫房间。

examples.english: He [readily] said yes when I asked him to play together.
examples.chinese: 我叫他一起玩的时候，他[痛痛快快]地答应了。

examples.english: My dad [readily] agreed to take us to the park this weekend.
examples.chinese: 爸爸[很爽快地]同意周末带我们去公园。

meanings.explanation: If something is [readily] available or obtainable, it is easy to find, get, or use.

examples.english: Fresh fruit is [readily] available at the market near my home.
examples.chinese: 我家附近的菜市场[很轻易就能]买到新鲜水果。

examples.english: You can [readily] find this storybook in the school library.
examples.chinese: 你在学校图书馆[很方便就能]找到这本故事书。

examples.english: The answers to these questions are [readily] found on the internet.
examples.chinese: 这些问题的答案在网上[很容易]就能查到。

meanings.explanation: If you [rearranged] something, you changed the position or order of things to make them different from before.

examples.english: My mom [rearranged] the living room furniture last weekend.
examples.chinese: 我妈妈上周末[重新摆放]了客厅的家具。

examples.english: The teacher [rearranged] our desks into small groups.
examples.chinese: 老师把我们的课桌[重新排列]成了小组。

examples.english: I [rearranged] my bookshelf to put my favorite books on top.
examples.chinese: 我[重新整理]了书架，把最喜欢的书放在最上面。

meanings.explanation: [Realism] is the attitude or practice of accepting the world as it really is, without pretending or imagining things are better than they are.

examples.english: The movie is famous for its [realism] in showing everyday life.
examples.chinese: 这部电影以呈现日常生活的[真实性]而闻名。

examples.english: She has a certain [realism] about her job situation.
examples.chinese: 她对工作现状有一种务实的[务实态度]。

examples.english: The book lacks [realism] and feels very fake.
examples.chinese: 这本书缺乏[真实感]，读起来很假。

meanings.explanation: In art and literature, [realism] is a style that depicts subjects exactly as they appear in real life, without idealization or stylization.

examples.english: [Realism] was a major art movement in the 19th century.
examples.chinese: [现实主义]是19世纪的一场重要艺术运动。

examples.english: The film pushed [realism] to its limits with its raw scenes.
examples.chinese: 这部电影的粗粝场景将[现实主义]发挥到了极致。

examples.english: Many writers returned to [realism] after the war.
examples.chinese: 战后许多作家回归了[现实主义]风格。

meanings.explanation: If you [quit] an activity or job, you stop doing it or leave it.

examples.english: My dad wants to [quit] smoking for his health.
examples.chinese: 我爸爸为了健康想要[戒掉]抽烟。

examples.english: She decided to [quit] her part-time job after the exam.
examples.chinese: 考试结束后她决定[辞去]这份兼职工作。

examples.english: I will not [quit] even when the problem gets hard.
examples.chinese: 就算题目很难，我也不会[放弃]。

meanings.explanation: If you [quit] during a game, race, or competition, you stop taking part before it ends because of difficulty or injury.

examples.english: Don't [quit] now—we can still win this game!
examples.chinese: 别现在[放弃]——我们还能赢下这场比赛！

examples.english: He [quit] the running race halfway because his leg hurt.
examples.chinese: 他因为腿疼，在跑步比赛中途[退出]了。

examples.english: Even if you fail once, don't [quit] trying again.
examples.chinese: 就算你失败一次，也别[停止]再次尝试。

meanings.explanation: If you [rectify] something that is wrong or imperfect, you correct or fix it.

examples.english: Please [rectify] this mistake in my report.
examples.chinese: 请帮我[纠正]报告里的这个错误。

examples.english: We need to [rectify] the situation before it gets worse.
examples.chinese: 我们需要在情况恶化之前[纠正]一下。

examples.english: The company promised to [rectify] the problem with my order.
examples.chinese: 公司承诺会[纠正]我订单的问题。

meanings.explanation: The [reception] is the desk or area in a hotel, office, or hospital where visitors go first to be greeted or to check in.

examples.english: Please leave your room key at the [reception] when you check out.
examples.chinese: 退房时请把房间钥匙留在[前台]。

examples.english: The [reception] is just behind the front door.
examples.chinese: [前台]就在大门的后面。

examples.english: My sister works at the [reception] of that big hotel.
examples.chinese: 我姐姐在那家大酒店的[前台]工作。

meanings.explanation: The [reception] of something is the way people react to it, especially the response to a new product, idea, or event.

examples.english: The new game got a warm [reception] from players.
examples.chinese: 这款新游戏得到了玩家们的热烈[反响]。

examples.english: Her speech met with a cold [reception] from the audience.
examples.chinese: 她的演讲遭到了观众的冷漠[反应]。

examples.english: The plan had a mixed [reception] among teachers.
examples.chinese: 这个计划在老师们中间收到了不一样的[反响]。

meanings.explanation: If you [recommend] someone or something, you tell people that they are good or that they should try, buy, or use them.

examples.english: My sister [recommends] this pizza restaurant.
examples.chinese: 我姐姐[推荐]这家披萨店。

examples.english: Can you [recommend] a good book for kids?
examples.chinese: 你能[推荐]一本适合孩子的好书吗？

examples.english: I [recommend] this game to all my friends.
examples.chinese: 我向所有朋友[推荐]这个游戏。

meanings.explanation: If you [recommend] that someone does something, you advise them to do it because you think it is the best thing to do.

examples.english: The doctor [recommends] lots of rest.
examples.chinese: 医生[建议]多休息。

examples.english: I [recommend] you eat more vegetables.
examples.chinese: 我[建议]你多吃点蔬菜。

examples.english: She [recommends] taking a walk after dinner.
examples.chinese: 她[建议]晚饭后散散步。

meanings.explanation: A [reaction] is something that you do, say, or feel as a response to something that has happened or been said.

examples.english: My [reaction] to the bad news was to cry.
examples.chinese: 我对这个坏消息的[反应]是哭了。

examples.english: What was your mom's [reaction] when you told her you broke the vase?
examples.chinese: 你告诉你妈妈你打碎花瓶时，她的[反应]是什么？

examples.english: His quick [reaction] saved the child from falling off the bike.
examples.chinese: 他敏捷的[反应]救了那个孩子，让他没从自行车上摔下来。

meanings.explanation: A [reaction] is a process in chemistry where two or more substances combine to create a new substance.

examples.english: We watched a cool chemical [reaction] in science class today.
examples.chinese: 我们今天在科学课上观看了一个有趣的化学[反应]。

examples.english: Mixing vinegar and baking soda causes a bubbly [reaction].
examples.chinese: 混合醋和小苏打会产生冒泡泡的[反应]。

examples.english: This [reaction] makes the water get hot quickly.
examples.chinese: 这个[反应]让水很快变热了。

meanings.explanation: If you [recover] from an illness, injury, or tiredness, you become healthy or well again.

examples.english: It took my grandma a month to [recover] from her bad cold.
examples.chinese: 我奶奶花了一个月才从重感冒中[康复]。

examples.english: He is still sitting on the sofa to [recover] after running in the park.
examples.chinese: 在公园跑步后，他还坐在沙发上[恢复]体力。

examples.english: The doctor says you will [recover] completely in two weeks.
examples.chinese: 医生说你两周后就能完全[康复]。

meanings.explanation: If you [recover] something that was lost or stolen, you get it back again.

examples.english: The police helped [recover] my dad's stolen bike.
examples.chinese: 警察帮[找回]了我爸爸被偷的自行车。

examples.english: I can't [recover] the deleted photos from my tablet.
examples.chinese: 我没法从平板电脑里[恢复]删掉的照片。

examples.english: The hiker [recovered] his lost backpack in the woods.
examples.chinese: 那个徒步旅行者在树林里[找回]了他丢失的背包。

meanings.explanation: If you [refer] to something, you look at it or read it for information.

examples.english: Please [refer] to your book to find the answer.
examples.chinese: 请[查阅]课本找答案。

examples.english: I often [refer] to a map when I travel.
examples.chinese: 我旅行时经常[查看]地图。

examples.english: You can [refer] to the instructions for help.
examples.chinese: 你可以[参考]说明书寻求帮助。

meanings.explanation: If you [refer] someone to someone or something, you send them there for help or advice.

examples.english: The teacher will [refer] you to the school nurse.
examples.chinese: 老师会[推荐]你去校医那里。

examples.english: My doctor [refer]red me to a specialist.
examples.chinese: 我的医生把我[转介]给了一位专科医生。

examples.english: Can you [refer] me to a good dentist?
examples.chinese: 你能[推荐]一位好牙医给我吗？

meanings.explanation: If something [refresh]es you, or if you [refresh] yourself, you feel less tired and more energetic.

examples.english: A cold glass of juice really [refresh]ed me after running.
examples.chinese: 跑步后，一杯冰果汁真让我[神清气爽]。

examples.english: She went to the bathroom to [refresh] herself.
examples.chinese: 她去洗手间[梳洗了一下]，让自己恢复精神。

examples.english: The cool wind [refresh]ed everyone on the hot day.
examples.chinese: 凉风让炎热天气里的每个人都[精神一振]。

meanings.explanation: To [refresh] something means to update it so that it shows the most recent information, or to help yourself remember something again.

examples.english: Please [refresh] the webpage if the picture doesn't show.
examples.chinese: 如果图片没有显示，请[刷新]一下网页。

examples.english: Let me [refresh] my memory and try to remember his name.
examples.chinese: 让我[回忆]一下，试着想起他的名字。

examples.english: I [refresh]ed the app to see if there were new messages.
examples.chinese: 我[刷新]了一下应用，看看有没有新消息。

meanings.explanation: If you [recreate] something, you make it again, especially so that it looks, sounds, or feels exactly like the original.

examples.english: The students tried to [recreate] a famous painting for the school art show.
examples.chinese: 学生们尝试为学校画展[重现]一幅名画。

examples.english: We used old photos to [recreate] my grandma's wedding dress.
examples.chinese: 我们用老照片来[复刻]我奶奶的婚纱。

examples.english: The movie set was built to [recreate] an ancient Chinese town.
examples.chinese: 电影布景是为了[还原]一个中国古镇而搭建的。

meanings.explanation: Something that is [regional] relates to or is typical of a particular area or part of a country.

examples.english: We enjoy trying [regional] dishes when we travel to new places.
examples.chinese: 我们旅行时喜欢品尝[当地的]特色美食。

examples.english: The [regional] weather report says it will rain in the north tomorrow.
examples.chinese: [地区性]天气预报说明天北部会下雨。

examples.english: Each state has its own [regional] traditions and holidays.
examples.chinese: 每个州都有自己独特的[地方]传统和节日。

meanings.explanation: If you [refuse] something, you say that you will not accept it or do it.

examples.english: He [refused] to answer the question.
examples.chinese: 他[拒绝]回答这个问题。

examples.english: She [refused] the offer politely.
examples.chinese: 她礼貌地[拒绝]了这个提议。

examples.english: The doctor [refused] to see any more patients today.
examples.chinese: 医生[拒绝]今天再看更多病人了。

meanings.explanation: [Refuse] is waste or garbage, especially from a house or business.

examples.english: The city collects [refuse] every Monday morning.
examples.chinese: 城市每周一早上收集[垃圾]。

examples.english: Please put your [refuse] in the bin outside.
examples.chinese: 请把你的[垃圾]放到外面的垃圾桶里。

examples.english: There was a pile of [refuse] behind the building.
examples.chinese: 楼后面有一堆[垃圾]。

meanings.explanation: Something that is [regular] happens often or at the same time each day, week, or month.

examples.english: I go swimming every Saturday — it's my [regular] routine.
examples.chinese: 我每个星期六都去游泳——这是我的[常规]安排。

examples.english: My grandpa takes a [regular] walk in the park every morning.
examples.chinese: 我爷爷每天早上都在公园[定时]散步。

examples.english: She is a [regular] visitor to our library.
examples.chinese: 她是我们图书馆的[常客]。

meanings.explanation: A [regular] thing is normal, ordinary, and not special or unusual in any way.

examples.english: I'll just have a [regular] hamburger, nothing special.
examples.chinese: 我就要一个[普通的]汉堡，不要什么特别的。

examples.english: These look like [regular] shoes to me.
examples.chinese: 这些在我看就是[普通的]鞋。

examples.english: Do you want the large size or the [regular] size?
examples.chinese: 你要大号的还是[正常]大小的？

meanings.explanation: If someone or something [reappears], they appear again after being gone or not seen for some time.

examples.english: My dog ran away yesterday but [reappeared] this morning.
examples.chinese: 我的狗昨天跑丢了，但今天早上[又出现了]。

examples.english: After the rain stopped, the sun [reappeared] from behind the clouds.
examples.chinese: 雨停之后，太阳从云后面[又出来了]。

examples.english: My favorite cartoon will [reappear] on TV tonight.
examples.chinese: 我最喜欢的动画片今晚会在电视上[重新播出]。

meanings.explanation: If you can [relate] to something or someone, you can understand how they feel or what they are going through because you have had a similar experience.

examples.english: I can really [relate] to how you feel about moving to a new school.
examples.chinese: 我特别能[理解]你转学后的感受。

examples.english: Many kids can [relate] to the story because they have the same dream.
examples.chinese: 很多孩子都能对这个故事[感同身受]，因为他们也有同样的梦想。

examples.english: She couldn't [relate] to the characters in the movie at all.
examples.chinese: 她完全无法对电影里的角色[产生共鸣]。

meanings.explanation: If you [relate] one thing to another, you show how they are connected or similar to each other.

examples.english: The teacher [related] the math problem to a real-life shopping trip.
examples.chinese: 老师把这个数学题和真实的生活购物场景[联系起来]。

examples.english: Can you [relate] what we learned today to what we discussed yesterday?
examples.chinese: 你能把今天学的和昨天讨论的[联系起来]吗？

examples.english: Scientists are trying to [relate] the strange weather to climate change.
examples.chinese: 科学家们正试图把这种异常天气与气候变化[联系起来]。

meanings.explanation: If you [reject] something such as an idea or a plan, you do not accept it or you refuse to agree with it.

examples.english: My mom will [reject] my plan to eat ice cream before dinner.
examples.chinese: 我妈妈会[拒绝]我饭前吃冰淇淋的计划。

examples.english: The teacher did not [reject] my answer; she said it was correct.
examples.chinese: 老师没有[否定]我的答案，她说那是正确的。

examples.english: I asked him to play, but he [rejected] my invitation.
examples.chinese: 我邀请他一起玩，但他[拒绝]了我的邀请。

meanings.explanation: A [reject] is a product that is not good enough to be sold or used, or a person who is not accepted by a group.

examples.english: This toy is a factory [reject] because the arm is broken.
examples.chinese: 这个玩具是工厂的[次品]，因为它的胳膊坏了。

examples.english: The [rejects] from the cookie factory were thrown away.
examples.chinese: 饼干厂的[不合格品]都被扔掉了。

examples.english: He felt like a [reject] when no one picked him for the team.
examples.chinese: 当没人选他进队伍时，他觉得自己像个[被排斥的人]。

meanings.explanation: If you are [reckless], you do dangerous things without thinking about the possible bad results.

examples.english: It was [reckless] of Tom to go swimming alone in the deep river.
examples.chinese: 汤姆一个人去深河里游泳，真是太[鲁莽]了。

examples.english: Don't make a [reckless] decision that you might regret later.
examples.chinese: 别做[鲁莽]的决定，不然以后会后悔的。

examples.english: The [reckless] boy climbed the tall tree without any help.
examples.chinese: 那个[莽撞]的男孩没人帮忙就爬上了那棵大树。

meanings.explanation: [Reckless] driving or behavior is extremely dangerous and shows no concern for safety.

examples.english: The driver was arrested for [reckless] driving on the busy road.
examples.chinese: 那个司机在繁忙路段因为[危险]驾驶被逮捕了。

examples.english: [Reckless] driving puts everyone's life in danger.
examples.chinese: [鲁莽]驾驶会把所有人的生命置于危险之中。

examples.english: He had an accident because of his [reckless] driving.
examples.chinese: 他因为[鲁莽]驾驶出了车祸。

meanings.explanation: If something is [rare], it is not common and you do not see it or experience it very often.

examples.english: It is [rare] to see snow in this city.
examples.chinese: 这个城市下雪很[罕见]。

examples.english: A [rare] bird flew into our garden yesterday.
examples.chinese: 昨天一只[稀有的]鸟飞进了我们的花园。

examples.english: My grandmother has a [rare] collection of old stamps.
examples.chinese: 我奶奶有一套[稀有的]老邮票。

meanings.explanation: When meat is [rare], it has been cooked for only a short time and the inside is still red.

examples.english: I like my steak [rare], not well-done.
examples.chinese: 我喜欢[三分熟的]牛排，不要全熟的。

examples.english: Father always orders his beef [rare] at the restaurant.
examples.chinese: 爸爸去餐厅吃饭总是点[三分熟的]牛肉。

examples.english: The chef cooked the meat [rare] as the customer asked.
examples.chinese: 厨师按顾客的要求把肉煎成了[三分熟的]。

meanings.explanation: A [reborn] person has started a completely new and better life, often with new spiritual beliefs.

examples.english: After his serious illness, he became a [reborn] man.
examples.chinese: 大病一场后，他变成了一个[新生]的人。

examples.english: My aunt is a [reborn] Christian who goes to church every week.
examples.chinese: 我的阿姨是一名[重生]的基督徒，她每周都去教堂。

examples.english: After changing his bad habits, he felt like a [reborn] person.
examples.chinese: 改掉坏习惯后，他觉得自己成了一个[新生]的人。

meanings.explanation: Something that is [reborn] has started to exist or be active again after it had disappeared or stopped existing.

examples.english: After the big fire, the forest became a [reborn] natural park.
examples.chinese: 大火过后，这片森林变成了一座[新生]的自然公园。

examples.english: The old factory turned into a [reborn] art center for kids.
examples.chinese: 那座旧工厂改造成了给孩子们用的[重生]艺术中心。

examples.english: The small ancient town is now a [reborn] popular tourist spot.
examples.chinese: 这座古老的小镇现在成了[新生]的热门景点。

meanings.explanation: A [question] is something that you say or write when you want to get information or an answer from someone.

examples.english: Can I ask you a [question]?
examples.chinese: 我能问你一个[问题]吗？

examples.english: The teacher answered all our [questions].
examples.chinese: 老师回答了我们所有的[问题]。

examples.english: If you have a [question], please raise your hand.
examples.chinese: 如果你有[问题]，请举手。

meanings.explanation: If you [question] someone, you ask them questions in order to find out information. If you [question] something, you have or express doubts about it.

examples.english: The doctor [questioned] me about what I ate for breakfast.
examples.chinese: 医生[问]我早餐吃了什么。

examples.english: The boy [questioned] whether the story was really true.
examples.chinese: 小男孩[怀疑]这个故事是不是真的。

examples.english: Mom [questioned] me about where I was going after school.
examples.chinese: 妈妈[问]我放学后要去哪儿。

meanings.explanation: If you feel [relaxed], you are calm and not worried or stressed.

examples.english: After a long walk, I feel so [relaxed].
examples.chinese: 走了很长一段路后，我感到非常[放松]。

examples.english: She was [relaxed] while listening to soft music.
examples.chinese: 听轻柔音乐时，她很[放松]。

examples.english: The warm sunshine made us feel [relaxed].
examples.chinese: 温暖的阳光让我们感到[放松]。

meanings.explanation: Something that is [relaxed] is informal and not strict.

examples.english: Our teacher has a [relaxed] style of teaching.
examples.chinese: 我们老师的教学方式很[随意]。

examples.english: It is a [relaxed] family gathering with no rules.
examples.chinese: 这是一次没有规矩的[轻松]家庭聚会。

examples.english: We had a [relaxed] conversation over dinner.
examples.chinese: 晚餐时我们进行了[轻松]的交谈。

meanings.explanation: A [regulation] is an official rule made by a government or other authority that tells people what they must or must not do.

examples.english: You must follow the school [regulation] about wearing uniforms.
examples.chinese: 你必须遵守学校关于穿校服的[规定]。

examples.english: The new traffic [regulation] says we must stop at the red light.
examples.chinese: 新的交通[规定]要求红灯时必须停车。

examples.english: There is a [regulation] that dogs must be on a leash in the park.
examples.chinese: 有一条[规定]说狗在公园里必须拴绳子。

meanings.explanation: [Regulation] is the act of controlling a process or system so that it works in a correct and orderly way.

examples.english: The [regulation] of room temperature keeps us comfortable in class.
examples.chinese: 教室温度的[调节]让我们上课时感到很舒适。

examples.english: Good [regulation] of water flow helps plants grow better.
examples.chinese: 好好[调控]水流能让植物长得更好。

examples.english: The body's [regulation] of blood sugar is very important for health.
examples.chinese: 身体对血糖的[调节]对健康非常重要。

meanings.explanation: A [reliable] person or thing is someone or something that you can trust to work well or behave as you expect.

examples.english: My grandmother is the most [reliable] person I know.
examples.chinese: 我奶奶是我认识的最[可靠的]人。

examples.english: This watch is always [reliable] and never stops.
examples.chinese: 这块手表一直很[靠得住]，从不罢工。

examples.english: You need a [reliable] car for a long road trip.
examples.chinese: 长途旅行你需要一辆[信得过的]车。

meanings.explanation: A [region] is a large area of a country or of the world that has particular qualities or features.

examples.english: My family lives in a beautiful [region] near the mountains.
examples.chinese: 我家住在山附近一片风景优美的[地区]。

examples.english: This [region] of the country gets a lot of snow in winter.
examples.chinese: 这个国家的这个[地区]冬天经常下大雪。

examples.english: The desert [region] is very hot during the day.
examples.chinese: 沙漠[地区]白天非常炎热。

meanings.explanation: A [region] is a particular area or part of the body.

examples.english: He felt pain in the lower [region] of his back.
examples.chinese: 他感到后背下部[部位]有点疼。

examples.english: The doctor carefully examined the [region] around my knee.
examples.chinese: 医生仔细检查了我膝盖周围的[部位]。

examples.english: She has a small scar on the upper [region] of her arm.
examples.chinese: 她手臂上方的[部位]有一道小疤痕。

meanings.explanation: To [regulate] means to control or direct something according to rules or laws, often to keep it orderly or safe.

examples.english: The government makes laws to [regulate] traffic on the roads.
examples.chinese: 政府制定法律来[管制]道路上的交通。

examples.english: Our school has rules to [regulate] student behavior.
examples.chinese: 我们学校有规则来[管理]学生的行为。

examples.english: The city wants to [regulate] the use of plastic bags.
examples.chinese: 这座城市想要[管制]塑料袋的使用。

meanings.explanation: To [regulate] also means to adjust or calibrate something so it works at a certain level or in a certain way.

examples.english: The thermostat can [regulate] the temperature in the room.
examples.chinese: 恒温器可以[调节]房间的温度。

examples.english: My watch helps [regulate] my daily schedule.
examples.chinese: 我的手表帮我[调整]日常生活。

examples.english: She uses a special tool to [regulate] the speed of the machine.
examples.chinese: 她用一种特殊工具来[调节]机器的速度。

meanings.explanation: If you are [relieved], you feel happy and relaxed because something bad that you were worried about has not happened, or because a difficult situation has ended.

examples.english: I was so [relieved] when I found my lost keys.
examples.chinese: 我找到丢失的钥匙时，[松了一口气]。

examples.english: She felt [relieved] after the exam was over.
examples.chinese: 考试结束后，她感到[如释重负]。

examples.english: We were [relieved] to hear that everyone was safe.
examples.chinese: 听到大家都安全，我们[放心了]。

meanings.explanation: If something [relieved] a problem or an unpleasant feeling, it made it less serious or less painful.

examples.english: The doctor [relieved] his pain with some medicine.
