examples.chinese: 医生用药物[减轻]了他的疼痛。

examples.english: A short nap [relieved] his tiredness.
examples.chinese: 小睡了一会儿[缓解]了他的疲劳。

examples.english: The good news [relieved] her worry.
examples.chinese: 好消息[打消了]她的担忧。

meanings.explanation: If you [reduce] something, you make it smaller in amount, size, or degree.

examples.english: Please [reduce] the heat when the soup starts to boil.
examples.chinese: 汤开始沸腾时请[调小]火候。

examples.english: The store decided to [reduce] the price of all old toys.
examples.chinese: 商店决定[降低]所有旧玩具的价格。

examples.english: You should [reduce] the amount of sugar in your tea.
examples.chinese: 你应该[减少]茶里糖的分量。

meanings.explanation: If someone is [reduced] to a particular state, they are made to be in that state, especially a sad or unpleasant one.

examples.english: The sad story [reduced] her to tears.
examples.chinese: 这个悲伤的故事[让]她哭了。

examples.english: The loud noise [reduced] the baby to tears.
examples.chinese: 巨大的噪音[让]宝宝哭了。

examples.english: His mean words [reduced] his friend to silence.
examples.chinese: 他刻薄的话[让]朋友安静了下来。

meanings.explanation: A [reference] is a source of information such as a book or map that you can look at for facts or help.

examples.english: You can use this dictionary as a [reference] for new words.
examples.chinese: 你可以把这本词典当作生词的[参考]。

examples.english: This book is an important [reference] for history students.
examples.chinese: 这本书对学历史的学生来说是重要的[参考资料]。

examples.english: I keep a map in my car for easy [reference] when I drive.
examples.chinese: 我开车时把地图放在车里方便[参考]。

meanings.explanation: When you [reference] something, you look at it for information or mention it in your writing or speech.

examples.english: You must [reference] all the books you used in your essay.
examples.chinese: 你必须在论文中[引用]你用过的所有书籍。

examples.english: I always [reference] my notes when I give a talk.
examples.chinese: 我做演讲时总会[参考]我的笔记。

examples.english: You should [reference] the map when you get lost.
examples.chinese: 你迷路时应该[参考]这张地图。

meanings.explanation: If you [remark] that something is the case, you say it in a natural way, giving your opinion or making an observation.

examples.english: She [remarked] that the cake was delicious.
examples.chinese: 她[说]这个蛋糕真好吃。

examples.english: My dad [remarked] how beautiful the sunset was.
examples.chinese: 爸爸[赞叹]夕阳真美。

examples.english: The teacher [remarked] that he had improved a lot.
examples.chinese: 老师[评价]他进步很大。

meanings.explanation: A [remark] is a spoken or written comment that gives an opinion about something.

examples.english: His kind [remark] made me feel happy.
examples.chinese: 他善意的[话语]让我感到开心。

examples.english: She ignored his rude [remark] and walked away.
examples.chinese: 她无视他粗鲁的[言论]，走开了。

examples.english: The teacher wrote some [remarks] on my homework.
examples.chinese: 老师在我的作业上写了一些[批注]。

meanings.explanation: The [removal] of something is the act of taking it away or moving it from one place to another.

examples.english: The [removal] of the old desk made the room look much bigger.
examples.chinese: 把旧书桌[搬走]之后，房间看起来大了好多。

examples.english: Dad arranged the [removal] of all the boxes from the garage.
examples.chinese: 爸爸安排人把车库里的箱子全部[搬走]。

examples.english: The [removal] of the wall changed the whole house.
examples.chinese: 那面墙被[拆除]后，整个房子都变了样。

meanings.explanation: [Removal] is also the process of getting rid of something that you do not want, such as dirt, hair, or stains.

examples.english: She uses a special cream for hair [removal].
examples.chinese: 她用一种特殊的脱毛膏来[去除]毛发。

examples.english: Stain [removal] is easy if you do it right away.
examples.chinese: 如果你马上处理，污渍[去除]其实很简单。

examples.english: The filter helps with the [removal] of dust in the air.
examples.chinese: 这个过滤器有助于[去除]空气中的灰尘。

meanings.explanation: If something is [renewable], it can be replaced naturally and will not run out when used.

examples.english: Solar power is a [renewable] energy source.
examples.chinese: 太阳能是一种[可再生的]能源。

examples.english: We should use [renewable] resources to protect the Earth.
examples.chinese: 我们应该使用[可再生的]资源来保护地球。

examples.english: Wind is a [renewable] source of power that never runs out.
examples.chinese: 风是一种永远用不完的[可再生]能源。

meanings.explanation: A [relapse] is a return to a bad or unhealthy condition, such as illness or addiction, after a period of improvement.

examples.english: After feeling better for a week, my uncle had a [relapse] of flu.
examples.chinese: 舒服了一周之后，我叔叔的流感出现了[复发]。

examples.english: The doctor said we need to watch for a [relapse] of his symptoms.
examples.chinese: 医生说我们需要留意他症状的[复发]。

examples.english: If you don't finish all your medicine, you might have a [relapse].
examples.chinese: 如果不吃完所有药，你可能会遭遇[复发]。

meanings.explanation: If someone [relapses], they return to a bad or unhealthy condition or habit after a period of improvement.

examples.english: He quit drinking last year, but [relapsed] last month.
examples.chinese: 他去年戒了酒，但上个月又[复发]了。

examples.english: If you stop taking your medicine early, your illness could [relapse].
examples.chinese: 如果提前停药，你的病可能会[复发]。

examples.english: She tried hard to stop biting her nails, but [relapsed] when she felt nervous.
examples.chinese: 她努力戒掉咬指甲的习惯，但紧张的时候还是[复发]了。

meanings.explanation: A [requirement] is something that is needed or necessary for a particular purpose.

examples.english: Water is a basic [requirement] for all living things.
examples.chinese: 水是所有生物的基本[必需品]。

examples.english: Good sleep is a [requirement] for a healthy life.
examples.chinese: 良好的睡眠是健康生活的[必要条件]。

examples.english: Each student has different [requirements] for their school project.
examples.chinese: 每个学生对自己的学校项目有不同的[需求]。

meanings.explanation: A [requirement] is a rule or condition that you must follow or meet.

examples.english: You must meet the age [requirement] to join the club.
examples.chinese: 你必须符合年龄[要求]才能加入俱乐部。

examples.english: The job has strict education [requirements].
examples.chinese: 这份工作有严格的学历[要求]。

examples.english: There is a dress code [requirement] for the party.
examples.chinese: 这个派对有着装[规定]。

meanings.explanation: A [remarkable] person or thing is unusual, impressive, or interesting enough to be easily noticed and talked about.

examples.english: Our teacher told us a [remarkable] story about a little girl who saved her friend.
examples.chinese: 我们老师给我们讲了一个关于小女孩救朋友的[了不起的]故事。

examples.english: My cousin made [remarkable] progress in drawing last year.
examples.chinese: 我表弟去年在绘画上取得了[惊人的]进步。

examples.english: It is [remarkable] that this small tree can grow flowers in winter.
examples.chinese: 这棵小树居然能在冬天开花，真[了不起]。

meanings.explanation: If you [release] someone or something, you set them free or let them go.

examples.english: The boy [release]d the butterfly from the jar.
examples.chinese: 男孩把蝴蝶从罐子里[放]了出来。

examples.english: Please [release] my hand, it hurts.
examples.chinese: 请[松开]我的手，好疼。

examples.english: The zoo will [release] the baby turtle into the sea.
examples.chinese: 动物园将把这只小海龟[放归]大海。

meanings.explanation: If a company or person [release]s something such as a movie, song, or product, they make it available for people to see or buy.

examples.english: The company will [release] a new game next week.
examples.chinese: 这家公司下周将[发布]一款新游戏。

examples.english: The singer [release]d a beautiful new song.
examples.chinese: 这位歌手[发行]了一首好听的新歌。

examples.english: When will they [release] the cartoon movie?
examples.chinese: 他们什么时候[上映]这部动画电影？

meanings.explanation: Someone who is [reserved] does not easily show their feelings or talk about themselves to other people. They tend to be quiet and keep their thoughts private.

examples.english: She is a very [reserved] person and doesn't like to talk about herself.
examples.chinese: 她是个非常[内向]的人，不喜欢谈论自己。

examples.english: He seems [reserved] at first, but he is very friendly once you know him.
examples.chinese: 他一开始看起来有些[沉默寡言]，但熟悉了以后其实很友好。

examples.english: The new girl in class was [reserved] and sat quietly in the corner.
examples.chinese: 班里新来的女孩很[腼腆]，安静地坐在角落里。

meanings.explanation: If something is [reserved], it has been kept or saved for a particular person or purpose, and other people cannot use it.

examples.english: This table is [reserved] for my family's dinner tonight.
examples.chinese: 这张桌子是[预留]给我家今晚聚餐用的。

examples.english: The front two rows of seats are [reserved] for teachers.
examples.chinese: 前两排座位是给老师们[预留]的。

examples.english: I called the restaurant and got a [reserved] table by the window.
examples.chinese: 我给餐厅打了电话，订到了一个靠窗的[预订]位。

meanings.explanation: If you [regret] something that you have done or failed to do, you feel unhappy and sorry about it.

examples.english: I [regret] eating too much candy at the birthday party.
examples.chinese: 我[后悔]在生日派对上吃了太多糖果。

examples.english: Do you [regret] not coming with us to the zoo yesterday?
examples.chinese: 你[后悔]昨天没跟我们一起去动物园吗？

examples.english: My dad says he does not [regret] changing his job.
examples.chinese: 我爸爸说他不[后悔]换工作。

meanings.explanation: A [regret] is a feeling of sadness or disappointment about something that you did or did not do.

examples.english: He felt great [regret] for breaking his favorite toy car.
examples.chinese: 他对弄坏自己最爱的玩具车感到深深的[懊悔]。

examples.english: She expressed her [regret] that she couldn't come to my party.
examples.chinese: 她对不能来参加我的派对表达了[遗憾]。

examples.english: My grandmother's biggest [regret] is never learning to dance.
examples.chinese: 我奶奶最大的[遗憾]是从来没学会跳舞。

meanings.explanation: If someone [represent] a group or team, they act on behalf of that group and speak or decide for them.

examples.english: Our class chose Tom to [represent] us at the school meeting.
examples.chinese: 我们班选汤姆[代表]我们在校会上发言。

examples.english: The lawyer will [represent] Mr. Li in court tomorrow.
examples.chinese: 律师明天将在法庭上[代表]李先生。

examples.english: Five players will [represent] our school in the basketball competition.
examples.chinese: 五名球员将[代表]我们学校参加篮球比赛。

meanings.explanation: To [represent] something means to show or picture it in a painting, photo, or description.

examples.english: This picture [represent]s the beautiful sunset over the ocean.
examples.chinese: 这幅画[展现]了大海上的美丽日落。

examples.english: The artist wanted to [represent] happiness through bright colors.
examples.chinese: 艺术家想用明亮的色彩来[表现]幸福。

examples.english: In the story, the white dove [represent]s peace.
examples.chinese: 在故事中，白鸽[象征]和平。

meanings.explanation: If something [relieves] pain, stress, or an uncomfortable feeling, it makes it less strong or removes it completely.

examples.english: This medicine will help [relieve] your headache.
examples.chinese: 这种药会帮助[缓解]你的头疼。

examples.english: A nice walk can [relieve] your stress after school.
examples.chinese: 一次愉快的散步可以[缓解]你放学后的压力。

examples.english: Opening the window can [relieve] the stuffy feeling in the room.
examples.chinese: 打开窗户可以[缓解]房间里的闷热感。

meanings.explanation: If you [relieve] someone who has been doing a job or duty, you take over from them so they can rest or leave.

examples.english: The new lifeguard will [relieve] the old one at noon.
examples.chinese: 新救生员会在中午[接替]老救生员的工作。

examples.english: My mom will [relieve] my aunt from watching the baby.
examples.chinese: 我妈妈会过来[接替]我姑姑看宝宝。

examples.english: He came to [relieve] me because I was feeling sick.
examples.chinese: 因为我不舒服，他过来[接替]了我的工作。

meanings.explanation: If you [replace] one thing or person with another, you remove the first one and put the second one in its place.

examples.english: I need to [replace] the old light bulb with a new one.
examples.chinese: 我得用一个新灯泡来[替换]旧灯泡。

examples.english: Mom will [replace] the broken cup tomorrow.
examples.chinese: 妈妈明天会[换掉]那个摔坏的杯子。

examples.english: Can you [replace] the batteries in the remote control?
examples.chinese: 你能把遥控器里的电池[换一下]吗？

meanings.explanation: To [replace] someone means to take their position or job when they leave.

examples.english: Miss Li will [replace] our math teacher next week.
examples.chinese: 下周李老师会来[接替]我们的数学老师。

examples.english: Who will [replace] the team leader when he is away?
examples.chinese: 队长不在的时候谁来[代替]他呢？

examples.english: The new student will [replace] Tom in the school play.
examples.chinese: 那个新同学将在校剧中[顶替]汤姆的角色。

meanings.explanation: [Resistance] is the act of fighting against something or refusing to accept something that you do not agree with.

examples.english: The people put up strong [resistance] against the unfair rules.
examples.chinese: 人们奋起[反抗]那些不公平的规定。

examples.english: There was little [resistance] to the new school uniform policy.
examples.chinese: 新的校服政策几乎没有遇到[抵制]。

examples.english: The hero led the [resistance] against the invaders.
examples.chinese: 英雄带领人们[抵抗]入侵者。

meanings.explanation: [Resistance] is the ability of your body to fight off germs or diseases, or the opposing force that slows down something like wind or water.

examples.english: Eating fruits helps build up your body's [resistance] to colds.
examples.chinese: 吃水果有助于增强身体对感冒的[抵抗力]。

examples.english: The smooth shape of the car reduces air [resistance].
examples.chinese: 汽车流线型设计减少了空气[阻力]。

examples.english: Some plants have natural [resistance] to bugs.
examples.chinese: 有些植物天生对虫子有[抵抗力]。

meanings.explanation: If you [reorganized] something such as a room, team, or company, you changed the way it is arranged or structured to make it work more effectively.

examples.english: Mom [reorganized] our kitchen this weekend.
examples.chinese: 妈妈这周末[重新整理]了我们的厨房。

examples.english: The boss [reorganized] the whole team last month.
examples.chinese: 老板上个月[重组]了整个团队。

examples.english: I [reorganized] my bookcase after buying new books.
examples.chinese: 我买了新书后[重新整理]了我的书架。

meanings.explanation: Something that is [reorganized] has been changed in its arrangement or structure to work more effectively.

examples.english: The [reorganized] company is now making more money.
examples.chinese: 这家[重组后的]公司现在赚了更多钱。

examples.english: Our [reorganized] classroom looks much tidier.
examples.chinese: 我们[重新整理后的]教室看起来整洁多了。

examples.english: The [reorganized] team won the school football game.
examples.chinese: 这支[重组后的]队伍赢得了学校的足球比赛。

meanings.explanation: A [respect] is a feeling of deep admiration for someone or something because of their good qualities, abilities, or achievements. It can also mean due regard for the feelings, wishes, or rights of others.

examples.english: I have a lot of [respect] for my teacher because she always helps us.
examples.chinese: 我非常[尊敬]我的老师，因为她总是帮助我们。

examples.english: The old man earned the [respect] of everyone in the village.
examples.chinese: 那位老人赢得了村里每个人的[尊重]。

examples.english: Children should show [respect] to their parents and older people.
examples.chinese: 孩子们应该对父母和长辈表示[尊敬]。

meanings.explanation: If you [respect] someone, you have a good opinion of their character or ideas, and you treat them politely and with consideration. It also means to accept the importance of someone's rights, feelings, or wishes.

examples.english: We should [respect] other people's opinions even if we don't agree.
examples.chinese: 即使不同意，我们也应该[尊重]别人的看法。

examples.english: I [respect] my mom because she works so hard for our family.
examples.chinese: 我[尊敬]我的妈妈，因为她为我们的家付出了这么多。

examples.english: Please [respect] the rules when you are in the library.
examples.chinese: 在图书馆时请[遵守]规定。

meanings.explanation: A [result] is something that happens or exists because of something else that has happened.

examples.english: What was the [result] of your English test?
examples.chinese: 你英语考试[结果]怎么样？

examples.english: She worked very hard, and the [result] was a big smile on her face.
examples.chinese: 她非常努力，[结果]脸上露出了灿烂的笑容。

examples.english: We will know the [result] of the game tomorrow.
examples.chinese: 我们明天就会知道比赛的[结果]。

meanings.explanation: If something [result]s in a particular situation, that situation is caused by it.

examples.english: Eating too much candy can [result] in a stomachache.
examples.chinese: 吃太多糖可能会[导致]肚子疼。

examples.english: The heavy rain [result]ed in the school trip being cancelled.
examples.chinese: 大雨[导致]学校春游被取消了。

examples.english: His careless mistake [result]ed in a low score.
examples.chinese: 他的粗心错误[导致]了低分。

meanings.explanation: To [restore] something means to bring it back to its original or normal condition after it has been damaged or broken.

examples.english: My dad will [restore] the old chair to make it look new.
examples.chinese: 我爸爸会把旧椅子[修复]得像新的一样。

examples.english: They worked hard to [restore] the historic building.
examples.chinese: 他们努力[修复]这座历史建筑。

examples.english: The dentist can [restore] your broken tooth.
examples.chinese: 牙医能把你断掉的牙齿[修复]好。

meanings.explanation: If you [restore] something that was lost or taken away, you give it back or return it to its owner.

examples.english: The police will [restore] your lost bike tomorrow.
examples.chinese: 警察明天会把你的自行车[归还]给你。

examples.english: Please [restore] my book after you finish reading it.
examples.chinese: 看完书后请把它[归还]给我。

examples.english: Good sleep can [restore] your energy.
examples.chinese: 良好的睡眠能帮你[恢复]精力。

meanings.explanation: A [retreat] is a quiet, peaceful place where you go to rest and relax, usually away from busy city life.

examples.english: Our family loves spending weekends at our small [retreat] in the mountains.
examples.chinese: 我们全家喜欢在山里的那个小[度假屋]度周末。

examples.english: The old house by the lake became their favorite [retreat].
examples.chinese: 湖边的那栋老房子成了他们最爱的[休养地]。

examples.english: She went to a yoga [retreat] for a whole week to relax.
examples.chinese: 她去参加了一个瑜伽[静修营]，整整放松了一周。

meanings.explanation: When you [retreat], you move away from a place or situation, often because it is dangerous, difficult, or uncomfortable.

examples.english: The army had to [retreat] after losing the battle.
examples.chinese: 军队在战斗失败后不得不[撤退]。

examples.english: When the dog came near, the cat quickly [retreated] behind the sofa.
examples.chinese: 当狗走近时，猫迅速[退到]了沙发后面。

examples.english: He decided to [retreat] from the busy city and move to the countryside.
examples.chinese: 他决定从繁忙的城市[退出]，搬到乡下去。

meanings.explanation: If you are [responsible] for something, you have a duty to take care of it or control it.

examples.english: Parents are [responsible] for their children's safety.
examples.chinese: 父母对孩子的安全[负责]。

examples.english: She is [responsible] for managing the team.
examples.chinese: 她[负责]管理这个团队。

examples.english: You are [responsible] for finishing your homework on time.
examples.chinese: 你[负责]按时完成作业。

meanings.explanation: Someone or something that is [responsible] for an event or situation caused it or is the reason for it.

examples.english: Smoking is [responsible] for many serious health problems.
examples.chinese: 吸烟是许多严重健康问题的[成因]。

examples.english: Who is [responsible] for this broken window?
examples.chinese: 谁[弄坏了]这扇窗户？

examples.english: The rain is [responsible] for the delay of the game.
examples.chinese: 雨天是比赛推迟的[原因]。

meanings.explanation: The [Renaissance] is the period in Europe between the 14th and 17th centuries when there was a great revival of interest in art, learning, and science.

examples.english: Many beautiful paintings were created during the [Renaissance].
examples.chinese: [文艺复兴]时期创作了许多美丽的画作。

examples.english: The [Renaissance] changed the way people thought about art and science.
examples.chinese: [文艺复兴]改变了人们对艺术和科学的看法。

examples.english: We learned about famous artists from the [Renaissance].
examples.chinese: 我们了解了许多来自[文艺复兴]时期的著名艺术家。

meanings.explanation: A [renaissance] is a situation in which something becomes popular, successful, or important again after a period of decline.

examples.english: The old town is having a [renaissance].
examples.chinese: 老城区正在[复兴]。

examples.english: Traditional music is experiencing a [renaissance].
examples.chinese: 传统音乐正迎来[复兴]。

examples.english: The park is going through a [renaissance] with new trees and benches.
examples.chinese: 这个公园种了新树、添了新长椅，正在[复兴]。

meanings.explanation: If you [require] something, you need it for a particular purpose or in order to do something.

examples.english: This recipe [requires] three eggs.
examples.chinese: 这个食谱[需要]三个鸡蛋。

examples.english: Plants [require] sunlight to grow.
examples.chinese: 植物[需要]阳光才能生长。

examples.english: This job [requires] a lot of patience.
examples.chinese: 这份工作[需要]很多耐心。

meanings.explanation: If a rule, law, or person in authority [requires] something, they make it necessary for you to do it.

examples.english: The school [requires] all students to wear uniforms.
examples.chinese: 学校[要求]所有学生穿校服。

examples.english: The law [requires] drivers to wear seat belts.
examples.chinese: 法律规定司机[必须]系好安全带。

examples.english: My teacher [requires] us to finish our homework before Friday.
examples.chinese: 老师[要求]我们周五前把作业做完。

meanings.explanation: If you [reserve] something such as a table, seat, or room, you arrange in advance for it to be kept for your use so it cannot be taken by anyone else.

examples.english: I want to [reserve] a table for four at our favorite restaurant.
examples.chinese: 我想在我们最喜欢的餐厅[预订]一张四人桌。

examples.english: We need to [reserve] our tickets early for the school trip.
examples.chinese: 我们需要提前[预订]学校旅行的门票。

examples.english: You must [reserve] a hotel room before our holiday starts.
examples.chinese: 我们度假开始前，你必须[预订]好酒店房间。

meanings.explanation: A [reserve] is an area of land that is kept protected to keep wild animals, plants, and their natural home safe.

examples.english: We saw many beautiful birds at the nature [reserve].
examples.chinese: 我们在自然[保护区]看到了很多漂亮的鸟儿。

examples.english: This forest [reserve] protects many rare animals.
examples.chinese: 这片森林[保护区]保护着许多稀有动物。

examples.english: The government created this [reserve] to save endangered pandas.
examples.chinese: 政府建立这片[保护区]来拯救濒危大熊猫。

meanings.explanation: If someone or something [remains] in a particular state or condition, they continue to be in that state and do not change.

examples.english: Please [remain] in your seat during the show.
examples.chinese: 演出期间请[待在]座位上。

examples.english: We should [remain] quiet in the library.
examples.chinese: 我们在图书馆应该[保持]安静。

examples.english: My grandma [remains] healthy even at age 80.
examples.chinese: 我奶奶八十岁了还[保持]健康。

meanings.explanation: If something [remains] when other parts have been removed or used, it is still present or left over.

examples.english: Only a few candies [remain] in the box.
examples.chinese: 盒子里只[剩下]几颗糖了。

examples.english: After the party, some food [remained] on the table.
examples.chinese: 派对结束后，一些食物还[剩]在桌子上。

examples.english: The old church still [remains] in the village.
examples.chinese: 那个老教堂还[留]在村子里。

meanings.explanation: If you [revert] to a previous state, condition, or way of behaving, you go back to it after a period of change.

examples.english: After the storm passed, the weather [reverted] to normal.
examples.chinese: 暴风雨过后，天气[恢复了]正常。

examples.english: He stopped exercising for a month and [reverted] to his old eating habits.
examples.chinese: 他停了一个月运动，又[回到了]以前的饮食习惯。

examples.english: The garden looked messy because it [reverted] to weeds.
examples.chinese: 花园看起来很乱，因为又[长回了]杂草。

meanings.explanation: If you [revert] to a topic or subject, you start talking about it again.

examples.english: Let's eat first and then [revert] to this topic later.
examples.chinese: 我们先吃饭，稍后再[回到]这个话题。

examples.english: She kept [reverting] to the same question during the meeting.
examples.chinese: 她在会议中一直[反复提起]同一个问题。

examples.english: The teacher said we would [revert] to this chapter next week.
examples.chinese: 老师说我们下周会[重新讨论]这一章。

meanings.explanation: If you [restrict] something, you keep it within certain fixed limits.

examples.english: My mom [restricts] how much candy I can eat each day.
examples.chinese: 我妈妈[限制]了我每天能吃多少糖。

examples.english: The park [restricts] the number of visitors every day.
examples.chinese: 这个公园[限制]每天的游客数量。

examples.english: You should [restrict] the time you spend playing games.
examples.chinese: 你应该[限制]自己玩游戏的时间。

meanings.explanation: If you [restrict] someone, you limit their freedom of movement or action.

examples.english: The small cage [restricts] the bear's movement.
examples.chinese: 这个小笼子[限制]了熊的活动。

examples.english: When I had the flu, the doctor [restricted] me to my room.
examples.chinese: 我得流感时，医生[限制]我只能待在房间里。

examples.english: The new rule [restricts] kids from entering that deep pool alone.
examples.chinese: 新规定[限制]小孩子单独进入那个深水池。

meanings.explanation: A [rhyme] is a short poem or song for children, with words that have the same sound at the end of each line.

examples.english: My mother sings me a [rhyme] before I go to sleep.
examples.chinese: 我妈妈会在睡前给我[唱儿歌]。

examples.english: The children love to read and recite nursery [rhymes] together.
examples.chinese: 孩子们喜欢一起朗读和背诵[童谣]。

examples.english: Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star is a famous [rhyme].
examples.chinese: 《一闪一闪小星星》是一首著名的[儿歌]。

meanings.explanation: If one word [rhymes] with another, they have the same sound at the end.

examples.english: Cat [rhymes] with hat because they both end in -at.
examples.chinese: Cat和hat[押韵]，因为它们都以-at结尾。

examples.english: Can you find a word that [rhymes] with blue?
examples.chinese: 你能找到一个和blue[押韵]的词吗？

examples.english: Dog and frog [rhyme] nicely together.
examples.chinese: Dog和frog在一起[押韵押]得很好。

meanings.explanation: To [reveal] something means to make something known or show something that was previously hidden, secret, or unknown.

examples.english: She opened the curtain to [reveal] a beautiful garden outside.
examples.chinese: 她拉开窗帘，[露出]了外面美丽的花园。

examples.english: The detective will [reveal] who stole the painting at the end of the story.
examples.chinese: 侦探会在故事结尾[揭晓]是谁偷了那幅画。

examples.english: Don't [reveal] your birthday surprise to Tom.
examples.chinese: 别把生日惊喜[透露]给汤姆。

meanings.explanation: If you [revive] someone who has fainted or is unconscious, you bring them back to consciousness. If something [revives] or you [revive] it, it becomes active or successful again after being inactive or unsuccessful.

examples.english: The doctor managed to [revive] the patient.
examples.chinese: 医生设法把病人[救醒]了。

examples.english: A cup of coffee helped me [revive] after lunch.
examples.chinese: 一杯咖啡帮我午餐后[恢复]了精神。

examples.english: The team is trying to [revive] their sales this quarter.
examples.chinese: 团队正在努力[重振]本季度的销售业绩。

meanings.explanation: A [resource] is a supply of something such as water, materials, or energy that is available to use when needed.

examples.english: Water is an important natural [resource].
examples.chinese: 水是一种重要的自然[资源]。

examples.english: Our school has many learning [resource]s for students.
examples.chinese: 我们学校为学生提供了很多学习[资源]。

examples.english: We don't have enough [resource]s to build a big treehouse.
examples.chinese: 我们没有足够的[资源]建一座大树屋。

meanings.explanation: Your [resource]s are the money, property, and assets that you have available to use when you need them.

examples.english: My family doesn't have enough [resource]s to go on vacation this year.
examples.chinese: 我们家今年没有足够的[财力]去度假。

examples.english: The city uses its [resource]s to build new playgrounds.
examples.chinese: 市政府动用自身[资源]修建新的游乐场。

examples.english: He spent all his [resource]s to open his cookie shop.
examples.chinese: 他倾尽所有[财力]开了自己的曲奇店。

meanings.explanation: [Roughly] means approximately or about, not exactly.

examples.english: There are [roughly] twenty students in my class.
examples.chinese: 我班上[大约]有二十个学生。

examples.english: The movie is [roughly] two hours long.
examples.chinese: 这部电影时长[大约]有两小时。

examples.english: We spent [roughly] fifty dollars on snacks.
examples.chinese: 我们买零食[大约]花了五十美元。

meanings.explanation: If you do something [roughly], you do it in a rough or violent way.

examples.english: Please don't play [roughly] with the puppy.
examples.chinese: 请别[使劲]折腾小狗。

examples.english: He [roughly] grabbed my arm.
examples.chinese: 他[粗鲁地]拽住了我的胳膊。

examples.english: The box was [roughly] thrown into the truck.
examples.chinese: 箱子被[粗暴地]扔进了卡车。

meanings.explanation: If you [run into] someone, you meet them by chance and without planning to, usually in a public place.

examples.english: I [ran into] my old friend at the supermarket yesterday.
examples.chinese: 我昨天在超市[碰巧遇到了]我的老朋友。

examples.english: She [ran into] her teacher while walking in the park.
examples.chinese: 她在公园散步时[偶遇了]她的老师。

examples.english: We [ran into] each other at the bus stop.
examples.chinese: 我们在公交车站[碰见了]彼此。

meanings.explanation: If you [run into] problems or difficulties, you start to experience them while you are doing something.

examples.english: We [ran into] some problems when we tried to fix the computer.
examples.chinese: 我们试着修电脑的时候[遇到了]一些问题。

examples.english: They [ran into] bad weather on their way to the beach.
examples.chinese: 他们在去海滩的路上[碰上了]坏天气。

examples.english: I [ran into] trouble when I lost my key.
examples.chinese: 我把钥匙弄丢的时候[碰到了]麻烦。

meanings.explanation: [Rest] is a period of time when you relax, sleep, or stop doing things because you are tired, so that you can feel better and have more energy again.

examples.english: You look tired. Go home and get some [rest].
examples.chinese: 你看起来很累。回家[休息]一下吧。

examples.english: After a long walk, we took a short [rest] under a big tree.
examples.chinese: 走了很长一段路后，我们在大树下短暂[休息]了一会儿。

examples.english: The doctor says I need to get plenty of [rest].
examples.chinese: 医生说我需要多[休息]。

meanings.explanation: If you [rest], you stop working, playing, or moving for a while to relax or sleep so that you can get back your strength and energy.

examples.english: After running, you should [rest] for a few minutes.
examples.chinese: 跑完步后你应该[休息]几分钟。

examples.english: My mom is [resting] on the sofa right now.
examples.chinese: 我妈妈正在沙发上[休息]。

examples.english: You should [rest] your eyes after reading for a long time.
examples.chinese: 长时间看书后你应该让眼睛[休息]一下。

meanings.explanation: [Ruthlessness] is the quality of being completely merciless and cruel, without any pity or concern for others.

examples.english: The villain in the story showed great [ruthlessness].
examples.chinese: 故事里的反派表现得非常[残忍]。

examples.english: Her [ruthlessness] surprised everyone in the game.
examples.chinese: 她在游戏中的[无情]让所有人都感到惊讶。

examples.english: We should not praise [ruthlessness] in our daily life.
examples.chinese: 我们在日常生活中不应该赞扬[冷酷无情]。

meanings.explanation: If you [save] someone or something, you help them to avoid harm, danger, or loss.

examples.english: The firefighter [saved] the little cat from the tree.
examples.chinese: 消防员把小猫从树上[救]了下来。

examples.english: An umbrella can [save] you from getting wet in the rain.
examples.chinese: 一把伞能让你在下雨时不被[淋湿]。

examples.english: The doctor [saved] the old man's life.
examples.chinese: 医生[救]了那位老人的命。

meanings.explanation: If you [save] money or resources, you keep them instead of spending or using them, often for future use.

examples.english: I [save] some of my pocket money every week.
examples.chinese: 我每周都会[存]一些零花钱。

examples.english: Turning off the lights can [save] electricity.
examples.chinese: 关灯可以[节约]用电。

examples.english: She is [saving] money to buy a new bike.
examples.chinese: 她正在[攒]钱买一辆新自行车。

meanings.explanation: A [sample] is a small part or amount of something that is shown or tested to find out what the rest is like.

examples.english: The nice lady at the store gave me a free [sample] of chocolate.
examples.chinese: 商店里那位友善的女士给了我一块免费的巧克力[样品]。

examples.english: This tiny [sample] of rock came from the moon.
examples.chinese: 这块小小的岩石[样本]来自月球。

examples.english: My mom likes to try [sample]s of new perfumes before she buys one.
examples.chinese: 我妈妈喜欢在买之前先试试新款香水的[小样]。

meanings.explanation: If you [sample] food or drink, you try a small amount of it in order to see what it tastes like.

examples.english: May I [sample] your delicious homemade soup?
examples.chinese: 我可以[尝尝]你做的美味汤吗？

examples.english: The visitors [sample]d different kinds of cheese at the farm.
examples.chinese: 游客们在农场[品尝]了不同种类的奶酪。

examples.english: Come in and [sample] our fresh apple juice!
examples.chinese: 进来[尝尝]我们新鲜的苹果汁吧！

meanings.explanation: If you [reverse] something, you change it to the opposite direction, state, or order.

examples.english: Please [reverse] your car into the driveway.
examples.chinese: 请把你的车[倒]进车道。

examples.english: Can you [reverse] the order of these toys?
examples.chinese: 你能把这些玩具的顺序[颠倒]过来吗？

examples.english: Let's [reverse] direction and go back home.
examples.chinese: 我们[调转]方向回家吧。

meanings.explanation: The [reverse] of something is the opposite side, direction, or order to the usual one.

examples.english: Please write your name on the [reverse] of the postcard.
examples.chinese: 请把你的名字写在明信片的[背面]。

examples.english: If you read from the end to the start, that is [reverse].
examples.chinese: 如果你从末尾往开头读，那就是[倒序]。

examples.english: We can see a star on the [reverse] of the coin.
examples.chinese: 我们可以在硬币的[背面]看到一颗星星。

meanings.explanation: If you [resist] something, you try to stop it from happening or you fight against it.

examples.english: The little tree [resisted] the strong wind all night.
examples.chinese: 那棵小树整夜[抵抗]着大风。

examples.english: The soldiers bravely [resisted] the enemy attack.
examples.chinese: 士兵们勇敢地[抵抗]了敌人的进攻。

examples.english: We should always [resist] unfair rules at school.
examples.chinese: 在学校我们应该始终[抵制]不公平的规定。

meanings.explanation: If you [resist] doing something, you stop yourself from doing it even though you really want to.

examples.english: I can't [resist] eating chocolate chip cookies.
examples.chinese: 我[忍不住]吃巧克力曲奇饼干。

examples.english: She [resisted] the urge to watch TV and finished her homework first.
examples.chinese: 她[忍住]了看电视的冲动，先完成了作业。

examples.english: Please try to [resist] the temptation to touch the wet paint.
examples.chinese: 请试着[忍住]不去摸未干的油漆。

meanings.explanation: A [rigid] object is stiff and does not bend, change shape, or move easily.

examples.english: This [rigid] plastic ruler doesn't bend when I press it hard.
examples.chinese: 我用力按这把[坚硬的]塑料尺，它也不会弯。

examples.english: The chair has a [rigid] metal frame that never breaks.
examples.chinese: 这把椅子有一个[坚固的]金属框架，从来不会断。

examples.english: Grandpa uses a [rigid] walking stick when he climbs hills.
examples.chinese: 爷爷爬山时会用一根[坚硬的]拐杖。

meanings.explanation: A [rigid] rule, system, or person's attitude is strict and not able or willing to change.

examples.english: Our teacher has [rigid] rules about homework deadlines.
examples.chinese: 我们老师对作业截止日期有[严格的]规定。

examples.english: My grandpa is very [rigid] and never changes his mind.
examples.chinese: 我爷爷很[固执]，从来不会改变想法。

examples.english: This [rigid] school rule doesn't let us bring snacks to class.
examples.chinese: 这条[死板的]校规不允许我们带零食去教室。

meanings.explanation: A [risk] is the possibility that something bad, dangerous, or harmful may happen.

examples.english: There is a [risk] of rain today, so take an umbrella.
examples.chinese: 今天有下雨的[风险]，记得带把伞。

examples.english: Playing near the road is a big [risk].
examples.chinese: 在马路边玩有很大的[危险]。

examples.english: He took a [risk] and tried the strange food.
examples.chinese: 他冒了一次[险]，尝了尝那种奇怪的食物。

meanings.explanation: If you [risk] something, you put it in danger or do something that might cause harm to it.

examples.english: Don't [risk] your life by running across the street.
examples.chinese: 不要在马路上乱跑去[冒]生命[危险]。

examples.english: She didn't want to [risk] losing her favorite toy.
examples.chinese: 她不想[冒]失去心爱玩具的[危险]。

examples.english: We can't [risk] being late for school.
examples.chinese: 我们不能[冒]上学迟到的[险]。

meanings.explanation: If a person or thing is [safe], they are not in danger and cannot be harmed or lost.

examples.english: We should stay [safe] by looking both ways before crossing the street.
examples.chinese: 我们过马路前要左右看看，这样才能保证[安全]。

examples.english: Put your money in a [safe] place where nobody can find it.
examples.chinese: 把钱放在没人能找到的[安全]地方。

examples.english: The kitten is [safe] now. We found its mother.
examples.chinese: 小猫现在[安全]了，我们找到了它妈妈。

meanings.explanation: A [safe] is a strong metal box with a lock, used to keep money and valuable things secure.

examples.english: Dad keeps his important papers in a [safe].
examples.chinese: 爸爸把重要文件放在[保险箱]里。

examples.english: The restaurant has a big [safe] behind the counter.
examples.chinese: 这家餐厅柜台后面有个大[保险柜]。

examples.english: Mom put the jewelry in the [safe] before we went on vacation.
examples.chinese: 妈妈度假前把首饰锁进了[保险箱]。

meanings.explanation: A [reward] is something that you are given because you have done something good, worked hard, or achieved something.

examples.english: She got a [reward] for finding the lost dog.
examples.chinese: 她因为找到了走失的小狗，得到了一份[奖励]。

examples.english: Good grades are a [reward] for hard work.
examples.chinese: 好成绩是努力学习的[回报]。

examples.english: The teacher gave him a small [reward] for helping other students.
examples.chinese: 老师给了他一小份[奖励]，因为他帮助了其他同学。

meanings.explanation: If you [reward] someone, you give them something because they have done something good or worked hard.

examples.english: Mom will [reward] me if I clean my room.
examples.chinese: 如果我打扫房间，妈妈会[奖励]我。

examples.english: The company [reward]ed its best workers with a trip.
examples.chinese: 公司用一次旅行来[奖励]最优秀的员工。

examples.english: My dad [reward]s me with ice cream when I finish my homework.
examples.chinese: 我写完作业时，爸爸会[奖励]我一杯冰淇淋。

meanings.explanation: A [rostrum] is a raised platform or podium used for public speaking, such as at a school assembly or meeting.

examples.english: The teacher stood at the [rostrum] to give the morning announcement.
examples.chinese: 老师站在[讲台]上做晨间讲话。

examples.english: Our class representative walked up to the [rostrum] to make a speech.
examples.chinese: 我们班长走到[讲台]前发表演讲。

examples.english: The principal spoke from the [rostrum] during the school assembly.
examples.chinese: 校长在全校大会上站在[演讲台]上讲话。

meanings.explanation: If you [scratch] something, you rub your skin with your fingernails, usually because it feels itchy.

examples.english: My arm itches a lot, so I need to [scratch] it.
examples.chinese: 我的胳膊特别痒，我得[挠一挠]。

examples.english: The little cat is [scratching] its ear with its paw.
examples.chinese: 小猫正在用爪子[挠]耳朵。

examples.english: Mom told me not to [scratch] the mosquito bite.
examples.chinese: 妈妈叫我别去[挠]蚊子咬的包。

meanings.explanation: A [scratch] is a small cut or mark on the surface of something, usually made by something sharp.

examples.english: Oh no, there is a [scratch] on my new phone screen!
examples.chinese: 糟了，我的新手机屏幕上有一道[划痕]！

examples.english: The cat left a [scratch] on my hand.
examples.chinese: 猫在我手上抓了一道[伤痕]。

examples.english: Dad was upset when he found a [scratch] on his car door.
examples.chinese: 爸爸发现车门上有一道[划痕]，很不高兴。

meanings.explanation: A [rough] surface is not smooth or flat. It feels uneven or bumpy when you touch it.

examples.english: The stone has a [rough] surface.
examples.chinese: 这块石头表面很[粗糙]。

examples.english: The old wooden floor felt [rough] under my feet.
examples.chinese: 脚下的旧木地板踩起来很[粗糙]。

examples.english: The cat's tongue is [rough] when it licks my hand.
examples.chinese: 猫舔我手的时候，它的舌头很[粗糙]。

meanings.explanation: If you have a [rough] idea, plan, or drawing of something, it is not exact or detailed, only approximate.

examples.english: Can you give me a [rough] idea of the price?
examples.chinese: 你能告诉我[大概]的价格吗？

examples.english: We made a [rough] plan for the party.
examples.chinese: 我们为派对做了一个[大致]的计划。

examples.english: Here is a [rough] drawing of the map.
examples.chinese: 这是一张[粗略]的地图草图。

meanings.explanation: If something is [secured], it is firmly fixed or fastened in place so that it cannot move, or it is protected and made safe from harm or loss.

examples.english: The ladder is [secured] to the wall with strong ropes.
examples.chinese: 梯子用粗绳[固定]在了墙上。

examples.english: Keep your money in a [secured] place at home.
examples.chinese: 把你的钱放在家里一个[安全的]地方。

examples.english: The dog must be [secured] inside the fence.
examples.chinese: 必须把狗[关]在栅栏里面。

meanings.explanation: If you [secured] something, you obtained it or achieved it, often after a lot of effort.

examples.english: She [secured] the last ticket to the movie.
examples.chinese: 她[抢到]了最后一张电影票。

examples.english: Our team [secured] first place in the school competition.
examples.chinese: 我们队在学校的比赛中[夺得]了第一名。

examples.english: He [secured] a summer job at the ice cream shop.
examples.chinese: 他在冰淇淋店[找到]了一份暑期工作。

meanings.explanation: A [seed] is the small hard part produced by a plant, from which a new plant can grow.

examples.english: We planted some [seeds] in the garden last spring.
examples.chinese: 去年春天，我们在花园里种了一些[种子]。

examples.english: This apple has tiny black [seeds] inside.
examples.chinese: 这个苹果里面有细小的黑色[籽]。

examples.english: The little girl put a sunflower [seed] in a small pot.
examples.chinese: 小女孩把一粒向日葵[种子]放进小花盆里。

meanings.explanation: If you [seed] a piece of land, you plant seeds in it so that plants will grow.

examples.english: The farmer wants to [seed] the field before it rains.
examples.chinese: 农民想趁着下雨前把这块地[播种]。

examples.english: We plan to [seed] the backyard with grass next week.
examples.chinese: 我们打算下周在后院[撒种]种草。

examples.english: It is the right time to [seed] the vegetable garden.
examples.chinese: 现在是给菜园[播种]的好时候。

meanings.explanation: [Savageness] refers to the quality of being extremely fierce, cruel, or violent.

examples.english: Everyone was shocked by the [savageness] of the dog's attack.
examples.chinese: 所有人都被这只狗攻击的[凶狠程度]震惊了。

examples.english: The [savageness] of the big storm surprised all the villagers.
examples.chinese: 这场大暴风雨的[凶猛]让所有村民都吃了一惊。

examples.english: The [savageness] in his voice made the little girl cry.
examples.chinese: 他语气里的[凶狠]把小女孩弄哭了。

meanings.explanation: [Savageness] can also describe the quality of being wild, untamed, or not civilized, often used to talk about wild nature or animals.

examples.english: The [savageness] of the deep jungle makes many people afraid to go in.
examples.chinese: 深山丛林的[野性]让很多人不敢进入。

examples.english: The documentary showed the [savageness] of wild animals in the mountains.
examples.chinese: 这部纪录片展现了山中野生动物的[野性]。

examples.english: Long ago, people feared the [savageness] of unknown wild lands.
examples.chinese: 很久以前，人们害怕未知荒野的[荒蛮]。

meanings.explanation: If something [scares] you, it makes you feel afraid or frightened.

examples.english: The loud thunder [scares] my little sister.
examples.chinese: 巨大的雷声[吓到了]我的小妹妹。

examples.english: Don't [scare] the cat with that loud noise.
examples.chinese: 别用那么大的声音[吓]那只猫。

examples.english: The spooky story [scared] all the children.
examples.chinese: 那个恐怖故事把所有孩子都[吓到了]。

meanings.explanation: A [scare] is a sudden feeling of fear or worry that you experience.

examples.english: You gave me a real [scare] when you jumped out!
examples.chinese: 你突然跳出来，真是[吓]了我一大跳！

examples.english: We had a [scare] when we couldn't find the dog.
examples.chinese: 找不到狗狗的时候，我们[吓]了一跳。

examples.english: The false alarm caused a big [scare] at school.
examples.chinese: 误报在学校里引起了不小的[恐慌]。

meanings.explanation: If something [ruins] another thing, it damages or destroys it completely so that it can no longer be used or enjoyed.

examples.english: The heavy rain [ruined] our picnic in the park.
examples.chinese: 大雨[毁了]我们在公园的野餐。

examples.english: Don't spill chocolate on the paper, you'll [ruin] my drawing.
examples.chinese: 别把巧克力洒在纸上，你会[毁了]我的画。

examples.english: Eating too many candies can [ruin] your teeth.
examples.chinese: 吃太多糖会[毁了]你的牙齿。

meanings.explanation: A [ruin] is what remains of a building, city, or old place after it has been destroyed or decayed over time.

examples.english: We visited the [ruins] of an old castle during our trip.
examples.chinese: 我们旅行时参观了一座古老城堡的[废墟]。

examples.english: After the big fire, the whole house was left in [ruins].
examples.chinese: 大火过后，整栋房子都成了[废墟]。

examples.english: We found some old coins near the [ruins] by the river.
examples.chinese: 我们在河边的[废墟]附近找到了一些古钱币。

meanings.explanation: A [script] is a written text of a play, movie, or broadcast where the lines and actions are recorded.

examples.english: The teacher asked us to read the [script] for the school play.
examples.chinese: 老师让我们读学校话剧的[剧本]。

examples.english: He wrote a [script] for a new movie.
examples.chinese: 他为一部新电影写了[剧本]。

examples.english: I practice my lines from the [script] every day.
examples.chinese: 我每天练习[剧本]里的台词。

meanings.explanation: To [script] means to write a script for a movie, play, or broadcast.

examples.english: She [scripted] a short video for her YouTube channel.
examples.chinese: 她为油管频道[写剧本]拍了一个短视频。

examples.english: The movie was [scripted] by a famous writer.
examples.chinese: 这部电影由一位著名作家[编剧]。

examples.english: They [scripted] the whole scene before filming.
examples.chinese: 他们在拍摄前把整个场景的[剧本]写好了。

meanings.explanation: If you [seize] something, you take hold of it suddenly and firmly.

examples.english: She managed to [seize] the falling cup before it broke.
examples.chinese: 她设法[接住]了那个快要掉落的杯子。

examples.english: He [seized] the rope and pulled the boat closer.
examples.chinese: 他[抓住]绳子，把船拉近了些。

examples.english: The dog [seized] the bone in its teeth and ran away.
examples.chinese: 狗用牙[叼住]了那根骨头，然后跑开了。

meanings.explanation: If someone [seizes] a place or takes control of something, they take control of it by force or sudden action.

examples.english: The army [seized] the capital city overnight.
examples.chinese: 军队一夜之间[占领]了首都。

examples.english: Police [seized] a large amount of illegal drugs.
examples.chinese: 警察[查获]了大量毒品。

examples.english: The group tried to [seize] control of the website.
examples.chinese: 那个组织试图[夺取]网站的控制权。

meanings.explanation: If you [scatter] things, you drop or put them in different places over a wide area instead of keeping them all together.

examples.english: The wind [scattered] the fallen leaves across the yard.
examples.chinese: 风把落叶[吹散]得满院子都是。

examples.english: I accidentally [scattered] my building blocks all over the floor.
examples.chinese: 我不小心把积木[散落]得满地板都是。

examples.english: Mom [scattered] flower seeds in the back garden.
examples.chinese: 妈妈在后花园里[播撒]了花种。

meanings.explanation: When a group of people or animals [scatter], they separate and move away from each other in different directions.

examples.english: When it started to rain, the kids [scattered] to find shelter.
examples.chinese: 开始下雨时，孩子们[散开]跑去找地方躲雨。

examples.english: The birds [scattered] when I walked near their tree.
examples.chinese: 当我走近那棵树时，鸟儿们[飞散]开了。

examples.english: After the birthday party, the guests [scattered] and went home.
examples.chinese: 生日派对结束后，客人们[散去]回家了。

meanings.explanation: A [shared] thing is used, owned, or enjoyed by two or more people.

examples.english: My sister and I sleep in a [shared] bedroom.
examples.chinese: 我和我姐姐睡在一间[共用的]卧室里。

examples.english: We sat at a [shared] table in the cafeteria.
examples.chinese: 我们在食堂里坐在一张[共用的]桌子旁。

examples.english: The two families have a [shared] garden.
examples.chinese: 这两户人家有一个[共用的]花园。

meanings.explanation: [Shared] is the past tense of [share]. If you [shared] something, you gave a part of it to someone or used it together with someone.

examples.english: I [shared] my cake with my friend at lunch.
examples.chinese: 午饭时我[分]了一点蛋糕给朋友。

examples.english: We [shared] a taxi to school this morning.
examples.chinese: 今天早上我们[合乘]了一辆出租车去学校。

examples.english: She [shared] her story with the whole class.
examples.chinese: 她把自己的故事[分享]给了全班同学。

meanings.explanation: If you describe something bad as [severe], you mean that it is extremely bad, serious, or harsh.

examples.english: The doctor says he has a [severe] headache and needs to rest.
examples.chinese: 医生说他[严重]头痛，需要休息。

examples.english: We had [severe] weather last night with heavy rain and strong winds.
examples.chinese: 昨晚我们遇到了[恶劣]天气，大雨倾盆，狂风大作。

examples.english: The teacher gave him a [severe] punishment for breaking the rules.
examples.chinese: 因为他违反了规定，老师给了他[严厉的]惩罚。

meanings.explanation: If someone is [severe], they behave in a strict or firm way that shows they have very high standards.

examples.english: My math teacher is very [severe] with us when we make mistakes.
examples.chinese: 我们犯错时，我的数学老师对我们非常[严格]。

examples.english: Her [severe] father never lets her stay out late.
examples.chinese: 她[严厉的]父亲从不让她在外面待到很晚。

examples.english: The coach is [severe] but fair to all the players.
examples.chinese: 这位教练很[严格]，但对所有队员都很公平。

meanings.explanation: If there is a [shortage] of something, there is not enough of it available for the people who need it.

examples.english: There is a water [shortage] in the village because it hasn't rained for months.
examples.chinese: 因为好几个月没下雨了，村子里[缺水]。

examples.english: The supermarket had a [shortage] of eggs, so my mom couldn't buy any.
examples.chinese: 超市[缺]鸡蛋，妈妈一个都没买到。

examples.english: During the winter, there was a [shortage] of warm clothes for the children.
examples.chinese: 那个冬天，孩子们的保暖衣物很[短缺]。

meanings.explanation: Something that is [significant] is large or important enough to have an effect or to be noticed.

examples.english: There was a [significant] drop in temperature today.
examples.chinese: 今天气温[大幅]下降了。

examples.english: She made a [significant] improvement in her math test.
examples.chinese: 她的数学考试成绩有了[显著]提高。

examples.english: The new park will have a [significant] impact on our neighborhood.
examples.chinese: 新建的公园将对我们的社区产生[重大]影响。

meanings.explanation: Something that is [significant] has a special meaning or expresses a particular idea.

examples.english: May 1st is a [significant] date for workers all over the world.
examples.chinese: 5月1日对全世界的工人来说是一个[有特殊意义的]日子。

examples.english: His words carried a [significant] message for all of us.
examples.chinese: 他的话对我们所有人传达了一个[意味深长的]信息。

examples.english: The red flag is a [significant] symbol of our country.
examples.chinese: 红旗是我国一个[具有象征意义的]标志。

meanings.explanation: A [senior] person holds a higher rank or position in an organization than others.

examples.english: My uncle is a [senior] doctor at the hospital.
examples.chinese: 我叔叔是医院的一位[资深]医生。

examples.english: The [senior] teacher helps the new teachers learn.
examples.chinese: [资深]老师会帮助新老师学习。

examples.english: She got a [senior] position after working hard for many years.
examples.chinese: 她努力工作多年后得到了一个[高级]职位。

meanings.explanation: A [senior] is an older person, especially someone who has stopped working.

examples.english: My grandpa is a [senior] and goes to the park every morning.
examples.chinese: 我爷爷是位[老年人]，每天早上都去公园。

examples.english: The bus has special seats for [seniors].
examples.chinese: 这辆公交车有给[老年人]的专座。

examples.english: Many [seniors] enjoy dancing together in the square.
examples.chinese: 很多[老年人]喜欢一起在广场上跳舞。

meanings.explanation: [sensory] means relating to the physical senses, such as sight, hearing, smell, taste, and touch.

examples.english: Our eyes, ears, nose, tongue, and skin are all [sensory] organs.
examples.chinese: 我们的眼睛、耳朵、鼻子、舌头和皮肤都是[感官]器官。

examples.english: Playing with sand and water is a fun [sensory] activity for kids.
examples.chinese: 玩沙子和水对孩子们来说是一种有趣的[感官]活动。

examples.english: Dogs have much stronger [sensory] abilities than humans.
examples.chinese: 狗的[感官]能力比人类强得多。

meanings.explanation: [Simple] means easy to understand or do; not complicated or difficult.

examples.english: This recipe is very [simple] to follow.
examples.chinese: 这个食谱[简单]易懂。

examples.english: Can you explain it in [simple] words?
examples.chinese: 你能用[简单]的话解释一下吗？

examples.english: I need a [simple] solution to this problem.
examples.chinese: 我需要一个[简单的]解决方案。

meanings.explanation: [Simple] means plain or basic, without anything fancy or elaborate.

examples.english: She wore a [simple] white dress.
examples.chinese: 她穿了一条[素雅的]白色连衣裙。

examples.english: We live in a [simple] cottage by the lake.
examples.chinese: 我们住在湖边一座[简朴的]小屋里。

examples.english: He has a [simple] taste in clothes.
examples.chinese: 他对穿着[朴素]不讲究。

meanings.explanation: If something is [secondary], it is less important than something else.

examples.english: Safety is the most important rule; everything else is [secondary].
examples.chinese: 安全是最重要的规则，其他都是[次要的]。

examples.english: Winning the game is [secondary] to having fun with your friends.
examples.chinese: 赢得比赛比起和朋友一起开心是[次要的]。

examples.english: The color of the pencil case is [secondary]; I just need one that lasts long.
examples.chinese: 铅笔盒的颜色是[次要的]，我只需要一个耐用的。

meanings.explanation: [Secondary] education is the schooling of children between the ages of about 11 and 18.

examples.english: My big sister just started [secondary] school this September.
examples.chinese: 我姐姐今年九月刚上[中学]。

examples.english: After you finish primary school, you go to a [secondary] school.
examples.chinese: 小学毕业后，你会去一所[中学]上学。

examples.english: Our [secondary] school has a science lab and a huge football field.
examples.chinese: 我们[中学]有一个科学实验室和一个超大的足球场。

meanings.explanation: [Separate] things are different or apart from each other; not joined or connected.

examples.english: My sister and I have two [separate] bedrooms.
examples.chinese: 我妹妹和我有两间[独立的]卧室。

examples.english: The teacher gave us three [separate] tasks to finish.
examples.chinese: 老师给了我们三个[不同的]任务来完成。

examples.english: Please put the big toys and the small toys in [separate] boxes.
examples.chinese: 请把大玩具和小玩具放到[不同的]盒子里。

meanings.explanation: To [separate] things or people means to cause them to move apart or become disconnected.

examples.english: Please [separate] the green apples from the red ones.
examples.chinese: 请把青苹果和红苹果[分开]。

examples.english: The fence [separates] our garden from our neighbor's garden.
examples.chinese: 栅栏把我们家的花园和邻居家的花园[隔开]。

examples.english: Let's [separate] into two groups for the game.
examples.chinese: 让我们把游戏分成两组[分开]。

meanings.explanation: A [sensitive] person, body part, or thing is easily affected or hurt by something outside.

examples.english: I have [sensitive] skin that turns red easily in the sun.
examples.chinese: 我的皮肤很[敏感]，一晒太阳就容易变红。

examples.english: She is [sensitive] to cold, so she wears a thick coat in winter.
examples.chinese: 她对寒冷很[敏感]，所以冬天会穿厚外套。

examples.english: My cat's ears are very [sensitive] to loud noises.
examples.chinese: 我家猫的耳朵对噪音非常[敏感]。

meanings.explanation: If you are [sensitive], you are easily hurt, upset, or offended by things other people say or do.

examples.english: Be gentle with her—she is a very [sensitive] person.
examples.chinese: 对她温柔一点，她是个很[敏感]的人。

examples.english: He felt sad because people hurt his [sensitive] feelings.
examples.chinese: 他很伤心，因为大家伤到了他[敏感]的感情。

examples.english: Don't tease your little sister—she is very [sensitive].
examples.chinese: 别逗你的小妹妹了，她很[敏感]。

meanings.explanation: When something [shrinks], it becomes smaller in size or amount.

examples.english: My sweater will [shrink] if I wash it in hot water.
examples.chinese: 如果用热水洗，我的毛衣会[缩水]。

examples.english: The snowman began to [shrink] when the sun came out.
examples.chinese: 太阳出来后，雪人开始[变小]。

examples.english: Her savings started to [shrink] after she bought the new bike.
examples.chinese: 买了新自行车后，她的积蓄开始[减少]。

meanings.explanation: If you [shrink] from something, you move back or away from it because you are frightened, shocked, or disgusted.

examples.english: The little girl would [shrink] away from the scary dog.
examples.chinese: 小女孩看到那只可怕的狗就会[吓得往后退]。

examples.english: He did not [shrink] from the challenge.
examples.chinese: 他没有[退缩]逃避这个挑战。

examples.english: The child would [shrink] back when strangers tried to touch him.
examples.chinese: 当陌生人试图碰他时，孩子会[缩回去]。

meanings.explanation: [Security] refers to the protection of people, places, and property from danger, crime, or attack.

examples.english: My mom added a new lock to our door for more [security].
examples.chinese: 我妈妈给家门装了一把新锁来增加[安全保障]。

examples.english: The airport has very strict [security] before you board the plane.
examples.chinese: 机场在你登机前设有非常严格的[安保]。

examples.english: The school hired more workers to improve its [security].
examples.chinese: 学校雇佣了更多工作人员来加强[安全保卫]。

meanings.explanation: If you feel [security], you feel safe, happy, and not worried about the future or anything bad that might happen.

examples.english: Playing with my mom gives me a feeling of [security].
examples.chinese: 和妈妈一起玩给我一种[安全感]。

examples.english: A warm home can bring people [security] and happiness.
examples.chinese: 温暖的家能给人带来[安全感]和幸福。

examples.english: Having a steady job gives people [security].
examples.chinese: 有一份稳定的工作能给人带来[安全感]。

common_collocations: under the shade of a tree

meanings.explanation: A [shade] is a dark, cool area where the sun's light is blocked by something.

examples.english: We sat in the [shade] of a big apple tree.
examples.chinese: 我们坐在一棵大苹果树的[阴凉处]。

examples.english: It's too hot in the sun—let's go find some [shade].
examples.chinese: 太阳下太热了，我们去找个[阴凉地]吧。

examples.english: The little cat slept in the [shade] under the table.
examples.chinese: 小猫睡在桌子底下的[阴凉处]。

meanings.explanation: A [shade] is a particular or slight variety of a color.

examples.english: This [shade] of blue looks very pretty on my notebook.
examples.chinese: 这种蓝色[色调]在我的笔记本上很好看。

examples.english: Mom chose a warm [shade] of yellow for our living room.
examples.chinese: 妈妈给我们客厅选了一种温暖的黄色[色调]。

examples.english: My favorite [shade] of green is light mint.
examples.chinese: 我最喜欢的绿色[色调]是浅薄荷绿。

meanings.explanation: [Shining] describes something that is giving out or reflecting a bright light; very bright and clear.

examples.english: The [shining] sun made everyone feel warm.
examples.chinese: [闪闪发光]的太阳让每个人都感到很温暖。

examples.english: Look at the [shining] stars in the night sky!
examples.chinese: 看夜空中那些[闪闪发亮]的星星！

examples.english: She has beautiful [shining] hair.
examples.chinese: 她有一头漂亮的[亮闪闪的]头发。

meanings.explanation: [Shining] is the present participle of "shine", meaning to give out or reflect light; to glow.

examples.english: The light is [shining] through the window.
examples.chinese: 光正[照]进窗户。

examples.english: The stars are [shining] brightly tonight.
examples.chinese: 今晚星星[闪烁]得很亮。

examples.english: His eyes were [shining] with happiness.
examples.chinese: 他的眼睛里[闪着]幸福的光芒。

meanings.explanation: If a person is [serious], they are thoughtful, quiet, and do not laugh or joke very much.

examples.english: My dad looks very [serious] when he is working.
examples.chinese: 我爸爸工作的时候表情很[严肃]。

examples.english: Please be [serious] in class and listen to the teacher.
examples.chinese: 上课要[认真]听老师讲。

examples.english: Lily is a [serious] student who always finishes her homework on time.
examples.chinese: 莉莉是个[认真]的学生，总是按时完成作业。

meanings.explanation: If a situation or problem is [serious], it is important and needs to be dealt with carefully.

examples.english: A car accident is a very [serious] thing.
examples.chinese: 车祸是非常[严重]的事情。

examples.english: He has a [serious] cold and needs to stay in bed.
examples.chinese: 他得了[严重]的感冒，得卧床休息。

examples.english: Throwing rubbish in the river is a [serious] problem.
examples.chinese: 往河里扔垃圾是个[严重]的问题。

meanings.explanation: If something is [scarce], there is not enough of it available for the people who need it.

examples.english: In the desert, clean water is very [scarce].
examples.chinese: 在沙漠里，干净的饮用水非常[紧缺]。

examples.english: During the dry season, food becomes [scarce].
examples.chinese: 到了旱季，食物会变得很[短缺]。

examples.english: Good jobs are [scarce] in this small town.
examples.chinese: 这个小镇上的好工作很[稀缺]。

meanings.explanation: If something is [scarce], it is rare or uncommon and not easy to find.

examples.english: This type of bird is [scarce] in our city.
examples.chinese: 这种鸟在我们城市很[罕见]。

examples.english: True friends are [scarce].
examples.chinese: 真正的朋友很[难得]。

examples.english: Snow is [scarce] in this warm country.
examples.chinese: 在这个温暖的国家，雪很[少见]。

meanings.explanation: You use [simply] to emphasize that something is easy to do or understand.

examples.english: The recipe is [simply] a mix of flour and water.
examples.chinese: 这个食谱[就是]面粉和水的混合。

examples.english: You can [simply] press this button to start the game.
examples.chinese: 你[只要]按这个按钮就能开始游戏。

examples.english: She explained the problem [simply] so everyone could understand.
examples.chinese: 她把问题解释得很[简单]，让每个人都能听懂。

meanings.explanation: You use [simply] to emphasize what you are saying or to make it stronger.

examples.english: The movie was [simply] wonderful!
examples.chinese: 这部电影[简直]太棒了！

examples.english: I [simply] love eating ice cream on hot days.
examples.chinese: 大热天吃冰淇淋，我[真的]太喜欢了。

examples.english: That dress is [simply] beautiful on you.
examples.chinese: 那条裙子穿在你身上[简直]美极了。

meanings.explanation: [Slavery] is the system or practice by which one person owns another person as property and forces them to work without pay.

examples.english: Many countries ended [slavery] over one hundred years ago.
examples.chinese: 许多国家一百多年前就废除了[奴隶制]。

examples.english: We learn about the history of [slavery] in our history class.
examples.chinese: 我们在历史课上学习[奴隶制]的历史。

examples.english: The book tells a story about people who escaped from [slavery].
examples.chinese: 这本书讲述了人们逃出[奴役]的故事。

meanings.explanation: A [singular] noun or verb form refers to only one person or thing.

examples.english: The word 'cat' is a [singular] noun.
examples.chinese: 单词 'cat' 是一个[单数]名词。

examples.english: In 'The dog runs', the verb 'runs' is in the [singular] form.
examples.chinese: 在 'The dog runs' 中，动词 'runs' 是[单数]形式。

examples.english: 'Apple' is the [singular] form of 'apples'.
examples.chinese: 'Apple' 是 'apples' 的[单数]形式。

meanings.explanation: If something is [singular], it is unusual, remarkable, or the only one of its kind.

examples.english: She made a [singular] mistake that surprised everyone.
examples.chinese: 她犯了一个[不同寻常的]错误，让大家都很惊讶。

examples.english: The boy showed a [singular] talent for painting at age five.
examples.chinese: 这个男孩在五岁时就展现出了[非凡的]绘画天赋。

examples.english: It was a [singular] moment that I will never forget.
examples.chinese: 那是一个我永远不会忘记的[独一无二的]时刻。

meanings.explanation: If something moves or happens [slowly], it takes a long time to move or happen, or it happens at a low speed.

examples.english: The turtle walks [slowly] across the road.
examples.chinese: 乌龟[慢慢地]穿过马路。

examples.english: Please speak [slowly] so I can understand you.
examples.chinese: 请[慢慢地]说，这样我才能听懂。

examples.english: The old man climbed the stairs [slowly].
examples.chinese: 那位老人[慢慢地]爬楼梯。

meanings.explanation: A [smooth] surface has no roughness, bumps, or holes on it, so it feels even and pleasant to touch.

examples.english: The baby's skin is very [smooth] and soft.
examples.chinese: 宝宝的皮肤非常[光滑柔软]。

examples.english: This table is so [smooth] that I can slide my hand across it easily.
examples.chinese: 这张桌子非常[光滑]，我的手轻轻一滑就过去了。

examples.english: She likes to walk on the [smooth] sand by the sea.
examples.chinese: 她喜欢在海边[细软平坦]的沙滩上散步。

meanings.explanation: A [smooth] process, movement, or event happens without any problems, difficulties, or interruptions.

examples.english: The meeting went very [smooth] and ended early.
examples.chinese: 会议进行得非常[顺利]，很早就结束了。

examples.english: We hope the trip will be [smooth] and safe.
examples.chinese: 我们希望旅途[顺利平安]。

examples.english: After some practice, his piano playing became much more [smooth].
examples.chinese: 经过练习，他的钢琴弹得越来越[流畅自然]了。

meanings.explanation: A [simplification] is the act or process of making something easier to do or understand by reducing its complexity.

examples.english: The [simplification] of the school rules made them easier to remember.
examples.chinese: 校规的[简化]让它们更容易记住了。

examples.english: Dad's [simplification] of the map helped us find the park.
examples.chinese: 爸爸对地图的[简化]帮我们找到了公园。

examples.english: The [simplification] of the game rules let younger kids play too.
examples.chinese: 游戏规则的[简化]让更小的孩子也能玩了。

meanings.explanation: A [simplification] is a simpler version of something complex that leaves out some of the details.

examples.english: Calling it a 'happy movie' is a [simplification] of the story.
examples.chinese: 称它为'开心电影'是对故事的[简化]。

examples.english: This drawing is a [simplification] of our town.
examples.chinese: 这幅画是我们小镇的[简化版]。

examples.english: The storybook gives a [simplification] of the history lesson.
examples.chinese: 这本故事书是对历史课的[简化讲述]。

meanings.explanation: A [slight] change, difference, or amount is small in degree, and is not serious or important.

examples.english: There is a [slight] difference between these two pictures.
examples.chinese: 这两张照片之间有一[点][细微的]差别。

examples.english: I made a [slight] mistake in my homework.
examples.chinese: 我的作业里犯了一个[小小的]错误。

examples.english: She felt a [slight] pain in her left arm.
examples.chinese: 她觉得左胳膊有一[点点][轻微的]疼。

meanings.explanation: If you [slight] someone, you treat them in an unfriendly or disrespectful way, often by ignoring them or not paying attention to them. (verb) / A [slight] is an act of treating someone without respect. (noun)

examples.english: She felt hurt because he [slighted] her in front of everyone.
examples.chinese: 她觉得很受伤，因为他当着大家的面[怠慢]了她。

examples.english: He didn't mean to [slight] you by not saying hello.
examples.chinese: 他没跟你打招呼并不是故意要[冷落]你。

examples.english: She took his silence as a [slight] and walked away angrily.
examples.chinese: 她把他的沉默当成一种[轻视]，生气地走开了。

meanings.explanation: [Slightly] means to a small degree; not very much.

examples.english: The second apple is [slightly] bigger than the first one.
examples.chinese: 第二个苹果比第一个[稍微]大一点。

examples.english: I felt [slightly] tired after running for an hour.
examples.chinese: 跑了一个小时后，我感到[有点]累。

examples.english: The dress is [slightly] too long for me.
examples.chinese: 这条裙子对我来说[稍微]有点长了。

meanings.explanation: A [signal] is a gesture, sound, or action that is intended to give a particular message or instruction to someone.

examples.english: The traffic [signal] turned green, so we could go.
examples.chinese: 交通[信号灯]变绿了，我们可以走了。

examples.english: Dad gave me a [signal] to hide behind the door.
examples.chinese: 爸爸给了我一个躲到门后的[信号]。

examples.english: The phone [signal] here is not very good.
examples.chinese: 这里的手机[信号]不太好。

meanings.explanation: If you [signal] something, you use a gesture, sound, or action to tell people what you want or what is happening.

examples.english: He [signaled] to me that he was OK.
examples.chinese: 他向我[示意]他没事。

examples.english: The teacher [signaled] the start of the test.
examples.chinese: 老师[示意]考试开始了。

examples.english: She [signaled] for a taxi with her hand.
examples.chinese: 她伸手[示意]拦出租车。

meanings.explanation: When a liquid [solidifies], or when something [solidifies] a liquid, it becomes hard and firm.

examples.english: Put the juice in the fridge and it will [solidify] into ice.
examples.chinese: 把果汁放进冰箱，它就会[凝固]成冰。

examples.english: The chocolate [solidified] after we left it outside in the cold.
examples.chinese: 巧克力放在外面冷的地方之后就[变硬]了。

examples.english: Melted wax [solidifies] when it cools down.
examples.chinese: 融化的蜡在冷却后会[凝固]。

meanings.explanation: If you [solidify] an idea, a relationship, or a plan, you make it stronger and more certain so that it is less likely to change.

examples.english: The camping trip really [solidified] our friendship.
examples.chinese: 那次露营旅行真正[巩固]了我们的友谊。

examples.english: He worked hard to [solidify] his position as team leader.
examples.chinese: 他努力工作来[巩固]自己作为队长的地位。

examples.english: This meeting will help [solidify] the plan for the school party.
examples.chinese: 这次会议有助于[落实]学校派对的计划。

meanings.explanation: [Solar] means relating to or using the energy from the sun.

examples.english: Our house uses [solar] power to make electricity.
examples.chinese: 我们家使用[太阳能]发电。

examples.english: We learned about the [solar] system in science class.
examples.chinese: 我们在科学课上学习了[太阳]系。

examples.english: My watch is [solar], so it never needs new batteries.
examples.chinese: 我的手表是[太阳能]的，所以永远不需要换电池。

meanings.explanation: A [slender] person or their body is thin in a graceful, attractive way.

examples.english: The young dancer has a [slender] figure.
examples.chinese: 这位年轻舞者有着[苗条的]身材。

examples.english: Her [slender] legs look pretty in the new dress.
examples.chinese: 她[纤细的]双腿穿这条新裙子很好看。

examples.english: That little cat has a [slender] tail.
examples.chinese: 那只小猫长着一条[细长的]尾巴。

meanings.explanation: A [slender] amount, chance, or difference is very small.

examples.english: We only have a [slender] chance of winning the game.
examples.chinese: 我们赢下这场比赛的机会十分[渺茫]。

examples.english: He won the match by a [slender] margin.
examples.chinese: 他以[微弱的]优势赢得了比赛。

examples.english: His family lives on a [slender] monthly income.
examples.chinese: 他一家靠着每个月[微薄的]收入生活。

meanings.explanation: [Smallest] is the superlative form of small, describing something that is less large in size than any other thing in a group.

examples.english: This is the [smallest] apple in the basket.
examples.chinese: 这是篮子里[最小的]苹果。

examples.english: My sister wears the [smallest] shoes in our family.
examples.chinese: 我妹妹穿我们家[最小的]鞋子。

examples.english: Can you see the [smallest] bird on that tall tree?
examples.chinese: 你能看到那棵高树上那只[最小的]鸟吗？

meanings.explanation: The [smallest] child in a family is the youngest one.

examples.english: Emma is the [smallest] child in my family.
examples.chinese: 艾玛是我家[最小的]孩子。

examples.english: My [smallest] brother is only four years old.
examples.chinese: 我[最小的]弟弟只有四岁。

examples.english: The [smallest] sister loves playing hide-and-seek with us.
examples.chinese: [最小的]妹妹喜欢和我们玩捉迷藏。

meanings.explanation: If you [slip], you accidentally slide or lose your balance, especially on a wet or smooth surface.

examples.english: Be careful not to [slip] on the wet floor.
examples.chinese: 小心别在湿地上[滑倒]。

examples.english: She [slipped] on the ice and fell down.
examples.chinese: 她在冰上[滑倒]摔倒了。

examples.english: The soap [slipped] out of my hand.
examples.chinese: 肥皂从我手里[滑]掉了。

meanings.explanation: If you [slip] somewhere, you go there quietly or quickly so that people do not notice you.

examples.english: He [slipped] out of the room while everyone was watching TV.
examples.chinese: 他趁大家在看电视时[悄悄溜出]了房间。

examples.english: She [slipped] the note into my pocket.
examples.chinese: 她把纸条[悄悄塞进]了我的口袋。

examples.english: Let's [slip] away before the party ends.
examples.chinese: 我们趁派对结束前[溜走]吧。

meanings.explanation: Something [soft] is not hard or firm, and gives way easily when you touch or press it.

examples.english: I love sleeping on this [soft] pillow.
examples.chinese: 我喜欢睡在这个[柔软的]枕头上。

examples.english: The little bunny has [soft] white fur.
examples.chinese: 这只小兔子有[软软的]白色绒毛。

examples.english: This cake is so [soft] and yummy.
examples.chinese: 这个蛋糕真[软]，很好吃。

meanings.explanation: [soft] describes something that is gentle, not loud or harsh, or a person who is kind and easily touched.

examples.english: She has a very [soft] voice.
examples.chinese: 她有一副[柔和的]嗓音。

examples.english: The light in the room is [soft] and warm.
examples.chinese: 房间里的光线[柔和]而温暖。

examples.english: My grandma has a [soft] heart.
examples.chinese: 我奶奶有颗[柔软的]心。

meanings.explanation: [Sophistication] is the quality of being cultured, refined, and having a good understanding of the world, art, and social situations.

examples.english: The [sophistication] of her dress impressed everyone at the party.
examples.chinese: 她的礼服[高雅]气质让派对上的每个人都印象深刻。

examples.english: This city is famous for its culture and [sophistication].
examples.chinese: 这座城市因其文化和[精致]而闻名。

examples.english: The restaurant shows great [sophistication] in its design.
examples.chinese: 这家餐厅的设计展现出极高的[品味]。

meanings.explanation: [Sophistication] is the quality of being complex, clever, and advanced in design or function.

examples.english: Modern phones have a high level of [sophistication].
examples.chinese: 现代手机具有很高程度的[精密性]。

examples.english: The [sophistication] of this computer program is amazing.
examples.chinese: 这个电脑程序的[复杂精妙]令人惊讶。

examples.english: Scientists admire the [sophistication] of nature's design.
examples.chinese: 科学家们赞叹大自然设计的[精巧]。

meanings.explanation: [Solid] describes a substance that has a fixed shape and is firm, not like a liquid or gas that flows.

examples.english: When water gets very cold, it becomes [solid] ice.
examples.chinese: 水在非常冷的时候会变成[固态的]冰。

examples.english: We can hold a [solid] object easily with our hands.
examples.chinese: 我们可以很容易地把[固态的]物体拿在手里。

examples.english: At room temperature, most stones are [solid].
examples.chinese: 在室温下，大多数石头都是[固态的]。

meanings.explanation: A [solid] object has no empty spaces or holes inside it, and it is usually strong and hard to break.

examples.english: This wooden chair is made of [solid] wood.
examples.chinese: 这把木椅是用[实心的]木头做的。

examples.english: We built a [solid] shelf to hold all our books.
examples.chinese: 我们做了一个[结实的]架子来放所有的书。

examples.english: The [solid] stone statue stood in the park for many years.
examples.chinese: 这座[实心的]石雕像在公园里矗立了很多年。

meanings.explanation: When fish or frogs [spawn], they lay their eggs in water.

examples.english: The salmon swim upstream to [spawn] in the same river where they were born.
examples.chinese: 鲑鱼逆流而上，在它们出生的同一条河里[产卵]。

examples.english: In spring, frogs [spawn] in the pond near our school.
examples.chinese: 春天，青蛙在我们学校附近的池塘里[产卵]。

examples.english: These fish [spawn] only once a year.
examples.chinese: 这些鱼每年只[产卵]一次。

meanings.explanation: If something [spawns] a new thing, it causes it to happen or be created.

examples.english: His funny video [spawned] a lot of copycat videos online.
examples.chinese: 他的搞笑视频在网上[催生了]大量模仿视频。

examples.english: The new game [spawned] a whole series of books and toys.
examples.chinese: 这款新游戏[衍生出]了一系列图书和玩具。

examples.english: A small mistake [spawned] many big problems later.
examples.chinese: 一个小小的失误后来[引发了许多大问题]。

meanings.explanation: A [slave] is a person who is owned by another person and has to work for them without being paid.

examples.english: Long ago, some people were kept as [slaves] and forced to work for their owners.
examples.chinese: 很久以前，有些人被当作[奴隶]，被迫给主人干活。

examples.english: The poor [slave] worked day and night without any rest.
examples.chinese: 那个可怜的[奴隶]没日没夜地干活，一刻也不能歇。

examples.english: She was sold as a [slave] when she was only five years old.
examples.chinese: 她才五岁的时候就被当成[奴隶]卖掉了。

meanings.explanation: If you [slave], you work very hard at a task, often doing physical work that is tiring.

examples.english: Dad [slaved] in the kitchen all morning to cook a big meal.
examples.chinese: 爸爸一上午都在厨房里[忙活]，做了一大桌菜。

examples.english: She [slaved] over her homework all evening.
examples.chinese: 她整个晚上都在[苦干]作业。

examples.english: The workers [slaved] in the fields from sunrise to sunset.
examples.chinese: 工人们从早到晚都在地里[苦干]。

meanings.explanation: A [single] thing or person is one individual, rather than two or more.

examples.english: I stayed in a [single] room last night.
examples.chinese: 我昨晚住了一间[单独的]房间。

examples.english: Can you see that [single] tree on the hill?
examples.chinese: 你能看到山顶那棵[单独的]树吗？

examples.english: Every [single] student in my class got a candy.
examples.chinese: 我班里每个[单独的]学生都得到了一颗糖。

meanings.explanation: Someone who is [single] is not married and does not have a romantic partner.

examples.english: My older sister is still [single].
examples.chinese: 我姐姐仍然是[单身的]。

examples.english: My [single] aunt often comes to play with me.
examples.chinese: 我那位[单身的]阿姨经常来陪我玩。

examples.english: He has been [single] since he broke up with his girlfriend.
examples.chinese: 他和女朋友分手之后一直是[单身的]。

meanings.explanation: If you [soften] something or if it softens, it becomes less hard, rough, or firm.

examples.english: Leave the butter out to [soften] before baking.
examples.chinese: 烘焙前把黄油拿出来[软化]。

examples.english: This lotion helps [soften] dry skin.
examples.chinese: 这款乳液有助于[软化]干燥的皮肤。

examples.english: Cook the vegetables until they start to [soften].
examples.chinese: 把蔬菜煮到开始[变软]。

meanings.explanation: If you [soften] something such as a rule, attitude, or feeling, you make it less strict, severe, or unpleasant.

examples.english: The school decided to [soften] the dress code rules.
examples.chinese: 学校决定[放宽]着装规定。

examples.english: Her kind words [softened] his angry heart.
examples.chinese: 她贴心的话[软化]了他愤怒的心。

examples.english: He tried to [soften] the bad news with a smile.
examples.chinese: 他试图用微笑来[缓和]这个坏消息。

meanings.explanation: A [sophisticated] person has good taste, knows a lot about culture, and knows how to behave well in social situations.

examples.english: My aunt is very [sophisticated]; she loves classical music and art shows.
examples.chinese: 我姑姑很[优雅]；她喜欢古典音乐和艺术展。

examples.english: Mom wore a [sophisticated] black dress to the party.
examples.chinese: 妈妈穿了一条[精致的]黑裙子去参加派对。

examples.english: He has [sophisticated] taste and only reads good books.
examples.chinese: 他品味很[高雅]，只读好书。

meanings.explanation: A [sophisticated] machine, system, or method is very advanced and has many complex parts or features.

examples.english: This robot is very [sophisticated]; it can clean the house all by itself.
examples.chinese: 这个机器人非常[精密]；它可以自己打扫整个房子。

examples.english: Dad bought a [sophisticated] camera that takes amazing pictures.
examples.chinese: 爸爸买了一台[高级的]相机，能拍出超棒的照片。

examples.english: The new video game has [sophisticated] graphics that look almost real.
examples.chinese: 这款新游戏有很[复杂的]画面，看起来几乎跟真的一样。

meanings.explanation: A [spirit] is a being that consists of a soul, ghost, or supernatural force. It can also refer to the part of a person that consists of their emotions, character, and mind.

examples.english: Many people believe that the [spirit] of a dead person lives on.
examples.chinese: 很多人都相信死者的[灵魂]会继续存在。

examples.english: She felt a [spirit] in the old house and got scared.
examples.chinese: 她觉得那栋老房子里有[鬼魂]，吓得不行。

examples.english: The old man says his [spirit] is free now after passing away.
examples.chinese: 老人说，他去世后[灵魂]终于自由了。

meanings.explanation: The [spirit] of someone or something is the attitude, energy, or mood that they show. It can also mean the liveliness and enthusiasm that a person or group has.

examples.english: Our team has a great [spirit] and never gives up.
examples.chinese: 我们队[精神状态]很好，从来不放弃。

examples.english: She always sings with [spirit] at the party.
examples.chinese: 她在派对上总是[充满活力]地唱歌。

examples.english: The children ran around with lots of [spirit].
examples.chinese: 孩子们[兴致勃勃]地到处跑。

meanings.explanation: Something that is [specialized] is designed or developed for a particular purpose, area of knowledge, or group of users.

examples.english: The hospital has [specialized] equipment for heart surgery.
examples.chinese: 这家医院有心脏手术用的[专业]设备。

examples.english: My brother works as a [specialized] chef in an Italian restaurant.
examples.chinese: 我哥哥在一家意大利餐厅做[专业]厨师。

examples.english: She took a [specialized] course to learn coding.
examples.chinese: 她参加了一个学习编程的[专业]课程。

meanings.explanation: The [speed] of something is the rate at which it moves or travels.

examples.english: The car is traveling at a [speed] of 50 miles per hour.
examples.chinese: 这辆车正以每小时50英里的[速度]行驶。

examples.english: Turtles walk with slow [speed].
examples.chinese: 乌龟以很慢的[速度]爬行。

examples.english: What is the top [speed] of this train?
examples.chinese: 这列火车的最高[速度]是多少？

meanings.explanation: When you [speed] somewhere, you move or travel there very quickly.

examples.english: The ambulance [speeds] through the streets to help people.
examples.chinese: 救护车[飞速]穿过街道去救人。

examples.english: He [speeded] to school because he was late.
examples.chinese: 他[快速]赶往学校，因为他迟到了。

examples.english: The rabbit [speeds] away when it sees the fox.
examples.chinese: 兔子看到狐狸就[飞快]逃走了。

meanings.explanation: If something [splits] or if you [split] it, it breaks or divides into two or more parts.

examples.english: Please [split] the apple into two pieces.
examples.chinese: 请把苹果[分成]两半。
