examples.english: The old tree [split] down the middle during the storm.
examples.chinese: 那棵老树在暴风雨中从中间[裂开]了。

examples.english: We need to [split] this chocolate bar so everyone gets some.
examples.chinese: 我们需要把这根巧克力[分成]几块，这样每个人都有份。

meanings.explanation: When a group of people [splits] or you [split] a group of people, they divide into two or more smaller groups.

examples.english: Let's [split] into two teams for the game.
examples.chinese: 我们[分成]两队来玩游戏吧。

examples.english: The band [split] up after ten years together.
examples.chinese: 这支乐队在一起十年后[解散]了。

examples.english: We should [split] the class into small groups.
examples.chinese: 我们应该把全班[分成]几个小组。

meanings.explanation: A [split] is a long crack or tear in something.

examples.english: There is a long [split] in my old jeans.
examples.chinese: 我的旧牛仔裤上有一道[裂口]。

examples.english: He fixed the [split] in the wooden door.
examples.chinese: 他把木门上的[裂缝]修好了。

examples.english: The [split] in the pipe caused water to leak.
examples.chinese: 管道上的[裂口]导致漏水。

meanings.explanation: If something is [spreading], it is moving outwards in all directions or covering a larger area.

examples.english: The fire is [spreading] quickly in the forest.
examples.chinese: 森林里的火正在快速[蔓延]。

examples.english: Good news is [spreading] all over the school.
examples.chinese: 好消息正在学校里到处[传开]。

examples.english: A cold is [spreading] among the kids in my class.
examples.chinese: 感冒正在我们班同学之间[传播]。

meanings.explanation: If you are [spreading] something, you are putting a soft substance in a thin layer over a surface.

examples.english: Mom is [spreading] butter on the bread for breakfast.
examples.chinese: 妈妈正在把黄油[涂抹]在面包上当早餐。

examples.english: She is [spreading] jam on the toast.
examples.chinese: 她正在把果酱[抹]在烤面包上。

examples.english: He is [spreading] cream cheese on the bagel.
examples.chinese: 他正在把奶油芝士[涂]在贝果上。

meanings.explanation: You use [specifically] to emphasize that something is done in a precise or particular way, often for a special purpose or reason.

examples.english: The teacher [specifically] told us to bring colored pencils to class.
examples.chinese: 老师[特别]嘱咐我们带彩色铅笔来上课。

examples.english: This medicine is [specifically] for treating coughs.
examples.chinese: 这种药是[专门]治咳嗽的。

examples.english: Mom [specifically] asked me to finish my homework before watching TV.
examples.chinese: 妈妈[特别]要求我看电视前先完成作业。

meanings.explanation: You use [specifically] to introduce more exact or detailed information about something you have just mentioned.

examples.english: I love eating fruit, [specifically] apples and strawberries.
examples.chinese: 我喜欢吃水果，[特别是]苹果和草莓。

examples.english: She wants to visit Asia, [specifically] Japan and South Korea.
examples.chinese: 她想去亚洲旅游，[特别是]日本和韩国。

examples.english: We need to practice more, [specifically] speaking and listening.
examples.chinese: 我们需要多练习，[特别是]口语和听力。

meanings.explanation: [Stock] is a supply of goods that is available for sale in a shop or store. You can also say [stock] to refer to the amount of something that someone has ready to use.

examples.english: The shop doesn't have this toy in [stock] right now.
examples.chinese: 这家店现在这款玩具[没货]了。

examples.english: We need to check the [stock] in the kitchen before going shopping.
examples.chinese: 去购物前我们得先看看厨房里还有多少[存货]。

examples.english: This supermarket always keeps a good [stock] of fresh fruit.
examples.chinese: 这家超市的新鲜水果[库存]一直很充足。

meanings.explanation: [Stocks] are shares in a company that people can buy as an investment. When you buy [stock], you own a small part of that company.

examples.english: My dad bought some [stock] in a tech company last year.
examples.chinese: 我爸爸去年买了一家科技公司的[股票]。

examples.english: The price of that [stock] went up a lot today.
examples.chinese: 那只[股票]今天涨了不少。

examples.english: She wants to learn how to invest in [stocks].
examples.chinese: 她想学习怎么投资[股票]。

meanings.explanation: Your [stomach] is the organ in your body where food goes when you eat it. In everyday language, people also use it to refer to the front part of the body below the chest.

examples.english: My [stomach] feels full after lunch.
examples.chinese: 我[胃里]吃完午饭感觉很撑。

examples.english: He has a pain in his [stomach].
examples.chinese: 他的[肚子]疼。

examples.english: Don't go to school on an empty [stomach].
examples.chinese: 别饿着[肚子]去上学。

meanings.explanation: If you cannot [stomach] something, you cannot accept or endure it, especially because it makes you feel angry or upset.

examples.english: I can't [stomach] that kind of behavior.
examples.chinese: [忍受]不了那种行为。

examples.english: She couldn't [stomach] the loud music.
examples.chinese: 她[受不了]那吵闹的音乐。

examples.english: He cannot [stomach] any more bad news.
examples.chinese: 他再也[承受]不了更多坏消息了。

meanings.explanation: A [stable] is a building where horses are kept.

examples.english: The horse lives in a [stable] on the farm.
examples.chinese: 这匹马住在农场里的[马厩]中。

examples.english: My uncle keeps three horses in his [stable].
examples.chinese: 我叔叔在他的[马厩]里养了三匹马。

examples.english: The [stable] door is painted red.
examples.chinese: [马厩]的门漆成了红色。

meanings.explanation: Something that is [stable] is firmly fixed and not likely to move or change.

examples.english: This table is very [stable] and won't shake.
examples.chinese: 这张桌子很[稳固]，不会晃动。

examples.english: After the storm, the roof remained [stable].
examples.chinese: 暴风雨过后，屋顶依然[牢固]。

examples.english: He finally got a [stable] job after months of searching.
examples.chinese: 找了几个月后，他终于找到了一份[稳定]的工作。

meanings.explanation: If you [spend] money, you use it to pay for things, services, or experiences you want.

examples.english: I [spend] three yuan on this ice cream.
examples.chinese: 我[花]三块钱买了这个冰淇淋。

examples.english: My mom [spends] 100 dollars on my new bike.
examples.chinese: 我妈妈[花]100美元给我买了这辆新自行车。

examples.english: We [spent] all our pocket money on candy last week.
examples.chinese: 上周我们把所有零花钱都[花]在糖果上了。

meanings.explanation: When you [spend] time, you use that time doing a particular activity or staying in a particular place.

examples.english: I [spend] two hours reading every day.
examples.chinese: 我每天[花]两个小时阅读。

examples.english: My family [spends] every summer at the beach.
examples.chinese: 我们全家每个夏天都在海滩[度过]。

examples.english: We [spent] a nice day with grandma last Sunday.
examples.chinese: 上周日我们和奶奶一起[度过]了愉快的一天。

meanings.explanation: If you [spit], you force liquid, food, or saliva out from your mouth, often in a small, quick burst.

examples.english: Please don't [spit] on the sidewalk.
examples.chinese: 请不要在人行道上[吐痰]。

examples.english: The baby [spat] out the peas because she didn't like them.
examples.chinese: 宝宝把豌豆[吐]了出来，因为她不喜欢吃。

examples.english: He bit into the lemon and [spit] the juice everywhere.
examples.chinese: 他咬了一口柠檬，[喷]得满地都是汁水。

meanings.explanation: [Spit] is the watery liquid that is produced in your mouth, also known as saliva.

examples.english: Wipe the [spit] off your chin with a tissue.
examples.chinese: 用纸巾把下巴上的[口水]擦掉。

examples.english: There was [spit] on the glass after he spoke too loudly.
examples.chinese: 他说话太大声后，玻璃上溅了些[唾沫]。

examples.english: The baby's [spit] dripped onto her new shirt.
examples.chinese: 宝宝的[口水]滴到了她的新衣服上。

meanings.explanation: If you [stand], your body is in an upright position, supported by your feet.

examples.english: Please [stand] up when the teacher enters the room.
examples.chinese: 老师进教室时，请[站起来]。

examples.english: The children like to [stand] on one foot and hop.
examples.chinese: 孩子们喜欢单脚[站]着跳。

examples.english: You have to [stand] in line to buy ice cream.
examples.chinese: 你得[站]在队伍里排队买冰淇淋。

meanings.explanation: A [stand] is a small structure or table where people sell things.

examples.english: Dad bought oranges at the fruit [stand].
examples.chinese: 爸爸在水果[摊]上买了橙子。

examples.english: There is a lemonade [stand] on the street corner.
examples.chinese: 街角有一个卖柠檬水的[摊位]。

examples.english: We went to a book [stand] at the school fair.
examples.chinese: 我们去学校集市上的书[摊]看了看。

meanings.explanation: Something that is [subjective] is based on or influenced by personal feelings, tastes, or opinions, rather than on facts or evidence.

examples.english: Whether a painting is beautiful is a [subjective] opinion.
examples.chinese: 一幅画好不好看，是一个[主观]的看法。

examples.english: My mom says the cake is too sweet, but I think that's [subjective].
examples.chinese: 妈妈说蛋糕太甜了，但我觉得这很[主观]。

examples.english: The teacher said grading art projects is [subjective].
examples.chinese: 老师说给美术作业打分是[主观]的。

meanings.explanation: If you [spread] a substance over a surface, you put a thin layer of it over the surface.

examples.english: I [spread] jam on my toast every morning.
examples.chinese: 我每天早上都会在烤吐司上[涂抹]果酱。

examples.english: She [spread] butter on the bread with a knife.
examples.chinese: 她用刀在面包上[涂抹]黄油。

examples.english: Can you [spread] some cream on the cake?
examples.chinese: 你能在蛋糕上[涂抹]一点奶油吗？

meanings.explanation: If something [spread]s, it gradually reaches more people or affects a larger area.

examples.english: The news [spread] quickly through our small town.
examples.chinese: 这个消息很快就在我们小镇上[传播]开了。

examples.english: The illness [spread] to many kids in the school.
examples.chinese: 这种疾病在学校里[传播]给了很多孩子。

examples.english: Fire [spread] quickly through the dry forest.
examples.chinese: 大火在干燥的森林里迅速[蔓延]开来。

meanings.explanation: A [striking] feature, difference, or quality is very noticeable because it is unusual, interesting, or impressive, and it immediately catches your attention.

examples.english: There is a [striking] difference between these two photos.
examples.chinese: 这两张照片之间有一个[显著的]差别。

examples.english: She noticed a [striking] resemblance between the two sisters.
examples.chinese: 她注意到两姐妹之间有[惊人的]相似之处。

examples.english: The most [striking] thing about the city is its beautiful skyline.
examples.chinese: 这座城市最[引人注目的]地方就是它美丽的轮廓线。

meanings.explanation: A [striking] person is very attractive, especially in an unusual or eye-catching way that makes you notice them immediately.

examples.english: She is a [striking] woman with long red hair.
examples.chinese: 她是一位留着红色长发的[引人注目的]女子。

examples.english: He looked very [striking] in his black suit at the party.
examples.chinese: 他在派对上穿黑色西装看起来[格外帅气]。

examples.english: The actress has a [striking] face that you won't easily forget.
examples.chinese: 这位女演员有一张令人[过目不忘的]面孔。

meanings.explanation: A [standard] is a level of quality, safety, or behavior that is generally accepted as normal or required.

examples.english: Our school has strict [standard]s for classroom cleanliness.
examples.chinese: 我们学校对教室整洁有严格的[标准]。

examples.english: My mom always asks me to reach a high [standard] in my drawing.
examples.chinese: 我妈妈总是要求我画画达到很高的[标准]。

examples.english: This kids' toy meets all the safety [standard]s.
examples.chinese: 这个儿童玩具符合所有安全[标准]。

meanings.explanation: If something is [standard], it is the usual, common, or expected type rather than something special or different.

examples.english: This is the [standard] size of a school water bottle.
examples.chinese: 这是学校水壶的[标准]尺寸。

examples.english: The [standard] keyboard fits my small desk perfectly.
examples.chinese: 这款[标准]键盘刚好适合我的小桌子。

examples.english: This store sells [standard] and large size T-shirts.
examples.chinese: 这家店卖[标准]码和大码T恤。

meanings.explanation: If you do something [straightway], you do it immediately without any delay.

examples.english: When my mom called me for dinner, I came [straightway] to the table.
examples.chinese: 妈妈喊我吃饭的时候，我[立刻]就走到餐桌旁了。

examples.english: After finishing her homework, she went [straightway] out to play.
examples.chinese: 做完作业后，她[马上]就出去玩了。

examples.english: The little boy ran [straightway] to his dad when he saw him.
examples.chinese: 小男孩看到爸爸后，[立刻]就朝他跑了过去。

meanings.explanation: If you move or go [straightway] somewhere, you go in a direct line without turning or stopping.

examples.english: Go [straightway] along this street and you'll find the bookstore.
examples.chinese: 沿着这条街[径直]走，你就能找到那家书店。

examples.english: The arrow flew [straightway] toward the center of the target.
examples.chinese: 箭[径直]朝着靶心飞了过去。

examples.english: This gate opens [straightway] into the back garden.
examples.chinese: 这扇门[直接]通向后花园。

meanings.explanation: Something that is [straight] goes in a line from one point or position to another, without any curves or bends.

examples.english: I need a [straight] ruler to draw this line.
examples.chinese: 我需要一把[直]尺来画这条线。

examples.english: Draw a [straight] line across the paper.
examples.chinese: 在纸上画一条[直]线。

examples.english: The road is long and [straight].
examples.chinese: 这条路又长又[直]。

meanings.explanation: If you go [straight] somewhere, you go there directly, without stopping or turning anywhere else.

examples.english: Go [straight] home after school.
examples.chinese: 放学后[直接]回家。

examples.english: Walk [straight] ahead to find the park.
examples.chinese: [一直]往前走就能找到公园。

examples.english: She looked me [straight] in the eyes.
examples.chinese: 她[直直地]看着我的眼睛。

meanings.explanation: Someone or something that is [strong] has great power or force, especially in their body or physical build.

examples.english: My dad is a very [strong] man; he can carry heavy boxes easily.
examples.chinese: 我爸爸是个非常[强壮]的人，他能轻松搬动沉重的箱子。

examples.english: The [strong] wind blew my hat off.
examples.chinese: [强劲]的风把我的帽子吹掉了。

examples.english: She is not [strong] enough to lift that big box.
examples.chinese: 她的力气不够[大]，搬不动那个大箱子。

meanings.explanation: Something that is [strong] has a great effect on your senses or is intense in quality.

examples.english: I like my coffee [strong] and hot.
examples.chinese: 我喜欢喝[浓]一点的热咖啡。

examples.english: This is a [strong] medicine; take only one pill a day.
examples.chinese: 这是一种[药效强的]药，每天只能吃一颗。

examples.english: She has a [strong] personality and never gives up.
examples.chinese: 她有[坚强]的个性，从来不放弃。

meanings.explanation: A [source] is the place, person, or thing from which something comes or is obtained.

examples.english: The river is the main [source] of drinking water for our village.
examples.chinese: 这条河是我们村饮用水的主要[来源]。

examples.english: My teacher is a great [source] of help when I'm in trouble.
examples.chinese: 当我遇到麻烦时，我的老师是帮助我的重要[来源]。

examples.english: The internet is now our most used [source] of news.
examples.chinese: 互联网现在是我们最常用的新闻[来源]。

meanings.explanation: If you [source] something such as food or materials, you obtain it from a particular place.

examples.english: This small bakery [sources] all its milk from a nearby farm.
examples.chinese: 这家小面包店的所有牛奶都从附近农场[采购]。

examples.english: I [source] all my favorite drawing pencils from that little shop.
examples.chinese: 我最喜欢的绘画铅笔都是从那家小店[采购]的。

examples.english: Our school [sources] fresh fruit for lunch from local farmers.
examples.chinese: 我们学校午餐的新鲜水果都是从当地农民那里[采购]的。

meanings.explanation: To [summarize] means to give a brief statement of the main points of something, without unnecessary details.

examples.english: Can you [summarize] the story in one sentence?
examples.chinese: 你能[概括]一下这个故事吗？

examples.english: Let me [summarize] what we discussed today.
examples.chinese: 让我[总结]一下我们今天讨论的内容。

examples.english: The teacher asked us to [summarize] the article.
examples.chinese: 老师让我们[概括]这篇文章的主要内容。

meanings.explanation: If you [suffer] something bad, you experience it or it happens to you, especially something painful or unpleasant.

examples.english: The little dog was left outside and [suffered] the cold rain all night.
examples.chinese: 小狗被留在门外，一整夜都[挨着]冷雨。

examples.english: Our school team [suffered] a defeat in yesterday's game.
examples.chinese: 我们校队在昨天的比赛中[遭遇]了失败。

examples.english: She didn't go to school because she [suffered] a bad headache.
examples.chinese: 她没去上学，因为她[得了]严重的头痛。

meanings.explanation: If you [suffer] from an illness or a problem, you are badly affected by it over a period of time.

examples.english: My grandpa [suffers] from back pain and can't walk far.
examples.chinese: 我爷爷[患有]背痛，走不了远路。

examples.english: Many kids [suffer] from allergies in spring.
examples.chinese: 很多孩子在春天会[患上]过敏。

examples.english: She [suffers] from a fear of heights and never goes to high places.
examples.chinese: 她[患有]恐高症，从不去高处。

meanings.explanation: Something that is [subtle] is not very noticeable or obvious, but you can see it if you look carefully.

examples.english: There is a [subtle] difference between the two blue colors.
examples.chinese: 这两种蓝色之间有很[细微的]差别。

examples.english: She made a [subtle] change to her hairstyle.
examples.chinese: 她对发型做了一个[细微的]改动。

examples.english: I can smell the [subtle] scent of flowers in the room.
examples.chinese: 我能闻到房间里[淡淡的]花香。

meanings.explanation: If someone uses a [subtle] method to achieve something, they do it in a clever and indirect way that is not easy to notice.

examples.english: Mom gave me a [subtle] hint that it was time for bed.
examples.chinese: 妈妈[委婉地]暗示我该睡觉了。

examples.english: He dropped a [subtle] clue about my birthday gift.
examples.chinese: 他[委婉地]透露了关于我生日礼物的线索。

examples.english: The teacher used a [subtle] way to remind us to be quiet.
examples.chinese: 老师用一种[巧妙的]方式提醒我们要安静。

meanings.explanation: A [store] is a place where people can buy different kinds of goods.

examples.english: Let's go to the [store] to buy some milk.
examples.chinese: 我们去[商店]买牛奶吧。

examples.english: The toy [store] has so many fun games.
examples.chinese: 那家玩具[店]有好多好玩的游戏。

examples.english: My mom works at a big [store] near our house.
examples.chinese: 我妈妈在我们家附近的一家大[商店]上班。

meanings.explanation: If you [store] something, you put it somewhere and keep it for future use.

examples.english: Squirrels [store] nuts for the winter.
examples.chinese: 松鼠[储存]坚果过冬。

examples.english: We [store] our winter clothes in the closet.
examples.chinese: 我们把冬天的衣服[收]在柜子里。

examples.english: Please [store] the leftover food in the fridge.
examples.chinese: 请把剩饭[放]到冰箱里。

meanings.explanation: If you [submit] something such as a form, document, or plan, you present it to the relevant person or organization for consideration or approval.

examples.english: Students must [submit] their homework before the deadline.
examples.chinese: 学生们必须在截止日期前[提交]作业。

examples.english: She decided to [submit] her application online.
examples.chinese: 她决定在网上[递交]申请表。

examples.english: Our team needs to [submit] the project proposal today.
examples.chinese: 我们团队今天需要[提交]项目提案。

meanings.explanation: If you [submit] to someone or something, you stop resisting and accept their authority or decision.

examples.english: He would not [submit] to the unfair rules.
examples.chinese: 他不会[服从]这些不公平的规则。

examples.english: The rebels finally [submitted] after months of fighting.
examples.chinese: 叛军经过数月战斗后最终[投降]了。

examples.english: She had to [submit] to her parents' decision.
examples.chinese: 她不得不[顺从]父母的选择。

meanings.explanation: If something is [stuck], it is fixed in one position and cannot move.

examples.english: The door is [stuck] and won't open.
examples.chinese: 门[卡住]了，打不开。

examples.english: My shoe got [stuck] in the mud.
examples.chinese: 我的鞋子[陷]进泥里了。

examples.english: The cat was [stuck] up the tree.
examples.chinese: 那只猫[困]在树上了。

meanings.explanation: If you are [stuck], you are unable to continue with something because it is too difficult.

examples.english: I am [stuck] on this math problem.
examples.chinese: 我[卡]在这道数学题上了。

examples.english: Can you help me? I'm [stuck]!
examples.chinese: 你能帮我吗？我[想不出来]了！

examples.english: She was [stuck] for an answer.
examples.chinese: 她[想不出]答案。

meanings.explanation: If you [support] someone, you help them emotionally, financially, or practically, or you agree with their ideas and actions.

examples.english: My family always [supports] me when I have a problem.
examples.chinese: 我遇到困难时，家人总是会[支持]我。

examples.english: She works hard to [support] her two children.
examples.chinese: 她努力工作来[养活]两个孩子。

examples.english: Our school [supports] a lot of clubs for students.
examples.chinese: 我们学校为学生[支持]了许多社团。

meanings.explanation: [Support] is help, encouragement, or money that someone gives you, or the act of holding something up so it does not fall.

examples.english: Thank you for your [support] during the hard time.
examples.chinese: 感谢你在那段困难时期给予的[支持]。

examples.english: The old bridge needs more [support] to keep it safe.
examples.chinese: 这座老桥需要更多[支撑]来保持安全。

examples.english: I could not finish the project without my teacher's [support].
examples.chinese: 没有老师的[帮助]，我无法完成这个项目。

meanings.explanation: Something that is [substantial] is large in amount, size, or degree.

examples.english: We made [substantial] progress on our science project today.
examples.chinese: 今天我们的科学项目取得了[很大的]进展。

examples.english: She saved a [substantial] amount of money for her summer trip.
examples.chinese: 她为暑假旅行攒了[相当多的]钱。

examples.english: There has been a [substantial] increase in the number of students this year.
examples.chinese: 今年学生人数有了[显著的]增长。

meanings.explanation: A [substantial] object or structure is strong, solid, and well-made.

examples.english: The old wooden table is still very [substantial] and we use it every day.
examples.chinese: 这张旧木桌依然很[结实]，我们每天还在用。

examples.english: They live in a [substantial] brick house with thick walls.
examples.chinese: 他们住在一栋[结实的]砖房里，墙壁很厚。

examples.english: The rope needs to be [substantial] enough to hold the swing.
examples.chinese: 绳子要够[牢固]才能撑得住这个秋千。

meanings.explanation: If something is [staggering], it is so large, surprising, or shocking that it is hard to believe.

examples.english: The pizza was [staggering] — it was as big as the table!
examples.chinese: 那个披萨[大得惊人]——跟桌子一样大！

examples.english: My grandma has a [staggering] collection of 500 tea cups.
examples.chinese: 我奶奶收藏了[数量惊人]的五百个茶杯。

examples.english: He spent a [staggering] three hours finishing his homework.
examples.chinese: 他花了[惊人的]三个小时才写完作业。

meanings.explanation: If you are [staggering], you are walking or moving in an unsteady way, as if you might fall.

examples.english: After spinning around ten times, she was [staggering] across the room.
examples.chinese: 转了十圈之后，她[踉跄]着走过房间。

examples.english: The tired dog was [staggering] home after the long walk.
examples.chinese: 走了很远的路后，疲惫的小狗[踉跄]着走回家。

examples.english: The baby is learning to walk and is [staggering] around the living room.
examples.chinese: 宝宝正在学走路，在客厅里[踉跄]着走来走去。

meanings.explanation: The [surface] of something is the flat top part of it or the outside part that you can see.

examples.english: The [surface] of the lake was very smooth this morning.
examples.chinese: 今天早上的湖[面]非常平静。

examples.english: We sat on the [surface] of the big rock by the beach.
examples.chinese: 我们坐在海滩边那块大石头的[表面]上。

examples.english: The [surface] of the table is made of wood.
examples.chinese: 桌子的[桌面]是木头做的。

meanings.explanation: When something [surface]s, it rises to the top or becomes visible after being hidden.

examples.english: A big fish [surface]d suddenly in the pond.
examples.chinese: 一条大鱼突然在池塘里[浮]了出来。

examples.english: The boy [surface]d from under the water and smiled.
examples.chinese: 那个男孩从水下[浮]上来，笑了。

examples.english: New problems are [surface]ing in the project.
examples.chinese: 项目中[出现]了新的问题。

meanings.explanation: If you [struggle] to do something, you try very hard to do it, even though it is difficult.

examples.english: I always [struggle] to wake up early in the morning.
examples.chinese: 我每天早上都[挣扎]着早起。

examples.english: My sister [struggles] with her math homework every night.
examples.chinese: 我妹妹每天晚上都为数学作业而[挣扎]。

examples.english: The little boy [struggled] to carry the heavy box upstairs.
examples.chinese: 小男孩[挣扎]着把沉重的箱子搬上楼。

meanings.explanation: A [struggle] is a situation in which you try very hard to do or get something difficult.

examples.english: Learning a new language can be a [struggle] at first.
examples.chinese: 学一门新语言一开始可能是件[难事]。

examples.english: The mouse's [struggle] to get away was unsuccessful.
examples.chinese: 老鼠想要逃脱的[挣扎]没有成功。

examples.english: It was a [struggle] to finish all my homework before dinner.
examples.chinese: 在晚饭前写完所有作业真是一场[苦战]。

meanings.explanation: If you [supply] something that people need or want, you provide it to them.

examples.english: The farmer [supplies] our school with fresh vegetables.
examples.chinese: 这位农民给我们学校[供应]新鲜蔬菜。

examples.english: Can you [supply] more paper for the classroom printer?
examples.chinese: 你能[提供]更多打印纸给教室打印机吗？

examples.english: This factory [supplies] toys to stores all over the country.
examples.chinese: 这家工厂向全国的商店[供应]玩具。

meanings.explanation: A [supply] of something is an amount of it that is kept available for when people need it.

examples.english: We have a good [supply] of drinking water at home.
examples.chinese: 我们家里有充足的饮用水[储备]。

examples.english: We need to check our [supply] of coal before winter comes.
examples.chinese: 我们需要在入冬前检查煤炭[供应]。

examples.english: The small store quickly ran out of its [supply] of masks.
examples.chinese: 这家小店的口罩[存货]很快就卖光了。

meanings.explanation: If you [suppose] that something is true, you believe that it is probably true, based on what you know.

examples.english: I [suppose] it will rain tomorrow because the sky is so dark.
examples.chinese: 我[猜想]明天会下雨，因为天这么黑。

examples.english: She is late, so I [suppose] her bus was delayed.
examples.chinese: 她迟到了，所以我[猜想]她的公交车晚点了。

examples.english: Do you [suppose] he will come to the party?
examples.chinese: 你[觉得]他会来参加派对吗？

meanings.explanation: If you are [supposed] to do something, you are expected or required to do it according to rules, plans, or people.

examples.english: You are [supposed] to finish your homework before watching TV.
examples.chinese: 你[应该]先完成作业再看电视。

examples.english: We are [supposed] to be quiet in the library.
examples.chinese: 我们在图书馆里[应该]保持安静。

examples.english: The shop is [supposed] to open at nine o'clock.
examples.chinese: 这家商店[应该]九点钟开门。

meanings.explanation: In mathematics, [subtraction] is the process of taking one number or amount away from another.

examples.english: We practice [subtraction] with small numbers every math class.
examples.chinese: 我们每节数学课都练习小数[减法]。

examples.english: Addition and [subtraction] are basic math skills for kids.
examples.chinese: 加法和[减法]是孩子需要掌握的基础数学技能。

examples.english: Can you solve this [subtraction] problem on the blackboard?
examples.chinese: 你会解答黑板上这道[减法]题吗？

meanings.explanation: The [subtraction] of something from a whole is the act of removing or taking it away from that whole.

examples.english: This [subtraction] from my allowance made me really sad.
examples.chinese: 这次零用钱的[扣除]让我非常难过。

examples.english: The [subtraction] of unnecessary words makes the story shorter.
examples.chinese: 对多余文字的[删减]让故事更简短了。

examples.english: The [subtraction] of bad apples left only good ones in the box.
examples.chinese: 坏苹果的[去除]让盒子里只剩下好苹果了。

meanings.explanation: A [supporter] is a person who cheers for and actively supports a sports team, player, or club, often following them regularly and attending games.

examples.english: My dad is a big [supporter] of the local basketball team.
examples.chinese: 我爸爸是本地篮球队的忠实[球迷]。

examples.english: The [supporter] cheered loudly when his team scored the winning goal.
examples.chinese: 那位[球迷]在球队踢进致胜球时大声欢呼。

examples.english: Thousands of [supporter]s gathered in the stadium to watch the final.
examples.chinese: 成千上万名[球迷]聚集在体育馆观看决赛。

meanings.explanation: A [supporter] is someone who backs or advocates for a particular cause, political party, or public figure, often working to help them succeed.

examples.english: She is a strong [supporter] of animal rights.
examples.chinese: 她是动物权利的坚定[支持者]。

examples.english: The candidate thanked all his [supporter]s at the end of his speech.
examples.chinese: 候选人在演讲结束时感谢了所有的[支持者]。

examples.english: Many young [supporter]s volunteered to help with the environmental campaign.
examples.chinese: 许多年轻的[支持者]义务帮助这次环保活动。

meanings.explanation: [Supreme] describes someone or something that has the highest level of power, authority, or status.

examples.english: The [supreme] court makes the most important legal decisions in our country.
examples.chinese: 在我们国家，[最高]法院会做出最重要的法律裁决。

examples.english: The king was the [supreme] ruler of the country long ago.
examples.chinese: 很久以前，国王是这个国家[最高]统治者。

examples.english: She holds the [supreme] position in our school's student government.
examples.chinese: 她在我们学校学生会中担任[最高]职位。

meanings.explanation: [Supreme] is used to emphasize that a quality or thing is the greatest or most excellent of its kind.

examples.english: The chef made a [supreme] chocolate cake for my birthday.
examples.chinese: 这位厨师为我的生日做了一个[极佳]的巧克力蛋糕。

examples.english: She showed [supreme] bravery when she saved the little cat from the fire.
examples.chinese: 她从火中救出小猫时表现出了[极大]的勇气。

examples.english: The sunset from the hill top was a [supreme] sight.
examples.chinese: 从小山顶看到的日落是[绝妙]的景色。

meanings.explanation: A [switch] is a small device that you press or move up and down in order to turn a light, machine, or other electrical device on or off.

examples.english: Can you press the [switch] to turn on the light?
examples.chinese: 你能按一下[开关]把灯打开吗？

examples.english: The fan won't work because the [switch] is broken.
examples.chinese: 电扇不转了，因为[开关]坏了。

examples.english: Don't play with the [switch] on the wall.
examples.chinese: 别玩墙上的[开关]。

meanings.explanation: If you [switch] to something different, you change from one thing to another.

examples.english: Let's [switch] seats so I can see the board.
examples.chinese: 咱们[换]一下座位吧，这样我能看清黑板。

examples.english: I want to [switch] to a different TV channel.
examples.chinese: 我想[换]一个电视频道。

examples.english: She decided to [switch] her favorite color from pink to blue.
examples.chinese: 她决定把自己最喜欢的颜色从粉色[换成]蓝色。

meanings.explanation: A [surplus] is an amount of something that is more than what is needed or used.

examples.english: We have a [surplus] of apples after the autumn harvest.
examples.chinese: 秋天收获后，我们的苹果有[盈余]。

examples.english: The store had a [surplus] of toys after the holiday season.
examples.chinese: 节假日过后，这家商店的玩具[过剩]。

examples.english: There is a [surplus] of water in the tank.
examples.chinese: 水箱里的水[过剩]。

meanings.explanation: If something is [surplus], it is more than what is needed or used.

examples.english: The farmer sold his [surplus] vegetables at the market.
examples.chinese: 农民在市场上卖掉了[多余的]蔬菜。

examples.english: We donated [surplus] food to the animal shelter.
examples.chinese: 我们把[多余的]食物捐给了动物收容所。

examples.english: The factory produced [surplus] goods last month.
examples.chinese: 这家工厂上个月生产了[过剩的]商品。

meanings.explanation: A [subject] is a thing, topic, or area of knowledge that is being discussed, studied, or investigated.

examples.english: Math is my favorite [subject] at school.
examples.chinese: 数学是我在学校最喜欢的[科目]。

examples.english: We discussed the [subject] of healthy eating today.
examples.chinese: 我们今天讨论了健康饮食这个[话题]。

examples.english: This book's main [subject] is a boy's adventure in the forest.
examples.chinese: 这本书的主要[主题]是一个男孩在森林里的冒险。

meanings.explanation: If you [subject] someone or something to a particular experience or treatment, you make them experience it.

examples.english: You shouldn't [subject] your skin to too much strong sunlight.
examples.chinese: 你不应该让你的皮肤[遭受]太强的阳光照射。

examples.english: I don't want to [subject] you to such a long wait.
examples.chinese: 我不想让你[遭受]这么久的等待。

examples.english: The big storm [subjected] the small village to serious flooding.
examples.chinese: 大暴风雨让这个小村庄[遭受]了严重的水灾。

meanings.explanation: A [summary] is a short statement that gives only the main ideas or facts about something, without including all the details.

examples.english: I wrote a [summary] of my favorite story.
examples.chinese: 我写了一篇我最喜欢的故事的[梗概]。

examples.english: The teacher asked us to write a short [summary].
examples.chinese: 老师让我们写一个简短的[总结]。

examples.english: This is a [summary] of what we learned today.
examples.chinese: 这是今天所学内容的[概括]。

meanings.explanation: If you [suspect] something, you think it is probably true or likely to happen, but you are not certain.

examples.english: I [suspect] that it will rain tomorrow.
examples.chinese: 我[猜想]明天会下雨。

examples.english: The teacher [suspects] Tom is lying.
examples.chinese: 老师[怀疑]汤姆在撒谎。

examples.english: We [suspect] something is wrong with the machine.
examples.chinese: 我们[觉得]机器出了问题。

meanings.explanation: A [suspect] is a person who is believed to have committed a crime.

examples.english: The police caught the [suspect] yesterday.
examples.chinese: 警察昨天抓住了[嫌疑人]。

examples.english: The [suspect] ran away from the scene.
examples.chinese: [嫌疑犯]从现场逃跑了。

examples.english: The [suspect] was questioned by the police.
examples.chinese: [嫌疑人]被警察审问。

meanings.explanation: A [surgeon] is a doctor who performs medical operations on people's bodies to treat diseases or injuries.

examples.english: The [surgeon] fixed my broken leg in the hospital.
examples.chinese: [外科医生]在医院治好了我摔断的腿。

examples.english: My uncle is a [surgeon] at the city hospital.
examples.chinese: 我叔叔是市医院的一名[外科医生]。

examples.english: The [surgeon] wore a mask and gloves during the operation.
examples.chinese: [外科医生]做手术时戴着口罩和手套。

meanings.explanation: A [supporting] person or thing gives help, encouragement, or assistance to someone or something else, often in a way that is not the main focus but is still very important.

examples.english: My dad is very [supporting] and always cheers for me at my games.
examples.chinese: 我爸爸非常[支持]我，每次比赛都为我加油。

examples.english: She got a [supporting] role in the school play.
examples.chinese: 她在学校话剧中扮演一个[配角]。

examples.english: The [supporting] evidence helped the teacher find out the truth.
examples.chinese: 这些[辅助]证据帮助老师弄清了真相。

meanings.explanation: [Supporting] is the act of giving help, encouragement, or backing to someone or something.

examples.english: [Supporting] your friends when they are sad is very important.
examples.chinese: [支持]难过的朋友是非常重要的。

examples.english: Thank you for [supporting] me when I was learning to ride a bike.
examples.chinese: 谢谢你在我学骑自行车时[支持]我。

examples.english: Our team won because of everyone's [supporting].
examples.chinese: 我们队赢了是因为每个人的[支持]。

meanings.explanation: If you [survive] a dangerous or harmful event, you continue to live after it happens.

examples.english: My grandma [survived] a terrible car accident when she was young.
examples.chinese: 我奶奶年轻时在一场严重的车祸中[活了下来]。

examples.english: Only a few trees [survived] the big forest fire.
examples.chinese: 只有几棵树在那场森林大火中[存活了下来]。

examples.english: Did anyone [survive] the plane crash?
examples.chinese: 有人在这次飞机失事中[幸存]吗？

meanings.explanation: If you [survive] with very little money, food, or help, you manage to continue living in difficult conditions.

examples.english: We can [survive] on bread and water for two days.
examples.chinese: 我们靠面包和水能[存活]两天。

examples.english: How do you [survive] on such a little pocket money?
examples.chinese: 靠这么少的零花钱你怎么[活下去]呀？

examples.english: The small shop [survived] through the hard time.
examples.chinese: 这家小店[撑过]了那段艰难的时光。

meanings.explanation: If something is [tedious], it is boring, takes a long time, and makes you feel tired because it is repetitive or dull.

examples.english: Cleaning the whole house is a very [tedious] job.
examples.chinese: 打扫整栋房子是一件非常[枯燥]的差事。

examples.english: I had to write my name on every page — it was so [tedious].
examples.chinese: 我得在每一页上写名字——真是[太无聊了]。

examples.english: Sorting all these tiny beads by color is [tedious] work.
examples.chinese: 把这些小珠子按颜色分类是一件[繁琐]的活儿。

meanings.explanation: [Talent] is a natural ability to do something well, especially something artistic or practical.

examples.english: She has a [talent] for singing beautiful songs.
examples.chinese: 她有[天赋]能唱出好听的歌。

examples.english: My sister has a [talent] for drawing animals.
examples.chinese: 我妹妹有画动物的[天赋]。

examples.english: Everyone was amazed by his [talent] in playing the guitar.
examples.chinese: 大家都对他弹吉他的[天赋]感到惊讶。

meanings.explanation: A [talent] is a person who has a special natural ability to do something very well.

examples.english: That young dancer is a real [talent].
examples.chinese: 那位年轻舞者真是个[天才]。

examples.english: The music teacher saw that the boy was a [talent].
examples.chinese: 音乐老师看出这男孩是个[人才]。

examples.english: We are looking for new [talents] for our school choir.
examples.chinese: 我们正在为学校合唱团寻找新[人才]。

meanings.explanation: A [symptom] is a physical or mental feature that indicates a condition or disease. It is something that you can see or feel that tells you there is a problem with your body.

examples.english: A fever is a [symptom] of being sick.
examples.chinese: 发烧是生病的一种[症状]。

examples.english: He started showing [symptoms] of a cold.
examples.chinese: 他开始表现出感冒的[症状]。

examples.english: Headache is one of the [symptoms] of this illness.
examples.chinese: 头痛是这种病的[症状]之一。

meanings.explanation: If something is [terrible], it is very bad, unpleasant, or of very poor quality.

examples.english: The food at that restaurant was [terrible].
examples.chinese: 那家餐厅的饭菜[糟透了]。

examples.english: What a [terrible] movie! I almost fell asleep.
examples.chinese: 这电影[太烂了]！我差点睡着。

examples.english: I had a [terrible] headache yesterday.
examples.chinese: 我昨天头疼得[厉害]。

meanings.explanation: [Terrible] can also describe something that is very serious, severe, or extreme in a bad way.

examples.english: A [terrible] storm hit our town last night.
examples.chinese: 一场[可怕的]暴风雨昨晚袭击了我们的镇子。

examples.english: She was in [terrible] pain after falling off her bike.
examples.chinese: 她从自行车上摔下来后，疼得[厉害]。

examples.english: It was a [terrible] accident on the highway.
examples.chinese: 高速公路上发生了一起[严重的]事故。

meanings.explanation: If you are [tense], you feel nervous and worried and cannot relax.

examples.english: I feel [tense] right before a school test.
examples.chinese: 在学校考试前我感到[紧张]。

examples.english: The room became [tense] when the teacher was angry.
examples.chinese: 老师生气的时候，房间里变得[紧张]起来。

examples.english: My brother gets [tense] when he meets new people.
examples.chinese: 我哥哥见到陌生人时会[紧张]。

meanings.explanation: The [tense] of a verb group is the form of the verb that shows the time at which the action happened.

examples.english: We use past [tense] to talk about things that happened yesterday.
examples.chinese: 我们用过去[时态]来说昨天发生的事情。

examples.english: In English, we say 'she walks' in present [tense].
examples.chinese: 在英语中，我们说"she walks"是现在[时态]。

examples.english: Learning verb [tenses] helps us speak correctly.
examples.chinese: 学习动词[时态]能帮助我们正确说话。

meanings.explanation: When you [swallow] food, drink, or another object, you make it go down your throat from your mouth into your stomach.

examples.english: You need to chew your food well before you [swallow] it.
examples.chinese: 你要把食物嚼碎后再[咽]下去。

examples.english: My little sister can't [swallow] this big pill yet.
examples.chinese: 我妹妹还不会[吞]这片大药片。

examples.english: He was so nervous that he couldn't [swallow] anything.
examples.chinese: 他太紧张了，什么东西都[咽]不下去。

meanings.explanation: A [swallow] is a small bird with long pointed wings and a forked tail that often migrates long distances every year.

examples.english: A [swallow] built a nest under the roof of our house.
examples.chinese: 一只[燕子]在我们家屋檐下筑了巢。

examples.english: [Swallow]s fly to the south for winter every year.
examples.chinese: 每年[燕子]都会飞到南方过冬。

examples.english: The little [swallow] learned to fly last week.
examples.chinese: 这只小[燕子]上周学会了飞。

meanings.explanation: If you [take chances], you do something that involves risk, hoping to achieve something good even though you might fail.

examples.english: Don't be afraid to [take chances] when you try new things.
examples.chinese: 尝试新事物时，不要害怕[冒险]。

examples.english: She likes to [take chances] when she plays board games with her friends.
examples.chinese: 她和朋友玩桌游时喜欢[冒险]。

examples.english: If you never [take chances], you will never know what you can do.
examples.chinese: 如果你从来不[冒险]，你永远不会知道自己能做什么。

meanings.explanation: If you [take a chance] on someone or something, you decide to give them an opportunity even though there is a risk of failure.

examples.english: The coach [took a chance on] the youngest player and let him play in the big game.
examples.chinese: 教练[冒了次险]，让最年轻的球员上场打重要比赛。

examples.english: My dad [took a chance] and bought an old broken bike to fix up himself.
examples.chinese: 我爸爸[赌了一把]，买了辆破旧自行车自己修。

examples.english: The teacher [took a chance on] the shy boy and made him the class leader.
examples.chinese: 老师[冒着风险]让那个害羞的男孩当了班长。

meanings.explanation: You use [therefore] to introduce a logical result or conclusion based on what has just been said.

examples.english: It was raining outside, [therefore] we stayed at home.
examples.chinese: 外面在下雨，[因此]我们待在家里。

examples.english: She practiced the piano every day, [therefore] she played very well.
examples.chinese: 她每天练钢琴，[因此]弹得很好。

examples.english: He forgot to bring his umbrella, [therefore] he got wet.
examples.chinese: 他忘了带伞，[因此]被淋湿了。

meanings.explanation: If something is [tight], it is fixed firmly in place and does not move easily; not loose.

examples.english: The lid is so [tight] that I cannot open it.
examples.chinese: 盖子太[紧]了，我打不开。

examples.english: Make sure the rope is [tight] before you climb.
examples.chinese: 爬之前一定要把绳子系[紧]。

examples.english: The screws are [tight] and won't come loose.
examples.chinese: 螺丝很[紧]，不会松开。

meanings.explanation: [Tight] clothes fit very closely to your body, often because they are too small.

examples.english: These shoes are too [tight] and hurt my feet.
examples.chinese: 这双鞋太[紧]了，磨脚。

examples.english: She wore a [tight] dress to the party.
examples.chinese: 她穿了一条[紧身]连衣裙去参加聚会。

examples.english: I need bigger pants — these are too [tight].
examples.chinese: 我需要更大的裤子，这条太[紧]了。

meanings.explanation: If a schedule or time is [tight], there is very little time available and no extra to spare.

examples.english: We have a [tight] schedule this week.
examples.chinese: 我们这周日程排得很[紧]。

examples.english: The deadline is really [tight] — only three days left.
examples.chinese: 截止日期很[紧]，只剩三天了。

examples.english: Our budget is [tight] this month.
examples.chinese: 我们这个月的预算很[紧张]。

meanings.explanation: Something that is [thick] has a large distance between its two opposite sides.

examples.english: This [thick] book has 500 pages.
examples.chinese: 这本[厚厚的]书有500页。

examples.english: The castle has very [thick] stone walls.
examples.chinese: 那座城堡有[厚厚的]石墙。

examples.english: Please cut me a [thick] slice of bread.
examples.chinese: 请给我切一片[厚]面包。

meanings.explanation: A [thick] liquid or mass is fairly solid and does not flow easily, or contains a lot of things close together.

examples.english: We could not see because of the [thick] fog.
examples.chinese: [浓浓的]雾让我们什么也看不见。

examples.english: She has beautiful [thick] black hair.
examples.chinese: 她有[浓密的]黑发，很漂亮。

examples.english: The [thick] soup was full of vegetables.
examples.chinese: 这碗[浓稠的]汤里全是蔬菜。

meanings.explanation: If something or someone is [tiny], they are extremely small in size, amount, or degree.

examples.english: Look at that [tiny] bird!
examples.chinese: 快看那只[小小的]鸟！

examples.english: My little sister has [tiny] hands.
examples.chinese: 我妹妹有一双[小小的]手。

examples.english: We found a [tiny] shell on the beach.
examples.chinese: 我们在海滩上发现了一个[小小的]贝壳。

meanings.explanation: A [thorough] action or activity is done very carefully and covers every detail, so that nothing is missed.

examples.english: Mom gave our house a [thorough] cleaning at the weekend.
examples.chinese: 周末妈妈给我们的房子做了一次[彻底的]打扫。

examples.english: The teacher did a [thorough] check of all students' bags.
examples.chinese: 老师对所有学生的书包做了一次[全面的]检查。

examples.english: We did a [thorough] search for my lost toy car.
examples.chinese: 我们对我丢失的玩具车进行了[彻底的]搜寻。

meanings.explanation: A [thorough] person is very careful about every detail of their work, so that nothing is missed or forgotten.

examples.english: My uncle is a very [thorough] carpenter.
examples.chinese: 我叔叔是一个非常[细致的]木匠。

examples.english: You should be more [thorough] when you check your answers.
examples.chinese: 检查答案时你应该更[细致]。

examples.english: The [thorough] old doctor checked every part of my body.
examples.chinese: 这位[细致的]老医生检查了我身体的每个部位。

meanings.explanation: Something that is [tough] is very difficult to deal with or endure.

examples.english: It was a [tough] choice between pizza and noodles for dinner.
examples.chinese: 晚饭在披萨和面条之间做选择真是件[头疼的事]。

examples.english: Last year was a [tough] time for our family because we moved to a new city.
examples.chinese: 去年对我们家来说是段[艰难的时光]，因为我们搬到了一座新城市。

examples.english: The math test was so [tough] that many kids cried.
examples.chinese: 那次数学考试太[难了]，好多孩子都哭了。

meanings.explanation: A [tough] person or thing is strong and not easily hurt, damaged, or defeated.

examples.english: My grandpa is a [tough] old man who still runs every morning.
examples.chinese: 我爷爷是个[硬朗的]老人，每天早上还坚持跑步。

examples.english: This soccer ball is made of [tough] material, so kids can kick it hard.
examples.chinese: 这个足球是用[耐磨的]材料做的，小朋友们可以使劲踢。

examples.english: Don't worry, she is a [tough] girl and can handle it.
examples.chinese: 别担心，她是个[坚强的]女孩，能应付得来。

meanings.explanation: [Temperateness] is the quality of being moderate, calm, and self-restrained in one's behavior, emotions, or opinions.

examples.english: Her [temperateness] in dealing with the rude customer impressed everyone.
examples.chinese: 她在对待那位粗鲁的顾客时表现出的[克制]给所有人都留下了深刻印象。

examples.english: The leader's [temperateness] helped calm the heated argument.
examples.chinese: 那位领导人的[沉稳]有助于使激烈的争论平静下来。

examples.english: He showed great [temperateness] when he didn't get angry at the bad news.
examples.chinese: 听到坏消息时他没有生气，表现出了极大的[克制]。

meanings.explanation: [Temperateness] refers to mild, pleasant weather conditions without extreme heat or cold.

examples.english: The [temperateness] of the spring weather made it perfect for a picnic.
examples.chinese: 春天[温和]的天气非常适合野餐。

examples.english: This region is famous for its [temperateness] throughout the year.
examples.chinese: 这个地区全年都以[气候温和]著称。

examples.english: We enjoyed the [temperateness] of the autumn afternoon.
examples.chinese: 我们享受着秋天[宜人]的午后时光。

meanings.explanation: If you [terminate] something such as an activity, contract, or process, you end it.

examples.english: Our teacher had to [terminate] the picnic because of heavy rain.
examples.chinese: 因为下大雨，老师不得不[终止]这次野餐。

examples.english: The school decided to [terminate] the unpopular after-school club.
examples.chinese: 学校决定[终止]这个不受欢迎的课外俱乐部。

examples.english: This app will automatically [terminate] when your phone runs out of battery.
examples.chinese: 当你的手机没电时，这个应用会自动[终止]运行。

meanings.explanation: If a company or employer [terminates] a worker, they officially end their employment.

examples.english: My older cousin was [terminated] from his job at the local cafe.
examples.chinese: 我表哥在当地咖啡馆的工作被[解雇]了。

examples.english: The store manager [terminated] the worker for always being late.
examples.chinese: 门店经理因为这个工人总是迟到[解雇]了他。

examples.english: If you steal from the shop, they will [terminate] you immediately.
examples.chinese: 如果你在商店偷东西，他们会立刻[解雇]你。

common_collocations: suspend something from a hook / the ceiling

meanings.explanation: If you [suspend] an activity or process, you stop it for a period of time, usually to wait for something or because there is a problem.

examples.english: The teacher decided to [suspend] the game because it started to rain.
examples.chinese: 因为开始下雨了，老师决定[暂停]比赛。

examples.english: Dad [suspended] my screen time for a week because I didn't do my homework.
examples.chinese: 因为没写作业，爸爸[暂停]了我一周的屏幕时间。

examples.english: The school [suspended] all outdoor activities because of the heavy snow.
examples.chinese: 学校因大雪[暂停]了所有户外活动。

meanings.explanation: If you [suspend] something, you hang it from a high place so it is held up without support from below.

examples.english: We [suspended] a swing from the big tree in the garden.
examples.chinese: 我们在花园的大树上[悬挂]了一个秋千。

examples.english: Colorful paper lanterns were [suspended] from the ceiling at the party.
examples.chinese: 派对上，彩色纸灯笼[悬挂]在天花板上。

examples.english: A bird feeder was [suspended] from the balcony rail.
examples.chinese: 一个喂鸟器[悬挂]在阳台栏杆上。

meanings.explanation: A [theory] is a set of ideas or principles that explain something, especially one based on evidence or reasoning rather than actual proof.

examples.english: My teacher explained the [theory] of how plants grow.
examples.chinese: 老师给我们讲解了植物生长的[原理]。

examples.english: In [theory], if you mix yellow and blue paint, you get green.
examples.chinese: [理论上]，黄色和蓝色颜料混合会变成绿色。

examples.english: He has a [theory] about why his cat likes sunny places.
examples.chinese: 他对猫为什么喜欢晒太阳的地方有了一个[猜测]。

meanings.explanation: A [target] is a goal or result that you try hard to achieve.

examples.english: We set a [target] to read 20 books this summer.
examples.chinese: 我们定下了这个夏天读20本书的[目标]。

examples.english: Our class reached the [target] of collecting 100 toys for poor kids.
examples.chinese: 我们班实现了为贫困孩子收集100个玩具的[目标]。

examples.english: Dad's [target] is to run 5 kilometers every week.
examples.chinese: 爸爸的[目标]是每周跑五公里。

meanings.explanation: If you [target] a person or thing, you aim your efforts, actions, or attacks at them.

examples.english: This new picture book [targets] kids aged 4 to 6.
examples.chinese: 这本新绘本[针对]4到6岁的孩子。

examples.english: The hunter [targeted] a small deer by the river.
examples.chinese: 猎人[瞄准]了河边的一只小鹿。

examples.english: Our teacher [targets] our weakest math skills.
examples.chinese: 老师[针对]我们最弱的数学技巧进行练习。

meanings.explanation: A [tragedy] is a very sad event or situation, especially one in which people suffer or die.

examples.english: The big fire that burned down the school was a terrible [tragedy].
examples.chinese: 烧毁学校的那场大火是一场可怕的[悲剧]。

examples.english: Everyone cried when they heard about the fishing boat [tragedy].
examples.chinese: 听到渔船[遇难]的消息，大家都哭了。

examples.english: Losing his dog in the flood was a [tragedy] for the little boy.
examples.chinese: 小狗在洪水中走失，对这个小男孩来说是个[悲剧]。

meanings.explanation: A [tragedy] is a play, film, or book that has a sad ending, especially one in which the main character dies.

examples.english: Romeo and Juliet is a famous [tragedy] written by Shakespeare.
examples.chinese: 《罗密欧与朱丽叶》是莎士比亚写的一部著名[悲剧]。

examples.english: The movie ended as a [tragedy] when the hero died.
examples.chinese: 电影以[悲剧]结尾，男主角最后死了。

examples.english: My sister prefers love stories, but I enjoy watching a good [tragedy].
examples.chinese: 我姐姐喜欢看爱情故事，但我喜欢看好的[悲剧]。

meanings.explanation: A [trap] is a device or trick that is designed to catch animals or people, often by surprising them or holding them so they cannot escape.

examples.english: The farmer set a [trap] to catch the mouse in the kitchen.
examples.chinese: 农民在厨房里放了一个[捕鼠器]来抓老鼠。

examples.english: Don't touch that box — it might be a [trap]!
examples.chinese: 别碰那个盒子——那可能是个[陷阱]！

examples.english: The rabbit was caught in a [trap] in the garden.
examples.chinese: 兔子被花园里的[捕兽夹]夹住了。

meanings.explanation: If you [trap] someone or something, you catch them or prevent them from escaping, often by using a trick or a device.

examples.english: The door closed and [trapped] the cat inside the room.
examples.chinese: 门关上了，把猫[困]在了房间里。

examples.english: Be careful not to [trap] your fingers in the door.
examples.chinese: 小心别让手指被门[夹]住。

examples.english: The hunter [trapped] a fox near the river.
examples.chinese: 猎人在河边[捕获]了一只狐狸。

meanings.explanation: If something happens [typically], it happens in the way that is usual or most common for a particular situation.

examples.english: I [typically] go to bed at nine o'clock.
examples.chinese: 我[通常]九点上床睡觉。

examples.english: We [typically] eat dinner together as a family.
examples.chinese: 我们一家人[通常]一起吃晚饭。

examples.english: It [typically] rains a lot in summer here.
examples.chinese: 这里夏天[通常]雨水很多。

meanings.explanation: You use [typically] to say that something is a good or clear example of a particular type of person or thing.

examples.english: The movie is a [typically] funny cartoon for kids.
examples.chinese: 这部动画片是一部[典型的]适合儿童观看的搞笑电影。

examples.english: It was a [typically] hot day in July.
examples.chinese: 那是一个七月里[典型的]热天。

examples.english: She gave a [typically] smart answer in class.
examples.chinese: 她在课堂上给出了一个[一如既往]聪明的回答。

meanings.explanation: Something that is [tremendous] is extremely large in size, amount, or degree.

examples.english: We saw a [tremendous] whale at the aquarium.
examples.chinese: 我们在水族馆看到一条[巨大的]鲸鱼。

examples.english: The concert was a [tremendous] success with thousands of fans.
examples.chinese: 这场音乐会取得了[巨大的]成功，吸引了成千上万的粉丝。

examples.english: It takes a [tremendous] amount of work to build a house.
examples.chinese: 建造一座房子需要[大量的]工作。

meanings.explanation: You can describe something as [tremendous] when you think it is excellent or wonderful.

examples.english: We had a [tremendous] time at the birthday party.
examples.chinese: 我们在生日派对上度过了[非常愉快的]时光。

examples.english: The teacher did a [tremendous] job helping us learn.
examples.chinese: 老师做得[非常出色]，帮助我们学习。

examples.english: That was a [tremendous] game we played yesterday!
examples.chinese: 昨天我们玩的那场比赛[太精彩了]！

meanings.explanation: If you [tolerate] something unpleasant or difficult, you accept it and do not get angry or upset about it, even though you do not like it.

examples.english: I cannot [tolerate] the loud noise from the construction site.
examples.chinese: 我无法[忍受]工地传来的巨大噪音。

examples.english: She [tolerates] her brother's messy room because she loves him.
examples.chinese: 她[容忍]弟弟乱糟糟的房间，因为她爱他。

examples.english: My mom won't [tolerate] rude behavior at the dinner table.
examples.chinese: 我妈妈不会[容忍]餐桌上的粗鲁行为。

meanings.explanation: If a person, animal, or plant [tolerates] a particular condition or treatment, they are able to survive or function well in it without being harmed.

examples.english: Some plants can [tolerate] cold weather better than others.
examples.chinese: 有些植物比其他植物更能[耐受]寒冷天气。

examples.english: The medicine is safe for people who cannot [tolerate] dairy products.
examples.chinese: 这种药对不能[耐受]乳制品的人来说是安全的。

examples.english: This dog breed can [tolerate] hot temperatures.
examples.chinese: 这个品种的狗能[耐受]高温。

meanings.explanation: Your [tongue] is the soft movable part inside your mouth that you use for tasting, eating, and speaking.

examples.english: I stuck my [tongue] out at the doctor.
examples.chinese: 我对着医生伸出了[舌头]。

examples.english: This cold popsicle makes my [tongue] numb.
examples.chinese: 这个冰棒太冰了，把我的[舌头]冻麻了。

examples.english: A cat's [tongue] feels rough when it licks you.
examples.chinese: 猫舔你的时候，它的[舌头]摸起来很粗糙。

meanings.explanation: A [tongue] is a language, especially the first language you learn when you are a child.

examples.english: My grandma's native [tongue] is German.
examples.chinese: 我奶奶的本族[语]是德语。

examples.english: We should be proud of our mother [tongue].
examples.chinese: 我们应该为自己的母[语]感到骄傲。

examples.english: This song is sung in the singer's own [tongue].
examples.chinese: 这首歌是用歌手自己的[语言]演唱的。

meanings.explanation: [Trade] is the activity of buying and selling goods and services between people, companies, or countries.

examples.english: My father works in international [trade].
examples.chinese: 我父亲从事国际[贸易]工作。

examples.english: The [trade] between the two countries has increased a lot.
examples.chinese: 两国之间的[贸易]增加了很多。

examples.english: She works in the clothing [trade].
examples.chinese: 她在服装[行业]工作。

meanings.explanation: To [trade] means to buy and sell goods, or to exchange something you have for something someone else has.

examples.english: They [trade] stocks online every day.
examples.chinese: 他们每天在网上[交易]股票。

examples.english: I'll [trade] my apple for your banana.
examples.chinese: 我想用我的苹果[交换]你的香蕉。

examples.english: This shop [trades] in fresh fruits and vegetables.
examples.chinese: 这家店[经营]新鲜水果和蔬菜。

meanings.explanation: Someone who is [unapproachable] seems unfriendly and difficult to talk to.

examples.english: The new teacher looks [unapproachable] when she is serious.
examples.chinese: 这位新老师严肃的时候看起来很[难以接近]。

examples.english: Don't be afraid; he is not as [unapproachable] as he seems.
examples.chinese: 别害怕，他并没有看起来那么[不好接近]。

examples.english: She seemed [unapproachable] at first, but she is actually very kind.
examples.chinese: 她一开始看起来很[高冷]，但其实人很好。

meanings.explanation: A place that is [unapproachable] is difficult or impossible to get to.

examples.english: The castle on the mountain top is [unapproachable] in winter.
examples.chinese: 冬天的时候，山顶上的那座城堡[无法到达]。

examples.english: The island is [unapproachable] by boat because of the big rocks.
examples.chinese: 因为有很多大石头，这座岛坐船[无法靠近]。

examples.english: This forest is [unapproachable] without a good map.
examples.chinese: 没有一张好地图，这片森林是[进不去的]。

common_collocations: have a tendency to do something

meanings.explanation: A [tendency] is a natural way that a person or thing often behaves or reacts in a particular situation.

examples.english: My dog has a [tendency] to bark at strangers.
examples.chinese: 我家狗有冲陌生人叫的[习惯]。

examples.english: She has a [tendency] to bite her nails when she is nervous.
examples.chinese: 她一紧张就有咬指甲的[倾向]。

examples.english: Tom has a [tendency] to leave his toys all over the room.
examples.chinese: Tom有把玩具扔得满屋都是的[习惯]。

meanings.explanation: A [tendency] is a general direction in which a situation is changing or developing over time.

examples.english: There is a [tendency] for temperatures to rise in summer.
examples.chinese: 夏天有气温升高的[趋势]。

examples.english: There is a growing [tendency] for people to shop online.
examples.chinese: 人们网购的[趋势]越来越明显。

examples.english: There is a [tendency] for fashion to change every year.
examples.chinese: 时尚每年都有变化的[趋势]。

meanings.explanation: A [survivor] is a person who continues to live after a dangerous event, accident, or illness.

examples.english: She is a [survivor] of the big earthquake.
examples.chinese: 她是那场大地震的[幸存者]。

examples.english: Many [survivors] were taken to the hospital after the flood.
examples.chinese: 洪水过后，许多[幸存者]被送到了医院。

examples.english: My grandpa is a cancer [survivor] and he still runs every day.
examples.chinese: 我爷爷是一位癌症[幸存者]，他现在每天都跑步。

meanings.explanation: A [survivor] is the last person in a group who is still alive, after all the others have died.

examples.english: She is the last [survivor] of her family.
examples.chinese: 她是家族里最后一位[幸存者]。

examples.english: He is the only [survivor] of the old team.
examples.chinese: 他是老队伍里唯一的[幸存者]。

examples.english: My great-grandma is a [survivor] who lived through two wars.
examples.chinese: 我的曾祖母是一位[幸存者]，她经历过两次战争。

meanings.explanation: A [treatment] is something that doctors do to help a sick or injured person get better.

examples.english: My mom took me to the hospital for [treatment] when I had a fever.
examples.chinese: 我发烧的时候，妈妈带我去医院接受[治疗]。

examples.english: The [treatment] helped my leg heal very quickly.
examples.chinese: 这个[治疗]让我的腿很快就好了。

examples.english: The doctor said I need a special [treatment] for my sore throat.
examples.chinese: 医生说我的嗓子疼需要一种特别的[治疗]。

meanings.explanation: Your [treatment] of someone is the way you behave toward them or deal with them.

examples.english: Everyone deserves kind [treatment] from others.
examples.chinese: 每个人都值得别人友善[对待]。

examples.english: The children got special [treatment] on their birthday.
examples.chinese: 孩子们在生日那天得到了特殊[待遇]。

examples.english: Our teacher gives equal [treatment] to every student.
examples.chinese: 我们老师对每个学生都给予平等的[对待]。

meanings.explanation: A [transport] is a system or method for carrying people or goods from one place to another.

examples.english: I take public [transport] to school every day.
examples.chinese: 我每天乘坐公共[交通工具]上学。

examples.english: This [transport] is faster than riding a bike.
examples.chinese: 这种[交通工具]比骑自行车更快。

examples.english: We need better public [transport] in our town.
examples.chinese: 我们镇上需要更好的公共[交通]。

meanings.explanation: If you [transport] people or goods from one place to another, you carry them there.

examples.english: Trucks [transport] vegetables to the supermarket every day.
examples.chinese: 卡车每天把蔬菜[运输]到超市。

examples.english: Boats [transport] people across the river.
examples.chinese: 船[运送]人们过河。

examples.english: Trains [transport] more people than cars.
examples.chinese: 火车比汽车能[运送]更多人。

meanings.explanation: You use [ultimately] to say that something happens or is true after a long process or series of events, often suggesting that it is the final result or conclusion.

examples.english: After many tries, [ultimately] we found the right answer.
examples.chinese: 经过多次尝试，[最终]我们找到了正确答案。

examples.english: The plan [ultimately] didn't work out.
examples.chinese: 这个计划[最终]没有成功。

examples.english: She [ultimately] became a famous writer.
examples.chinese: 她[最终]成为了一名著名作家。

meanings.explanation: An [unconsidered] action, remark, or opinion is one that is made or given without careful thought.

examples.english: His [unconsidered] words hurt his best friend's feelings.
examples.chinese: 他[未经深思]的话伤害了好朋友的感情。

examples.english: She made an [unconsidered] decision and later regretted it.
examples.chinese: 她做了一个[欠考虑]的决定，后来很后悔。

examples.english: Don't give an [unconsidered] answer in the exam.
examples.chinese: 考试时不要给出[未经仔细考虑]的答案。

meanings.explanation: Something that is [unconsidered] has not been thought about or taken into account at all.

examples.english: The cost of the trip was left [unconsidered] until the last minute.
examples.chinese: 旅行的费用一直[未被考虑]，直到最后一刻才被提起。

examples.english: Many small details were [unconsidered] in the plan.
examples.chinese: 计划中许多小细节都[没有考虑到]。

examples.english: Her feelings were [unconsidered] when the teacher changed the seats.
examples.chinese: 老师换座位时[没有顾及]她的感受。

meanings.explanation: An [unavoidable] event, situation, or thing is one that cannot be avoided, prevented, or escaped; it is certain to happen.

examples.english: The heavy rain was [unavoidable], so we couldn't go out to play.
examples.chinese: 那场大雨是[不可避免的]，所以我们没法出去玩。

examples.english: Making mistakes is [unavoidable] when you learn something new.
examples.chinese: 学新东西的时候，犯错是[不可避免的]。

examples.english: There was an [unavoidable] delay because the bus broke down on the way.
examples.chinese: 因为公交车在路上坏了，所以出现了[不可避免的]延误。

meanings.explanation: You use [traditionally] to describe something that is done according to the customs or beliefs that have been followed by a group of people for a long time.

examples.english: Chinese people [traditionally] eat dumplings during the Spring Festival.
examples.chinese: 中国人[按传统]春节都要吃饺子。

examples.english: This kind of bread is [traditionally] baked in a stone oven.
examples.chinese: 这种面包[传统上]是用石炉烤出来的。

examples.english: In many countries, the bride [traditionally] wears a white dress at the wedding.
examples.chinese: 在很多国家，新娘[按传统]在婚礼上穿白色裙子。

meanings.explanation: You use [traditionally] to describe the usual or typical way something is done, especially when it has been done that way for a long period.

examples.english: Our family [traditionally] goes to the beach every summer.
examples.chinese: 我们家[照例]每年夏天都去海边。

examples.english: The class meeting is [traditionally] held on Friday afternoon.
examples.chinese: 班会[照例]在周五下午开。

examples.english: She [traditionally] takes a walk after dinner every day.
examples.chinese: 她[一向]每天晚饭后都散步。

common_collocations: uncommon for someone to do something

meanings.explanation: If something is [uncommon], it does not happen often or is not often seen.

examples.english: It is [uncommon] to see snow in this city during winter.
examples.chinese: 这座城市冬天下雪[不常见]。

examples.english: Finding a four-leaf clover is very [uncommon].
examples.chinese: 找到四叶草非常[罕见]。

examples.english: Heavy rain is [uncommon] here in summer.
examples.chinese: 这里夏天下大雨[很少见]。

meanings.explanation: If you describe someone or something as [uncommon], you mean they are special or remarkable in some way.

examples.english: She has an [uncommon] talent for singing.
examples.chinese: 她有[非凡的]歌唱天赋。

examples.english: The teacher noticed the boy's [uncommon] kindness to others.
examples.chinese: 老师注意到这个男孩对别人[不同寻常的]友善。

examples.english: His [uncommon] bravery saved the little dog.
examples.chinese: 他[非凡的]勇气救了那只小狗。

meanings.explanation: If you [treat] someone in a particular way, you behave toward them in that way.

examples.english: My mom always [treats] me kindly when I am sad.
examples.chinese: 我难过的时候，妈妈总是温柔地[对待]我。

examples.english: The teacher [treats] all students fairly.
examples.chinese: 老师公平地[对待]每一位学生。

examples.english: We should [treat] our pets with love and care.
examples.chinese: 我们应该用爱心和关心来[对待]我们的宠物。

meanings.explanation: If you [treat] someone to something nice, you buy it or arrange it for them as a surprise.

examples.english: Dad [treats] us to ice cream every Sunday.
examples.chinese: 爸爸每个星期天都[请]我们吃冰淇淋。

examples.english: I will [treat] you to a big birthday cake!
examples.chinese: 我会[请]你吃一个大生日蛋糕！

examples.english: Let me [treat] you to lunch today.
examples.chinese: 今天让我[请]你吃午饭。

meanings.explanation: A [treat] is something special that you enjoy, especially something sweet or nice to eat.

examples.english: Getting a cookie after school was our favorite [treat].
examples.chinese: 放学后得到一块小饼干是我们最爱的[小零食]。

examples.english: A movie and popcorn is a special [treat] for the weekend.
examples.chinese: 看电影和爆米花是周末的特别[享受]。

examples.english: Grandma always has a little [treat] ready for us.
examples.chinese: 奶奶总是为我们准备好吃的小[好吃的]。

meanings.explanation: A [trust] is a strong belief that someone or something is reliable, honest, and will not harm or deceive you.

examples.english: Building [trust] between friends takes time.
examples.chinese: 朋友之间建立[信任]需要时间。

examples.english: I have full [trust] in my dad's promises.
examples.chinese: 我对爸爸的承诺充满[信任]。

examples.english: Mutual [trust] makes our team work better.
examples.chinese: 相互[信任]让我们团队合作得更好。

meanings.explanation: If you [trust] someone, you believe that they are honest, reliable, and will not harm or deceive you.

examples.english: I [trust] my best friend to keep my secrets.
examples.chinese: 我[信任]我的好朋友会保守我的秘密。

examples.english: You can [trust] me to finish the job on time.
examples.chinese: 你可以[信任]我会按时完成工作。

examples.english: She doesn't [trust] strangers easily.
examples.chinese: 她不会轻易[信任]陌生人。

meanings.explanation: If you [uncover] something hidden, you remove the cover from it, or you discover something that was secret or unknown.

examples.english: She lifted the cloth to [uncover] the birthday cake.
examples.chinese: 她掀起布，[揭开]了生日蛋糕。

examples.english: The detective worked hard to [uncover] the truth about the missing dog.
examples.chinese: 侦探努力[查明]了那只失踪小狗的真相。

examples.english: Archaeologists [uncover] ancient treasures buried underground.
examples.chinese: 考古学家们[发掘]埋在地下古老的宝藏。

meanings.explanation: If you [undergo] something, you experience it, especially something difficult, unpleasant, or that takes a lot of time and effort.

examples.english: The old building will [undergo] a big repair next month.
examples.chinese: 那栋旧楼下个月将[经历]一次大修。

examples.english: She [underwent] a lot of hard training before the competition.
examples.chinese: 她在比赛前[经历了]大量艰苦的训练。

examples.english: Our city is [undergoing] great changes these years.
examples.chinese: 这些年来，我们的城市正在[经历]巨大的变化。

meanings.explanation: If a patient [undergoes] a medical treatment or operation, they have it done to them by a doctor.

examples.english: My grandpa will [undergo] a small surgery tomorrow.
examples.chinese: 我爷爷明天要[接受]一个小手术。

examples.english: She had to [undergo] a medical check before starting school.
examples.chinese: 她开学前必须[接受]一次体检。

examples.english: The boy [underwent] three operations on his leg last year.
examples.chinese: 这个男孩去年[接受了]三次腿部手术。

meanings.explanation: A person who is [uncoordinated] moves in a clumsy way and has difficulty controlling their body movements.

examples.english: My little brother is still [uncoordinated] and trips over his own feet.
examples.chinese: 我弟弟还是[笨手笨脚]的，经常被自己的脚绊倒。

examples.english: She felt [uncoordinated] during her first dance class.
examples.chinese: 她在第一节舞蹈课上感到[动作不协调]。

examples.english: The baby is [uncoordinated] but loves to grab things.
examples.chinese: 宝宝虽然[动作不协调]，但很喜欢抓东西。

meanings.explanation: Something that is [uncoordinated] is not well organized or planned, so different parts do not work together properly.

examples.english: The [uncoordinated] team effort caused a lot of confusion.
examples.chinese: [配合不协调的]团队努力造成了很多混乱。

examples.english: Their [uncoordinated] response to the emergency was criticised.
examples.chinese: 他们对紧急事件的[不协调的]应对受到了批评。

examples.english: The plan was [uncoordinated] and missed the deadline.
examples.chinese: 计划[缺乏协调]，还错过了截止日期。

meanings.explanation: An [unamiable] person is not friendly or pleasant, so other people do not enjoy being with them.

examples.english: The [unamiable] man next door never smiles at anyone.
examples.chinese: 隔壁那个[不友善]的男人从不对任何人笑。

examples.english: My dog is [unamiable] and barks at everyone it sees.
examples.chinese: 我的狗[不友善]，见到谁都叫。

examples.english: She spoke in an [unamiable] tone, so nobody wanted to talk to her.
examples.chinese: 她说话语气[不友善]，所以没人想跟她说话。

meanings.explanation: If something is [unavailable], it cannot be obtained, used, or accessed by people.

examples.english: The blue T-shirt you like is [unavailable] in your size right now.
examples.chinese: 你喜欢的那件蓝色T恤，你的尺码现在[没货]。

examples.english: This app is [unavailable] on older phones.
examples.chinese: 这个应用程序在旧手机上[用不了]。

examples.english: The tickets for the cartoon show are [unavailable] online.
examples.chinese: 这场卡通秀的票网上已经[买不到]了。

meanings.explanation: If a person is [unavailable], they are not able to meet, talk, or join in something at a particular time.

examples.english: My mom is [unavailable] right now—she's in a work meeting.
examples.chinese: 我妈妈现在[没空]，她正在开工作会议。

examples.english: The doctor is [unavailable] this afternoon, can you come tomorrow?
examples.chinese: 医生今天下午[没空]，你能明天来吗？

examples.english: I was [unavailable] for your birthday party because I was sick.
examples.chinese: 我[没空]参加你的生日派对，因为我生病了。

meanings.explanation: If something is [unchangeable], it cannot be changed or made different.

examples.english: Some things in nature are [unchangeable], like the sun rising every morning.
examples.chinese: 自然界有些东西是[不变的]，比如太阳每天早上都会升起。

examples.english: The basic rules of this game are [unchangeable]; you cannot change them.
examples.chinese: 这个游戏的基本规则是[改不了的]，你不能去改变它们。

examples.english: My father's promise is [unchangeable]; he always keeps his word.
examples.chinese: 爸爸的承诺是[不会变的]，他总是说到做到。

meanings.explanation: If something is [unimaginable], it is so extreme, great, or strange that you cannot imagine or picture it in your mind.

examples.english: The amount of homework he had was [unimaginable].
examples.chinese: 他作业多得[难以想象]。

examples.english: Living without the internet today seems [unimaginable] to most kids.
examples.chinese: 如今没有网络的日子对大多数孩子来说[难以想象]。

examples.english: The earthquake caused [unimaginable] damage to the town.
examples.chinese: 地震给这座小镇造成了[难以想象的]破坏。

meanings.explanation: A [unicorn] is an imaginary animal that looks like a white horse with a long, straight horn growing from its forehead.

examples.english: My little sister loves drawing [unicorns] with rainbow manes.
examples.chinese: 我妹妹喜欢画长着彩虹鬃毛的[独角兽]。

examples.english: The storybook tells a tale of a brave [unicorn] saving the forest.
examples.chinese: 这本故事书讲述了一只勇敢的[独角兽]拯救森林的故事。

examples.english: She wore a pink dress with pictures of [unicorns] on it.
examples.chinese: 她穿了一条上面印有[独角兽]图案的粉色裙子。

meanings.explanation: If you [uncouple] two things that are joined together, you disconnect or separate them so that they are no longer attached.

examples.english: The train driver had to [uncouple] the red carriage from the rest of the train.
examples.chinese: 火车司机不得不把红色车厢和火车其他部分[脱开]。

examples.english: Can you help me [uncouple] the garden hose from the tap?
examples.chinese: 你能帮我把花园水管从水龙头上[拧下来]吗？

examples.english: Dad showed me how to [uncouple] the trailer from the car.
examples.chinese: 爸爸教我如何把拖车从汽车上[卸下来]。

meanings.explanation: If two people or groups [uncouple], they end their relationship, partnership, or association and go their separate ways.

examples.english: After years of working together, the two singers decided to [uncouple] and start solo careers.
examples.chinese: 合作多年后，这两位歌手决定[分开]各自单飞。

examples.english: The twins sometimes [uncouple] during games to play with different friends.
examples.chinese: 双胞胎有时候在游戏中会[分开]跟不同的朋友玩。

examples.english: The two companies chose to [uncouple] their partnership last year.
examples.chinese: 这两家公司去年选择[解除]了合作关系。

meanings.explanation: If someone is [unbending], they are not willing to change their opinions, behavior, or plans, even when other people ask them to.

examples.english: My dad is very [unbending] about his morning routine.
examples.chinese: 我爸爸对早上的例行安排很[固执]。

examples.english: She stayed [unbending] and wouldn't try any new food.
examples.chinese: 她很[固执]，不肯尝试任何新食物。

examples.english: The [unbending] old man never listens to other's ideas.
examples.chinese: 那个[固执]的老人从不听别人的意见。

meanings.explanation: If something is [uncommonly] good, large, or has another quality, it has more of that quality than is usual, often in a way that is noticeable or surprising.

examples.english: This apple is [uncommonly] sweet.
examples.chinese: 这个苹果[格外]甜。

examples.english: This summer has been [uncommonly] rainy.
examples.chinese: 今年夏天[异常]多雨。

examples.english: My little brother is [uncommonly] good at drawing.
examples.chinese: 我弟弟画画[格外]厉害。

meanings.explanation: If something happens [uncommonly], it does not happen very often.

examples.english: It [uncommonly] snows in my hometown in winter.
examples.chinese: 我家乡冬天[很少]下雪。

examples.english: My dad [uncommonly] cooks dinner at home.
examples.chinese: 我爸爸[难得]在家做晚饭。

examples.english: I [uncommonly] stay up after nine o'clock.
examples.chinese: 我[很少]九点后还不睡觉。

meanings.explanation: If you [undertake] a task or job, you start it and take responsibility for it.

examples.english: Our class will [undertake] a science project next week.
examples.chinese: 我们班下周将[承担]一个科学项目。

examples.english: She decided to [undertake] the challenge of learning piano.
examples.chinese: 她决定[接受]学习钢琴的挑战。

examples.english: The team [undertook] the mission to clean the park.
examples.chinese: 这个团队[承担]了打扫公园的任务。

meanings.explanation: If you [undertake] to do something, you promise or agree to do it.

examples.english: He [undertook] to finish the homework before dinner.
examples.chinese: 他[承诺]晚饭前完成作业。

examples.english: The company [undertook] to fix the problem within 24 hours.
examples.chinese: 公司[保证]在24小时内解决这个问题。

examples.english: I can [undertake] that the plan will work well.
examples.chinese: 我可以[保证]这个计划会顺利进行。

meanings.explanation: A [unitary] state or system of government is one in which a central government has complete power over the whole country, rather than power being shared with individual regions or states.

examples.english: France has a [unitary] government, meaning Paris makes all the big decisions.
examples.chinese: 法国是一个[中央集权]的国家，也就是说巴黎负责做出所有重大决定。

examples.english: In a [unitary] system, local governments must follow rules from the national capital.
examples.chinese: 在[中央集权]体制下，地方政府必须遵守首都制定的规定。

examples.english: Japan is an example of a [unitary] state.
examples.chinese: 日本就是一个[中央集权]国家的例子。

meanings.explanation: Something that is [unitary] is a single, complete whole, rather than being made up of different parts.

examples.english: She thinks of her family as one [unitary] group that always helps each other.
examples.chinese: 她把家人看作一个[统一的]整体，大家总是互相帮助。

examples.english: The teacher treated the whole class as a [unitary] team.
examples.chinese: 老师把全班同学当作一个[统一的]团队来对待。

examples.english: The project has a [unitary] design, so every part fits perfectly together.
examples.chinese: 这个项目有一个[统一的]设计，每个部分都完美地衔接在一起。

meanings.explanation: Something that is [unimportant] is not significant or valuable; it does not matter much.

examples.english: The small scratch on my book is [unimportant].
examples.chinese: 书上那道小划痕[无关紧要]。

examples.english: It is [unimportant] whether we go today or tomorrow.
examples.chinese: 我们今天去还是明天去[不重要]。

examples.english: She said something [unimportant] and walked away.
examples.chinese: 她说了一句[无关紧要的话]就走了。

meanings.explanation: [Uncultivated] land or soil has not been prepared or used for growing crops or plants.

examples.english: There is a lot of [uncultivated] land behind our house.
examples.chinese: 我们家后面有很多[未开垦的]土地。

examples.english: This [uncultivated] soil is not good enough for growing rice.
examples.chinese: 这块[未耕作的]土壤不适合种水稻。

examples.english: We often play games on that [uncultivated] field.
examples.chinese: 我们经常在那片[未开垦的]田地上玩游戏。

meanings.explanation: If you describe a person or their behavior as [uncultivated], you mean they lack education, good manners, or refined taste.

examples.english: His [uncultivated] words made everyone at the party feel uncomfortable.
examples.chinese: 他[粗俗的]话语让聚会上的每个人都感到不舒服。

examples.english: She was annoyed by his [uncultivated] manners at the dinner table.
examples.chinese: 她对他在餐桌上[没教养的]举止感到很生气。

examples.english: An [uncultivated] person often doesn't know how to be polite in public.
examples.chinese: 一个[没修养的]人往往不知道在公共场合如何保持礼貌。

meanings.explanation: If something is [universally] true or accepted, it is true or accepted by everyone.

examples.english: This idea is [universally] accepted as true.
examples.chinese: 这个观点被[普遍]认为是正确的。

examples.english: The rule applies [universally] to all players.
examples.chinese: 这条规则[对所有运动员普遍]适用。

examples.english: It is [universally] known that smoking is bad for health.
examples.chinese: [人人皆知]吸烟有害健康。

meanings.explanation: [Unnecessaries] are things that are not needed or not essential. They are the items or extras that you can easily do without.

examples.english: Before the trip, she cleaned out her school bag and took out all the [unnecessaries].
examples.chinese: 出发前，她把书包清理了一下，把所有[不必要的东西]都拿了出来。

examples.english: When you go camping, you should leave the [unnecessaries] at home.
examples.chinese: 去露营的时候，应该把那些[用不上的东西]留在家里。

examples.english: My dad says we should not spend money on [unnecessaries].
examples.chinese: 爸爸说我们不该把钱花在[不必要的东西]上。

meanings.explanation: If something is [unnecessary], it is not needed.

examples.english: Don't make [unnecessary] noise. The baby is sleeping.
examples.chinese: 别发出[不必要的]噪音。宝宝在睡觉。

examples.english: We should avoid all [unnecessary] spending.
examples.chinese: 我们应该避免一切[不必要的]开支。

examples.english: It's [unnecessary] to bring so many clothes for a one-day trip.
examples.chinese: 一天的旅行带这么多衣服[没必要]。

meanings.explanation: If something is [unique], it is the only one of its kind, or there is nothing else like it.

examples.english: Each snowflake has a [unique] shape.
examples.chinese: 每一片雪花都有[独特]的形状。

examples.english: This is a [unique] toy that you cannot find in any store.
examples.chinese: 这是一个[独一无二]的玩具，你在任何商店都找不到。

examples.english: My grandma has a [unique] way of making cookies.
examples.chinese: 我奶奶做饼干有[独特]的方法。

meanings.explanation: If something is [unique] to a particular person, place, or thing, it belongs or relates only to that person, place, or thing.

examples.english: This plant is [unique] to this small island.
examples.chinese: 这种植物是这个小岛[特有]的。

examples.english: Every person has a [unique] fingerprint.
examples.chinese: 每个人都有[独一无二]的指纹。

examples.english: The panda's black-and-white fur is [unique] to this animal.
examples.chinese: 熊猫的黑白皮毛是这种动物[特有]的。
